en.description: AI agent generating structured clinical notes from conversations, reducing documentation time and improving accuracy and completen
en.long_description:
The AI Medical Scribe Agent is an intelligent documentation assistant that captures and transforms clinical conversations into structured, accurate, and compliant medical notes in real time.
Clinicians spend a significant portion of their time on documentation, often leading to burnout, incomplete records, and reduced patient interaction. This agent addresses these challenges by automatically generating clinical notes from voice or text inputs, aligned with standardized formats such as SOAP.
Integrated directly into clinical workflows, the agent structures information into history, examination findings, assessments, and plans, while preserving clinical context and relevance. It supports customization based on specialty-specific templates and organizational requirements.
The agent also enhances documentation quality by ensuring completeness and consistency, which supports downstream processes such as coding, billing, and clinical decision-making.
By reducing manual data entry and streamlining documentation workflows, the AI Medical Scribe Agent improves clinician efficiency, increases time available for patient care, and supports high-quality, compliant medical records.

en.description:
Our Unique Challenge: Every User and Every Model is Unique

We believe in "Optimal Decisions in Minutes." This is not just a catchy tagline; it is the core of our philosophy.

And now, it’s also how we structure our pricing. Whether you’re generating a Candidate Assessment Report for a small team of 100 or a large crew of 500, or if you’re scheduling 200 shifts versus 2,000, the processing times differ. Given the diversity in requirements, a one-size-fits-all approach simply won’t work.

Flexible Pricing for Every Need

Instead of trying to guess your needs, we’ve introduced a flexible, transparent pricing model based on consumption. With our model, $5 is equivalent to 1 minute of processing. This ensures that you only pay for the actual computational effort required for your task, making our powerful AI models accessible for any size problem.

name: ibmanalyticsengine

de.description: Übergeben Sie Ihre Apache Spark-Anwendungen nach Bedarf und passen Sie die Spark-Laufzeiten an die Anforderungen Ihrer Anwendung an.
de.long_description: Einer IBM Analytics Engine-Instanz werden Rechen- und Speicherressourcen bei Bedarf zugeordnet, wenn Spark-Anwendungen gestartet werden. Wenn sich eine Anwendung nicht im aktiven Status befindet, werden der Instanz keine Rechenressourcen zugeordnet. Die Preisstruktur basiert auf der Menge der Ressourcen, die von den in der Instanz ausgeführten Anwendungen verbraucht werden. Die Abrechnung erfolgt pro Sekunde.

en.description: Submit your Apache Spark applications as needed and customize the Spark runtimes to satisfy the requirements of your application.
en.long_description: An IBM Analytics Engine instance is allocated compute and memory resources on demand when Spark applications are started. When an application is not in running state, no computing resources are allocated to the instance. Pricing is based on the amount of resources consumed by the applications running in the instance, billed on a per second basis.

es.description: Envíe las aplicaciones de Apache Spark según sea necesario y personalice los tiempos de ejecución de Spark para satisfacer los requisitos de la aplicación.
es.long_description: A una instancia de IBM Analytics Engine se le asignan recursos de cálculo y de memoria bajo demanda cuando se inician las aplicaciones de Spark. Cuando una aplicación no está en estado de ejecución, no se asignan recursos de cálculo a la instancia. Los precios dependen de la cantidad de recursos consumidos por las aplicaciones que se ejecutan en la instancia y se factura por segundo.

fr.description: Soumettez vos applications Apache Spark selon vos besoins et personnalisez les environnements d'exécution de Spark pour répondre aux exigences de votre application.
fr.long_description: Une instance IBM Analytics Engine est allouée aux ressources de calcul et de mémoire à la demande lorsque des applications Spark sont démarrées. Lorsqu'une application n'est pas en cours d'exécution, aucune ressource informatique n'est allouée à l'instance. La tarification est basée sur la quantité de ressources consommée par les applications exécutées dans l'instance, facturée à la seconde.

it.description: Inoltra le applicazioni Apache Spark in base alle esigenze e personalizza i runtime Spark per soddisfare i requisiti dell'applicazione.
it.long_description: Quando vengono avviate le applicazioni Spark, un'istanza IBM Analytics Engine viene assegnata alle risorse di calcolo e memoria su richiesta. Quando lo stato di un'applicazione non è in esecuzione, le risorse di calcolo non vengono assegnate all'istanza. Il prezzo si basa sulla quantità di risorse utilizzate dalle applicazioni in esecuzione sull'istanza, con fatturazione al secondo.

ja.description: 必要に応じて Apache Spark アプリケーションをサブミットし、アプリケーションの要件を満たすように Spark ランタイムをカスタマイズします。
ja.long_description: Spark アプリケーションの開始時に、IBM Analytics Engine インスタンスにオンデマンドでコンピュート・リソースとメモリー・リソースが割り振られます。 アプリケーションが実行状態でない場合、インスタンスにコンピューティング・リソースは割り振られません。 価格設定は、インスタンスで実行されているアプリケーションで消費されるリソースの量に基づいており、1 秒単位で請求されます。

ko.description: 필요에 따라 Apache Spark 애플리케이션을 제출하고 애플리케이션의 요구사항을 충족하도록 Spark 런타임을 사용자 정의합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Analytics Engine 인스턴스에는 Spark 애플리케이션이 시작될 때 요청 시 컴퓨팅 및 메모리 리소스가 할당됩니다. 애플리케이션이 실행 중 상태가 아닌 경우 컴퓨팅 자원이 인스턴스에 할당되지 않습니다. 가격 책정은 인스턴스에서 실행되는 애플리케이션이 소비하는 리소스의 양을 기준으로 하며 초당 청구됩니다.

pt-br.description: Envie suas aplicações Apache Spark conforme necessário e customize os tempos de execução do Spark para satisfazer os requisitos de sua aplicação.
pt-br.long_description: Recursos de computação e de memória são alocados on demand para uma instância do IBM Analytics Engine quando as aplicações Spark são iniciadas. Quando um aplicativo não está em estado de execução, nenhum recurso de computação é alocado para a instância. A precificação é baseada na quantia de recursos consumidos pelas aplicações em execução na instância, faturados em uma segunda base.

zh-cn.description: 根据需求提交 Apache Spark 应用程序，并定制 Spark 运行时以满足应用程序的需求。
zh-cn.long_description: 启动 Spark 应用程序时，将按需为 IBM Analytics Engine 实例分配计算和内存资源。 当应用程序未处于运行状态时，不会为实例分配任何计算资源。 定价基于实例中运行的应用程序所耗用的资源量，按秒计费。

zh-tw.description: 視需要提交 Apache Spark 應用程式，並自訂 Spark 執行時期以滿足應用程式的需求。
zh-tw.long_description: 當 Spark 應用程式啟動時，IBM Analytics Engine 實例會隨需應變配置運算及記憶體資源。 當應用程式不在執行中狀態時，不會將任何運算資源配置給實例。 定價是根據實例中執行的應用程式所耗用的資源數量，以每秒計費。

bullets.title: Spark-Cluster werden bei Bedarf erstellt, wenn Workloads übergeben werden
Spark clusters are created on-demand when workloads are submitted
Los clústeres de Spark se crean bajo demanda cuando se envían las cargas de trabajo
Les clusters Spark sont créés à la demande lorsque les charges de travail sont soumises
I cluster Spark vengono creati su richiesta quando si inoltrano i workload

Spark 클러스터는 워크로드를 제출할 때 요청 시 작성됨
Os clusters do Spark são criados sob demanda quando as cargas de trabalho são enviadas.
Spark 集群是提交工作负载时按需创建的

en.long_description:
Overview
The AnonTech team is revolutionizing personal information management and re-defining the data privacy space with ViziVault.

Our personal information management platform, ViziVault, allows you to isolate, manage, analyze, and protect your customer's personal information. Our powerful, easy-to-use, API makes integration a breeze and handles all data encryption & decryption. The ViziVault Enterprise management console allows the right people to monitor and administer personal information usage, keeping your organization safe, secure, and in compliance with data privacy regulations.

Engineers use the technology as a data source-of-truth & achieve full data security, administrators have complete role-based access control over who has access to what data, data privacy officers get visibility into risk levels within an organization, and management gets peace-of-mind knowing they are safe from data breaches and in full compliance with government & corporate data privacy regulations.

The AnonTech team has leveraged their 15+ years of legal and compliance experience to develop a new data privacy technology, called ViziVault, which bridges the gap between security and compliance. With ViziVault, data privacy is built into products by design instead of being an afterthought.

Getting Support
Please submit issues directly to our support form on our website: https://www.anontech.io/support 24/7/365. Please include as much detail as possible on the issue. Daytime support is available during standard business hours (M-F 9-5 US EST). Off-hour support is limited and responses may be delayed. Prior to submitting an issue, please take a moment to review our documentation here: docs.anontech.io. To submit additional information, include attachments/screenshots, or escalate an urgent issue, please e-mail us at support@anontech.io. A member of our team will respond immediately upon receipt.

name: anycloud-365-backup

en.description: Microsoft 365 backup service protecting Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams with secure cloud-to-cloud backup and restore.
en.long_description:
OVERVIEW

Anycloud Backup for 365 is a partner-ready SaaS backup service designed to protect organizational data stored in Microsoft 365. The solution provides cloud-to-cloud backup and recovery for Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams. The service creates an independent copy of Microsoft 365 data by transferring backup data directly to IBM Cloud. By storing backups outside the Microsoft 365 environment, organizations maintain an additional recovery option in cases such as accidental deletion, configuration errors, ransomware incidents, or data retention changes.
Anycloud Backup for 365 is designed to be delivered by IT partners, managed service providers, and distributors as a scalable data protection service for organizations using Microsoft 365.
Backup storage is hosted in IBM Cloud data centers located across multiple global regions, allowing customers to select the storage location during deployment.





MANAGEMENT AND OPERATIONS
The service is managed through a web-based management portal that provides centralized control of backup and restore operations. Partners and administrators can configure backup jobs, manage tenants, monitor operations, and control restore activities through a unified interface. 
• Centralized management of Microsoft 365 backup jobs
• Automated backup scheduling
• Self-service restore functionality for email and OneDrive data
• Administrator-driven restore for files, folders, mailboxes, and SharePoint sites
• Multi-tenant management designed for service providers

Backup operations run automatically according to the configured schedule and generate activity logs for operational visibility.

KEY CAPABILITIES
Anycloud Backup for 365 provides capabilities designed to support structured Microsoft 365 data protection.
• Cloud-to-cloud architecture separating backup data from the Microsoft 365 tenant
• Independent backup storage hosted in IBM Cloud infrastucture, with the possibility of choosing a climate-friendly site
• Role-based access control for administrative access management
• Multi-tenant platform supporting partner and MSP operations
• Protection mechanisms preventing deletion of backup data during a defined safeguard period

These capabilities enable partners to deliver Microsoft 365 backup services to their customers through a centralized platform.

SECURITY AND DATA PROTECTION
Backup data is encrypted using AES-256 encryption both during transmission and while stored. Customers select the storage region during the onboarding process, and backup data remains stored in the selected location. The platform includes operational features that support governance and operational transparency, including activity logging for backup and restore operations and capabilities for removing user data from retention when required by applicable regulations.
IBM Cloud data centers used by the service maintain recognized industry certifications, including ISO 27001 and SOC reporting.

TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS
• SaaS-based cloud-to-cloud Microsoft 365 backup service
• Protection for Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams
• AES-256 encryption for data in transit and at rest
• Retention configuration from 1 year to 25 years
• Item-level and full restore capabilities
• Hosted across IBM Cloud data centers globally

EXTENDED PROTECTION FOR MICROSOFT ENVIRONMENTA
Anycloud Backup for 365 protects collaboration and productivity data such as email, files, and team contect. Anycloud Backup for Entra ID protects identity configuration elements including users, groups, roles, and access policies. When deployed together, the service provide backup coverage across both the data layer and identity layer of Microsoft environments.

en.description: Backup bundle for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID protecting data and identity with cloud-to-cloud backup and recovery.
en.display_name: Anycloud Backup for 365 and Entra ID
en.long_description:
OVERVIEW: 
Anycloud Backup for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID is a partner-ready SaaS bundle designed to protect both organizational data and identity configurations within Microsoft cloud environments. The solution combines cloud-to-cloud backup for Microsoft 365 workloads with identity configuration backup for Microsoft Entra ID. Together, the services enable backup and recovery of collaboration data and identity objects across a unified platform. Microsoft 365 data such as emails, files, sites, and team content is backed up from Exchange Online, OneDrive for Business, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams. Identity configurations within Microsoft Entra ID - including users, groups, roles, applications, and policies - can also be backup and restored. 
By maintaining independent backups of both data and identity configurations, organizations and partners gain additional recovery options in scenarios such as accidental deletion, configuration errors, security incidents, or administrative changes. The bundle is designed to be delivered by IT partners, managed service providers, and distributors as a scalable protection service for organizations usinf Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID. Backup data is stored in IBM Cloud data centers located across multiple global regions, allowing customers to select the storage location during deployment. 

MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS
The platform is managed through a web-based portal that provides centralized administration of backup, monitoring, and recovery operations. Partners and administrators can manage Microsoft 365 and Entra ID protection through a unified interface designed for multi-tenant environments.
Operational capabilities include: 
• Backup and recovery for Microsoft 365 workloads
• Backup of Microsoft Entra ID identity configurations
• Centralized monitoring of backup activities
• Identity security score insights
• Restore workflows for both data and identity objects
• Multi-tenant management for partners and service providers
Backup and monitoring operations run automatically and generate activity logs for operational transparency.

KEY CAPABILITIES
The bundle provides combined protection for collaboration data and identity infrastructure within Microsoft environments. Capabilities include:
• Cloud-to-cloud backup for Microsoft 365 data
• Visibility into identity security posture through security insights
• Item-level restore for Microsoft 365 workloads
• Multi-tenant management platform for partner environments
These capabilities allow partners to deliver a combined data and identity protection service to their customers.

SECURITY & DATA RPOTECTION:
Backup data is encrypted using AES-256 encryption both during transit and while stored. Customers select the storage region during deployment, and backup data remains stored in the chosen location. The platform records backup and recovery operations through activity logs that provide operational visibility. The service is delivered using IBM Cloud infrastructure designed to support global deployments. 

TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS:
• SaaS-based backup for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID
• Cloud-to-cloud backup architecture
• Protection for Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and Entra ID configurations
• Identity security score insight visibility
• AES-256 encryption for data in transit and at rest
• Automaed backup scheduling and monitoring

Identity configurations within Microsoft Entra ID - including users, groups, roles, applications, and policies - can also be backup and restored. 
By maintaining independent backups of both data and identity configurations, organizations and partners gain additional recovery options in scenarios such as accidental deletion, configuration errors, security incidents, or administrative changes. The bundle is designed to be delivered by IT partners, managed service providers, and distributors as a scalable protection service for organizations usinf Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID. Backup data is stored in IBM Cloud data centers located across multiple global regions, allowing customers to select the storage location during deployment. 

MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS
The platform is managed through a web-based portal that provides centralized administration of backup, monitoring, and recovery operations. Partners and administrators can manage Microsoft 365 and Entra ID protection through a unified interface designed for multi-tenant environments.
Operational capabilities include: 
• Backup and recovery for Microsoft 365 workloads
• Backup of Microsoft Entra ID identity configurations
• Centralized monitoring of backup activities
• Identity security score insights
• Restore workflows for both data and identity objects
• Multi-tenant management for partners and service providers
Backup and monitoring operations run automatically and generate activity logs for operational transparency.

KEY CAPABILITIES
The bundle provides combined protection for collaboration data and identity infrastructure within Microsoft environments. Capabilities include:
• Cloud-to-cloud backup for Microsoft 365 data
• Visibility into identity security posture through security insights
• Item-level restore for Microsoft 365 workloads
• Multi-tenant management platform for partner environments
These capabilities allow partners to deliver a combined data and identity protection service to their customers.

SECURITY & DATA RPOTECTION:
Backup data is encrypted using AES-256 encryption both during transit and while stored. Customers select the storage region during deployment, and backup data remains stored in the chosen location. The platform records backup and recovery operations through activity logs that provide operational visibility. The service is delivered using IBM Cloud infrastructure designed to support global deployments. 

TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS:
• SaaS-based backup for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID
• Cloud-to-cloud backup architecture
• Protection for Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and Entra ID configurations
• Identity security score insight visibility
• AES-256 encryption for data in transit and at rest
• Automaed backup scheduling and monitoring

Anycloud backup for Entra ID is a partner-ready SaaS backup service designed to protect identity configurations within Microsoft Entra ID. The solution enables backup and recovery of users, groups, roles, applications, and identity policies. 
Identity systems play a central role in access management and security operations. Changes to identity configurations, whether caused by administrative errors, misconfigurations, or security incidents, can disrupt access to business systems and cloud services. Anycloud Backup for Entra ID create independent backups of identity configurations and eables organizations to restore critical identity objects when needed. This helps IT teams recover from unintended changes and maintain operational continuity. The service also provides visibility into identity security by presenting insights related to Microsoft Entra ID security score metrics. The solution is designed to be delivered by IT partners and managed service providers as part of a managed identity protection service for organizations using Microsoft Entra ID.

MANAGEMENT AND OPERATIONS
The service is managed through a web-based portal that provides centralized administration of backup and recovery operations. Administrators and partners can monitor identity configuration changes, review security insights, and perform recovery operations through a unified interface. Operational capabilities include: 
• Backup of Entra ID indetity objects and configuration elements
• Monitoring of identity security score insights
• Administrative visibility into identity configuration changes
• Multi-tenant management for partners and managed service providers
Backup and monitoring operations run automatically and generate activity logs that provide operational transparency. 

KEY CAPABILITIES
Anycloud Backup for Entra ID provides capabilities designed to support identity resilience and recovery.
• Backup and recovery of Microsoft Entra ID identity configurations
• Protection of users, groups, roles, applications, and access policies
• Identity security score insights providing visibility into identity posture
• Centralized identity recovery workflows
• Role-based access control for administrative operations
• Multi-tenant management for partner and MSP environments
These capabilities allow partners to provide identity protection services for organizations relying on Microsoft Entra ID. 

SECURITY AND DATA PROTECTION
The platform stores backup data using encryption for both data in transit and data at rest. Activity logs record backup and recovery operations, providing operational visibility and traceability of identity configuration changes. The service is delivered using cloud infrastructure designed to support global deployments. 

TECHNICAL CHARACTERISTICS
• Backup of Microsoft Entra ID users, groups, roles, applications, and policies
• Security score insight visibility
• Automated monitoring and backup operations 
• Multi-tenant platform designed for partner environments

EXTENTED PROTECTION FOR MICROSOFT ENVIRONMENTS
Anycloud Backup for 365 and Anycloud Backup for Entra ID address different layers of the Microsoft cloud environment. Anycloud Backup for 365 protects collaboration and productivity data such as email, files, and team content across Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams. Anycloud Backup for Entra ID protects the identity configuration layer including users, groups, roles, applications, and identity policies. 
When deployed together, the services provide backup coverage across both the data layer and identity layer, enabling organizations and partners to manage recovery for Microsoft environments through a unified protection approach.

IBM API Connect ist eine umfassende Ent-to-End-Lösung zur API-Verwaltung, die für die Erstellung, den Schutz, die Verwaltung, die gemeinsame Nutzung, den gewinnbringenden Einsatz und das Analysieren von angepassten APIs in der Cloud oder an lokalen Standorten verwendet werden kann. 



Der Reserved Instance-Plan bietet eine dedizierte Hochverfügbarkeitsbereitstellung von API Connect Version 10 mit mehreren Zonen, die zentrale IBM Cloud-Services für allgemeine Tasks wie Identitätsverwaltung, Überwachung, Audits und Protokollierung nutzt. Er umfasst die Verwaltungs-, Gateway-, Analyse- und Portalserverkomponenten von API Connect sowie Tools für die Registrierung und Verwaltung vorhandener Gateways an lokalen Standorten und in Clouds anderer Anbieter. 



Im Rahmen des Lite-Plans (kostenfrei) und des Enterprise-Plans (nutzungsabhängig) wird eine öffentliche Cloud-Bereitstellung von API Connect Version 5 mit mehreren Tenants verwendet.

en.description: An enterprise-grade platform for creating, securing, managing, sharing, monetizing, and analyzing custom APIs located on-premises and on the cloud.
en.long_description:
IBM API Connect is a comprehensive, end-to-end API management solution for creating, securing, managing, sharing, monetizing, and analyzing APIs located on cloud and on-premises.



The Reserved Instance plan provides a dedicated, multi-zone high availability deployment of API Connect v10 that leverages core IBM Cloud services for common tasks like identity management, monitoring, auditing, and logging. It includes the management, gateway, analytics, and portal server components of API Connect, as well as tools for registering and managing existing gateways located on-premises and on third-party clouds.

es.description: Una plataforma de nivel empresarial de IBM para crear, proteger, gestionar, compartir, monetizar y analizar las API personalizadas que se encuentran en el entorno local y en la nube.
es.long_description:
IBM API Connect es una solución de API exhaustiva de principio a fin para crear, proteger, gestionar, compartir, monetizar y analizar las API que se encuentran en el entorno local y en la nube. 



El plan Instancia reservada proporciona un despliegue dedicado, multizona y de alta disponibilidad de API Connect v10 que utiliza los servicios básicos de IBM Cloud para tareas comunes como la gestión de identidades, la supervisión, la auditoría y el registro. Incluye los componentes de gestión, pasarela, analítica y servidor de portal de API Connect, así como herramientas para registrar y gestionar las pasarelas existentes que se encuentran en los entornos local y de nube de terceros. 



Los planes Lite (gratuito) y Enterprise (pago por uso) utilizan un despliegue multiarrendatario de nube pública de API Connect v5.

fr.description: Une plateforme d'entreprise conçue pour créer, sécuriser, gérer, partager, monétiser et analyser des API personnalisées sur site et sur le cloud.
fr.long_description:
IBM API Connect est une solution complète de gestion des API de bout en bout conçue pour créer, sécuriser, gérer, partager, monétiser et analyser les API situées sur le cloud et sur site.



Le plan Reserved Instance offre un déploiement dédié, multi-zone et à haute disponibilité de l'API Connect v10 qui exploite les services IBM Cloud de base pour les tâches courantes comme la gestion des identités, la surveillance, l'audit et la journalisation. Il comprend les composants serveur de gestion, de passerelle, d'analyse et de portail d'API Connect, ainsi que des outils pour l'enregistrement et la gestion des passerelles existantes situées sur les sites et sur des clouds tiers.



Les plans Lite (gratuit) et Enterprise (à la carte) utilisent un déploiement de l'API Connect v5 dans un cloud public multi-locataires.

it.description: Una piattaforma a livello aziendale per la creazione, la protezione, la gestione, la condivisione, la monetizzazione e l'analisi di API personalizzate che si trovano on-premise e sul cloud.
it.long_description:
IBM API Connect è una soluzione completa di gestione API end-to-end per la creazione, la protezione, la gestione, la condivisione, la monetizzazione e l'analisi di API che si trovano sul cloud e on-premise. 



Il piano Istanza riservata fornisce una distribuzione dedicata, multi-zona ad alta disponibilità di API Connect v10 che utilizza servizi IBM Cloud principali per attività comuni come la gestione delle identità, il monitoraggio, il controllo e la registrazione. Include i componenti di gestione, gateway, di analisi e del server del portale di API Connect, oltre agli strumenti per la registrazione e la gestione di gateway esistenti che si trovano on-premise e su cloud di terze parti. 



I piani Lite (gratuito) ed Enterprise (pay-as-you-go) utilizzano una distribuzione cloud pubblica multi-tenant di API Connect v5.

ja.description: オンプレミスとクラウドでカスタム API の作成、保護、管理、共有、有料化、分析を行うためのエンタープライズ・グレードのプラットフォームです。
ja.long_description:
IBM API Connect は、オンプレミスとクラウドでカスタム API の作成、保護、管理、共有、有料化、分析を行うための包括的なエンドツーエンドの API 管理ソリューションです。



予約済みインスタンス・プランでは、ID 管理、監視、監査、ロギングなどの共通のタスクに対してコア IBM Cloud サービスを利用する API Connect v10 の専用マルチゾーン高可用性デプロイメントが用意されています。API Connect の管理、ゲートウェイ、分析、ポータル・サーバーのコンポーネントや、オンプレミスおよびサード・パーティーのクラウド上にある既存のゲートウェイを登録および管理するためのツールが含まれています。



ライト (無料) プランとエンタープライズ (従量課金) プランでは、マルチテナントの API Connect v5 のパブリック・クラウド・デプロイメントを使用します。

ko.description: 온프레미스 및 클라우드에 위치한 사용자 정의 API를 작성, 보안 설정, 관리, 공유, 수익 창출 및 분석하기 위한 엔터프라이즈급 플랫폼입니다.
ko.long_description:
IBM API Connect는 클라우드 및 온프레미스에 위치한 API를 작성, 보안 설정, 관리, 공유, 수익 창출 및 분석하기 위한 포괄적인 엔드-투-엔드 API 관리 솔루션입니다. 



예약된 인스턴스 플랜은 ID 관리, 모니터링, 감사 및 로깅과 같은 공통 태스크에 대해 핵심 IBM Cloud 서비스를 활용하는 API Connect v10의 다중 구역 고가용성 전용 배치를 제공합니다. 여기에는 API Connect의 관리, 게이트웨이, 분석 및 포털 서버 컴포넌트뿐만 아니라 온프레미스 및 서드파티 클라우드에 위치한 기존의 게이트웨이를 등록 및 관리하기 위한 도구가 포함됩니다. 



Lite(무료) 및 Enterprise(종량과금제) 플랜은 API Connect v5의 멀티 테넌트 퍼블릭 클라우드 배치를 활용합니다.

pt-BR.description: Uma plataforma de classificação corporativa para criar, assegurar, gerenciar, compartilhar, monetizar e analisar APIs customizadas localizadas na nuvem e no local.
pt-BR.long_description:
O IBM API Connect é uma solução de gerenciamento de API abrangente e de ponta a ponta para criar, assegurar, gerenciar, compartilhar, monetizar e analisar APIs localizadas na nuvem ou no local.



O plano de instância reservada fornece uma implementação dedicada multizona e com alta disponibilidade do API Connect v10 que alavanca os principais serviços IBM Cloud para tarefas comuns como gerenciamento de identidade, monitoramento, auditoria e criação de log. Ele inclui os componentes de gerenciamento, de gateway, de análise de dados e de servidor de portal do API Connect, bem como as ferramentas para registrar e gerenciar gateways existentes localizados no local ou em nuvens de terceiros.



Os planos Lite (grátis) e Enterprise (pré-pago) utilizam uma implementação de nuvem pública com diversos locatários do API Connect v5.

zh-Hans.description: 企业级平台，用于在本地和云上创建、保护、管理、共享、货币化和分析定制 API。
zh-Hans.long_description:
IBM API Connect 是一个综合的端到端 API 管理解决方案，用于在本地和云上创建、保护、管理、共享、货币化和分析 API。



预留实例套餐提供了 API Connect V10 的专用多区域高可用性部署，可将 IBM Cloud 核心服务用于一些常见任务，例如，身份管理、监视、审计和日志记录。其包含 API Connect 的管理、网关、分析和门户网站服务器组件，以及用于注册和管理位于本地和第三方云上的现有网关的工具。



Lite（免费）和 Enterprise（按使用付费）套餐将使用 API Connect V5 的多租户公共云部署。

zh-Hant.description: 一個企業級平台，用於建立、保護、管理、共用、貨幣化和分析位於本地和雲端的自定義 API。
zh-Hant.long_description:
IBM API Connect 是一個全面的端到端 API 管理解決方案，用於建立、保護、管理、共用、貨幣化和分析位於雲端和本地的 API。



預留實例方案提供了 API Connect v10 的專用、多區域高可用性部署，此部署利用核心 IBM Cloud 服務完成身份管理、監視、審核和日誌記錄等常見作業。它包括 API Connect 的管理、閘道、分析和入口網站伺服器元件，以及用於註冊和管理位於本地和協力廠商雲端的現有閘道的工具。



小型（免費）和企業（隨收隨付）計劃利用 API Connect v5 的多租戶公用雲端部署。

description: An enterprise-grade platform for creating, securing, managing, sharing, monetizing, and analyzing custom APIs located on-premises and on the cloud.
longDescription:
IBM API Connect is a comprehensive, end-to-end API management solution for creating, securing, managing, sharing, monetizing, and analyzing APIs located on cloud and on-premises.



The Reserved Instance plan provides a dedicated, multi-zone high availability deployment of API Connect v10 that leverages core IBM Cloud services for common tasks like identity management, monitoring, auditing, and logging. It includes the management, gateway, analytics, and portal server components of API Connect, as well as tools for registering and managing existing gateways located on-premises and on third-party clouds.

bullets.description: Zentrale Konfiguration mehrerer verteilter Ressourcen. Mithilfe von Sammlungen können Sie Flags nach Apps oder Ressourcen organisieren.  DevOps-Entwickler können ohne großen Aufwand Konfigurationen für komplexe Anwendungen und Umgebungen über ein zentrales Dashboard verwalten.
bullets.title: Zentrale Konfiguration

bullets.description: Einbeziehen noch nicht einsatzbereiter Features in Bereitstellungen und Aktivieren dieser Features, sobald sie bereit sind. Entwickler können mithilfe von Dark Launches die Komplexität von Quellcodeverzweigungen und aufwendige Zusammenführungen reduzieren, indem sie nicht getestete oder nicht fertiggestellte Features einbeziehen und durch ein Feature-Flag im Masterzweig inaktivieren.  Tester können die Funktionsfähigkeit neuer Features in Produktionsumgebungen überprüfen, indem sie mithilfe der Feature-Flags Test in der entsprechenden Umgebung durchführen.
bullets.title: Dark Launch

bullets.description: Aktivieren von Features für verschiedene Segmente zu unterschiedlichen Zeitpunkten oder segmentabhängiges Variieren von Features.  App-Eigner können Anwendungen für Benutzer optimieren und DevOps-Entwickler können Umgebungskonfiugrationen differenziert steuern.
bullets.title: Segmentierte Features

bullets.description: Rollout von Features und Konfigurationen, ohne dass neue Codebereitstellungen erforderlich sind.  App-Eigner können Features effizient steuern, ohne dass zeitaufwendige Ausführungen von Pipelines erforderlich sind.
bullets.title: Entkopplung der Feature-Rollouts von den Bereitstellungen

bullets.description: Sofortiges Rollback problematischer Features durch das Aktivieren/Inaktivieren von Feature-Flags im Cloud-Dashboard von App Configuration.
bullets.title: Sofortiges Rollback

bullets.description: Configure multiple, distributed resources from a central location. Use Collections to organize your flags by app or resource.  DevOps engineers can easily manage configurations for complex application and environment from one dashboard.
bullets.title: Centralized configuration

bullets.description: Include features that are not ready for launch into your deployments, and activate them when they are ready. Developers can use dark launch to reduce source code branch complexity and troublesome merges by including untested or unfinished features behind a feature flag in their master branch.  Testers can be confident new features will work in production by using feature flags to actually test there.
bullets.title: Dark launch

bullets.description: Activate features for different segments at different times, or vary features by segment.  App owners can fine-tune applications to users, and DevOps engineers can have granular control over environment configurations.
bullets.title: Segmented features

bullets.description: Roll out features and configurations without requiring new code deployments.  App owners can efficiently control features without time-consuming pipeline runs.
bullets.title: Feature rollout decoupled from deployments

bullets.description: Instantly roll back problematic features by toggling feature flags in the App Configuration cloud dashboard.
bullets.title: Instant rollback

bullets.description: Configure varios recursos distribuidos desde una ubicación central. Utilice colecciones para organizar los distintivos por app o recurso.  Los ingenieros de DevOps pueden gestionar fácilmente complejas configuraciones de aplicaciones y entornos desde un panel de instrumentos.
bullets.title: Configuración centralizada

bullets.description: Incluya en los despliegues funciones que no estén preparadas para su lanzamiento y actívelas cuando estén preparadas. Los desarrolladores pueden utilizar los lanzamientos oscuros para reducir la complejidad de la ramificación del código fuente y las fusiones problemáticas, incluyendo funciones no probadas o inacabadas detrás de un distintivo de función en su rama maestra.  Los testers pueden tener la tranquilidad de que las nuevas características funcionen en producción mediante el uso de distintivos de función para que se prueben realmente ahí.
bullets.title: Lanzamiento oscuro

bullets.description: Active funciones para diferentes segmentos en diferentes momentos, o cámbielas por segmento.  Los propietarios de las aplicaciones pueden hacerles un ajuste fino de las aplicaciones a los usuarios, y los ingenieros de DevOps pueden tener un control granular de las configuraciones de entorno.
bullets.title: Funcionalidad segmentada

bullets.description: Implante funciones y configuraciones sin necesidad de nuevos despliegues de código.  Los propietarios de aplicaciones pueden controlar de forma eficiente la funcionalidad sin necesidad de largas ejecuciones secuenciales.
bullets.title: Implantación de funciones desacoplada de los despliegues

bullets.description: Retrotraiga las funciones problemáticas de forma instantánea alternando los distintivos de función en el panel de control de nube de App Configuration.
bullets.title: Retrotracción instantánea

bullets.description: Configurez plusieurs ressources réparties à partir d'un emplacement central. Utilisez les collections pour organiser vos indicateurs par application ou par ressource.  Les ingénieurs de DevOps peuvent facilement gérer des configurations pour des applications et des environnements complexes à partir d'un tableau de bord.
bullets.title: Configuration centralisée

bullets.description: Incluez les fonctions qui ne sont pas prêtes à être lancées dans vos déploiements et activez-les lorsqu'elles sont prêtes. Les développeurs peuvent utiliser le lancement noir pour réduire la complexité des branches du code source et les fusions gênantes en incluant des fonctions non testées ou non terminées derrière un indicateur de fonction dans leur branche principale.  Les testeurs peuvent être sûrs que de nouvelles fonctionnalités vont fonctionner dans la production en utilisant des options de fonction pour tester là-bas.
bullets.title: Lancement noir

bullets.description: Activez des fonctions pour différents segments à des moments différents ou modifiez les fonctions par segment.  Les propriétaires d'application peuvent affiner les applications pour les utilisateurs, et les ingénieurs DevOps peuvent disposer d'un contrôle granulaire sur les configurations d'environnement.
bullets.title: Fonctions segmentées

bullets.description: Déploylez les fonctions et les configurations sans nécessiter de nouveaux déploiements de code.  Les propriétaires d'application peuvent contrôler efficacement les fonctions sans prendre en compte les exécutions de pipeline.
bullets.title: Le déploiement du dispositif est découplé des déploiements

bullets.description: Rétrogradé instantanément des fonctions problématiques en activant des indicateurs de fonction dans le tableau de bord du nuage de configuration d'application.
bullets.title: Rappel automatique

media.caption: Que sont les indicateurs de fonction ?

bullets.description: Configura più risorse distribuite da un'ubicazione centrale. Utilizza Raccolte per organizzare i tuoi indicatori per app o risorsa.  Gli ingegneri DevOps possono facilmente gestire configurazioni per un'applicazione o un ambiente complessi da un unico dashboard.
bullets.title: Configurazione centralizzata

bullets.description: Includi funzioni non pronte per il lancio nelle tue implementazioni e attivale quando sono pronte. Gli sviluppatori possono utilizzare il lancio al buio per ridurre la complessità della diramazione del codice sorgente e le integrazioni problematiche includendo funzioni non ultimate o non sottoposte a test in un indicatore di funzione nella relativa diramazione master.  I tester possono essere certi che le nuove funzioni funzioneranno in produzione, utilizzando gli indicatori di funzione per eseguire effettivamente il test in quella fase.
bullets.title: Lancio al buio

bullets.description: Attiva funzioni per diversi segmenti in momenti diversi, oppure varia le funzioni per segmento.  I proprietari di app possono ottimizzare le applicazioni in modo che gli utenti e gli ingegneri DevOps possano esercitare un controllo granulare sulle configurazioni dell'ambiente.
bullets.title: Funzioni segmentate

bullets.description: Implementa funzioni e configurazioni senza necessità di nuove distribuzioni di codice.  I proprietari di app possono controllare in modo efficiente le funzioni, senza esecuzioni di pipeline impegnative in termini di tempo.
bullets.title: Implementazione delle funzioni disgiunta dalle distribuzioni

bullets.description: Ripristina istantaneamente allo stato precedente le funzioni problematiche attivando/disattivando gli indicatori di funzione nel dashboard cloud di App Configuration.
bullets.title: Ripristino istantaneo allo stato precedente

media.caption: Cosa sono gli indicatori di funzione?

bullets.description: 中心となる場所から、複数の分散リソースを構成します。 コレクションを使用して、アプリまたはリソースごとにフラグを編成します。  DevOps エンジニアは、複雑なアプリケーションおよび環境の構成を 1 つのダッシュボードで容易に管理できます。
bullets.title: 集中構成

bullets.description: リリースの準備ができていない機能をデプロイメントに組み込み、準備できたらアクティブ化します。 開発者は、テスト前または未完了の機能を機能フラグの背後でマスター・ブランチに組み込むことにより、ソース・コード・ブランチの複雑さを低減して面倒なマージを削減するために、ダーク・ローンチを使用することができます。  テスターは、機能フラグを使用して新機能を実際に実動環境でテストすることにより、新機能を実動用に利用できることを確認できます。
bullets.title: ダーク・ローンチ

bullets.description: 異なる時間帯に異なるセグメントを対象に機能をアクティブ化したり、セグメントごとに機能を提供したりします。  アプリ所有者はユーザーに合わせてアプリケーションを微調整し、DevOps エンジニアは環境構成をきめ細かく制御することができます。
bullets.title: 機能のセグメント化

bullets.description: 新規コード・デプロイメントを必要とせずに、機能と構成をロールアウトします。  アプリ所有者は、時間のかかるパイプラインを実行せずに、機能を効率的に管理できます。
bullets.title: 機能のロールアウトをデプロイメントから分離

bullets.description: App Configuration クラウド・ダッシュボードで機能フラグを切り替えることで、問題のある機能を素早くロールバックします。
bullets.title: 素早いロールバック

bullets.description: 중앙 위치에서 분산된 여러 리소스를 구성합니다. 콜렉션을 사용하여 앱 또는 리소스별로 플래그를 구성합니다.  DevOps 엔지니어는 하나의 대시보드에서 복잡한 애플리케이션 및 환경에 대한 구성을 쉽게 관리할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 중앙 집중식 구성

bullets.description: 배치를 실행할 준비가 되지 않은 기능을 포함하고, 준비가 되면 활성화합니다. 개발자들은 다크 런칭을 사용하여 마스터 분기에 있는 기능 플래그 뒤에 테스트되지 않았거나 완료되지 않은 기능을 포함시킴으로써 소스 코드 분기의 복잡도와 문제가 있는 병합을 줄일 수 있습니다.  테스터는 기능 플래그를 사용하여 실제로 테스트함으로써 새로운 기능이 프로덕션에서 작동함을 보장할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 다크 런칭

bullets.description: 다른 시간에 다른 세그먼트에 대한 기능을 활성화하거나 세그먼트별로 다른 기능을 활성화합니다.  앱 소유자는 사용자에 대한 애플리케이션을 미세 조정할 수 있으며, DevOps 엔지니어는 환경 구성을 세부적으로 제어할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 세그먼트화된 기능

bullets.description: 새 코드 배치 없이 기능 및 구성을 출시합니다.  앱 소유자는 시간이 많이 소요되는 파이프라인을 실행하지 않고도 기능을 효율적으로 제어할 수 있습니다.

bullets.description: App Configuration 클라우드 대시보드에서 기능 플래그를 토글하여 문제가 있는 기능을 즉시 롤백할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 인스턴트 롤백

bullets.description: Configure vários recursos distribuídos por meio de um local central. Use coleções para organizar as seus sinalizadores por app ou recurso.  Os engenheiros do DevOps podem gerenciar facilmente as configurações para aplicativo e ambiente complexos por meio de um painel.
bullets.title: Configuração centralizada

bullets.description: Inclua recursos que não estejam prontos para ativação em suas implementações e ative-os quando eles estiverem prontos. Os desenvolvedores podem usar o lançamento no escuro para reduzir a complexidade da ramificação de código-fonte e as mesclagens problemáticas, incluindo recursos não testados ou não concluídos atrás de um sinalizador de recurso em sua ramificação principal.  Ao usar os sinalizadores de recurso para um teste real no ambiente de produção, os testadores podem ter certeza de que os novos recursos funcionarão na produção.
bullets.title: Lançamento secreto

bullets.description: Ative recursos para diferentes segmentos em momentos diferentes ou varie recursos por segmento.  Os proprietários de aplicativos podem ajustar com precisão os aplicativos aos usuários e os engenheiros do DevOps podem ter controle granular sobre as configurações do ambiente.
bullets.title: Recursos segmentados

bullets.description: Apresente recursos e configurações sem requerer novas implementações de código.  Os proprietários de aplicativo podem controlar os recursos de maneira eficiente, sem execuções de pipeline demoradas.
bullets.title: Lançamento de recurso desacoplado de implementações

bullets.description: Retroceda instantaneamente os recursos problemáticos alternando os sinalizadores de recurso no painel de nuvem do App Configuration.
bullets.title: Retrocesso instantâneo

media.caption: O que são sinalizadores de recursos?

bullets.description: 在一个中心位置中配置多个分布式资源。 使用“集合”，可以按应用或资源来组织标志。  DevOps 工程师可在一个仪表板中轻松地管理复杂应用和环境的配置。
bullets.title: 集中式配置

bullets.description: 将尚未做好启动准备的功能包含到部署中，并在准备就绪时激活这些功能。 通过在主分支中的功能标志后面包含未经测试或未完成的功能，开发人员可以使用暗启动来降低源代码分支的复杂性并减少复杂合并的次数。  通过使用功能标志在生产环境中进行实际测试，测试人员可以放心地在生产环境中使用新功能。
bullets.title: 暗启动

bullets.description: 可以在不同时间激活不同段的功能，或按段区分功能。  应用所有者可以根据用户对应用进行微调，而 DevOps 工程师可以对环境配置进行精细控制。
bullets.title: 分段的功能

bullets.description: 无需部署新代码，即可推出功能和配置。  应用所有者可以有效地控制各项功能，而无需耗时的管道运行。
bullets.title: 功能推出与部署分离

bullets.description: 通过在 App Configuration 云仪表板中切换功能标志，可以即时回滚有问题的功能。
bullets.title: 即时回滚

bullets.description: 從集中位置配置多個分散式資源。 使用「集合」按應用程式或資源組織您的旗標。  DevOps 工程師可以從一個儀表板輕鬆管理複雜應用程式和環境的配置。
bullets.title: 集中化配置

bullets.description: 包括尚未準備好啟動到部署中的功能，並在備妥時啟動功能。 開發人員可以使用暗啟動來降低原始碼分支複雜性與麻煩的合併作業，方式是將未經測試或未完成的功能併入到其主分支中功能旗標的後面。  測試人員可以確信，透過使用功能旗標在生產環境中進行實際測試，新功能將可以在生產環境中正常工作。
bullets.title: 暗啟動

bullets.description: 在不同時間啟動不同區段的功能，或按區段改變功能。  應用程式擁有者可以為使用者細部調整應用程式，DevOps 工程師可以對環境配置進行精細控制。
bullets.title: 分段功能

bullets.description: 部署功能和配置，而無需部署新程式碼。  應用程式擁有者可以有效地控制功能，而無需非常耗時的管線執行。
bullets.title: 與部署解除聯結的功能部署

bullets.description: 透過切換 App Configuration 雲端儀表板中的功能旗標，立即回復有問題的功能。
bullets.title: 即時回復

name: apprapp

de.description: Zentrale Inflight-Konfiguration für Web- und Mobilanwendungen und verteilte Umgebungen.
de.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration ist ein zentraler Featureverwaltungs- und -konfigurationsservice für Web- und Mobilanwendungen, Microservices und verteilte Umgebungen.
Instrumentieren Sie Ihre Anwendungen mit App Configuration-SDKs und verwenden Sie das App Configuration-Dashboard oder die Administrator-API, um Feature-Flags zu definieren, diese in Sammlungen zusammenzufassen und auf von Ihnen definierte Benutzer- oder Ressourcensegmente oder -gruppen auszurichten. Sie können den Status von Feature-Flags in der Cloud ändern, um Features in Ihrer Anwendung oder Umgebung zu aktivieren bzw. zu inaktivieren, häufig ohne erforderlichen Neustart.

en.description: Centralized, in-flight configuration for web and mobile applications and distributed environments.
en.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration is a centralized feature management and configuration service for use with web and mobile applications, microservices, and distributed environments.
Instrument your applications with App Configuration SDKs, and use the App Configuration dashboard or administrator API to define feature flags, organize them into collections, and target them to segments (groups) of users or resources that you define. Change feature flag states in the cloud to activate or deactivate features in your application or environment, often without re-starting.

es.description: Configuración centralizada y sobre la marcha para aplicaciones web y móviles, y entornos distribuidos.
es.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration es un servicio centralizado de gestión de funciones y configuración que se usa con aplicaciones web y móviles, microservicios y entornos distribuidos.
Instrumente sus aplicaciones con los SDK de App Configuration y use el panel de control o el API de administrador de App Configuration para definir distintivos funcionales, organizarlos en colecciones y dirigirlos a los segmentos (grupos) de usuarios o recursos que defina. Cambie los estados de distintivo funcional en la nube para activar o desactivar las funciones de su aplicación o entorno, a menudo sin necesidad de reiniciar.

fr.description: Configuration centralisée en vol pour les applications Web et mobiles et les environnements distribués.
fr.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration est un service centralisé de gestion et de configuration des fonctions pour les applications Web et mobiles, les microservices et les environnements distribués.
Instrumentez vos applications avec les SDK App Configuration et utilisez le tableau de bord ou l'API d'administration App Configuration pour définir des indicateurs de fonction, les organiser en collections et les cibler sur des segments (groupes) d'utilisateurs ou de ressources que vous définissez. Modifiez les états de l'indicateur de fonction dans le nuage pour activer ou désactiver les fonctions de votre application ou de votre environnement, souvent sans redémarrage.

it.description: Configurazione centralizzata, in esecuzione, per applicazioni web e per dispositivo mobile e ambienti distribuiti.
it.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration è un servizio centralizzato di configurazione e gestione di funzioni per l'utilizzo con applicazioni web e per dispositivo mobile, microservizi e ambienti distribuiti.
Equipaggia le tue applicazioni con gli SDK di App Configuration e utilizza il dashboard App Configuration o l'API dell'amministratore per definire gli indicatori di funzioni, organizzarli in raccolte e destinarli a segmenti (gruppi) di utenti o risorse che hai in precedenza definito. Modifica gli stati degli indicatori di funzioni nel cloud per attivare o disattivare funzioni nell'applicazione o nell'ambiente, spesso senza riavvio.

ja.description: Web およびモバイルのアプリケーションと分散環境の集中インフライト構成。
ja.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration は、Web およびモバイルのアプリケーション、マイクロサービス、分散環境で使用する、機能の集中管理/構成サービスです。
App Configuration SDKを使用してアプリケーションをインスツルメントし、App Configuration ダッシュボードまたは管理者 API を使用して、フィーチャー・フラグを定義し、それらをコレクションに編成し、定義したユーザーまたはリソースのセグメント (グループ) にそれらをターゲットとしてターゲットにします。 クラウド内で機能フラグの状態を変更することで、アプリケーション内または環境内の機能をアクティブ化または非アクティブ化することができ、その際の再始動は通常不要です。

ko.description: 웹 및 모바일 애플리케이션과 분산 환경을 위한 중앙 집중화된 인플라이트 구성입니다.
ko.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration은 웹 및 모바일 애플리케이션, 마이크로서비스 및 분산 환경에서 사용할 수 있는 중앙 집중화된 기능 관리 및 구성 서비스입니다.
App Configuration SDK를 사용하여 애플리케이션을 확인하고, App Configuration 대시보드 또는 관리 API를 사용하여 기능 플래그를 정의하고, 이를 콜렉션으로 구성하며, 정의하는 사용자 또는 리소스의 세그먼트(그룹)로 대상을 지정하십시오. 클라우드의 기능 플래그 상태를 변경하여 애플리케이션 또는 환경에서 기능을 활성화하거나 비활성화합니다(종종 다시 시작하지 않음).

pt-BR.description: Configuração em andamento centralizada para aplicativos da web e móveis, bem como ambientes distribuídos.
pt-BR.long_description:
O IBM Cloud App Configuration é um serviço de gerenciamento e configuração de recursos centralizado para uso com aplicativos móveis e da web, microsserviços e ambientes distribuídos.
Instrumente seus aplicativos com SDKs do App Configuration e use o painel do App Configuration ou a API de administrador para definir sinalizadores de recursos, organizá-los em coleções e destiná-los a segmentos (grupos) de usuários ou recursos que você definir. Mude os estados do sinalizador de recurso na nuvem para ativar ou desativar recursos em seu aplicativo ou ambiente, muitas vezes sem reiniciar.

zh-Hans.description: 适用于 Web 和移动应用以及分布式环境的集中式动态配置。
zh-Hans.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration 是一种集中式功能管理和配置服务，适用于 Web 和移动应用、微服务以及分布式环境。
使用 App Configuration SDK 来检测应用程序，并使用 App Configuration 仪表板或管理员 API 来定义功能部件标志，将其组织到集合中，并将其设计为您定义的用户或资源的段（组）。 更改云中的功能标志状态以激活或停用应用或环境中的功能，通常无需重新启动即可完成这些操作。

zh-Hant.description: 針對 Web 和行動式應用程式以及分散式環境的集中式進行中配置。
zh-Hant.long_description:
IBM Cloud App Configuration 是一項集中式功能管理和配置服務，可與 Web 和行動式應用程式、微服務和分散式環境搭配使用。
使用 App Configuration SDK 來檢測應用程式，並使用 App Configuration 儀表板或管理者 API 來定義特性旗標、將它們組織成集合，並將它們設為您定義的使用者或資源的區段（群組）。 變更雲端中的功能旗標狀態，可啟動或停用您的應用程式或環境中的功能，而無需重新啟動。

description: Centralized, in-flight configuration for web and mobile applications and distributed environments.
longDescription:
IBM Cloud App Configuration is a centralized feature management and configuration service for use with web and mobile applications, microservices, and distributed environments.
Instrument your applications with App Configuration SDKs, and use the App Configuration dashboard or administrator API to define feature flags, organize them into collections, and target them to segments (groups) of users or resources that you define. Change feature flag states in the cloud to activate or deactivate features in your application or environment, often without re-starting.

name: appid

de.description: Benutzerauthentifizierung und Benutzerprofile für Ihre Apps
de.long_description:
App ID ermöglicht Ihnen, eine Authentifizierung zu Ihren mobilen und Web-Apps hinzuzufügen und Ihre APIs und Back-Ends zu schützen, ganz gleich wo diese ausgeführt werden. Für Ihre containerisierten Apps ist keine Codeänderung oder erneute Bereitstellung erforderlich.

Sie können die skalierbare Benutzerregistry von App ID (Cloud Directory) nutezn und eine auf der E-Mail-Adresse mit Kennwort basierende Anwendung und MFA zu Ihren Apps hinzufügen oder für die Anmeldung das Google- oder Facebook-Konto nutzen. Bei Mitarbeiter-Apps sollten Sie SAML 2.0 einbinden, damit sich die Benutzer mit den Berechtigungsnachweisen des Unternehmens anmelden können. Ergänzen Sie die Profile aller App-Benutzer durch zusätzliche Informationen, sodass diese eine begeisternde App-Erfahrung machen.

en.description: User Authentication and User Profiles for your apps.
en.long_description:
Use App ID to add authentication to your mobile and web apps and protect your APIs and back-ends running anywhere. No code change or redeploy is required for your containerised apps.

Add email/password based sign-up and sign-in, and MFA with App ID's scalable user registry - Cloud Directory, or social log-in with Google or Facebook. For employee apps, use SAML 2.0 federation to let users sign-in with their enterprise credentials. For all app users, enrich their profiles with additional info so you can build engaging experiences.

es.description: Autenticación de usuario y perfiles de usuario para sus apps.
es.long_description:
Utilice App ID para añadir autenticación a sus aplicaciones móviles y web y proteger sus API y back-ends en ejecución en cualquier ubicación. No se requiere modificar o volver a desplegar ningún código para sus aplicaciones contenerizadas.

Añada registro e inicio de sesión basado en correo electrónico/contraseña, y MFA con el registro de usuarios escalable de App ID, Cloud Directory o inicio de sesión social con Google o Facebook.Para las apps de empleados, utilice la federación con SAML 2.0 para que los usuarios puedan iniciar sesión con sus credenciales de empresa. Para todos los usuarios de app, enriquezca sus perfiles con más información para poder crear experiencias interesantes.

fr.description: Authentification d'utilisateur et profils utilisateur pour vos applications.
fr.long_description:
Utilisez App ID pour ajouter l'authentification à vos applications mobiles et Web et protéger vos API et vos back-end qui s'exécutent partout. Aucun changement de code ou redéploiement n'est requis pour vos applications conteneurisées.

Ajoutez la connexion et l'inscription basée sur adresse électronique/mot de passe, et l'authentification multifacteur avec un registre d'utilisateurs évolutif (Cloud Directory) ou la connexion sociale avec Google ou Facebook. Pour les applications destinées aux employés, utilisez la fédération SAML 2.0 pour permettre aux utilisateurs de se connecter avec leurs données d'identification d'entreprise. Pour tous les utilisateurs des applications, enrichissez leur profil avec des informations supplémentaires pour créer des expériences conviviales.

it.description: Autenticazione utente e profili utente per le applicazioni.
it.long_description:
Utilizza App ID per aggiungere l'autenticazione alle applicazioni mobili e Web e proteggere le API e le risorse di backend in esecuzione ovunque. Per le app nel contenitore non è richiesta alcuna modifica al codice o ridistribuzione. 

Aggiungi funzioni di registrazione ed accesso basate su email/password e MFA con il registro utenti scalabile - Cloud Directory di App ID o l'accesso social con Google o Facebook. Per le applicazioni dei dipendenti, utilizza la federazione SAML 2.0 per consentire agli utenti di accedere con le proprie credenziali aziendali. Per tutti gli utenti dell'applicazione, completa i relativi profili con informazioni aggiuntive, in modo da poter creare un'esperienza coinvolgente.

ja.description: アプリケーションのユーザー認証とユーザー・プロファイル。
ja.long_description:
App ID を使用すると、モバイル・アプリおよび Web アプリに認証を追加し、実行場所を問わず API とバックエンドを保護することができます。コンテナー化アプリには、コード変更も再デプロイも必要ありません。

App ID のスケーラブルなユー���ー・レジストリー (クラウド・ディレクトリー) を使用するか、Google または Facebook のソーシャル・ログインを使用して、E メール/パスワードによるサインアップとサインインおよび MFA を追加できます。従業員アプリケーションでは、SAML 2.0 連携を使用して、ユーザーに会社用の資格情報でサインインさせることができます。どのアプリでも、ユーザーのプロファイルを追加情報でエンリッチして魅力的なエクスペリエンスを構築できます。

ko.description: 앱의 사용자 인증 및 사용자 프로파일입니다.
ko.long_description:
App ID를 사용해 모바일 및 웹 앱에 인증을 추가하고 모든 위치에서 실행되는 API와 백엔드를 보호하십시오. 컨테이너화된 앱의 코드 변경 또는 재배치가 필요하지 않습니다. 

이메일/비밀번호 기반 가입 및 로그인을 추가하고, App ID의 스케일링 가능한 사용자 레지스트리인 Cloud Directory, 또는 Google이나 Facebook을 사용한 소셜 로그인을 통한 MFA를 추가하십시오. 직원 앱의 경우, SAML 2.0 연합을 사용하여 사용자가 자신의 엔터프라이즈 신임 정보로 로그인하도록 하십시오. 모든 앱 사용자는 앱 제공자가 흥미 있는 경험을 구축할 수 있도록 추가 정보로 프로파일을 강화할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.description: Autenticação e perfis do usuário para os seus apps.
pt-BR.long_description:
Use o App ID para incluir a autenticação em seus apps de dispositivo móvel e da web, além de proteger as suas APIs e back-ends em execução em qualquer lugar. Nenhuma mudança de código ou reimplementação é necessária para seus apps conteinerizados.

Inclua a inscrição e o login com base em e-mail/senha e a MFA com o registro do usuário escalável do App ID, o Cloud Directory, ou o login de rede social com o Google ou o Facebook. Para apps de funcionários, use a federação do SAML 2.0 para permitir que os usuários se conectem com suas credenciais corporativas. Enriqueça os perfis de todos os usuários do aplicativo com informações adicionais para que seja possível construir experiências envolventes.

zh-Hans.description: 针对您应用程序的用户认证和用户个人档案。
zh-Hans.long_description:
使用应用程序标识向移动和 Web 应用程序添加认证并保护在任何位置运行的 API 和后端系统。容器化应用程序无需代码更改或重新部署。

使用应用程序标识的可扩展用户注册表 (Cloud Directory) 添加基于电子邮件/密码的注册、登录和 MFA，或者使用 Google 或 Facebook 社交帐户登录。对于员工应用程序，请使用 SAML 2.0 联合来允许用户使用其企业凭证进行登录。对于所有其他用户，请使用其他信息扩充其个人档案以便您可构建具有吸引力的体验。

zh-Hant.description: 適用於應用程式的使用者鑑別及使用者設定檔。
zh-Hant.long_description:
使用 App ID 將鑑別新增至行動式應用程式及 Web 應用程式，並保護任何位置執行的 API 及後端。您的儲存器化應用程式不需要程式碼變更或重新部署。

新增電子郵件/密碼型註冊和登入，並使用 App ID 的可調式使用者登錄（雲端目錄）進行 MFA，或者使用 Google 或 Facebook 進行社交登入。對於員工應用程式，請使用 SAML 2.0 聯合以讓使用者透過其企業認證進行登入。對於所有應用程式使用者，請使用其他資訊來強化其設定檔，以便能夠營造具有吸引力的體驗。

bullets.description: Die ersten 1.000 Authentifizierungsereignisse und die ersten 1.000 autorisierten Benutzer im Monat sind gebührenfrei. Alle erweiterten Sicherheitsereignisse sind kostenpflichtig.

- Authentifizierungsereignisse treten ein, wenn ein Zugriffstoken oder anonymes Token ausgegeben wird. Token können als Reaktion auf eine Anmeldeanforderung ausgegeben werden, die von einem Benutzer oder durch eine App für einen Benutzer eingeleitet wird. Zugriffstoken bleiben standardmäßig 1 Stunde und anonyme Token 30 Tage gültig.

- Wenn Sie mindestens eine der folgenden erweiterten Funktionen aktiviert haben, sind Authentifizierungsereignisse auch erweiterte Sicherheitsereignisse: Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung, Laufzeitaktivitäten oder erweiterte Kennwortrichtlinie.

- Berechtigte Benutzer sind alle eindeutigen Benutzer, die sich über Ihren Service anmelden oder auf anderem Wege zu Ihrem Service hinzugefügt wurden. Dies schließt auch anonyme Benutzer ein. Beispiel: Wenn sich ein Benutzer mit den Angaben für sein Facebook-Konto anmeldet und für eine spätere Anmeldung seine Google-Angaben verwendet, wird dies als zwei verschiedene berechtigte Benutzer interpretiert.
Your first 1000 authentication events and first 1000 authorized users are free each month. All advanced security events have a cost.

- Authentication events occur when an access token or an anonymous token is issued. Tokens can be issued as a response to a sign-in request initiated by a user, or on behalf of the user by an app. By default access tokens last for 1 hour and anonymous tokens last for 30 days.

- If you have turned on one or more of the following advanced capabilities, authentication events are, in addition, advanced security events: Two-Factor Authentication, Runtime Activity, or Advanced Password Policy.

- Authorized users include any unique user that has signed-in by using your service, or is otherwise added to your service, including anonymous users. Example: if a user signs-in with Facebook and later signs-in by using Google, they are considered two separate authorized users.
Los primeros 1000 sucesos de autenticación y los primeros 1000 usuarios autorizados son gratis cada mes. Todos los sucesos de seguridad avanzada tienen un coste.

- Los sucesos de autenticación se producen cuando se emite una señal de acceso o una señal anónima. Las señales se pueden emitir como una respuesta a una solicitud de inicio de sesión iniciada por un usuario o por una aplicación en nombre del usuario. De forma predeterminada, las señales de acceso son válidas durante una hora y las señales anónimas durante 30 días.

- Si ha activado una o varias de las siguientes funciones avanzadas, los sucesos de autenticación son, además, sucesos de seguridad avanzada: autenticación de dos factores, actividad de tiempo de ejecución o política avanzada de contraseña.

- Entre los usuarios autorizados se incluyen los usuarios únicos que inician una sesión en su servicio, o que de alguna forma se han añadido al servicio, incluidos los usuarios anónimos. Por ejemplo, si un usuario inicia una sesión con Facebook y más tarde la inicia utilizando Google, se consideran dos usuarios autorizados diferentes.
Les 1000 premiers événements d'authentification et les 1000 premiers utilisateurs sont gratuits chaque mois. Tous les événements de sécurité avancée ont un coût.

- Les événements d'authentification se produisent lorsqu'un jeton d'accès ou un jeton anonyme est émis. Les jetons peuvent être émis en réponse à une demande de connexion initiée par un utilisateur, ou par une application pour l'utilisateur. Par défaut, la durée de vie des jetons d'accès est d'une heure, celle des jetons anonymes est de 30 jours.

- Si vous avez activé une ou plusieurs des fonctions avancées suivantes, les événements d'authentification sont, en plus, des événements de sécurité avancés : Authentification à deux facteurs, Activité d'exécution ou Règles avancées sur les mots de passe.

- Les utilisateurs autorisés incluent tous les utilisateurs uniques qui se sont connectés à l'aide de votre service, ou qui ont été ajoutés à votre service, y compris les utilisateurs anonymes. Ainsi, un utilisateur qui se connecte initialement par Facebook puis ultérieurement par Google est considéré comme 2 utilisateurs autorisés distincts.
I primi 1000 eventi di autenticazione ed i primi 1000 utenti autorizzati sono gratuiti ogni mese. Tutti gli eventi di sicurezza avanzata hanno un costo.

- Gli eventi di autenticazione si verificano quando viene emesso un token di accesso o un token anonimo. I token possono essere emessi come risposta a una richiesta di accesso inviata da un utente o per conto dell'utente da parte di un'applicazione. Per impostazione predefinita, i token di accesso durano 1 ora ed i token anonimi durano 30 giorni.

- Se è stata attivata una o più delle seguenti funzionalità, gli eventi di autenticazione sono anche eventi di sicurezza avanzata: autenticazione a due fattori, attività di runtime o politica della password avanzata.

- Gli utenti autorizzati comprendono tutti gli utenti univoci che hanno eseguito l'accesso utilizzando il servizio, o sono stati aggiunti al servizio, inclusi gli utenti anonimi. Esempio: se un utente accede con Facebook e successivamente accede utilizzando Google, viene considerato come due utenti autorizzati.
毎月、最初の 1000 件の認証イベントと最初の 1000 人の許可ユーザーは無料です。すべての拡張セキュリティー・イベントにはコストがかかります。
- 認証イベントは、アクセス・トークンまたは匿名トークンが発行されると発生します。トークンは、ユーザーが開始した、あるいはユーザーの代わりにアプリが開始した、サインイン要求への応答として発行できます。デフォルトでは、アクセス・トークンの有効期間は 1 時間、匿名トークンの有効期間は 30 日間です。
- 次の 1 つ以上の拡張機能をオンにした場合は、認証イベントは拡張セキュリティー・イベント (2 要素認証、ランタイム・アクティビティー、拡張パスワード・ポリシー) でもあります。
- 許可ユーザーには、匿名ユーザーを含め、サービスを使用してサインインした固有のユーザー、あるいは他の方法でサービスに追加された固有のユーザーがすべて含まれます。例えば、Facebook でサインインした後に Google を使用してサインインしたユーザーは、2 人の別々の許可ユーザーと見なされます。
매월 처음 1000개의 인증 이벤트와 처음 1000명의 권한 부여된 사용자는 무료입니다. 모든 고급 보안 이벤트에는 비용이 있습니다.
- 인증 이벤트는 액세스 토큰 또는 익명 토큰이 발행되면 발생합니다. 토큰은 사용자가 시작한 로그인 요청에 대한 응답으로, 또는 애플리케이션에 의해 사용자 대신 발행될 수 있습니다. 기본적으로 액세스 토큰은 1시간 동안 지속되며 익명 토큰은 30일 동안 지속됩니다.
- 이중 인증, 런타임 활동 또는 고급 비밀번호 정책과 같은 고급 기능 중 하나 이상을 켠 경우 인증 이벤트는 고급 보안 이벤트를 포함합니다.
- 권한 부여된 사용자는 익명 사용자를 포함하여, 서비스를 사용해 로그인한 고유 사용자 또는 그 외에 서비스에 추가된 사용자를 포함합니다. 예: 특정 사용자가 Facebook을 사용하여 로그인한 후 나중에 Google을 사용하여 로그인하는 경우, 이들은 별도의 두 권한 부여된 사용자로 간주됩니다.
Seus primeiros 1.000 eventos de autenticação e seus primeiros 1.000 usuários autorizados são grátis a cada mês. Todos os eventos de segurança avançada têm um custo.

- Os eventos de autenticação ocorrem quando um token de acesso ou um token anônimo é emitido. Os tokens podem ser emitidos como uma resposta a uma solicitação de conexão iniciada por um usuário ou em nome de um usuário por um app. Por padrão, os tokens de acesso duram uma hora e os anônimos duram 30 dias.

- Se você tiver ativado um ou mais dos recursos avançados a seguir, os eventos de autenticação serão, além disso, eventos de segurança avançada: autenticação de dois fatores, atividade de tempo de execução ou política de senha avançada.

- Os usuários autorizados incluem qualquer usuário exclusivo que tenha se conectado por meio do uso do seu serviço ou seja incluído de qualquer outra forma em seu serviço, incluindo usuários anônimos. Exemplo: se um usuário se conectar com o Facebook e, depois, com o Google, dois usuários autorizados separados serão considerados.
每月前 1000 起认证事件和前 1000 个授权用户免费。所有高级安全事件均具有成本。
- 发放访问令牌或匿名令牌时，发生认证事件。发放的令牌可作为对用户或者由应用程序代表用户启动的登录请求的响应。 缺省情况下，访问令牌有效期为 1 小时，匿名令牌有效期为 30 天。
- 此外，如果已开启以下一个或多个高级功能，那么认证事件是高级安全事件：双因子验证、运行时活动或高级密码策略。
- 授权用户包括使用您的服务登录或者添加到服务的任何非重复用户（包括匿名用户）。示例：如果用户使用 Facebook 登录，稍后又使用 Google 登录，那么会将其视为两个独立的授权用户。
每個月的前 1000 個鑑別事件以及前 1000 個授權使用者免費。所有進階安全事件都有成本。
- 當您發出存取記號或匿名記號時會發生鑑別事件。記號可以作為對使用者起始的登入要求之回應而發出，或由應用程式代表使用者發出。依預設，存取記號會持續 1 小時，匿名記號會持續 30 天。
- 如果您開啟了下列其中一項進階功能，則鑑別事件還包括進階安全事件：雙因素鑑別、執行時期活動或進階密碼原則。
- 授權使用者包括使用您的服務進行登入的任何唯一使用者，或者以其他方式新增至您的服務的任何唯一使用者，其中包括匿名使用者。範例：如果某個使用者先使用 Facebook 登入，稍後又使用 Google 登入，則會將其視為兩個個別的授權使用者。

bullets.description: 1.000 Ereignisse pro Monat und 1.000 berechtigte Benutzer

Ein Authentifizierungsereignis tritt ein, wenn ein Token ausgegeben wird. Token können als Reaktion auf eine Anmeldeanforderung ausgegeben werden, die von einem Benutzer oder durch eine App für einen Benutzer eingeleitet wird. Authentifizierte Token bleiben 1 Stunde und anonyme Token 30 Tage gültig.

Berechtigte Benutzer sind alle eindeutigen Benutzer, die sich über Ihren Service anmelden. Dies schließt auch anonyme Benutzer ein. Beispiel: Wenn sich ein Benutzer mit den Angaben für sein Facebook-Konto anmeldet und für eine spätere Anmeldung seine Google-Angaben verwendet, wird dies als zwei verschiedene berechtigte Benutzer interpretiert.
1000 monthly events and 1000 authorized users.

Authentication events occur when a token is issued. Tokens can be issued as a response to a sign-in request initiated by a user, or on behalf of the user by an app. Authenticated tokens last for 1 hour and anonymous tokens last for 30 days.

Authorized users include any unique users that log in by using your service, including anonymous users. Example: if a user logs in with Facebook and later logs in by using Google, they are considered two separate authorized users.
1000 usuarios autorizados y 1000 sucesos al mes.

Los sucesos de autenticación se producen cuando se emite una señal. Las señales se pueden emitir como una respuesta a una solicitud de inicio de sesión iniciada por un usuario o por una aplicación en nombre del usuario. Las señales autenticadas son válidas durante una hora y las señales anónimas durante 30 días.

Entre los usuarios autorizados se incluyen los usuarios únicos que inician una sesión en su servicio, incluidos los usuarios anónimos. Por ejemplo, si un usuario inicia una sesión con Facebook y más tarde la inicia utilizando Google, se consideran dos usuarios autorizados diferentes.
1 000 événements mensuels et 1 000 utilisateurs autorisés.

Des événements d'authentification se produisent lorsqu'un jeton est émis. Les jetons peuvent être émis en réponse à une demande de connexion initiée par un utilisateur, ou par une application pour l'utilisateur. La durée de vie des jetons authentifiés est d'une heure, celle des jetons anonymes est de 30 jours.

Les utilisateurs autorisés incluent tous les utilisateurs uniques connectés à l'aide de votre service, y compris les utilisateurs anonymes. Ainsi, un utilisateur qui se connecte initialement par Facebook puis ultérieurement par Google est considéré comme 2 utilisateurs autorisés distincts.
1000 eventi mensili e 1000 utenti autorizzati.

Gli eventi di autenticazione si verificano quando viene emesso un token. I token possono essere emessi come risposta a una richiesta di accesso inviata da un utente o per conto dell'utente da parte di un'applicazione. I token autenticati durano 1 ora ed i token anonimi durano 30 giorni.

Gli utenti autorizzati comprendono tutti gli utenti univoci che eseguono l'accesso utilizzando il servizio, inclusi gli utenti anonimi. Esempio: se un utente accede con Facebook e successivamente accede utilizzando Google, viene considerato come due utenti autorizzati separati.
1000 件の毎月のイベントと 1000 人の許可ユーザー。
認証イベントは、トークンが発行されると発生します。トークンは、ユーザーが開始した、あるいはユーザーの代わりにアプリが開始した、サインイン要求への応答として発行できます。認証されたトークンの有効期間は 1 時間、匿名トークンの有効期間は 30 日間です。
許可ユーザーには、匿名ユーザーも含め、サービスを使用してログインした固有のユーザーがすべて含まれます。例えば、Facebook でログインした後に Google を使用してログインしたユーザーは、2 人の別々の許可ユーザーと見なされます。
1000개의 월별 이벤트와 1000명의 권한 부여된 사용자
인증 이벤트는 토큰이 발행되면 발생합니다. 토큰은 사용자가 시작한 로그인 요청에 대한 응답으로, 또는 애플리케이션에 의해 사용자 대신 발행될 수 있습니다. 인증된 토큰은 1시간 동안 지속되며 익명 토큰은 30일 동안 지속됩니다.
권한 부여된 사용자는 익명 사용자를 포함하여, 서비스를 사용해 로그인한 고유 사용자를 포함합니다. 예: 특정 사용자가 Facebook을 사용하여 로그인한 후 나중에 Google을 사용하여 로그인하는 경우, 이들은 별도의 두 권한 부여된 사용자로 간주됩니다.
1.000 eventos mensais e 1.000 usuários autorizados.

Os eventos de autenticação ocorrem quando um token é emitido. Os tokens podem ser emitidos como uma resposta a uma solicitação de conexão iniciada por um usuário ou em nome de um usuário por um app. Os tokens autenticados duram 1 hora e os anônimos duram 30 dias.

Os usuários autorizados incluem qualquer usuário exclusivo que efetue login usando o serviço, incluindo usuários anônimos. Exemplo: se um usuário efetuar login com o Facebook e, depois, com o Google, dois usuários autorizados separados serão considerados.
每月 1000 起事件和 1000 名授权用户。
发放令牌时，即发生认证事件。 发放的令牌可作为对用户或者由应用程序代表用户启动的登录请求的响应。 认证令牌有效期为 1 小时，匿名令牌有效期为 30 天。
授权用户包括使用您的服务登录的任何非重复用户（包括匿名用户）。 示例：如果用户使用 Facebook 登录，稍后又使用 Google 登录，那么会将其视为两个独立的授权用户。
1000 個事件（每月）及 1000 個授權使用者。
發出記號時將會發生鑑別事件。 記號可以作為對使用者起始的登入要求之回應而發出，或由應用程式代表使用者發出。 鑑別記號會持續 1 小時，匿名記號會持續 30 天。
授權使用者包括使用服務登入的任何唯一使用者，其中包括匿名使用者。 範例：如果某個使用者先使用 Facebook 登入，稍後又使用 Google 登入，則會將其視為兩個個別的授權使用者。

bullets.description:
When using the Backup and Recovery service, you are charged for the 'gigabyte hours' of storage used. This is the number of gigabytes stored per hour of usage in the service.

To estimate a monthly cost, use the following calculation:
Number of gigabytes used × gigabyte hours metric × 730 (average number of hours in a month)

Note: Gigabytes used in the formula above must take in to account the total gigabytes backed up from all source servers using the service. In addition both the number of full backups and incremental backups of data that has changed will affect the final gigabytes used value. 

As an example if you have:
A server with 1,000GB of used storage
A backup policy taking 1 full backup per week and an incremental backup per day.
A daily change rate (how much data changes on the server) of 10%

For gigabytes used:
1,000GB x 4 (weeks in the month) = 4,000GB
100GB (change rate) x 30 (days in month) = 3,000GB
Total = 7,000 gigabytes used.

Example monthly charge:
7,000 (GB used) x $0.00013 (per gigabyte hour) x 730 (hours in month) = $664.30

This can also be done within the IBM Cloud estimator. Take the number of GB used and multiply it by 730. Enter the output into the field labelled 'Gigabyte Hour', this will allow different currencies and locations to be estimated.
bullets.title: Estimating Service cost

name: backup-recovery

de.description: Backup and Recovery ist ein verwalteter Service für die Sicherung von Dateien, Ordnern und Datenbankservern (wie etwa MS SQL Server) in VMware-Umgebungen, deren Ausführung in IBM Cloud erfolgt.
de.long_description: Backup and Recovery ist ein verwalteter Service für die Sicherung von Dateien, Ordnern und Datenbankservern (wie etwa MS SQL Server) in ein VMware-Umgebungen, deren Ausführung in IBM Cloud erfolgt. Mit diesem Service können Sie Sicherungszeitpläne definieren, um Datenquellen routinemäßig mit einem sicheren, agentenbasierten, anwendungskonsistenten Sicherungsservice zu schützen. Die Sicherungsinfrastruktur wird von IBM verwaltet.

en.description: Backup and Recovery is a managed service for File and folder backup & Database servers (such as MS SQL Server) in VMware and VPC environments running on IBM Cloud.
en.long_description: Backup and Recovery is a managed backup service for File and folder & Database servers (such as MS SQL Server) in VMware and VPC environments running on IBM Cloud. This service lets you define backup schedules to routinely protect data sources using a secure, agent-based, application-consistent backup service. Backup infrastructure is managed by IBM.

es.description: Backup and Recovery es un servicio gestionado de copia de seguridad de archivos y carpetas y servidores de bases de datos (como MS SQL Server) en un entorno VMware que se ejecuta en IBM Cloud.
es.long_description: Backup and Recovery es un servicio de copia de seguridad gestionado para servidores de archivos, carpetas y bases de datos (como MS SQL Server) en entornos VMware que se ejecutan en IBM Cloud. Este servicio le permite definir programas de copia de seguridad para proteger rutinariamente orígenes de datos mediante un servicio de copia de seguridad basado en agente, coherente con la aplicación y seguro. La infraestructura de copia de seguridad está gestionada por IBM.

fr.description: Backup and Recovery est un service géré pour la sauvegarde de fichiers et de dossiers et les serveurs de bases de données (comme MS SQL Server) dans un environnement VMware s'exécutant sur IBM Cloud
fr.long_description: Backup and Recovery est un service de sauvegarde géré pour les serveurs de fichiers et de dossiers et les serveurs de bases de données (tels que MS SQL Server) dans des environnements VMware s'exécutant sur IBM Cloud. Ce service vous permet de définir des plannings de sauvegarde pour protéger régulièrement les sources de données à l'aide d'un service de sauvegarde sécurisé, basé sur des agents et conforme aux applications. L'infrastructure de sauvegarde est gérée par IBM.

it.description: Backup and Recovery è un servizio gestito per il backup di file e cartelle e server di database (come MS SQL Server) in ambiente VMware in esecuzione su IBM Cloud.
it.long_description: Backup and Recovery è un servizio di backup gestito per server di file e cartelle e database (come MS SQL Server) in ambienti VMware in esecuzione su IBM Cloud. Questo servizio consente di definire pianificazioni di backup per proteggere regolarmente le origini di dati utilizzando un servizio di backup sicuro, basato su agenti e coerente con le applicazioni. L'infrastruttura di backup è gestita da IBM.

ja.description: Backup および復旧は、IBM Cloud 上で実行中の VMware 環境におけるファイルとフォルダー・バックアップ & データベース・サーバー (MSSQL Server など) のマネージド・サービスです。
ja.long_description: Backup および復旧は、IBM Cloud 上で実行中の VMware 環境におけるファイルとフォルダー& データベース・サーバー (MSSQL Server など) のマネージド・バックアップ・サービスです。 このサービスでは、バックアップ・スケジュールを定義し、安全なエージェント・ベースのアプリケーション一貫バックアップ・サービスを使用して、データソースを定期的に保護することができます。 バックアップ・インフラは IBM が管理しています。

ko.description: Backup and Recovery는 IBM Cloud에서 실행되는 VMware 환경의 파일 및 폴더 백업과 데이터베이스 서버(MS SQL Server)를 위한 전문화된 서비스입니다.
ko.long_description: Backup and Recovery는 IBM Cloud에서 실행되는 VMware 환경의 파일 및 폴더 백업과 데이터베이스 서버(예: MS SQL Server)를 위한 전문화된 백업 서비스입니다. 이 서비스를 사용하면 안전하고, 에이전트 기반이며, 애플리케이션과 일관된 백업 서비스를 사용하여 데이터 소스를 정기적으로 보호하는 백업 스케줄을 정의할 수 있습니다. 백업 인프라는 IBM에서 관리합니다.

pt-BR.description: O Backup and Recovery é um serviço gerenciado para backup de arquivos e pastas e servidores de banco de dados (como o MS SQL Server) em ambiente VMware em execução na IBM Cloud.
pt-BR.long_description: O Backup and Recovery é um serviço de backup gerenciado para servidores de arquivos e pastas e bancos de dados (como o MS SQL Server) em ambientes VMware em execução no IBM Cloud. Esse serviço permite definir os planejamentos de backup para proteger rotineiramente as origens de dados usando um serviço de backup seguro, com base em agente e consistente com os aplicativos. A infraestrutura de backup é gerenciada pela IBM.

zh-Hans.description: Backup and Recovery 是一项托管服务，适用于在 IBM Cloud 上运行的 VMware 环境中的文件和文件夹备份以及数据库服务器（如 MS SQL Server）
zh-Hans.long_description: Backup and Recovery 是一项托管服务，适用于在 IBM Cloud 上运行的 VMware 环境中的文件和文件夹以及数据库服务器（如 MS SQL Server）。借助该服务，您可以定义备份计划，使用安全、基于代理且与应用程序一致的备份服务对数据源进行例行保护。 备份基础架构由 IBM 管理。

zh-Hant.description: Backup and Recovery 是一項受管理服務，用於在 IBM Cloud 上執行之 VMware 環境中的檔案和資料夾備份及資料庫伺服器（如 MS SQL Server）。
zh-Hant.long_description: Backup and Recovery 是一項受管理備份服務，用於在 IBM Cloud 上執行之 VMware 環境中的檔案和資料夾及資料庫伺服器（如 MS SQL Server）。本服務可讓您定義備份排程，以使用以代理程式為基礎、應用程式一致的安全備份服務，定期保護資料來源。 備份基礎架構由 IBM 管理。
