bullets.description: Available options from single processor 4-core architectures to quad-processor 20-core architectures and up to 3 TB RAM. Local storage can scale up to 36x 12 TB HDDs (432 TB) or 24x 7.6 TB SSDs (182 TB) and up to 36 drivers per server.
bullets.title: Custom configurations

bullets.description: NVIDIA Tesla GPUs on IBM Cloud are designed for high-performance acceleration of scientific computation, data analytics, and professional-grade virtualized graphics.
bullets.title: GPUs

bullets.description: Deploy your SAP landscapes to IBM Cloud to realize all the advantages of cloud: cost reductions, on-demand flexibility, and limitless growth potential. IBM Cloud offers a full complement of SAP HANA certified servers and SAP Application Servers. The SAP servers range in size from single socket servers with 32 GB of RAM up to the latest eight socket Intel Cascade Lake processors with up to 12 TB of RAM.
bullets.title: SAP certified infrastructure

bullets.description:
Order IBM Cloud Bare Metal Servers that include the VMware ESXi hypervisor that automatically installs. Select a "Configurable" server and choose VMware v6.5 or v6.7 as the operating system.

Looking for VMware vSphere 7.0? You can find vSphere 7 hosts that are all certified for vSAN within IBM Cloud VMware Solutions vCS product.
bullets.title: VMware certified infrastructure

bullets.description: Get up-and-running quickly across 60 IBM Cloud data centers and point of presences in 9 regions and 18 availability zones. Deploy to one region or across multiple regions. Choose IBM Cloud federal data centers to meet government compliance requirements.
bullets.title: Modern networking, global data centers

bullets.description: Choose the billing cycle that works for you, with on-demand hourly, monthly, and reserved options.
bullets.title: Pay-as-you-go

bullets.description: Los servidores nativos para un único arrendatario están dirigidos a los clientes que buscan un mayor control, flexibilidad y seguridad.
bullets.title: Control y seguridad

bullets.description: Elija el procesador que mejor se adapte a sus necesidades de rendimiento. Actualice la configuración base para ajustar con mayor precisión el hardware para las cargas de trabajo con RAM o SSD personalizables, entre otros recursos.
bullets.title: Personalizable

bullets.description: Suministro de servidores en los centros de datos de IBM Cloud en todo el mundo con una respuesta entre dos y cuatro horas. Si necesita estar en línea en pocos minutos o si no desea límites en los recursos, seleccione un servidor nativo por horas.
bullets.title: Bajo demanda

bullets.description: Las opciones disponibles abarcan desde arquitecturas de 4 núcleos de procesadores individuales hasta arquitecturas de 12 núcleos de procesadores Quad con hasta 3 TB de RAM. El almacenamiento local abarca desde 800 GB a SSD de 1,2 TB y hasta 36 unidades por servidor.
bullets.title: Potencia

bullets.description: Suministro de servidores nativos con GPU de última generación para manejar las cargas de trabajo más intensivas de los cálculos más complejos. Las GPU NVIDIA Tesla en IBM Cloud están diseñadas mejorar un alto rendimiento para cálculos científicos, analíticas de datos y gráficos virtualizados a nivel profesional.
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: Cambie desde entornos SAP locales a un entorno totalmente respaldado por IBM Cloud para aprovecharse de todas las ventajas que hay en la nube: reducciones de coste, flexibilidad bajo demanda así como un crecimiento potencial sin límites. Encontrará servidores nativos SAP HANA de 4 sockets y 8 sockets certificados para la producción de cargas de trabajo S/4 HANA, soportados por procesadores Intel Xeon E7-8890 v4, con hasta 8 TB de RAM.
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: Un serveur bare metal à service exclusif est dédié aux clients afin d'optimiser contrôle, flexibilité et sécurité.
bullets.title: Contrôle & sécurité

bullets.description: Choisissez un processeur bien adapté à vos besoins en performances. Effectuez une mise à niveau à partir de la configuration de base afin de régler avec précision le matériel pour votre charge de travail avec une mémoire RAM, un disque SSD, etc. personnalisable.
bullets.title: Personnalisable

bullets.description: Met à disposition des serveurs dans des centres de données IBM Cloud à travers le monde dans un délai de deux à quatre heures. Si vous devez être connecté en quelques minutes ou si les ressources dont vous avez besoin sont limitées, sélectionnez un serveur bare metal à l'heure.
bullets.title: A la demande

bullets.description: Options disponibles depuis des architectures 4 coeurs monoprocesseur à des architectures 12 coeurs quatre processeurs et jusqu'à 3 To de mémoire RAM. Le stockage local comprend des disques SSD de 800 Go à 1,2 To et inclut jusqu'à 36 pilotes par serveur.
bullets.title: Puissant

bullets.description: Mise à disposition de serveurs bare metal avec des processeurs graphiques dernière génération pouvant traiter vos charges de travail à traitement intensif les plus complexes. Les processeurs graphiques NVIDIA Tesla sur IBM Cloud sont conçus pour une accélération de grande efficacité des graphiques virtualisés de calcul scientifique, d'analyse de données et de qualité professionnelle.
bullets.title: Processeurs graphiques

bullets.description: Faites passer les environnements SAP sur site à IBM Cloud pour réaliser tous les avantages du cloud : réduction des coûts, flexibilité à la demande et potentiel de croissance infini. Les serveurs bare metal SAP HANA 4 sockets et 8 sockets sont certifiés SAP pour les charges de travail S/4 HANA de production, alimentés par des processeurs Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 v4 avec jusqu'à 8 To de mémoire RAM.
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: Ai clienti viene dedicato un server bare metal single tenant per consentire controllo, flessibilità e sicurezza completi.
bullets.title: Controllo & Sicurezza

bullets.description: Scegliere un processore che risponda al meglio alle proprie esigenze di prestazioni. Aggiornare dalla configurazione di base per ottimizzare l'hardware per il tuo carico di lavoro con RAM, SSD personalizzabili ed altro.
bullets.title: Personalizzabile

bullets.description: Server di provisioning nei data center IBM Cloud nel mondo da due a quattro ore. Se devi essere online in pochi minuti o se hai solo bisogno di risorse limitate, seleziona un server bare metal orario.
bullets.title: On-demand

bullets.description: Opzioni disponibili da architetture a processore singolo 4-core ad architetture 12-core quad-processor, fino a 3TB RAM. La memoria locale spazia da 800 GB a 1.2 TB SSD e oltre, fino a 36 driver per server.
bullets.title: Potente

bullets.description: I server bare metal di provisioning con cutting-edge GPU per gestire i carichi di lavoro più complessi ad alta intensità di calcolo. NVIDIA Tesla GPU su IBM Cloud sono progettati per l'accelerazione ad alte prestazioni del calcolo scientifico, analisi dei dati e grafica virtualizzata di livello professionale.
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: Sposta gli ambienti SAP dalla sede ad un IBM Cloud completamente potenziato per attuare tutti i vantaggi del cloud: riduzione dei costi, flessibilità on-demand e potenzialità di crescita senza limite. SAP HANA 4-socket e i server 8-socket bare metal sono certificati SAP per produzione di carichi di lavoro S/4 HANA, potenziati da processori Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 v4, fino a 8TB di RAM.
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: シングル・テナント Bare Metal Server は、完全制御で柔軟性があり、セキュリティーを備えた、顧客専用のサーバーです。
bullets.title: 管理およびセキュリティー

bullets.description: パフォーマンス・ニーズを最大限に満たすプロセッサーを選択してください。 基本構成からアップグレードし、カスタマイズ可能な RAM や SSD などと共にハードウェアをワークロードに合わせて微調整します。
bullets.title: カスタマイズ可能

bullets.description: 2 時間から 4 時間で、世界中の IBM Cloud データ・センター内のサーバーをプロビジョンします。 今すぐオンラインにする必要がある場合、または限定的なリソースのみが必要な場合は、時間単位の Bare Metal Server を選択してください。
bullets.title: オンデマンド

bullets.description: 使用できるオプションは、シングル・プロセッサー 4 コア・アーキテクチャーからクワッド・プロセッサー 12 コア・アーキテクチャーで、最大 3 TB RAM まで可能です。 ローカル・ストレージの範囲は 800 GB から 1.2 TB の SSD で、1 サーバーあたり最大 36 ドライバーが可能です。
bullets.title: 強力

bullets.description: 最先端の GPU を搭載した Bare Metal Server をプロビジョンして、お客様の最も複雑な計算主体のワークロードを処理します。 IBM Cloud 上の NVIDIA Tesla GPU は、ハイパフォーマンスで高速の科学技術計算、データ分析、およびプロフェッショナル・グレードの仮想化グラフィックス向けに設計されています。
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: SAP 環境をオンプレミスからフルパワーの IBM Cloud に移行することにより、コスト削減、オンデマンドの柔軟性、無限の成長の可能性など、クラウドのすべての強みを実現します。 SAP HANA 4 ソケットおよび 8 ソケットの Bare Metal Server は、実動 S/4 HANA ワークロードに対して SAP 認定された、最大 8 TB RAM の Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 v4 プロセッサーを搭載しています。
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: 싱글 테넌트 베어메탈 서버는 완전한 제어, 유연성 및 보안을 위해 고객 전용으로 제공됩니다.
bullets.title: 제어 및 보안

bullets.description: 성능 요구에 가장 잘 맞는 프로세서를 선택합니다. 사용자 정의 가능한 RAM, SSD 등을 사용하여 워크로드에 맞게 하드웨어를 세부 조정하려면 기본 구성에서 업그레이드합니다.
bullets.title: 사용자 정의 가능

bullets.description: 2 - 4시간 내에 전세계 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터에서 서버를 프로비저닝합니다. 몇 분 동안 온라인 상태여야 하거나 제한된 리소스만 필요한 경우 시간별 과금 베어메탈 서버를 선택합니다.
bullets.title: On-Demand

bullets.description: 단일 프로세서 4코어 아키텍처부터 쿼드 프로세서 12코어 아키텍처까지(최대 3TB RAM) 옵션을 사용할 수 있습니다. 로컬 스토리지의 범위는 800GB부터 1.2TB SSD이며 서버당 최대 36개의 드라이버가 있습니다.
bullets.title: 강력함

bullets.description: 베어메탈 서버에 최첨단 GPU를 프로비저닝하여 가장 복잡한 컴퓨팅 집약적 워크로드를 처리합니다. IBM Cloud의 NVIDIA Tesla GPU는 과학적 계산, 데이터 분석 및 전문적 수준의 가상화된 그래픽의 고성능 가속화를 위해 설계되었습니다.
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: SAP 환경을 온프레미스 환경에서 완전한 기능을 갖춘 IBM Cloud로 전환하여 클라우드의 모든 이점(비용 감축, On-Demand 유연성 및 무제한의 성장 가능성)을 실현합니다. SAP HANA 4소켓 및 8소켓 베어메탈 서버는 프로덕션 S/4 HANA 워크로드에 대해 SAP 인증을 받았으며 Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 v4 프로세서로 구동되고 최대 8TB의 RAM을 사용할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: Um servidor bare metal de único locatário é dedicado a clientes para controle, flexibilidade e segurança completos.
bullets.title: Controle e segurança

bullets.description: Escolha um processador que atenda melhor às suas necessidades de desempenho. Faça upgrade da configuração base para fazer um ajuste preciso do hardware para a sua carga de trabalho com RAM e SSD customizáveis e mais.
bullets.title: Customizável

bullets.description: Servidores de provisão em data centers do IBM Cloud ao redor do mundo em duas a quatro horas. Se você precisar estar on-line em minutos ou apenas precisar de recursos limitados, selecione um servidor bare metal por hora.
bullets.title: On demand

bullets.description: As opções disponíveis vão de arquiteturas de quatro núcleos com processador único até arquiteturas de 12 núcleos com quatro processadores e até 3 TB de RAM. Intervalos de armazenamento local de SSDs de 800 GB até 1,2 TB e até 36 drivers por servidor.
bullets.title: Poderoso

bullets.description: Provisione servidores bare metal com GPUs de ponta para lidar com suas cargas de trabalho mais complexas com processamento intensivo de informações. Os GPUs NVIDIA Tesla no IBM Cloud são projetados para aceleração de alto desempenho de computação científica, análise de dados e gráficos virtualizados de nível profissional.
bullets.title: GPUs

bullets.description: Saia dos ambientes SAP locais e mude para o IBM Cloud totalmente desenvolvido para obter todas as vantagens da nuvem: reduções de custo, flexibilidade sob demanda e potencial de crescimento ilimitado.  Os servidores bare metal SAP HANA com quatro e oito soquetes são certificados pela SAP para a produção de cargas de trabalho S/4 HANA, desenvolvidos por processadores Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 v4, com até 8 TB de RAM.
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: 专门为客户提供了单租户裸机服务器，以实现完全控制、灵活性和安全性。
bullets.title: 控制和安全性

bullets.description: 选择能够最好地满足您的性能需求的处理器。从基本配置升级，以使用可定制 RAM 和 SSD 等调优硬件以承载所需的工作负载。
bullets.title: 可定制

bullets.description: 在 2 到 4 小时内，在全球的 IBM Cloud 数据中心供应服务器。如果需要数分钟内联机或者仅需要有限的资源，请选择每小时裸机服务器。
bullets.title: 随需应变

bullets.description: 有多种可用选项，从单处理器 4 核体系结构到四核处理器 12 核体系结构，以及最高 3 TB RAM。本地存储器的大小范围从 800 GB 到 1.2 TB SSD，每台服务器最多 36 个驱动程序。
bullets.title: 功能强大

bullets.description: 使用先进的 GPU 供应裸机服务器，以处理最复杂的计算密集型工作负载。IBM Cloud 上的 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 旨在高性能地加速科学计算、数据分析和专业级虚拟化图形。
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: 将 SAP 环境从内部部署切换到功能全面的 IBM Cloud，以实现云的所有优势：降低成本、随需应变的灵活性以及无限的增长潜力。SAP HANA 4 插槽和 8 插槽裸机服务器经过 SAP 认证，可用于生产 S/4 HANA 工作负载，采用 Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 V4 处理器，最高可达 8TB 的 RAM。
bullets.title: SAP

bullets.description: 單一承租戶裸機伺服器是專供客戶獲得完全控制、彈性及安全。
bullets.title: 控制及安全

bullets.description: 選擇最能滿足您效能需求的處理器。從基本配置升級，以使用可自訂的 RAM、SSD 等等來細部調整您工作負載的硬體。
bullets.title: 可自訂

bullets.description: 在兩到四小時的時間內，於全球 IBM Cloud 資料中心內佈建伺服器。如果您需要立即上線或只需要有限資源，請選取每小時裸機伺服器。
bullets.title: 隨需應變

bullets.description: 從單一處理器 4 核心架構到四處理器 12 核心架構且最多 3TB RAM 的可用選項。本端儲存空間的範圍從 800 GB 到 1.2 TB SSD，且每部伺服器最多 36 個驅動程式。
bullets.title: 功能強大

bullets.description: 具有尖端 GPU 的佈建裸機伺服器，可處理最複雜運算密集工作負載。IBM Cloud 上的 NVIDIA Tesla GPU 的設計目的是要獲得科學運算、資料分析及專業級虛擬化圖形的高效能加速。
bullets.title: GPU

bullets.description: 將 SAP 環境從內部部署轉換到全加強 IBM Cloud 以實現雲端的所有優點：成本削減、依彈性隨需應變及無限成長的可能。SAP HANA 4 插座及 8 插座裸機伺服器具有 SAP 認證可用於正式作業 S/4 HANA 工作負載、採用 Intel® Xeon® E7-8890 第 4 版處理器技術，且最多有 8TB 的 RAM。
bullets.title: SAP

name: bare-metal

de.description: Bare Metal Servers bieten die reine Leistung, die Sie für Ihre prozessorintensiven und Platten-E/A-intensiven Workloads benötigen. Mit diesen Servern steht Ihnen das umfassendste Paket mit Standardfeatures und -services zur Verfügung.
de.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Servers bieten Leistung, Flexibilität, bedarfsorientierte Einrichtung und Kontrolle. Wählen Sie zwischen vorkonfigurierten Servern auf Stunden- oder Monatsbasis aus oder nutzen Sie die Anpassung von Einzel- bis zu Quad-Prozessorlösungen mit 4 bis 72 Cores. Bare Metal Servers sind weltweit und ohne monatliche Verträge verfügbar, so haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die bestmögliche Lösung für Ihre Workloads zu finden.

en.description: IBM Cloud Bare Metal Servers provide performance, flexibility, on-demand provisioning, and control.
en.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Server provides performance, flexibility, on-demand provisioning, and control. Choose between hourly or monthly pre-configured servers or customize with single to quad processing solutions that range from 4 to 72 cores. Bare metal servers are available worldwide and with no monthly contracts so you can build the best solution for your workloads.

es.description: Los servidores nativos ofrecen la potencia que necesita para sus cargas de trabajo de uso intensivo de E/S de disco y de procesador. Estos servidores incluyen el paquete más completo de características y servicios.
es.long_description: Los servidores nativos de IBM ofrecen rendimiento, flexibilidad, suministro bajo demanda y control. Elija entre servidores preconfigurados por horas o mensuales, o personalícelos con soluciones de un solo procesador o procesadores cuádruples de 4 a 72 núcleos. Los servidores dedicados están disponibles de forma global sin contratos mensuales, para que pueda crear la mejor solución para sus cargas de trabajo.

fr.description: Les serveurs bare metal fournissent la puissance brute dont vous avez besoin pour vos charges de travail exigeantes en termes de processeur et d'entrée-sortie de disque. Ces serveurs sont fournis avec le package le plus complet de services et fonctions standard.
fr.long_description: Les serveurs bare metal IBM allient performances, souplesse, mise à disposition à la demande et contrôle. Choisissez entre les serveurs préconfigurés à l'heure ou au mois ou optez pour une formule personnalisée avec les solutions proposant de un à quatre processeurs s'échelonnant de 4 à 72 coeurs. Les serveurs bare metal sont disponibles dans le monde entier et sans contrats mensuels afin que vous puissiez construire la meilleure solution adaptée à vos charges de travail.

it.description: I server bare metal forniscono la potenza grezza richiesta per i carichi di lavoro a uso intensivo del processore e del disco I/O. Tali server vengono forniti con il pacchetto più completo di funzioni standard e di servizi.
it.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Server fornisce prestazioni, flessibilità, provisioning on-demand e controllo. Scegli tra server pre-configurati orari o mensili oppure personalizza il tuo ambiente con soluzioni di elaborazione da singolo a quad che spaziano da 4 a 72 core. I server bare metal sono disponibili in tutto il mondo e senza contratti mensili in modo da poter costruire la migliore soluzione per i tuoi carichi di lavoro.

ja.description: ベアメタル・サーバーは、プロセッサー集中型およびディスク入出力集中型のワークロードに対して必要な直接的な処理能力を提供します。 これらのサーバーには、標準の機能とサービスが含まれた、最も包括的なパッケージが付属しています。
ja.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Servers は、パフォーマンス、柔軟性、オンデマンド・プロビジョニング、および制御を提供します。 事前に構成されたサーバーを時間単位または月単位から選択するか、4 コアから 72 コアの範囲のシングル・プロセッサーからクワッド・プロセッサーのソリューションにカスタマイズします。 ベア・メタル・サーバーは月ごとに契約することなく世界中で利用可能であり、ワークロードに最適なソリューションを構築できます。

ko.description: Bare Metal Server는 사용자가 프로세서 집약적 워크로드와 디스크 I/O 집약적 워크로드에 대해 요구하는 뛰어난 성능을 제공합니다. 이 서버는 표준 기능 및 서비스의 가장 완벽한 패키지와 함께 제공됩니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Server는 강력한 성능, 유연성, On-Demand 프로비저닝, 제어를 제공합니다. 시간별 또는 월별 과금의 사전 구성된 서버 중에 선택하거나 4 - 72개의 코어가 있는 단일부터 쿼드 프로세서 솔루션을 사용하여 사용자 정의하십시오. Bare Metal Server는 월별 계약 없이 전세계에서 사용 가능하므로 워크로드에 가장 적합한 솔루션을 빌드할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Os servidores bare metal fornecem a potência que você procura para suas cargas de trabalho intensivas de processador e de E/S de disco. Estes servidores vêm com o mais completo pacote de recursos e serviços padrão.
pt-br.long_description: Os IBM Bare Metal Servers fornecem desempenho, flexibilidade, provisionamento sob demanda e controle. Escolha entre servidores pré-configurados de hora em hora ou mensais, ou customize com soluções de processamento único ou quádruplo que variam de 4 a 72 núcleos. Os servidores bare metal estão disponíveis no mundo inteiro e sem contratos mensais, para que seja possível projetar a melhor solução para suas cargas de trabalho.

zh-cn.description: Bare Metal Server 为处理器密集型和磁盘 I/O 密集型工作负载提供了所需的强大动力。这些服务器随附最完整的标准功能和服务包。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Server 集高性能、灵活性、可控性、随需应变配置于一体。您可选择每小时或每月预配置服务器，也可定制单处理器到四处理器解决方案（核心数为 4 到 72 个）。Bare Metal Server 可在全球范围内使用，无需签订月度合同，因此您可以为工作负载构建最佳解决方案。

zh-tw.description: Bare Metal Server 為您的處理器密集與磁碟 I/O 密集的工作負載，提供您需要的原始馬力。這些伺服器具有標準特性及服務的最完整套件。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Bare Metal Server 提供效能、彈性、隨需應變佈建，以及控制。請選擇按小時或按月的預先配置伺服器，或以單一到四個處理解決方案進行自訂，這些解決方案的範圍會從 4 個核心到 72 個核心。Bare Metal Server 可在全球使用，並且沒有每月合約，因此您可以為您的工作負載建置最佳的解決方案。

name: is.bare-metal-server

en.description: Leverage x86 servers with physical single tenancy and high performance offering end user virtualization.
en.long_description:
Bare metal servers for VPC are dedicated servers offering direct hardware performance and is integrated as a first-class compute offering within Virtual Private Cloud. Users can leverage existing VPC services across storage, networking, and security with bare metal for VPC and can incorporate its higher end hardware profiles with the additional benefit of end-user managed virtualization.

#### Pricing

##### Hourly, pay-as-you-go
Pay-as-you-go bandwidth is per gigabyte. Your billing charges accrue from provision to cancellation, and are billed in arrears. This VPC product does not support suspended billing and will continue to bill regardless of the power state. Total pricing includes bare metal server instance profiles and software, internet data transfers, and optional VPC services. Each additional component is priced separately and included as part of your total IBM Cloud VPC charge. Service tiers are bound to your account, not to any specific VPC.

description: Leverage x86 servers with physical single tenancy and high performance offering end user virtualization.
longDescription:
Bare metal servers for VPC are dedicated servers offering direct hardware performance and is integrated as a first-class compute offering within Virtual Private Cloud. Users can leverage existing VPC services across storage, networking, and security with bare metal for VPC and can incorporate its higher end hardware profiles with the additional benefit of end-user managed virtualization.

#### Pricing

##### Hourly, pay-as-you-go
Pay-as-you-go bandwidth is per gigabyte. Your billing charges accrue from provision to cancellation, and are billed in arrears. This VPC product does not support suspended billing and will continue to bill regardless of the power state. Total pricing includes bare metal server instance profiles and software, internet data transfers, and optional VPC services. Each additional component is priced separately and included as part of your total IBM Cloud VPC charge. Service tiers are bound to your account, not to any specific VPC.

Beam's Invoice Reconciliaton Agents streamlines invoice status management. Beam's agent autmatomatically
1. Detects and validates email relevance to filter invoice-related commmunications
2. Extracts key information from incoming emails and attachments including invoices and external data
3. Integrates with internal systems to check invoice status and retrieve payment and transactions history
4. Reasoning on invoice status and determining whether invoices are paid, pending, in processing, not received, or required status clarification.
5. Generates automated responses and appropiate email formatting based on invoice status.

Includes POC verficiation for addtional validation and quality assurance.


Key benefits:
1. Reduces manual invoice tracking and follow-ups up to 80%
2. Maintains accuracte records through system integration with accuracy scores at 95%
3. Provides consistent communciation with suppliers and internal teams
4. Minimizes human error by 5 - 15%
5. Scale efficiently to handle high volume invoice inquiries

en.description: Bespoken is a leader in fully automated testing for IVR systems, conversational AI, and chatbots.
en.display_name: Bespoken Automated Testing For IVR and Chat
en.long_description:
Bespoken is the AI-powered solution built to reduce the time, cost, and tedium of testing, monitoring, and scaling your contact center. 
Our platform automates testing, monitoring, and load simulation to ensure your voice and chatbot experiences are working exactly as they should — every time.

Bespoken helps your contact center deliver flawless customer interactions, reduce costs, and scale with confidence.  Our suite of tools ensures better customer experiences and better business outcomes.

The Bespoken platform consists of five products: Exploratory Testing, Functional Testing, Continuous Monitoring, Model/LLM Testing, and Load Testing.

Exploratory Testing, Functional Testing, and Continuous Monitoring are included in all Bespoken subscriptions (Self-Serve Professional, Guided Professional, and Enterprise).  Model/LLM Testing is available with Guided Professional and higher, and Load Testing is a separate product priced on the load test parameters.

name: biollm-culture-query-agent

en.description: AI-powered agent for querying and analyzing biological culture data using large language model capabilities.
en.long_description:
BioLLM Culture Query Agent is an AI-powered native agent built on IBM watsonx Orchestrate that enables researchers, lab technicians, and bioinformaticians to interact with biological culture databases using natural language queries.

The agent leverages large language model (LLM) capabilities to understand complex biological queries, retrieve relevant culture data, and deliver actionable insights—eliminating the need for specialized query languages or manual database navigation.

Key capabilities include natural language querying of culture collections, intelligent data retrieval and summarization, cross-referencing of culture metadata, and seamless integration with existing laboratory information management systems (LIMS). Whether you are managing microbial cultures, cell lines, or other biological specimens, BioLLM Culture Query Agent streamlines data access and accelerates research workflows.

name: block-storage-group

de.description: Persistenter Speicher auf iSCSI-Basis mit höchster Leistung und einer Kapazität von bis zu 12 TB.
de.long_description:
Diese Option bietet Ihnen Leistung für lokale Platten mit SAN-Persistenz und Permanenz. Erhöhen Sie die Speicherkapazität, die für Ihre IBM Cloud Virtual Server- und Bare Metal Server-Instanzen zur Verfügung steht, mit einem Maximum von 48k IOPs. Stellen Sie Blockspeicherdatenträger mit Flashspeicherunterstützung und einer Kapazität von 20 GB bis 12 TB bereit und nutzen Sie dabei eine Reihe von Anpassungsoptionen. 

Wählen Sie Endurance-Tiers für eine einfache, vordefinierte, auf GB-Einheiten basierende Preisstruktur aus - ideal für Workloads ohne eindeutig definierte Leistungsanforderungen. 
Oder erstellen Sie eine differenziert abgestimmte Umgebung mit zugeordneten IOPS und Leistungsoptionen - ideal für im Detail bekannte Workloadanforderungen außerhalb der verfügbaren Endurance-Tiers.

en.description: Persistent iSCSI based storage with high-powered performance and capacity up to 12TB.
en.long_description:
Get local disk performance with SAN persistence and durability. Increase storage capacity available to your IBM Cloud Virtual Servers and Bare Metal Servers with a maximum of 48k IOPs. Deploy flash-backed block storage volumes from 20GB to 12TB–and customize it all with a variety of capabilities. 

Choose Endurance tiers for simple, predefined, per-GB pricing—ideal for workloads without well defined performance requirements. 
Or, build a fine-tuned environment with allocated IOPS with Performance options—ideal for well-understood workload requirements that fall outside of the available Endurance tiers.

es.description: Almacenamiento basado en iSCSI persistente con rendimiento de alta potencia y capacidad de hasta 12 TB.
es.long_description:
Consiga rendimiento de disco local con duración y persistencia de SAN. Aumente la capacidad de almacenamiento disponible para sus servidores dedicados y virtuales de IBM Cloud con un máximo de 48 mil IOPS. Despliegue volúmenes de almacenamiento en bloque con soporte flash de 20 GB a 12 TB y personalícelos con una variedad de capacidades. 

Elija niveles de resistencia para obtener un establecimiento de precios simple y predefinido por GB, ideal para cargas de trabajo sin requisitos de rendimiento bien definidos. 
O bien, cree un entorno ajustado con IOPS asignadas de Rendimiento, ideal para empresas con requisitos de rendimiento bien conocidos que quedan fuera de los niveles de resistencia disponibles.

fr.description: Stockage persistant basé iSCSI avec performances haute puissance et une capacité maximale de 12 To.
fr.long_description:
Optimisez les performances de vos disques locaux grâce à la persistance et la durabilité du réseau de stockage SAN. Augmentez la capacité de stockage disponible pour vos serveurs IBM Cloud virtuels et bare metal, avec un maximum de 4800 IOPs. Déployez des volumes de stockage par blocs flash de 20 Go à 12 To, et personnalisez-les grâce à une large gamme de fonctionnalités. 

Optez pour des niveaux Endurance pour une tarification simple, prédéfinie et par Go, idéale pour charges de travail pour lesquelles les exigences de performance ne sont pas parfaitement définies. 
Ou bien, créez un environnement optimisé en choisissant des IOPS allouées avec des options Performance, idéales pour des exigences de charge de travail bien maîtrisées et qui dépassent les niveaux Endurance disponibles.

it.description: iSCSI persistente basato sull'archiviazione con prestazioni elevate e capacità fino a 12TB.
it.long_description:
Ottieni prestazioni del disco locale con durabilità e persistenza SAN. Aumenta la capacità di archiviazione disponibile per IBM Cloud Virtual Servers e Bare Metal Servers con un massimo di 48k IOPs. Distribuisci i volumi con archiviazione con supporto all-flash da  20GB a 12TB e personalizzali tutti con molte funzionalità. 

Scegli i livelli di durata per carichi di lavoro semplici, predefiniti, per GB e ideali per prezzo senza requisiti di prestazioni ben definiti. 
Oppure crea un ambiente ottimizzato con IOPS assegnati con opzioni di prestazioni ideali per requisiti del carico di lavoro ben compresi che non rientrano nei livelli di durata disponibili.

ja.description: 最大 12 TB までのハイパフォーマンスと容量を備えた、永続的な iSCSI ベースのストレージです。
ja.long_description:
SAN の永続性および耐久性を備えたローカル・ディスク・パフォーマンスを獲得します。 IBM Cloud 仮想サーバーおよびベアメタル・サーバーで、最大 48k IOP のストレージ容量を増やすことができます。 20 GB から 12 TB までの flash-backed ブロック・ストレージ・ボリュームをデプロイし、それをすべてさまざまな機能によってカスタマイズします。 

シンプルで事前定義された、GB 単位の価格設定で提供されるエンデュランス・ティアは、パフォーマンス要件が明確に定義されていないワークロードにとって理想的です。 
あるいは、パフォーマンス・オプションによって割り振られた IOPS によるきめ細かな環境の構築は、使用可能なエンデュランス・ティアの範囲外の、十分に理解されたワークロード要件にとって理想的です。

ko.description: 최대 용량이 12TB인 고성능의 지속적 iSCSI 기반 스토리지입니다.
ko.long_description:
SAN 지속성과 내구성을 통해 로컬 디스크 성능을 확보합니다. 최대 48k IOP로 IBM Cloud Virtual Server 및 Bare Metal Server에 사용 가능한 스토리지 용량을 늘립니다. 20GB - 12TB의 플래시백 블록 스토리지 볼륨을 배치하고 다양한 기능을 사용하여 모두 사용자 정의합니다. 

사전 정의된 단순한 GB당 가격을 원할 경우 Endurance 티어를 선택하십시오. 이는 성능 요구사항이 제대로 정의되지 않은 워크로드에 적합합니다. 
또는 성능 옵션을 통해 할당된 IOPS로 세부 조정된 환경을 빌드하십시오. 이는 사용 가능한 Endurance 티어를 벗어나는 워크로드 요구사항이 명확한 경우에 적합합니다.

pt-br.description: Armazenamento baseado em iSCSI persistente com desempenho altamente poderoso e capacidade de até 12 TB.
pt-br.long_description:
Obtenha desempenho de disco local com persistência e durabilidade de SAN. Aumente a capacidade de armazenamento disponível dos seus IBM Cloud Virtual Servers e Bare Metal Servers com um máximo de IOPs de 48k. Implemente volumes de armazenamento de bloco suportados por atualização de 20GB a 12TB e customize tudo com uma variedade de capacidades. 

Escolha camadas do Endurance para precificação por GB simples e predefinida: ideais para cargas de trabalho sem requisitos de desempenho bem definidos. 
Ou construa um ambiente ajustado com IOPs alocados com opções do Performance: ideal para requisitos de carga de trabalho bem compreendidos que não são abrangidos pelas camadas disponíveis do Endurance.

zh-cn.description: 高性能基于持久性 iSCSI 的存储器，容量最高至 12 TB。
zh-cn.long_description:
通过 SAN 的持续性和耐久性获得本地磁盘的性能。增大最大 IOPS 为 48000 的 IBM Cloud Virtual Server 和 Bare Metal Server 的存储容量。部署从 20 GB 到 12 TB 的基于闪存的块存储卷 - 并使用各种功能对所有块存储卷进行定制。

为简单、预定义的按 GB 计算的定价选择“耐久性”层 - 最适用于没有明确定义性能需求的工作负载。
或者，使用“性能”选项构建具有已分配 IOPS 的微调环境 - 最适用于充分了解工作负载需求超出可用“耐久性”层的情况。

zh-tw.description: 持續性的 iSCSI 型儲存空間，並且具備強大效能與最多 12TB 的容量。
zh-tw.long_description:
取得具有 SAN 持續性及延續性的本端磁碟效能。增加可供您 IBM Cloud Virtual Server 及 Bare Metal Server 使用的儲存空間容量，最多可達 48k IOPS。部署快閃記憶體支援的區塊儲存空間磁區，從 20GB 到 12TB，並且以各種功能徹底自訂。

選擇「耐久性」層級可獲得簡單、預先定義、以每 GB 為基礎的定價—最適合沒有完整定義之效能需求的工作負載。
或者，使用已配置 IOPS 與「效能」選項，建置微調的環境—最適合清楚瞭解且落在可用「耐久性」層級以外的工作負載需求。

Block Storage for Virtual Private Cloud bietet eine konsistente Leistung mit geringstmöglicher Latenzzeit für die Unterstützung Ihrer Workloads.   Es können Blockspeicherdatenträger mit einer Kapazität von bis zu 2 TB bei bis zu 20.000 IOPS (E/A-Operationen pro Sekunde) bereitgestellt werden.

en.description: Persistent storage for use as boot and data storage for  Virtual Servers in a VPC network.
en.long_description:
Get local disk performance with SAN persistence and durability. Increase storage capacity available to your IBM Cloud Virtual Servers with a maximum of 48k IOPS. Deploy flash-backed block storage volumes from 20GB to 16TB–and customize it all with a variety of capabilities.

Choose an IOPS tier profile for simple, predefined, per-GB pricing—ideal for workloads without well-defined performance requirements.

plans.name: gen2-volume-sdp

en.description:
With the sdp profile (latest generation), you can provision block storage volumes in VPC with capacity starting from 1 GB and up to 32,000 GB. This profile allows you to customize capacity, IOPS and throughput independently of each other based on your application needs, enabling you to scale volume performance independently of volume size. 

Sdp volumes deliver a baseline IOPS performance of 3,000 IOPS and a baseline throughput performance of 125 MB/s, both of which (IOPS and throughput) are included with the price of storage. You can provision additional IOPS (up to 64,000) and throughput (up to 1,024 MB/s) at an additional price.

Pricing for the sdp profile is based on a combination of capacity plus IOPS and throughput performance. Price for capacity and performance is calculated using a linear model, the price will scale linearly depending on the volume size, IOPS and throughput you select.

description: Persistent storage for use as boot and data storage for  Virtual Servers in a VPC network.
longDescription:
Get local disk performance with SAN persistence and durability. Increase storage capacity available to your IBM Cloud Virtual Servers with a maximum of 48k IOPS. Deploy flash-backed block storage volumes from 20GB to 16TB–and customize it all with a variety of capabilities.

Choose an IOPS tier profile for simple, predefined, per-GB pricing—ideal for workloads without well-defined performance requirements.

Or, build a fine-tuned environment with allocated IOPS using a Custom IOPS profile—ideal for workloads without well-understood requirements that fall outside of the predefined IOPS tiers.

en.description: The ID of a given snapshot

bullets.description: You can create point in time copies of your data with our snapshot feature and copy data to another data center for disaster recovery readiness.
bullets.title: Data volume snapshots

bullets.description: You can take a snapshot of a boot volume that is attached to a running virtual server instance. Later, you can create a virtual server instance that is initialized with a boot volume that is created from that snapshot. The instance profile of the new instance doesn't need to match the original profile that was used to create the snapshot.
bullets.title: Boot volume snapshots

bullets.description: You can take snapshots of all the block storage volumes that are attached to a virtual server simultaneously. These snapshots are loosely coupled. They can be managed individually and be used to create new volumes or restore a virtual server instance.
bullets.title: Consistency groups

bullets.description: You can take up to 100 snapshots per volume in your region. The cumulative size of all snapshots for a volume can be up to 10 TB.
bullets.title: Capacity

bullets.description: Snapshots inherit the encryption type from the source block storage volume. Your data is protected either by provider-managed encryption, or by using your own root keys.
bullets.title: Encryption for data security

bullets.description: You can create and keep a clone of the snapshot in another zone within your region instead of a Cloud Object Storage bucket. Restoring a volume by using a fast restore clone creates a fully functioning volume much faster than a normal snapshot, which helps reducing recovery time during an incident.
bullets.title: Fast restore clones

bullets.description: Snapshots of your block storage volumes are stored in Object Storage in the same region as your VPC. You can copy your snapshots to another region and use them to restore volumes in a different geography.
bullets.title: Global footprint

bullets.description: Billing is affected by the size and the number of snapshots that you keep in various regions. Data transfer charges also apply when you copy snapshots to another region.
bullets.title: Flexible billing

name: is.snapshot

de.description: Regionaler Snapshot-Service für sichere Backups von Blockspeicherdaten in IBM Cloud Object Storage
de.long_description: Der Block Storage Snapshots for VPC-Service ermöglicht regionale, inkrementelle Backups Ihrer Blockspeicherdatenträger.

en.description: Back up block storage volumes to IBM Cloud Object Storage with this regional snapshot service.
en.long_description:
With this service, you can create point-in-time copies of your block storage boot and data volumes. The snapshots are stored in Cloud Object Storage.

The first snapshot is a full backup of the volume. The subsequent snapshots of the same volume are incremental; they capture only the changes that occurred since the last snapshot was taken. 

You can take snapshots of individual volumes and you can create a consistency group to take snapshots of multiple volumes that are attached to the same VSI simultaneously.

You can use these snapshots later to create stand-alone data volumes, provision new virtual server instances, or add new data volumes to existing virtual server instance. You can use the snapshots to recover operations after a disastrous event or to expand your VPC to other regions.

description: Back up block storage volumes to IBM Cloud Object Storage with this regional snapshot service.
longDescription:
With this service, you can create point-in-time copies of your block storage boot and data volumes. The snapshots are stored in Cloud Object Storage.

The first snapshot is a full backup of the volume. The subsequent snapshots of the same volume are incremental; they capture only the changes that occurred since the last snapshot was taken. 

You can take snapshots of individual volumes and you can create a consistency group to take snapshots of multiple volumes that are attached to the same VSI simultaneously.

You can use these snapshots later to create stand-alone data volumes, provision new virtual server instances, or add new data volumes to existing virtual server instance. You can use the snapshots to recover operations after a disastrous event or to expand your VPC to other regions.

en.description: Branch FLOW™ is an AI-powered operations agent providing real-time insights into branch demand, utilization, and wait times.
en.long_description:
Branch FLOW™ enables institutions to transform branch operational data into actionable intelligence that improves customer experience, workforce productivity, and operational efficiency.

The platform continuously analyzes branch demand, serving capacity, transaction patterns, staffing levels, and utilization metrics to identify operational stress, peak traffic periods, service bottlenecks, and emerging operational risks. By combining operational analytics with AI-driven decision support, Branch FLOW™ helps branch managers, operations teams, and business leaders make faster, more informed decisions.

Through a conversational AI experience, users can explore branch performance using natural language. The platform provides visibility into operational stress, staffing effectiveness, wait-time risks, queue pressure, utilization trends, and capacity constraints, enabling proactive intervention before service levels are impacted.

Powered by a proprietary six-signal scoring engine, Branch FLOW™ moves organizations beyond traditional reporting to always-on operational intelligence. Helps organizations improve service consistency, reduce customer wait times, optimize workforce allocation, enhance operational productivity, and accelerate decision-making.

Acting as an intelligent orchestration layer, it manages proactive outreach through specialized care programs, including appointment recalls and appointment reminders.

Hubkom AI Care Coordinator leverages advanced conversational intelligence to streamline medical administrative tasks that traditionally place a heavy burden on front-desk staff. Through specialized care workflows, it evaluates patient records, identifies care gaps, initiates timely outreach, schedules appointments, answers common clinical and administrative questions, assesses follow-up needs, and supports multilingual patient interactions to improve access and continuity of care.

Designed to coordinate multiple AI-driven patient engagement workflows, the Care Coordinator intelligently routes each conversation to the appropriate care program while maintaining a seamless and personalized patient experience. This modular architecture enables healthcare organizations to expand automation across new outreach initiatives without changing the patient experience.

Built by Hubkom Solutions, a provider dedicated to empowering medical practices with physician-designed smart support and secure digital health solutions.

en.long_description:
# CopyAssure – Clean, Fast, and Secure Cyber Recovery for IBM PowerVS

**CopyAssure** is Celerity’s advanced cyber recovery and data resilience solution for **IBM Power Virtual Server (PowerVS)** environments, supporting **IBM i, AIX, and Linux**.  
Built for mission-critical workloads, CopyAssure delivers automated, verified recovery using continuously tested backup copies. Based on IBM’s **Cyber Vault blueprint**, it combines frequent data copies, immutable storage, cleanroom validation, and end-to-end orchestration—helping organisations recover with confidence from even the most disruptive cyberattacks and more.

CopyAssure can also be leveraged to spin up clean, digital twin system copies for testing, development, or even **AI training**—without risking the integrity of the core environment.

Find out more: https://celerity-uk.com/data-security-and-resilience/copyassure

---

### Key Features

---

### Scheduled Snapshots, Cloning & Exports with Continuous Testing

CopyAssure orchestrates scheduled snapshots, volume clones, and optional image export to IBM Cloud Object Storage (COS) to provide layered, resilient recovery points with immutability. These are continuously tested to demonstrate recoverability within defined RPO and RTO thresholds.

To extend assurance further, the service includes automated system validation through a proprietary virtual operator. This technology emulates real user interactions—such as 5250 terminal sessions for IBM i, and interactive workloads for AIX and Linux—to verify that systems are fully operational post-recovery.

---

### Proactive Air-Gapped Copies

CopyAssure leverages PowerVS volume clone technology to create logically air-gapped snapshots. This approach provides an additional layer of defence against ransomware and insider threats by ensuring backup copies are inaccessible from compromised systems.

---

### Immutable Data Protection

CopyAssure supports image export to IBM Cloud Object Storage (COS) using write-once, read-many (WORM) storage, providing immutable backup copies protected against tampering, deletion, or ransomware encryption. This capability supports long-term data integrity and aligns with regulatory and audit-readiness requirements.

---

### Continuous Recoverability Validation

Aligned with IBM’s Cyber Vault methodology, CopyAssure provisions secure cleanroom environments to validate cloned backups prior to restoration. This process proves that a system is fully recoverable through controlled boot procedures, OS-level checks, and bespoke validation of user activity and application services.

**The validation framework includes multiple stages:**

- **T1 – System Validation**: Confirms successful boot and core OS integrity  
- **T2 – Application Validation**: Verifies application availability and service responsiveness  
- **T3 – Data Validation**: Confirms access to critical data and consistency within key datasets

This multi-layered approach ensures only clean, operational recovery points are promoted for restoration.

---

### Fully Automated Workflow

CopyAssure delivers end-to-end automation across backup validation and recovery orchestration. By removing manual steps, the service improves consistency, reduces human error, and accelerates recovery across complex environments—enabling repeatable, policy-driven execution at scale.

---

### NIST-Aligned Architecture

CopyAssure is aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, supporting the core functions of Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover. This alignment helps organisations strengthen their cyber resilience strategy, meet regulatory expectations, and streamline audit readiness.

---

### Operational Continuity

CopyAssure enables secure, verified recovery without interrupting production systems. All validation and testing occur in isolated cleanroom environments, ensuring non-disruptive assurance for high-availability workloads and regulated operations. This supports continuous business operations, even during threat response or audit preparation.

---

### Cost Efficiency

CopyAssure helps reduce both direct and hidden costs associated with cyber recovery—including unplanned downtime, manual recovery labour, extended investigation cycles, and potential ransomware-related losses. Automated processes and cleanroom validation reduce operational burden while accelerating time-to-recovery.

---

### Peace of Mind

With immutable storage, automated cleanroom validation, and proven recovery workflows, CopyAssure gives organisations confidence that every restore point is secure, tested, and reliable. This assurance supports both operational resilience and regulatory compliance.

en.long_description:
# Expert Power Systems Services for PowerVS and Hybrid Cloud

### Ensure Resilience, Security, and Performance

Expert services for IBM i, AIX, and Linux on Power to ensure critical workloads in PowerVS and hybrid cloud remain resilient, secure, and performant.

---

### Migration to PowerVS

- Full end-to-end workload migrations for IBM i, AIX, and Linux on Power—with minimal downtime.
- Industry-leading replication tools ensure data integrity and seamless cutover without disrupting operations.
- Support for deploying cloud-native applications and AI to IBM i and AIX VMs in PowerVS.
- Modernise data management by moving away from traditional tape and multiple VTL instances.

---

### Disaster Recovery (DR) in the Cloud

- Proven DR strategies for IBM i, AIX, and Linux on Power, tailored to environments of any size.
- DR designs that dynamically scale to match production capacity.
- Testing and validation to ensure DR readiness and reliability.

---

### System Design and Sizing in PowerVS

- Expert resource planning for compute, storage, and network requirements.
- Design includes secure routing, workload optimization, and hybrid or multi-cloud integration.

---

### Data Resilience in the Cloud

- Cloud-based VTL solutions and native storage backups.
- Use of software replication and snapshot technology for layered protection.
- Cross-cloud and hybrid replication options for added resilience.

---

### Ongoing Support and Monitoring

- Proactive monitoring and support for IBM i, AIX, and Linux workloads in PowerVS.
- Ensure continuous system health, performance, and compliance.

---

### Security for IBM Power Workloads in PowerVS

- TLS and certificate management across platforms.
- IBM i exit point controls and hardened remote access.
- OS-level lockdowns and configuration reviews for AIX and Linux.
- Continuous compliance assessments.

---

### SIEM Integration

- Centralised log and event forwarding to your SIEM platform.
- Support for IBM i logs, AIX syslogs, and Linux event streams.
- Integration with cloud or on-prem SIEM, configured and tuned by our SOC experts.

---

### Scoping Our Professional Services

- Engagements begin with a structured discovery phase to define scope and objectives.
- All services are delivered remotely via secure connections.
- Regular communication and reporting ensure project visibility and success.

de.description: Controller für Anwendungsbereitstellung des Anbieters Citrix mit umfassender administrativer Steuerung.
de.long_description: Citrix NetScaler VPX ist ein branchenführender Controller für Anwendungsleistung, der die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Geschäftsanwendungen auf beliebigen Geräten und an beliebigen Standorten ermöglicht und gleichzeitig einen überragenden Lastausgleich mit Layer-4 und Layer-7, erweiterte Anwendungsoptimierung und eine unerreichte Sicherheit bereitstellt. Der Einsatz ist möglich für Ihren lokalen Lastausgleich beim Datenverkehr zwischen Servern innerhalb eines einzigen Rechenzentrums und auch für den globalen Lastausgleich zwischen Servern, die auf mehrere Rechenzentren verteilt sind.

en.description: Application delivery controller from vendor Citrix with complete administrative control.
en.long_description: Citrix NetScaler VPX is an industry-leading application delivery controller that enables seamless delivery of business applications - to any device and location – with superior layer 4-7 load balancing, advanced application optimization and unmatched security. It can be used for local load balancing of traffic among servers within a single data center and also global load balancing of traffic among servers spread across multiple data centers.

es.description: Controlador de entrega de aplicaciones del proveedor Citrix con un control administrativo completo.
es.long_description: Citrix NetScaler VPX es un controlador de entrega de aplicaciones líder en el sector que permite la entrega ininterrumpida de aplicaciones empresariales a cualquier dispositivo y ubicación, con una optimización avanzada de aplicaciones, un equilibrio de carga superior de las capas 4-7 y una seguridad sin precedentes. Puede utilizarse para el equilibrio de carga local del tráfico entre servidores dentro de un mismo centro de datos y para el equilibrio de carga global del tráfico entre servidores distribuidos en varios centros de datos.

fr.description: Contrôleur de distribution d'application élaboré par Citrix avec un contrôle administratif complet.

Il peut être utilisé pour l'équilibrage de charge local du trafic entre les serveurs présents dans un centre de données et également pour l'équilibrage de charge global entre les serveurs présents dans plusieurs centres de données.

Può essere utilizzato per il bilanciamento locale del traffico tra i server all'interno di un singolo data center ed il bilanciamento del carico globale del traffico tra i server presenti in più data center.

name: nexar-workzone-permits

en.description: Automated AI Work zone compliance monitoring tool
en.long_description:
Nexar's Work Zone Compliance Solution eliminates the need for cities to send inspectors into the field to verify whether construction activity is properly permitted. By leveraging a nationwide network of dashcam-equipped vehicles that continuously capture street-level imagery, the platform uses AI vision models to automatically detect construction equipment and cross-reference those detections against official permit databases in real time. Cities can monitor every active work zone across their jurisdiction simultaneously, flag unpermitted activity as it appears, and issue enforcement actions directly from a single console.

For municipal agencies managing thousands of permits with limited staff, this means dramatically faster violation detection, higher compliance rates, and increased revenue recovery from civil penalties — all without adding headcount. The platform integrates with IBM watsonx Orchestrate to let operators query compliance data conversationally, generate maps of active violations, and drill into specific locations with full photographic evidence and permit context. It turns work zone enforcement from a reactive, labor-intensive process into a continuous, automated intelligence layer over the city's streets.

Guided onboarding and shared Customer Success Manager

de.description: Stellen Sie von überall eine sichere Verbindung zu Ihren IBM Cloud-Ressourcen über einen Client-zu-Site-VPN-Server her.
de.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC stellt eine Open-Source-fähige Client-to-Site-VPN-Lösung bereit, mit der Benutzer über sichere, verschlüsselte Verbindungen eine Verbindung zu IBM Cloud-Ressourcen herstellen können.  Wenn Ihre Benutzer über Fernzugriff arbeiten, reisen oder sich an einem Standort ohne eine Site-to-Site-VPN-Verbindung befinden, können sie einen OpenVPN-Client verwenden, um eine Verbindung zu VPN-Servern in Ihrer IBM Cloud VPC herzustellen.

en.description: Securely connect to your IBM Cloud resources from anywhere through a client-to-site VPN server.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC provides an open-source compatible client-to-site VPN solution that allows users to connect to IBM Cloud resources through secure, encrypted connections.  When your users are working remotely, traveling or at a location without a site-to-site VPN connection, they can use an OpenVPN client to connect to VPN servers on your IBM Cloud VPC.

es.description: Conéctese de forma segura a los recursos de IBM Cloud desde cualquier lugar a través de un servidor VPN de cliente a sitio.
es.long_description: El cliente VPN for VPC de IBM Cloud proporciona una solución de VPN de cliente a sitio compatible con código abierto que permite a los usuarios conectarse a los recursos de IBM Cloud a través de conexiones seguras y cifradas.  Cuando los usuarios estén trabajando de forma remota, viajando o en una ubicación sin una conexión VPN de sitio a sitio, pueden utilizar un cliente OpenVPN para conectarse a servidores VPN en su VPC de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: Connectez-vous en toute sécurité à vos ressources IBM Cloud depuis n'importe où via un serveur VPN client-à-site.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC est une solution VPN client vers site compatible open source qui permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter aux ressources IBM Cloud par le biais de connexions sécurisées et chiffrées.  Lorsque vos utilisateurs travaillent à distance, qu'ils sont en déplacement ou qu'is se trouvent dans un lieu dépourvu de connexion VPN de site à site, ils peuvent utiliser un client OpenVPN pour se connecter aux serveurs VPN sur votre IBM Cloud VPC.

it.description: Connettiti in modo sicuro alle tue risorse IBM Cloud da qualsiasi luogo tramite un server VPN client-to-site.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC fornisce una soluzione VPN da client a sito compatibile con open source che consente agli utenti di connettersi alle risorse IBM Cloud attraverso connessioni sicure e crittografate.  Quando gli utenti lavorano in remoto, sono in viaggio o in un'ubicazione sprovvista di connettività VPN da sito a sito, possono utilizzare un client OpenVPN per connettersi ai server VPN su IBM Cloud VPC.

ja.description: クライアントとサイト間の VPN サーバーを介して、どこからでも IBM Cloud リソースに安全に接続できます。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC は、ユーザーがセキュアな暗号化された接続を介して IBM Cloud のリソースに接続できるようにする、オープンソース互換のクライアントとサイト間の VPN ソリューションを提供します。  ユーザーがリモートで作業していたり、移動中であったり、サイト間 VPN 接続がない場所にいる場合、OpenVPN クライアントを使用して IBM Cloud VPC 上の VPC サーバーに接続できます。

ko.description: 어디에서든 IBM Cloud 자원에 안전하게 연결하려면 클라이언트-사이트 VPN 서버를 통해 연결하십시오.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC는 사용자가 안전하며 암호화된 연결을 통해 IBM Cloud 리소스에 연결할 수 있도록 하는, 오픈 소스이며 호환 가능한 클라이언트 대 사이트 VPN 솔루션을 제공합니다.  원격으로 작업하거나 이동 중이거나 사이트 간 VPN 연결이 없는 위치에 있는 경우 OpenVPN 클라이언트를 사용하여 IBM Cloud VPC에서 VPN 서버에 연결할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Conecte-se com segurança aos recursos da IBM Cloud de qualquer lugar por meio de um servidor VPN cliente para site.
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC fornece uma solução VPN de cliente para site compatível com software livre que permite que os usuários se conectem aos recursos da IBM Cloud por meio de conexões criptografadas seguras.  Quando seus usuários estiverem trabalhando remotamente, viajando ou estiverem em um local sem uma conexão VPN de site para site, eles poderão usar um cliente OpenVPN para se conectarem a servidores VPN em sua IBM Cloud VPC.

zh-cn.description: 通过客户机到站点 VPN 服务器从任何位置安全地连接到 IBM Cloud 资源。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud 客户机 VPN for VPC 提供兼容开放式源代码的客户机到站点 VPN 解决方案，允许用户通过安全的加密连接来连接至 IBM Cloud 资源。  当用户远程工作、出差或者在没有站点到站点 VPN 连接的位置工作时，他们可以使用 OpenVPN 客户端连接到 IBM Cloud VPC 上的 VPN 服务器。

zh-tw.description: 透過用戶端對網站 VPN 伺服器，從任何地方安全地連接至 IBM Cloud 資源。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Client VPN for VPC 提供開放程式碼相容用戶端至網站 VPN 解決方案，可讓使用者透過安全且加密的連線連接至 IBM Cloud 資源。  如果您的使用者在遠端工作、旅行或在沒有網站至網站 VPN 連線的位置工作，他們可以使用 OpenVPN 用戶端連接至 IBM Cloud VPC 上的 VPN 伺服器。
