en.description: Wanclouds' Custom Multi-Cloud Migrations and Disaster Recovery as a Service offering for IBM
en.display_name: Custom Migrations DR and Managed Service
en.long_description:
This is a fully-managed and accelerated way of taking your current environment, be it on-premises or cloud, and backing it or migrating  as well as managing it post-migration to your desired IBM cloud account and region. 


With this offering we can backup, restore, migrate, and manage:

- IBM Cloud VSIs & Data
- VMWare Infrastructure on-prem
- VMware VMs and Data on-premise or within IBM Classic or AWS
- On Premise Linux, Window, Data, OpenShift, K8s, Data
- Kubernetes and Red Hat Openshift
- IKS and ROKS clusters
- AWS VMs, Data, EKS, VPC Resources
- Google Cloud VMs, GKE, Data, and Workloads
- Microsoft Azure VMs, AKS, Data and workloads
- On Prem IBM Power System LPARs (AIX, IBMi, x86, Linux on Power )

to:

- IBM Cloud
- IBM Cloud Classic
- IBM Cloud Satellite (for Red Hat Openshift)


Disaster Recovery Setup and Migration scenarios coverage;

- VMware (on-premise) to IBM Cloud VPC
- VMware (in Classic) to Cloud VPC
- VMware (on-premise) to VMware on Cloud
- Red Hat Openshift to Red Hat Openshift on Cloud
- Kubernetes deployments from on-prem or other public clouds
- Linux Servers (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS, SUSE, Debian versions supported by cloud)
- Windows Servers (versions supported by cloud)
- Data and Storage

Managed Service:

- Setup, Configure, and Maintain IBM Cloud Environment (VPC)
- Device Management (Linux, Windows, FWs, LBs)
- Help customer setup and maintain security policies, ACLs, and Firewalls
- Backup IBM Cloud VPC workloads to the same or different regions (VPC Configs, VSIs, Kubernetes, Red Hat Openshift)
- Manage IBM IKS (Kubernetes) and ROKS (Red Hat Openshift)
- Optimize Cloud Infrastructure and Cloud Spending
- Ongong Consultation regarding changes, scaling, optimizing infrastructure
- Infrastructure Monitoring
- 8x5 support (This doesn't replace IBM's 24x7 cloud support)

Our team of experts leverage our VPC+ Automation Suite which is hosted on IBM Cloud to fast-track the entire process and eliminate the long, complicated and error-prone manual processes.

There are three categories of this offering:

- Disaster Recovery as a Service
- Migrations as a Service
- Ongoing Managed Service

Disaster Recovery as a Service:

- Minimum of 1 year subscription
- Kick-off, Onboard the customer on VPC+
- Discover source environment
- Setup Cloud VPC Infrastructure for DR
- Backup workloads to cloud object store
- Configure DR scenario according to customer RPO, RTO goals
- Provide cloud support for the DR setup
- Customer to facilitate access and actively collaborate with   Wanclouds
- All source OSs and software must be compatible with cloud


Migrations as a Service (MaaS):

The following tasks are involved:
- Kick-off
- Project/Program Management 
- Discover the source environment
- Workout migration timeline and schedule
- Design and Setup the Cloud environment 
- Perform the migration in the least disruptive manner using VPC+
- Verify that everything is working as expected
- Customer to facilitate access to the source and cloud environments and actively collaborate with Wanclouds
- Migration tasks are completed within 4-6 weeks
- Post Migration cloud support 
-    Options of 1 month, 3 months, 1 year
-    8x5 workdays - support portal 
- All source OSs and software must be compatible with cloud

Managed Service

- Mininum 1 year subscription


Why choose Wanclouds ?

- Fast, simple, and accelerated timelines
- Comprehensive coverage for diverse resources and platforms
- Efficient RTO and Flexible RPO
- Setup Cold DR, Warm DR, or Hot DR
- Comprehensive - Single Pane of Glass for VMware, Kubernetes, Data, and Cloud Infra.
- Flexible DR - On-Prem to Cloud and across Clouds
- Encryption - in transit and at rest
- Non-Disruptive to running environments
- Cost-effective
- Fully managed - no need to learn clouds, multiple tools



Learn more: https://www.wanclouds.net/ibm

description: Wanclouds' Custom Multi-Cloud Migrations and Disaster Recovery as a Service offering for IBM
longDescription:
This is a fully-managed and accelerated way of taking your current environment, be it on-premises or cloud, and backing it or migrating  as well as managing it post-migration to your desired IBM cloud account and region. 


With this offering we can backup, restore, migrate, and manage:

- IBM Cloud VSIs & Data
- VMWare Infrastructure on-prem
- VMware VMs and Data on-premise or within IBM Classic or AWS
- On Premise Linux, Window, Data, OpenShift, K8s, Data
- Kubernetes and Red Hat Openshift
- IKS and ROKS clusters
- AWS VMs, Data, EKS, VPC Resources
- Google Cloud VMs, GKE, Data, and Workloads
- Microsoft Azure VMs, AKS, Data and workloads
- On Prem IBM Power System LPARs (AIX, IBMi, x86, Linux on Power )

to:

- IBM Cloud
- IBM Cloud Classic
- IBM Cloud Satellite (for Red Hat Openshift)


Disaster Recovery Setup and Migration scenarios coverage;

- VMware (on-premise) to IBM Cloud VPC
- VMware (in Classic) to Cloud VPC
- VMware (on-premise) to VMware on Cloud
- Red Hat Openshift to Red Hat Openshift on Cloud
- Kubernetes deployments from on-prem or other public clouds
- Linux Servers (RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS, SUSE, Debian versions supported by cloud)
- Windows Servers (versions supported by cloud)
- Data and Storage

Managed Service:

- Setup, Configure, and Maintain IBM Cloud Environment (VPC)
- Device Management (Linux, Windows, FWs, LBs)
- Help customer setup and maintain security policies, ACLs, and Firewalls
- Backup IBM Cloud VPC workloads to the same or different regions (VPC Configs, VSIs, Kubernetes, Red Hat Openshift)
- Manage IBM IKS (Kubernetes) and ROKS (Red Hat Openshift)
- Optimize Cloud Infrastructure and Cloud Spending
- Ongong Consultation regarding changes, scaling, optimizing infrastructure
- Infrastructure Monitoring
- 8x5 support (This doesn't replace IBM's 24x7 cloud support)

Our team of experts leverage our VPC+ Automation Suite which is hosted on IBM Cloud to fast-track the entire process and eliminate the long, complicated and error-prone manual processes.

There are three categories of this offering:

- Disaster Recovery as a Service
- Migrations as a Service
- Ongoing Managed Service

Disaster Recovery as a Service:

- Minimum of 1 year subscription
- Kick-off, Onboard the customer on VPC+
- Discover source environment
- Setup Cloud VPC Infrastructure for DR
- Backup workloads to cloud object store
- Configure DR scenario according to customer RPO, RTO goals
- Provide cloud support for the DR setup
- Customer to facilitate access and actively collaborate with   Wanclouds
- All source OSs and software must be compatible with cloud


Migrations as a Service (MaaS):

The following tasks are involved:
- Kick-off
- Project/Program Management 
- Discover the source environment
- Workout migration timeline and schedule
- Design and Setup the Cloud environment 
- Perform the migration in the least disruptive manner using VPC+
- Verify that everything is working as expected
- Customer to facilitate access to the source and cloud environments and actively collaborate with Wanclouds
- Migration tasks are completed within 4-6 weeks
- Post Migration cloud support 
-    Options of 1 month, 3 months, 1 year
-    8x5 workdays - support portal 
- All source OSs and software must be compatible with cloud

Managed Service

- Mininum 1 year subscription


Why choose Wanclouds ?

- Fast, simple, and accelerated timelines
- Comprehensive coverage for diverse resources and platforms
- Efficient RTO and Flexible RPO
- Setup Cold DR, Warm DR, or Hot DR
- Comprehensive - Single Pane of Glass for VMware, Kubernetes, Data, and Cloud Infra.
- Flexible DR - On-Prem to Cloud and across Clouds
- Encryption - in transit and at rest
- Non-Disruptive to running environments
- Cost-effective
- Fully managed - no need to learn clouds, multiple tools



Learn more: https://www.wanclouds.net/ibm

For any help, please go to https://support.wanclouds.net or email us at support@wanclouds.net
For sales related queries, please contact usat sales@wanclouds.net

name: data-virtualization

de.description: Daten anzeigen, aufrufen, ändern und analysieren, ohne dass ein Verschieben der Daten erforderlich ist.
de.long_description: Seit Jahrzehnten versuchen Unternehmen, Datensilos aufzugliedern, indem sie Daten aus verschiedenen Betriebssystemen zur Analyse in zentrale Datenspeicher kopieren, wie z. B. Datamarts, Data-Warehouses und Data-Lakes. Diese Methoden können kostenintensiv und fehleranfällig sein. Dabei kämpfen die meisten Unternehmen mit der Verwaltung von durchschnittlich 33 unterschiedlichen Datenquellen, die verschiedene Strukturen aufweisen und sich häufig in schwer zugänglichen Datensilos befinden. Mit Data Virtualization können Sie Daten über viele Systeme hinweg abfragen, ohne sie kopieren und replizieren zu müssen, was Zeit und Kosten spart. Data Virtualization fragt Daten direkt an der Quelle ab und vereinfacht Ihre Analysen, indem es die neuesten und genauesten Daten bereitstellt.

en.description: Lite-tier provisioning is no longer available due to the sunsetting of Data Virtualization as a Service (DVaaS). Enterprise-tier provisioning remains available and now requires approval from a product manager
en.long_description: For decades, companies have tried to break down silos by copying data from different operational systems into central data stores for analysis, such as data marts, data warehouses and data lakes. These methods can be costly and are prone to error. Most struggle to manage an average of 33 unique data sources, which are diverse in structure and often trapped within inaccessible data silos. With Data Virtualization, you can query data across many systems without having to copy and replicate it, saving time and reducing costs. Data Virtualization queries data from its source, simplifying your analytics by providing the latest and most accurate data.

es.description: Vea, acceda, manipule y analice los datos sin moverlos.
es.long_description: Durante décadas, las empresas han tratado de romper el aislamiento de los grandes contenedores de datos copiando datos de diferentes sistemas operativos en almacenes de datos centrales para su análisis, como depósitos de datos, almacenes de datos y lagos de datos. Estos métodos pueden ser costosos y son propensos al error. La mayoría tiene dificultades para gestionar un promedio de 33 fuentes de datos únicas, que son diversas en la estructura y, a menudo, se quedan atrapados dentro de silos de datos inaccesibles. Con Data Virtualization, puede consultar datos en muchos sistemas sin tener que copiarlos y replicarlos, ahorrando tiempo y reduciendo costes. Data Virtualization consulta los datos desde su origen, lo que simplifica el análisis proporcionando los datos más recientes y más precisos.

fr.description: Affichez, manipulez, analysez et accédez à vos données sans les déplacer.
fr.long_description: Pendant des décennies, les sociétés se sont efforcées de mettre fin aux cloisonnements en copiant des données de différents systèmes d'exploitation vers des magasins de données centralisés, tels que les entrepôts et les lacs de données. Ces méthodes peuvent être coûteuses et sujettes à erreur. La plupart ont des difficultés pour gérer en moyenne 33 sources de données uniques, dont la structure est hétérogène et qui sont piégées dans des silos de données inaccessibles. Avec Data Virtualization, vous pouvez interroger des données dans de nombreux systèmes sans avoir à les copier et les reproduire, ce qui vous permet de gagner du temps et de réduire les coûts. Data Virtualization interroge les données de sa source, simplifiant vos analyses en fournissant les données les plus récentes et les plus exactes.

it.description: Visualizza, accedi, manipola e analizza i tuoi dati senza spostarli.
it.long_description: Per decenni le aziende hanno cercato di abbattere i silos copiando dati da diversi sistemi operativi in archivi di dati centrali per l'analisi, come i data mart, i data warehouse e i data lake. Questi metodi possono essere costosi e sono soggetti a errori. La maggior parte delle aziende ha difficoltà a gestire una media di 33 fonti di dati uniche, diverse nella struttura e spesso intrappolate in silos di dati inaccessibili. Con Data Virtualization è possibile interrogare i dati su diversi sistemi senza doverli copiare e replicare, risparmiando tempo e riducendo i costi. Data Virtualization interroga i dati all'origine, semplificando la vostra analisi in quanto fornisce i dati più recenti e accurati.

ja.description: データを移動せずに、データの表示、アクセス、操作、および分析を行います。
ja.long_description: 何十年もの間、企業は、異なる運用システムのデータをデータマート、データウェアハウス、データレイクなどの分析用の中央データ・ストアにコピーすることでサイロ化の解消を試みてきました。 これらの方法は、コストがかかり、エラーが発生しやすい傾向があります。 ほとんどの企業は、平均 33 個の固有データ・ソースの管理に苦労しています。これらのデータ・ソースは構造が多様で、多くの場合、アクセスできないデータ・サイロに閉じ込められています。 Data Virtualizationを使えば、データをコピーしたり複製したりすることなく、多くのシステムでデータを照会することができ、時間を節約してコストを削減することができます。 Watson 照会はソースからデータを照会し、最新のデータと最も正確なデータを提供することにより、分析を簡素化します。

ko.description: 이동하지 않고 데이터를 보고, 액세스하고 조작 및 분석합니다.
ko.long_description: 수십 년 동안 기업은 분석을 위해 다양한 운영 체제의 데이터를 데이터 마트, 데이터 웨어하우스 및 데이터 레이크와 같은 중앙 데이터 저장소로 복사하여 부서간 정보단절을 줄이려고 노력해 왔습니다. 이러한 방법은 비용이 많이 들고 오류가 발생하기 쉽습니다. 구조적으로 다양하며 액세스할 수 없는 부서의 내부 데이터 저장소에 갇혀 있는 평균 33개의 고유한 데이터 소스를 관리하기 위해 고군분투하고 있습니다. Data Virtualization를 사용하는 경우 복사 및 복제하지 않고도 다양한 시스템 간에 데이터를 쿼리할 수 있어 시간을 절약하고 비용을 줄일 수 있습니다. Data Virtualization는 해당 소스로부터 데이터를 쿼리하여 가장 정확한 최신 데이터를 제공함으로써 분석을 단순화합니다.

pt-BR.description: Visualize, acesse, manipule e analise seus dados sem movê-los.
pt-BR.long_description: Durante décadas, as empresas tentaram quebrar silos, copiando dados de diferentes sistemas operacionais em armazenamentos de dados centrais para análise, como data marts, data warehouses e data lakes. Esses métodos podem ser custosos e são propenos a erro. A maioria luta para gerenciar uma média de 33 fontes de dados exclusivas, que são diversas em estrutura e muitas vezes presas dentro de silos de dados inacessíveis. Usando o Data Virtualization, é possível consultar dados de vários sistemas, sem que seja necessário copiar e replicar esses dados, economizando tempo e reduzindo custos. O Data Virtualization consulta dados a partir da origem, simplificando a análise e fornecendo os dados mais recentes e precisos disponíveis.

zh-Hans.description: 无需移动即可查看、访问、操作和分析数据。
zh-Hans.long_description: 几十年来，企业一直试图将数据从不同的操作系统复制到中央数据存储器（例如数据集市、数据仓库和数据湖）中进行分析，以便打破孤岛。 但这些方法成本高昂，而且容易出错。 大多数企业都难以管理平均数量达到 33 个的独特数据源，这些数据源的结构多种多样，并且常常被困在无法访问的数据孤岛中。 使用 Data Virtualization，您可以在许多系统中查询数据，而不必进行拷贝和复制，从而节省时间并降低成本。 Data Virtualization 从其源查询数据，通过提供最新、最准确的数据来简化分析。

zh-Hant.description: 檢視、存取、操作及分析資料而不移動資料。
zh-Hant.long_description: 幾十年來，公司一直試圖透過將來自不同作業系統的資料複製到中央資料儲存庫進行分析來打破孤島，例如資料集區、資料倉儲和資料湖。 這些方法的成本很高，容易發生錯誤。 大多數都努力管理平均 33 個不同的資料來源，這些資料來源結構多樣，容易陷於無法存取的資料孤島中。 透過 Data Virtualization，您可以在許多系統之間查詢資料，而無需複製並抄寫它，節省時間並降低成本。 Data Virtualization 可查詢來自其來源的資料，透過提供最新且最準確的資料來簡化您的分析。

bullets.description: Dedizierte, hoch verfügbare Instanz mit flexibler Skalierung der Rechenressourcen.

Eine hochverfügbare Data Virtualization-Instanz mit mindestens 3 Kopf- und 3 Worker-Knoten. Führungsknoten verfügen über 8 vCPU und 32 GB RAM pro Knoten. 4 vCPU pro Führungsknoten werden der Serviceverwaltung und Überwachung zugeordnet und sind nicht Teil der Gebühren für VPC-Stunden (VPC = Virtual Processor Core). Workerknoten verfügen über 4 vCPU und 32 GB RAM pro Knoten. Data Virtualization ist unter IBM Cloud Pak for Data als Service verfügbar.
Dedicated and highly available instance with flexible scaling of compute.

One highly available Data Virtualization instance with a minimum of 3 head and 3 worker nodes. Head nodes have 8 vCPU and 32 GB RAM per node. 4 vCPU per head node are allocated to service management and monitoring and are not included in the Virtual Processor Core-Hour charge. Worker nodes have 4 vCPU and 32 GB RAM per node. Data Virtualization is available on IBM Cloud Pak for Data as a Service.
Instancia dedicada y altamente disponible con escalado flexible de cálculo.

Una instancia de Data Virtualization de alta disponibilidad con un mínimo de 3 nodos de cabecera y 3 de trabajadores. Los nodos principales tienen 8 vCPU y 32 GB de RAM cada uno. 4 vCPU de cada nodo principal se asignan a la gestión y supervisión de servicios y no se incluyen en el cargo hora-núcleo de procesador virtual. Los nodos de trabajo tienen 4 vCPU y 32 GB de RAM cada uno. Data Virtualization está disponible en IBM Cloud Pak for Data como Servicio.
Instance dédiée et hautement disponible avec mise à l'échelle flexible du traitement.

Une instance de requête Watson hautement disponible avec un minimum de 3 noeuds principaux et 3 noeuds secondaires. Les noeuds head possèdent 8 vCPU et 32 Go de mémoire RAM par noeud. 4 unités vCPU par noeud head sont allouées à la gestion et à la surveillance des services et ne sont pas comprises dans le prix horaire de coeur de processeur virtuel. Les noeuds worker possèdent 4 vCPU et de 32 Go de mémoire RAM par noeud. Data Virtualization est disponible sous IBM Cloud Pak for Data en tant que service.
Istanza dedicata e ad alta disponibilità con scalabilità di elaborazione flessibile.

Un'istanza Data Virtualization altamente disponibile con un minimo di 3 head node e 3 worker node. I nodi head hanno 8 vCPU e 32 GB di RAM ciascuno. 4 vCPU per nodo head sono assegnate alla gestione e al monitoraggio del servizio e non sono incluse nella tariffa Core-Ora del processore virtuale. I worker node hanno 4 vCPU e 32 GB di RAM per nodo. Data Virtualization è disponibile su IBM Cloud Pak for Data as a Service.
コンピュートを柔軟にスケーリングできる、可用性の高い専用インスタンス。

最小 3 つのヘッド・ノードと 3 つのワーカノードを持つ、可用性の高い Data Virtualization インスタンス。 ヘッド・ノードには、ノードごとに 8 vCPU と 32 GB RAM があります。 各ヘッド・ノードの 4 vCPU はサービスの管理とモニタリングに割り振られており、仮想プロセッサー・コア - 時間の料金には含まれていません。 ワーカー・ノードには、ノードごとに 4 vCPU と 32 GB RAM があります。 Data Virtualization は、IBM Cloud Pak for Data 上でご利用になれるサービスです。
컴퓨팅을 유연하게 스케일링하는 전용 고가용성 인스턴스입니다.

하나의 고가용성 Data Virtualization 인스턴스에는 최소 3개의 헤드 및 3개의 작업자 노드가 포함되어 있습니다. 헤드 노드에는 노드별 8 vCPU 및 32GB RAM이 있습니다. 헤드 노드별 4 vCPU가 서비스 관리 및 모니터링에 할당되고 가상 프로세서 코드 시간 비용에는 포함되지 않습니다. 작업자 노드에는 노드당 4vCPU 및 32GB RAM이 포함되어 있습니다. Data Virtualization는 IBM Cloud Pak for Data에서 서비스로 사용할 수 있습니다.
Instância dedicada e altamente disponível com ajuste de escala de cálculo flexível.

Uma instância altamente disponível do Data Virtualization, com no mínimo 3 nós de cabeçote e 3 nós de trabalhador. Os nós do cabeçote possuem 8 vCPU e 32 GB de RAM por nó. 4 vCPU por nó de cabeçote são alocados para gerenciamento e monitoramento de serviços e não estão incluídos no encargo de Núcleo de Processador Virtual/Hora. Os nós do trabalhador possuem 4 vCPU e 32 GB de RAM por nó. O  Data Virtualization está disponível no IBM Cloud Pak for Data como um Serviço.
提供专用的高可用性实例，可灵活扩展计算
一个高可用性 Watson 查询实例，最少有 3 个头节点和 3 个工作节点。 每个头节点具有 8 个 vCPU 和 32 GB RAM。 每个头节点将 4 个 vCPU 分配给服务管理和监控，但不包括在虚拟处理器核心小时数费用中。 每个工作节点具有 4 个 vCPU 和 32 GB RAM。 Watson 查询在 IBM Cloud Pak for Data 上作为服务提供。
可彈性調整計算資源的專用高可用性實例。

一個高可用性 Data Virtualization 實例最少具有 3 個前端節點和 3 個工作者節點。 每個前端節點具有 8 個 vCPU 和 32 GB RAM。 每個前端節點 4 個 vCPU 配置給服務管理和監控，不包括在虛擬處理器核心小時費用中。 每個工作者節點具有 4 個 vCPU 和 32 GB RAM。 Data Virtualization 可在 IBM Cloud Pak for Data 上提供作為「服務」。

name: databases-for-elasticsearch

en.description: Elasticsearch combines the power of a full text search engine with the indexing strengths of a JSON document database.
en.long_description: Elasticsearch combines the power of a full text search engine with the indexing strengths of a JSON document database to create a powerful tool for rich data analysis on large volumes of data. Databases for Elasticsearch makes Elasticsearch even better by managing it for you. Features include high availability, automated backup orchestration, autoscaling, and de-coupled allocation of storage, RAM, and vCPUs. Databases for Elasticsearch pricing is based on underlying disk, RAM, and optional vCPU allocation, as well as backup storage usage. The service is HIPAA-Ready and compliant with PCI-DSS, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, GDPR and HITRUST. You can also learn more by viewing docs, API docs, and terms.

name: databases-for-mongodb

en.description: MongoDB is a JSON document store with a rich query and aggregation framework.
en.long_description: MongoDB is a JSON document store with a rich query and aggregation framework. Databases for MongoDB makes MongoDB even better by managing it for you. Features include high availability, automated backup orchestration, autoscaling, and de-coupled allocation of storage, RAM, and vCPUs. Databases for MongoDB pricing is based on underlying disk and RAM allocation, as well as backup storage usage. MongoDB Standard and Enterprise is HIPAA-Ready and compliant with PCI-DSS, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, GDPR and HITRUST. You can also learn more by viewing docs, API docs, and terms.

en.description: Build mission critical web applications that offer high performance with scalability and security.
en.long_description: MySQL is a fast, easy-to-use, and flexible RDBMS. As the central component of the LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL and PHP) web service model, it sports a number of connectors, including Python, PHP and C++ for development needs. Databases for MySQL makes MySQL even better by managing it for you. Features include high availability, automated backup orchestration, autoscaling, and de-coupled allocation of storage, RAM, and vCPUs. Databases for MySQL pricing is based on underlying disk, RAM, and optional vCPU allocation, as well as backup storage usage. You can also learn more by viewing docs, API docs, and terms.

description: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database that is highly customizable.
longDescription: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database that is highly customizable. It’s a feature-rich enterprise database with JSON support, giving you the best of both the SQL and NoSQL worlds. Databases for PostgreSQL makes PostgreSQL even better by managing it for you. Features include high availability, automated backup orchestration, autoscaling, and de-coupled allocation of storage, RAM, and vCPUs. Databases for PostgreSQL pricing is based on underlying disk, RAM, and optional vCPU allocation, as well as backup storage usage. The service is HIPAA-Ready and compliant with PCI-DSS, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, GDPR and HITRUST. You can also learn more by viewing docs, API docs, and terms.

name: databases-for-redis

en.description: Redis is a blazingly fast, in-memory data structure store.
en.long_description: Redis is an open source, in-memory data structure store, used as a database, cache and message broker. It supports data structures such as strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets with range queries, bitmaps, hyperloglogs and geospatial indexes with radius queries. Databases for Redis makes Redis even better by managing it for you. Features include high availability, automated backup orchestration, autoscaling, and de-coupled allocation of storage, RAM, and vCPUs. Databases for Redis pricing is based on underlying disk, RAM, and optional vCPU allocation, as well as backup storage usage. The service is HIPAA-Ready and compliant with PCI-DSS, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, GDPR and HITRUST. You can also learn more by viewing docs, API docs and terms.

name: databases-independent-backups

en.description: Independent Backups allows you to retain, manage, and restore database backups independently of the database instance lifecycle.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Databases Independent Backups is a managed offering for IBM Cloud Databases Gen 2 (on VPC) that lets you retain and restore backups independently of the database instance lifecycle.  The service support use cases such as compliance, testing, or protection against accidental data loss. Backups are enabled by VPC Block Storage snapshots, providing cost‑efficient and flexible storage designed for instant restore, including large, multi-terabyte recovery. Each instance is an IBM Cloud resources with its own lifecycle, identity, billing, and IAM access controls, enabling fine grained access control and support even after the original database instance is no longer present.

name: datastage

de.description: IBM® DataStage® bietet branchenweit führende Datenintegration im Batchbetrieb und in Echtzeit, mit der sichere Datenpipelines in lokalen und Hybrid-Cloud-Umgebungen erstellt werden können.
de.long_description: IBM® DataStage® bietet branchenweit führende Datenintegration im Batchbetrieb und in Echtzeit, mit der sichere Datenpipelines in lokalen und Hybrid-Cloud-Umgebungen erstellt werden können, wobei für die Vorbereitung der Daten für KI beliebige Integrationsmethoden (ETL, ELT) verwendet werden können.

en.description: Create ETL and data pipeline services for real-time, micro-batch, and batch data orchestration.
en.long_description: IBM® DataStage® offers industry-leading batch and real-time data integration to build trusted data pipelines across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments allowing any integration style (ETL, ELT) to prepare data for AI.

es.description: IBM® DataStage® ofrece integración de datos líder en tiempo real y por lotes para crear canalizaciones de datos de confianza.
es.long_description: IBM® DataStage® ofrece integración de datos líder en tiempo real y por lotes para crear canalizaciones de datos de confianza en entornos locales y de nube híbrida que permiten cualquier estilo de integración (ETL, ELT) para preparar los datos para la IA.

fr.description: IBM® DataStage® offre un traitement par lots et une intégration de données en temps réel permettant de générer des pipelines de données fiables.
fr.long_description: IBM® DataStage® offre un traitement par lots performant et une intégration de données en temps réel permettant de générer des pipelines de données fiables dans des environnements sur site et de cloud hybride. Il permet à tous les styles d'intégration (ETL, ELT) de préparer des données pour l'IA.

it.description: IBM® DataStage® offre l'integrazione dei dati in tempo reale e batch leader del settore per creare pipeline di dati attendibili.
it.long_description: IBM® DataStage® offre l'integrazione dei dati in tempo reale e batch leader del settore per creare pipeline di dati attendibili negli ambienti on-premises e cloud ibridi consentendo qualsiasi stile di integrazione (ETL, ELT) per preparare i dati per l'AI.

ja.description: IBM® DataStage® は、信頼できるデータ・パイプラインを構築するための、業界最高レベルのバッチおよびリアルタイムのデータ統合を提供します。
ja.long_description: IBM® DataStage® は、オンプレミスおよびハイブリッド・クラウド環境全体で信頼できるデータ・パイプラインを構築するための、業界最高レベルのバッチおよびリアルタイムのデータ統合を提供します。これにより、AI 用データを用意するための任意の統合スタイル (ETL、ELT) を使用できます。

ko.description: IBM® DataStage®는 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 파이프라인을 빌드하기 위한 업계 최고의 일괄처리 및 실시간 데이터 통합을 제공합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM® DataStage®는 온프레미스 및 하이브리드 클라우드 환경에서 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 파이프라인을 빌드하기 위한 업계 최고의 일괄처리 및 실시간 데이터 통합을 제공하여 모든 통합 스타일(ETL, ELT)에서 AI를 위한 데이터를 준비할 수 있도록 합니다.

pt-BR.description: O IBM® DataStage oferece integração de dados em lote e em tempo real líder do setor para construção de pipelines de dados confiáveis.
pt-BR.long_description: O IBM® DataStage oferece integração de dados em lote e em tempo real líder do setor para construção de pipelines de dados confiáveis em ambientes de nuvem híbridos e no local, permitindo que qualquer estilo de integração (ETL, ELT) prepare os dados para a IA.

zh-Hans.description: IBM® DataStage® 提供了行业领先的批量和实时数据集成，可用于构建可信数据管道。
zh-Hans.long_description: IBM® DataStage® 提供了行业领先的批量和实时数据集成，可用于跨本地环境和混合云环境构建可信数据管道，支持使用任何集成方式（ETL 或 ELT）来为 AI 准备数据。

zh-Hant.description: IBM® DataStage® 提供領先業界的批次和即時資料整合，以建置授信資料管線。
zh-Hant.long_description: IBM® DataStage® 提供領先業界的批次和即時資料整合，透過內部部署和混合式雲端環境建置授信資料管線，讓任何整合樣式（ETL、ELT）都能為 AI 準備資料。

bullets.description: Deploy DataStage remote runtime engine(s) on any cloud or on-premises and pay for the VPCs you use
• Pay for the VPCs you use with DataStage remote runtime engine(s) (there is no upper limit)
• Deploy DataStage runtime engine(s) to your local environment - on any cloud, data center, or on-premises - to run integration jobs
• Any VPC or capacity unit hour (CUH) usage will be billed with the per VPC and per CUH rates defined in this plan
• Recommended for customers getting started with DataStage-aaS Anywhere
--- Features ---
• DataStage runtime engine is a containerized offering that is deployed in customers environment for enhanced performance and security
• Design ETL, ELT, or TETL pipelines on IBM Cloud and run data integration tasks with your remote runtime engine.
• Spin up one or multiple remote runtime engines with flexibility
• Dynamically scale remote runtime engines up or down
--- Notes ---
• You cannot revert the execution style back to IBM Cloud serverless runtime once SaaS Anywhere is enabled for a Project.
• If a job uses IBM Cloud serverless runtime, then it will be billed using CUH with the minimum duration for a job run being one minute
Everything you need to get started with the DataStage remote runtime engine.

bullets.description: IBM DataStage Standard-Plan
Umgebung = Anzahl der pro Stunde erforderlichen Kapazitätseinheiten (CUH)
• 1 vCPU + 4 GB RAM = 1 CUH
• 2 vCPU + 8 GB RAM = 2 CUH
• 4 vCPU + 16 GB RAM = 4 CUH
• 8 vCPU + 32 GB RAM = 8 CUH
• 16 vCPU + 64 GB RAM = 16 CUH
Fully managed, serverless data integration with readily scalable DataStage parallel engine
• Integrate and transform data across multiple sources by designing flows in a visual interface
• Preview and visualize data with options to customize view and export views
• View operational metrics on job execution – during or after job run completes
• Pre-packaged connectors to over 75 different data stores
• Usage is based on number of Capacity Unit-Hours used to run DataStage jobs
• Job run number of seconds and total vCPU in corresponding configuration determines CUH used
• DataStage as a service jobs will have a 60 second minimum billing duration. All job durations will be rounded up to the next minute for billing purposes.
• Design ETL, ELT, or TETL pipelines on IBM Cloud - no manual reconfiguration required.

de.description: Im Rahmen der Startkonfiguration steht eine SQL-Datenbank pro Serviceinstanz zur Verfügung, die sich in dedizierten Rechenressourcensektoren befinden; dabei stehen 4 vCPUs (16 GB Speicher) und 20 GB Speicherplatz für Daten und Protokolle zur Verfügung. Skalieren Sie Ihre Datenbank auf bis zu 56 vCPUs (240 GB Hauptspeicher) und 24 TB Speicher für Daten und Protokolle. Der Enterprise-Plan bietet eine Hochverfügbarkeitsoption mit einer Datenbank, die auf drei dedizierten virtuellen Servern ausgeführt wird. Jeder HA-Knoten wird separat abgerechnet. Die virtuellen Hochverfügbarkeitsserver werden in mehreren Verfügbarkeitszonen in IBM Cloud-Regionen mit der entsprechenden Unterstützung eingerichtet. Fournit jusqu'à 500 Go de stockage pour les données et journaux. Toutes les méthodes de facturation sont prises en charge, notamment les cartes de crédit et l'abonnement Bluemix. Le prix est basé sur un mois complet d'utilisation, mais les clients ne sont facturés que pour les jours de service activés. (Référence IBM : EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

it.description: I piani Precise Performance di IBM offrono le migliori prestazioni per dollaro sfruttando le risorse riservate. Per i sistemi che scalano on-demand, considera invece il piano Flex. Un database SQL per istanza di servizio su un server virtuale dedicato con 8 GB di RAM e 2 vCPU. Fornisce fino a 500 GB di storage per dati e log. Sono supportati tutti i metodi di fatturazione, inclusa la carta di credito e l'abbonamento Bluemix. Il prezzo è basato su un mese completo di utilizzo, ma la fatturazione viene effettuata solo per i giorni di attivazione del servizio. (IBM Part: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

ja.description: IBM の Precise Performance プランは、予約済みのリソースを活用することにより、1 ドルあたり最大のパフォーマンスを提供します。 オンデマンドで拡張するシステムの場合は、このプランではなく Flex プランを検討してください。 8 GB の RAM と 2 vCPU を備えた専用仮想サーバー上で、1 つのサービス・インスタンスにつき 1 つの SQL データベース。 データとログ用に、最大 500 GB のストレージを提供します。 クレジット・カードおよび Bluemix サブスクリプションを含む、あらゆる請求方法がサポートされます 価格は 1 カ月分の使用量を基準としていますが、お客様はサービスをアクティブ化した日数に対してのみ請求されます。 (IBM パーツ: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)
ja.long_description: IBM の Precise Performance プランは、予約済みのリソースを活用することにより、1 ドルあたり最大のパフォーマンスを提供します。 オンデマンドで拡張するシステムの場合は、このプランではなく Flex プランを検討してください。 8 GB の RAM と 2 vCPU を備えた専用仮想サーバー上で、1 つのサービス・インスタンスにつき 1 つの SQL データベース。 データとログ用に、最大 500 GB のストレージを提供します。 クレジット・カードおよび Bluemix サブスクリプションを含む、あらゆる請求方法がサポートされます 価格は 1 カ月分の使用量を基準としていますが、お客様はサービスをアクティブ化した日数に対してのみ請求されます。 (IBM パーツ: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

ko.description: IBM의 Precise Performance 플랜은 예약된 리소스를 활용하여 비용당 최고의 성능을 제공합니다. 온디맨드 확장을 지원하는 시스템의 경우 유연한 플랜을 고려하세요. 8GB RAM 및 2개의 vCPU가 포함된 전용 가상 서버의 서비스 인스턴스당 하나의 SQL 데이터베이스입니다. 데이터 및 로그용으로 최대 500GB의 스토리지를 제공합니다. 신용카드, Bluemix 가입을 비롯한 모든 청구 방법으로 결제할 수 있습니다. 가격은 한 달 전체 사용량을 기준으로 하지만 고객에게는 서비스가 활성화된 날짜에 대해서만 요금이 청구됩니다. (IBM 파트: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

pt-br.description: Os planos do Desempenho preciso da IBM oferecem o melhor desempenho por dólar, alavancando recursos reservados. Para sistemas que têm escala sob demanda, considere o plano Flex em vez disso. Um banco de dados SQL por instância de serviço em um servidor virtual dedicado com 8 GB de RAM e duas vCPUs. Fornece até 500 GB de armazenamento para dados e logs. Todos os métodos de faturamento são suportados, incluindo o cartão de crédito e a assinatura do Bluemix. O preço é baseado em um mês integral de uso, mas os clientes são faturados apenas por dias de serviço ativados. (Parte IBM: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

One SQL database per service instance on a dedicated virtual server with 8GB RAM and 2 vCPUs. Provides up to 500GB of storage for data and logs. All billing methods are supported, including credit card and Bluemix subscription. Price is based on a full month of usage, but customers are only billed for days of service activated. (IBM Part: EnterpriseForTransactions 2.8.500)

de.description: Der Basisplan umfasst eine Datenbank pro Serviceinstanz mit 4 GB RAM und 1 Core auf einem dedizierten virtuellen Server.  Stellt 2 GB Speicher für Daten und Protokolle bereit. Hochverfügbarkeitsoption verfügbar. RAM und Speicher können dank der flexiblen Preisstruktur dynamisch skaliert werden. Bei einer Nutzung von Hochverfügbarkeit verdoppeln sich die Kosten für RAM und Speicher. Alle Abrechnungsmethoden werden unterstützt, einschließlich Kreditkarte und Bluemix-Abonnement. (IBM Part: EnterpriseForTransactions Flex)

pt-br.description: Os planos do Desempenho preciso da IBM oferecem o melhor desempenho por dólar, alavancando recursos reservados. Sie können den kostenfreien Plan so lange wie benötigt nutzen, jedoch werden die Benutzer gebeten, ihr kostenfreies Konto alle 90 Tage per E-Mail zu verlängern. bullets.description: Dedicated instance on VPC machines with flexible scaling of compute, storage and IOPS.

plans.name: performance

en.description:
Base configuration starts with 4 vCPUs, 16 GB of RAM, 400 IOPS and 50GB of storage.

The starting configuration provides one SQL database per service instance residing on dedicated VPC machines. Scale your database up to 128 vCPUs (1024 GB of memory) and 40 TB of storage for data and logs. Gen 3 offers a high availability option that includes one database running on two dedicated virtual servers. The high availability instances are provisioned across multiple availability zones. Scale your compute, storage and IOPS independently to achieve the perfect price/performance fit.

The service is billed hourly based on the number of resource units. Monthly resource units are shown for machine types during selection. Storage requires 2 RU per 20 GB/month and 5.7 RU per 100 IOPS/month. Backups require 52.5 RU per TB/month.

plans.name: standard

de.description: Im Rahmen der Startkonfiguration steht eine SQL-Datenbank pro Serviceinstanz zur Verfügung, die sich in gemeinsam genutzten Datenverarbeitungssektoren befinden; dabei stehen 2 gemeinsam nutzbare vCPUs (8 GB Speicher) und 20 GB Speicherplatz für Daten und Protokolle zur Verfügung. Alle Datenbanken werden in einer Multi-Tenant-Datenverarbeitungsinfrastruktur bereitgestellt. Eine Skalierung der Datenbank auf bis zu 16 vCPUs (64 GB Speicher) und 4 TB Speicherplatz für Daten und Protokolle ist möglich. Der Standardplan bietet eine Hochverfügbarkeitsoption mit einer Datenbank, die auf drei gemeinsam genutzten virtuellen Servern ausgeführt wird. Jeder HA-Knoten wird separat abgerechnet. Die virtuellen Hochverfügbarkeitsserver werden in mehreren Verfügbarkeitszonen in IBM Cloud-Regionen mit der entsprechenden Unterstützung eingerichtet. Durch eine unabhängige Skalierung der Datenverarbeitungs- und Speicherressourcen können Sie eine optimale Preis-/Leistungskombination erreichen.

en.description:
The starting configuration provides one SQL database per service instance residing on shared compute slices, with 2 sharable vCPUs (8 GB of memory), and 20 GB of storage for data and logs. All database deployed across multi-tenant compute infrastructure. Scale your database up to 16 vCPUs (64 GB of memory) and 4 TB of storage for data and logs. Standard offers a high availability option that includes one database running on three shared virtual servers. Each HA node is billed separately. The high availability virtual servers are provisioned across multiple availability zones in IBM Cloud regions that support it. Scale your compute and storage independently to achieve the perfect price/performance fit. Each plan includes up to 100 GB of backup storage, stored for 14 days.


This plan is being deprecated and will no longer be available. For more information visit - https://cloud.ibm.com/status/announcement?query=Deprecation+Announcement+-+IBM+Db2+SaaS+Standard+%26+Enterprise+Plans

Toda la base de datos está desplegada en una infraestructura de cálculo multiarrendatario. Escale su base de datos hasta 16 vCPU (64 GB de memoria) y 4 TB de almacenamiento para datos y registros. El plan Standard ofrece una opción de alta disponibilidad que incluye una base de datos que se ejecuta en tres servidores virtuales compartidos. Cada nodo de alta disponibilidad se factura por separado. Los servidores virtuales de alta disponibilidad se suministran en varias zonas de disponibilidad de las regiones de IBM Cloud que los admitan. Escale el cálculo y el almacenamiento de forma independiente para conseguir el precio/rendimiento perfecto.

ja.description: 使用開始時点の構成では、サービス・インスタンスごとに 1 つの SQL データベースが提供されます。これは、共有コンピュート・スライス上にあり、2 つの共有可能な vCPU (8 GB のメモリー) と 20 GB のデータおよびログ用のストレージを備えています。データベースはすべて、マルチ・テナントのコンピュート・インフラストラクチャーにデプロイされます。データベースを最大 16 の vCPU (メモリー 64 GB) と、データとログ用の 4 TB のストレージにスケーリングできます。Standard では、3 台の共有仮想サーバー上で稼働する 1 つのデータベースを含む高可用性オプションが提供されます。HA ノードごとに課金されます。高可用性の仮想サーバーは、それをサポートする IBM Cloud リージョンの複数のアベイラビリティー・ゾーンに渡ってプロビジョニングされます。コンピュートとストレージを個別にスケーリングすることで、最適な価格とパフォーマンスを実現します。

ko.description: 시작 구성에서는 서비스 인스턴스당 하나의 SQL 데이터베이스를 제공합니다. 공유 컴퓨팅 슬라이스에 있으며 2개의 공유 가능 vCPU(8GB 메모리)와 20GB의 데이터 및 로그용 스토리지를 포함합니다. 모든 데이터베이스가 멀티테넌트 컴퓨팅 인프라에 배치됩니다. 최대 16개의 vCPU(64GB 메모리)와 4TB의 데이터 및 로그용 스토리지로 데이터베이스를 스케일링하십시오. pt-br.description: A configuração inicial fornece um banco de dados SQL por instância de serviço, residindo em fatias de cálculo compartilhadas, com 2 vCPUs compartilháveis (8 GB de memória) e 20 GB de armazenamento para dados e logs. Todo o banco de dados implementado ao longo da infraestrutura de cálculo de diversos locatários. Escale o seu banco de dados até 16 vCPUs (64 GB de memória) e 4 TB de armazenamento para dados e logs. O padrão oferece uma opção de alta disponibilidade que inclui um banco de dados em execução em três servidores virtuais compartilhados. Cada nó de HA é faturado separadamente. Os servidores virtuais de alta disponibilidade são provisionados ao longo de múltiplas zonas de disponibilidade em regiões da IBM Cloud que a suportam. Escale o seu cálculo e armazenamento independentemente para atingir o ajuste de preço/desempenho perfeito.

plans.description:
The starting configuration provides one SQL database per service instance residing on shared compute slices, with 2 sharable vCPUs (8 GB of memory), and 20 GB of storage for data and logs. All database deployed across multi-tenant compute infrastructure. Scale your database up to 16 vCPUs (64 GB of memory) and 4 TB of storage for data and logs. Standard offers a high availability option that includes one database running on three shared virtual servers. Each HA node is billed separately. The high availability virtual servers are provisioned across multiple availability zones in IBM Cloud regions that support it. Scale your compute and storage independently to achieve the perfect price/performance fit. Each plan includes up to 100 GB of backup storage, stored for 14 days.


This plan is being deprecated and will no longer be available. For more information visit - https://cloud.ibm.com/status/announcement?query=Deprecation+Announcement+-+IBM+Db2+SaaS+Standard+%26+Enterprise+Plans

de.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud ist ein flexibles und leistungsfähiges Data-Warehouse für Analysen auf Unternehmensebene.
de.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud ist ein vollständig verwalteter, auf Unternehmen abgestimmter Cloud-Data-Warehouse-Service. Db2 Warehouse on Cloud basiert auf IBM BLU Acceleration und bietet Ihnen eine unübertroffene Abfrageleistung. Der Service wird in mehreren Formfaktoren angeboten: SMP für kosteneffizientes Cloud-Data-Warehousing und MPP für leistungsfähige parallele Abfrageverarbeitung und Hochverfügbarkeit.

en.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud is a flexible and powerful data warehouse for enterprise-level analytics.
en.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud is a fully-managed, enterprise-class, cloud data warehouse service. Powered by IBM BLU Acceleration, Db2 Warehouse on Cloud provides you with unmatched query performance. The service is offered in multiple form factors: SMP for cost-effective cloud data warehousing, and MPP for high-performance parallel query processing and high availability.

es.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud es un almacén de datos flexible y potente para la analítica de nivel empresarial.
es.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud es un servicio de almacén de datos en la nube, de nivel empresarial y totalmente gestionado. Basado en IBM BLU Acceleration, Db2 Warehouse on Cloud le proporciona un rendimiento de consultas inigualable. El servicio se ofrece en múltiples factores de forma: SMP para un almacenamiento de datos en la nube rentable, y MPP para el proceso de consultas paralelas de alto rendimiento y alta disponibilidad.

fr.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud est un entrepôt de données flexible et puissant pour les analyses de niveau entreprise.
fr.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud est un service d'entrepôt de données cloud d'entreprise entièrement géré. Utilisant IBM BLU Acceleration, Db2 Warehouse on Cloud vous offre des performances de requête inégalées. Le service est proposé sous plusieurs formes : SMP pour un entreposage de données cloud économique, ou MPP pour un traitement de requêtes parallèles hautes performances et une haute disponibilité.

it.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud è un data warehouse flessibile e potente per l'analytics a livello aziendale.
it.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud è un servizio di data warehouse cloud completamente gestito, di classe enterprise. Con tecnologia IBM BLU Acceleration, Db2 Warehouse on Cloud fornisce prestazioni di query senza pari. Il servizio è offerto in diversi fattori di forma: SMP per il data warehousing cloud economicamente vantaggioso ed MPP per l'elaborazione di query parallele ad elevate prestazioni e un elevata disponibilità.

ja.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud は、エンタープライズ・レベルの分析のための柔軟で強力なデータウェアハウスです。
ja.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud は、フル・マネージドのエンタープライズ・クラスのクラウド・データウェアハウス・サービスです。 IBM BLU Acceleration を採用した Db2 Warehouse on Cloud は、比類のない照会パフォーマンスを提供します。 このサービスは複数のフォーム・ファクターで提供されます。コスト効率の良いクラウド・データウェアハウジングのための SMP と、高性能な並列照会処理および高可用性のための MPP です。

ko.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud는 엔터프라이즈급 분석을 위한 유연하고 강력한 데이터 웨어하우스입니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud는 완전히 관리되는 엔터프라이즈급 클라우드 데이터 웨어하우스 서비스입니다. IBM BLU Acceleration에서 제공하는 Db2 Warehouse on Cloud는 탁월한 조회 성능을 제공합니다. 이 서비스는 비용 효율적인 클라우드 데이터 웨어하우징을 위한 SMP와 고성능 병렬 조회 처리 및 고가용성을 위한 MPP 등 여러 폼 팩터로 제공됩니다.

pt-br.description: O Db2 Warehouse on Cloud é um data warehouse flexível e poderoso para análise de nível corporativo.
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud é um serviço de data warehouse em nuvem, de classe corporativa, totalmente gerenciado. Desenvolvido com o IBM BLU Acceleration, o Db2 Warehouse on Cloud fornece desempenho de consulta incomparável. O serviço é oferecido em vários fatores de forma: SMP para data warehousing em nuvem com custo reduzido e MPP para processamento de consulta paralela de alto desempenho e alta disponibilidade.

zh-cn.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 是用于企业级分析的灵活且功能强大的数据仓库。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 是完全受管的企业级云数据仓库服务。 Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 由 IBM BLU Acceleration 提供支持，为您提供无与伦比的查询性能。 该服务以多种形式提供：SMP 用于经济有效的云数据仓储，MPP 用于高性能并行查询处理和高可用性。

zh-tw.description: Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 是一個彈性且強大的資料倉儲，用於企業層級分析。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 是完全受管理的企業級雲端資料倉儲服務。 採用 IBM BLU Acceleration 技術的 Db2 Warehouse on Cloud 可為您提供無與倫比的查詢效能。 此服務以多種形式提供：SMP 用於符合成本效益的雲端資料倉儲，MPP 用於高效能平行查詢處理及高可用性。

name: is.dedicated-host

de.description: Sie können Single-Tenant-Hosts einrichten, die dedizierte Ressourcen und umfassende Steuerungsmöglichkeiten bei der Platzierung von Instanzen bieten.
de.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC stellt Single-Tenant-Hosts bereit, die eine maximale Isolation und umfassende Steuerungsmöglichkeiten bei der Platzierung von Instanzen bieten und Sie so dabei unterstützen, Compliance- und gesetzliche Vorgaben im gesamten Unternehmen umzusetzen.

en.description: Provision single-tenant hosts that offer dedicated resources and maximum control over instance placement.
en.long_description:
Dedicated Hosts for VPC are single-tenant hosts that are available exclusively for your use.  Dedicated hosts provide the flexibility for you to use your own software licenses, and provide maximum isolation and control over instance placement to help address corporate compliance and regulatory requirements.


Dedicated host groups are built into the solution and can help you define one or more dedicated hosts for a specific business purpose.

es.description: Suministre hosts de un solo arrendatario que ofrecen recursos dedicados y el máximo control sobre la colocación de instancias.
es.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC proporciona hosts de un solo arrendatario que ofrecen el máximo aislamiento y control sobre la colocación de instancias para ayudarle a gestionar el cumplimiento corporativo y los requisitos normativos.

fr.description: Mettez à disposition des hôtes à service exclusif qui offrent des ressources dédiées et un maximum de contrôle sur le placement des instances.
fr.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC fournit des hôtes à service exclusif qui offrent un maximum d'isolement et de contrôle sur le placement des instances pour vous aider à respecter la conformité aux normes d'entreprise et les exigences réglementaires.

it.description: Il provisioning di host a singolo tenant che offrono risorse dedicate e il massimo controllo del posizionamento dell'istanza.
it.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC fornisce host a singolo tenant che offrono il massimo isolamento e controllo nel posizionamento dell'istanza per aiutare a soddisfare la conformità aziendale e i requisiti normativi.

ja.description: 専用リソースと、インスタンス配置に関する最高レベルの制御を提供するシングル・テナント・ホストをプロビジョンします。
ja.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC では、インスタンス配置に関する最高レベルの独立性と制御を提供するシングル・テナント・ホストが提供され、企業コンプライアンスと規制の要件に対処するのに役立ちます。

ko.description: 전용 리소스와 인스턴스 배치에 대한 최대의 제어를 제공하는 단일 테넌트 호스트를 프로비저닝합니다.
ko.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC는 인스턴스 배치에 대한 최대의 격리와 제어를 제공하는 단일 테넌트 호스트를 제공하여 회사의 규제 준수 및 규정 요구사항을 해결하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

pt-br.description: Provisione hosts de único locatário que ofereçam recursos dedicados e controle máximo sobre a localização da instância.
pt-br.long_description: O Dedicated Host for VPC fornece hosts de único locatário que oferecem isolamento e controle máximos sobre a localização da instância para ajudar a atender aos requisitos regulamentares e de conformidade corporativa.

zh-cn.description: 配置单租户主机，提供专用资源和最大程度的实例放置控制。
zh-cn.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC 提供单租户主机，可在实例放置上提供最大程度的隔离和控制，从而帮助满足公司合规性和法规需求。

zh-tw.description: 佈建單租戶主機，以提供專用資源和對實例放置的最大控制權。
zh-tw.long_description: Dedicated Host for VPC 提供單租戶主機，以提供最大限度的隔離和對實例放置的控制權，從而協助解決公司合規性和法規需求。

name: stardigilabs

en.description: Virtual Lab and LMS Platform
en.long_description:
Digilabs is at the forefront of digital transformation, offering cutting-edge labs and training programs designed to equip the next generation of technology leaders with the skills they need to excel. Our labs, hosted on IBM’s industry-leading cloud platform, provide a hands-on learning experience that bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Key Benefits:

Enhanced Learning Experience: Students gain practical insights and develop essential skills through hands-on experience in a real-world setting.

Improved Learning Outcomes: Practical application of concepts leads to deeper understanding and better retention.

Accessibility and Flexibility: Students can access labs anytime, anywhere, promoting flexible and self-paced learning.

Industry-Relevant Skills: Labs align with industry demands, equipping students with skills needed for success in the workforce.

Streamlined Workflow: Seamless LMS integration simplifies access and management for both students and educators.

Cost-Effective Solution: Virtual labs eliminate the need for expensive physical infrastructure and maintenance.

Multidisciplinary Specializations: Offers a range of specializations, including Cloud Architecture, Data Analytics, Information Security, DevOps, Blockchain, and Cyber Security.

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Our Offerings:

Extensive Cloud Labs: Gain hands-on experience with over 150 labs available on a robust cloud platform

Secure Online Assessments: Complete assessments online with automated proctoring for secure testing.

Schedule Management: Easily track and manage your classes and lab schedules through an integrated system.

Comprehensive Reporting: Access detailed reports on attendance,student performance, and class activities.

Timely Notifications: Receive timely notifications about classes, labs, tests, and other important update

Live Online Classes: Attend live online classes from anywhere, guided by expert instructors.
 
Project Guidance: Engage in project discussions and receive monitoring from faculty to ensure progress.

Interactive Forums & Dashboard:Participate in discussions on forums and monitor your progress via a personalized dashboard.

Real-Time Chat: Use the chatbox for real-time interaction between faculty and students, as well as group discussions.

name: directlink.connect

de.description: Mit einem Service-Provider eine schnelle Herstellung und Bereitstellung der Konnektivität zu IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglichen.
de.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect stellt über Ihr lokales IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum privaten Zugriff auf Ihre IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur und weitere Clouds bereit, die mit Ihrem Netzserviceanbieter verbunden sind. Diese Option eignet sich hervorragend zum Erstellen von Anschlussmöglichkeiten zu mehreren Clouds in einer einzelnen Umgebung. Wir verbinden Kunden mithilfe einer gemeinsamen Bandbreitentopologie mit dem privaten IBM Cloud-Netz. Wie bei allen Direct Link-Produkten können Sie globales Routing hinzufügen, das privaten Netzverkehr zu allen IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglicht.

en.description: Leverage a Service Provider to quickly establish and deliver connectivity to IBM Cloud locations.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offers private access to your IBM Cloud infrastructure and to any other clouds linked to your Network Service Provider, through your local IBM Cloud data center. This option is perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment. We connect customers to the IBM Cloud private network, using a shared bandwidth topology. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

es.description: Saque partido a un proveedor de servicios para establecer rápidamente una conexión y utilizarla con ubicaciones de IBM Cloud
es.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect ofrece acceso privado a la infraestructura de IBM Cloud y a otras nubes vinculadas a su proveedor de servicios de red través de un centro de datos local de IBM Cloud. Esta opción es perfecta para crear conectividad multinube en un entorno único. Conectamos a los clientes con la red privada de IBM Cloud mediante una topología de ancho de banda compartido. Como sucede con todos los productos de Direct Link, puede añadir direccionamiento global para habilitar el tráfico de red privada con todas las ubicaciones de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: Tirez parti d'un fournisseur de services pour établir et fournir rapidement la connectivité aux localisations IBM Cloud
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offre un accès privé à votre infrastructure IBM Cloud, ainsi qu'à d'autres clouds liés à votre fournisseur de services réseau, via votre centre de données IBM Cloud local. Cette option est idéale pour la création d'une connectivité multi-cloud dans un environnement individuel. Nous connectons des clients au réseau privé IBM Cloud grâce à une topologie de bande passante partagée. Comme avec tous les produits Direct Link, vous pouvez ajouter le routage mondial pour autoriser le trafic de réseau privé vers tous les emplacements IBM Cloud.

it.description: Sfruttare un provider del servizio per stabilire rapidamente e realizzare la connettività alle ubicazioni IBM Cloud
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect consente l'accesso privato all'infrastruttura IBM Cloud e ad altri cloud collegati a NSP (Network Service Provider) attraverso il data center IBM Cloud locale. Questa opzione è perfetta per la creazione di connettività multicloud in un singolo ambiente. I clienti vengono collegati alla rete privata IBM Cloud, utilizzando una topologia di larghezza di banda condivisa. Come per tutti i prodotti Direct Link, è possibile aggiungere l'instradamento globale che abilita il traffico di rete su tutte le ubicazioni IBM Cloud.

ja.description: サービス・プロバイダーが IBM Cloud ロケーションへの接続を素早く確立して提供できるようにします。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect により、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センターを経由した、IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャーへのプライベート・アクセスと、ネットワーク・サービス・プロバイダーにリンクされた他のクラウドへのプライベート・アクセスが提供されます。このオプションは、単一環境に複数のクラウド接続を作成する場合に最適です。 共有帯域幅トポロジーを使用して、お客様を IBM Cloud プライベート・ネットワークに接続します。 他の Direct Link 製品と同様に、すべての IBM Cloud ロケーションへのプライベート・ネットワーク・トラフィックを使用できるようにする、グローバル・ルーティングを追加できます。

ko.description: 서비스 제공자를 이용하여 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 연결을 신속하게 설정 및 제공함
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터를 통해 사용자의 IBM Cloud 인프라 및 네트워크 서비스 제공자에 연결된 기타 클라우드에 대한 개인용 액세스를 제공합니다. 이 옵션은 하나의 환경에 여러 클라우드 연결을 작성하는 데 적합합니다. 고객은 공유 대역폭 토폴로지를 사용하여 IBM Cloud 사설 네트워크에 연결됩니다. 모든 Direct Link 제품과 마찬가지로, 사용자는 모든 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 사설 네트워크 트래픽을 가능하게 하는 글로벌 라우팅을 추가할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Alavanque um provedor de serviços para estabelecer e entregar conectividade rapidamente aos locais da IBM Cloud
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect oferece acesso privado à infraestrutura do IBM Cloud e a quaisquer outras nuvens vinculadas ao seu Provedor de Serviços de Rede, por meio do data center local do IBM Cloud. Essa opção é perfeita para criar conectividade com múltiplas nuvens em um único ambiente. Nós conectamos os clientes à rede privada do IBM Cloud usando uma topologia de largura de banda compartilhada. Como com todos os produtos Direct Link, é possível incluir roteamento global que permite tráfego de rede privada para todos os locais do IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: 利用服务提供商以快速建立并交付与 IBM Cloud 位置的连接。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 通过本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心，提供对 IBM Cloud 基础架构以及链接到网络服务提供商的其他任何云的专用访问权。此选项最适合于在单个环境中创建多云连接。我们使用共享带宽拓扑将客户连接到 IBM Cloud 专用网络。与所有 Direct Link 产品一样，您可以添加全球路由，以支持专用网络流量流入所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

zh-tw.description: 利用「服務提供者」以快速建立並提供 IBM Cloud 位置的連線
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 透過本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心，對下列項目進行專用存取：IBM Cloud 基礎架構，以及鏈結至「網路服務提供者」的任何其他雲端。此選項最適合在單一環境中建立多雲端連線功能。我們使用共用頻寬拓蹼，將客戶連接至 IBM Cloud 專用網路。與所有 Direct Link 產品相同，您可以將啟用專用網路資料流量的廣域路徑新增至所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

description: Leverage a Service Provider to quickly establish and deliver connectivity to IBM Cloud locations.
longDescription: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offers private access to your IBM Cloud infrastructure and to any other clouds linked to your Network Service Provider, through your local IBM Cloud data center. This option is perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment. We connect customers to the IBM Cloud private network, using a shared bandwidth topology. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

bullets.description: Unabhängig davon, ob sich die Ressourcen im Rechenzentrum oder in der IBM Cloud befinden, können Sie die Geschwindigkeit und Sicherheit nutzen, die für Ihr Unternehmen erforderlich ist.

bullets.description: Wählen Sie eine der Portgeschwindigkeiten 50, 100, 200, 500 MB/s, 1 Gb/s, 2 Gb/s oder 5 Gb/s aus. Wenn Sie Ihre Anforderungen ändern, können Sie die Geschwindigkeiten ohne Reibungsverluste ändern.
bullets.title: Herausragende Auswahlmöglichkeiten und Investitionsschutz

bullets.description: Whether your resources are in your data center or on the IBM Cloud, you can operate with the speed and security that your business requires.

name: direct-link-cloud-connect

de.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect stellt über Ihr lokales IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum privaten Zugriff auf Ihre IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur und weitere Clouds bereit, die mit Ihrem Netzserviceanbieter verbunden sind.
de.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect stellt über Ihr lokales IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum privaten Zugriff auf Ihre IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur und weitere Clouds bereit, die mit Ihrem Netzserviceanbieter verbunden sind. Diese Option eignet sich hervorragend zum Erstellen von Anschlussmöglichkeiten zu mehreren Clouds in einer einzelnen Umgebung. Wir verbinden Kunden mithilfe einer gemeinsamen Bandbreitentopologie mit dem privaten IBM Cloud-Netz. Wie bei allen Direct Link-Produkten können Sie globales Routing hinzufügen, das privaten Netzverkehr zu allen IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglicht.

en.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offers private access to your IBM Cloud infrastructure and to any other clouds linked to your Network Service Provider, through your local IBM Cloud data center.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offers private access to your IBM Cloud infrastructure and to any other clouds linked to your Network Service Provider, through your local IBM Cloud data center. This option is perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment. We connect customers to the IBM Cloud private network, using a shared bandwidth topology. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

es.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect ofrece acceso privado a la infraestructura de IBM Cloud y a otras nubes vinculadas a su proveedor de servicios de red través de un centro de datos local de IBM Cloud.
es.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect ofrece acceso privado a la infraestructura de IBM Cloud y a otras nubes vinculadas a su proveedor de servicios de red través de un centro de datos local de IBM Cloud. Esta opción es perfecta para crear conectividad multinube en un entorno único. Conectamos a los clientes con la red privada de IBM Cloud mediante una topología de ancho de banda compartido. Como sucede con todos los productos de Direct Link, puede añadir direccionamiento global para habilitar el tráfico de red privada con todas las ubicaciones de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offre un accès privé à votre infrastructure IBM Cloud, ainsi qu'à d'autres clouds liés à votre fournisseur de services réseau, via votre centre de données IBM Cloud local.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offre un accès privé à votre infrastructure IBM Cloud, ainsi qu'à d'autres clouds liés à votre fournisseur de services réseau, via votre centre de données IBM Cloud local. Cette option est idéale pour la création d'une connectivité multi-cloud dans un environnement individuel. Nous connectons des clients au réseau privé IBM Cloud grâce à une topologie de bande passante partagée. Comme avec tous les produits Direct Link, vous pouvez ajouter le routage mondial pour autoriser le trafic de réseau privé vers tous les emplacements IBM Cloud.

it.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offre, attraverso il data center IBM Cloud locale, un accesso privato alla tua infrastruttura IBM Cloud e a qualsiasi altro cloud collegato al tuo Network Service Provider.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect offre, attraverso il data center IBM Cloud locale, un accesso privato alla tua infrastruttura IBM Cloud e a qualsiasi altro cloud collegato al tuo Network Service Provider. Questa opzione è perfetta per la creazione di connettività multicloud in un singolo ambiente. I clienti vengono collegati alla rete privata IBM Cloud, utilizzando una topologia di larghezza di banda condivisa. Come per tutti i prodotti Direct Link, è possibile aggiungere l'instradamento globale che abilita il traffico di rete su tutte le ubicazioni IBM Cloud.

ja.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect を利用することで、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センターを経由した IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャーへのプライベート・アクセスと、ネットワーク・サービス・プロバイダーにリンクされた他のクラウドへのプライベート・アクセスが実現します。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect を利用することで、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センターを経由した IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャーへのプライベート・アクセスと、ネットワーク・サービス・プロバイダーにリンクされた他のクラウドへのプライベート・アクセスが実現します。 このオプションは、単一環境に複数のクラウド接続を作成する場合に最適です。 共有帯域幅トポロジーを使用して、お客様を IBM Cloud プライベート・ネットワークに接続します。 他の Direct Link 製品と同様に、すべての IBM Cloud ロケーションへのプライベート・ネットワーク・トラフィックを使用できるようにする、グローバル・ルーティングを追加できます。

ko.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터를 통해, 사용자의 IBM Cloud 인프라 및 네트워크 서비스 제공자에 연결된 기타 클라우드에 대한 개인용 액세스를 제공합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터를 통해, 사용자의 IBM Cloud 인프라 및 네트워크 서비스 제공자에 연결된 기타 클라우드에 대한 개인용 액세스를 제공합니다. 이 옵션은 하나의 환경에 여러 클라우드 연결을 작성하는 데 적합합니다. 고객은 공유 대역폭 토폴로지를 사용하여 IBM Cloud 사설 네트워크에 연결됩니다. 모든 Direct Link 제품과 마찬가지로, 사용자는 모든 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 사설 네트워크 트래픽을 가능하게 하는 글로벌 라우팅을 추가할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect oferece acesso privado à infraestrutura do IBM Cloud e a quaisquer outras nuvens vinculadas ao seu Network Service Provider por meio do data center local do IBM Cloud.
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect oferece acesso privado à infraestrutura do IBM Cloud e a quaisquer outras nuvens vinculadas ao seu Network Service Provider por meio do data center local do IBM Cloud. Essa opção é perfeita para criar conectividade com múltiplas nuvens em um único ambiente. Nós conectamos os clientes à rede privada do IBM Cloud usando uma topologia de largura de banda compartilhada. Como com todos os produtos Direct Link, é possível incluir roteamento global que permite tráfego de rede privada para todos os locais do IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 通过本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心，提供对 IBM Cloud Infrastructure 以及链接到网络服务提供商的其他任何云的专用访问权。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 通过本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心，提供对 IBM Cloud Infrastructure 以及链接到网络服务提供商的其他任何云的专用访问权。此选项最适合于在单个环境中创建多云连接。我们使用共享带宽拓扑将客户连接到 IBM Cloud 专用网络。与所有 Direct Link 产品一样，您可以添加全球路由，以支持专用网络流量流入所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

zh-tw.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 透過本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心，對下列項目進行專用存取：IBM Cloud 基礎架構，以及鏈結至「網路服務提供者」的任何其他雲端。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Connect 透過本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心，對下列項目進行專用存取：IBM Cloud 基礎架構，以及鏈結至「網路服務提供者」的任何其他雲端。此選項最適合在單一環境中建立多雲端連線功能。我們使用共用頻寬拓蹼，將客戶連接至 IBM Cloud 專用網路。與所有 Direct Link 產品相同，您可以將啟用專用網路資料流量的廣域路徑新增至所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

name: directlink.dedicated

de.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link garantiert die Sicherheit sensibler Daten in die und aus der IBM Cloud.
de.long_description:
Direct Link Version 2.0. IBM Cloud Direct Link garantiert die Sicherheit sensibler Daten in die und aus der IBM Cloud. Sichern oder speichern Sie große Datenmengen aus Ihrem Rechenzentrum in der IBM Cloud - zu vorhersehbaren Bandbreitekosten. Mit einer dedizierten Netzverbindung sind die Übertragungsraten schnell, konsistent und zuverlässig.

Sicher
Schützen Sie Ihre sensiblen geschäftskritischen Daten bei jedem Hop im Netzpfad und vermeiden Sie Sicherheitsrisiken im öffentlichen Internet.

Sicher
Schützen Sie Ihre sensiblen geschäftskritischen Daten bei jedem Hop im Netzpfad und vermeiden Sie Sicherheitsrisiken im öffentlichen Internet.

Zuverlässig
Die perfekte Lösung für Kunden, die eine konsistente Konnektivität mit hohem Durchsatz zwischen einem fernen Netz und ihrer IBM Cloudumgebung benötigen.

en.description: Ensure the security of sensitive data to and from the IBM Cloud.
en.long_description:
This is the 2.0 version of Direct Link. IBM Cloud Direct Link helps ensure the security of sensitive data to and from the IBM Cloud. Back up or store huge volumes of data from your data center on IBM Cloud with predictable bandwidth costs. With a dedicated network connection, your transfer rates are fast, consistent and reliable.

Secure
Protect your sensitive, business-critical data by controlling every hop of its network path and avoiding exposure to the public internet.

Secure
Protect your sensitive, business-critical data by controlling every hop of its network path and avoiding exposure to the public internet.

Reliable
Designed for customers that need more consistent, higher-throughput connectivity between a remote network and their IBM Cloud environments.

es.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link ayuda a garantizar la seguridad de los datos sensibles a y desde IBM Cloud
es.long_description:
Esta es la versión 2.0 de Direct Link. IBM Cloud Direct Link ayuda a garantizar la seguridad de los datos confidenciales hacia y desde IBM Cloud. Realice una copia de seguridad o almacene grandes volúmenes de datos de su centro de datos en IBM Cloud con costes de ancho de banda predecibles. Con una conexión de red dedicada, sus velocidades de transferencia son rápidas, consistentes y fiables. 

Seguro
Proteja sus datos confidenciales críticos para la empresa controlando todos los saltos de su vía de acceso de red y evitando la exposición a la Internet pública.

Seguro
Proteja sus datos confidenciales críticos para la empresa controlando todos los saltos de su vía de acceso de red y evitando la exposición a la Internet pública.

Fiable
Diseñado para los clientes que necesitan una conectividad de alto rendimiento más coherente entre la red remota y sus entornos de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link aide à assurer la sécurité des données sensibles vers et depuis IBM Cloud
fr.long_description:
Ceci est la version 2.0 de Direct Link. IBM Cloud Direct Link aide à assurer la sécurité des données sensibles vers et depuis IBM Cloud. Sauvegardez ou stockez d'énormes volumes de données de votre centre de données à IBM Cloud avec des coûts de bande passante prévisibles. Grâce à une connexion réseau dédiée, vos débits de transfert sont élevés, constants et fiables.

Sécurité
Protégez vos données critiques sensibles en contrôlant chaque tronçon de leur trajet sur le réseau et en évitant leur exposition à l'Internet public.

Sécurité
Protégez vos données critiques sensibles en contrôlant chaque tronçon de leur trajet sur le réseau et en évitant leur exposition à l'Internet public.

Fiabilité
Conçu pour les clients ayant besoin d'une connectivité plus rapide et plus constante entre un réseau distant et leur environnement IBM Cloud.

it.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link aiuta a garantire la sicurezza dei dati sensibili verso e da IBM Cloud
it.long_description:
Questa è la versione 2.0 di Direct Link. IBM Cloud Direct Link aiuta a garantire la sicurezza dei dati sensibili verso e da IBM Cloud. Esegui il backup o archivia elevati volumi di dati dal data center su IBM Cloud con costi di larghezza di banda prevedibili. Con una connessione di rete dedicata, i tuoi trasferimenti saranno veloci, costanti ed affidabili.

Sicuro
Proteggi i tuo dati sensibili e critici per l'azienda controllando ogni hop del percorso dei rete ed evitando l'esposizione alla rete internet pubblica.

Sicuro
Proteggi i tuo dati sensibili e critici per l'azienda controllando ogni hop del percorso dei rete ed evitando l'esposizione alla rete internet pubblica.

Affidabile
Progettato per i clienti che richiedono una connettività più congruente e con una maggiore velocità di trasmissione tra una rete remota ed i propri ambienti IBM Cloud.

ja.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link は、IBM Cloud との間でやり取りされる機密データのセキュリティーを確保します
ja.long_description:
これは Direct Link の 2.0 バージョンです。IBM Cloud Direct Link は、IBM Cloud との間でやり取りされる機密データのセキュリティーを確保します。 IBM Cloud のデータ・センターの膨大な量のデータのバックアップや保管を、予測可能な処理能力コストで実行します。 専用のネットワーク接続により、高速で一貫した確実な転送速度を実現します。

セキュア
 ネットワーク・パスのすべてのホップを制御して公共インターネットへの露出を避けることにより、ビジネス上重要な機密データを保護します。

セキュア
 ネットワーク・パスのすべてのホップを制御して公共インターネットへの露出を避けることにより、ビジネス上重要な機密データを保護します。

信頼できる
 リモート・ネットワークと IBM Cloud 環境との間で、より一貫性のある、高スループットの接続を必要とするお客様向けに設計されています。

ko.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link는 IBM Cloud에서 주고 받는 민감한 데이터의 보안을 보장합니다.
ko.long_description:
이는 Direct Link 2.0 버전입니다. IBM Cloud Direct Link는 IBM Cloud에서 주고 받는 민감한 데이터의 보안을 보장합니다. 예측 가능한 대역폭 비용으로 IBM Cloud의 데이터 센터에서 대량 데이터를 백업하고 저장합니다. 전용 네트워크 연결을 사용하면 더 빠르고 일관되게 안정적으로 전송할 수 있습니다.

보안
네트워크 경로의 모든 홉을 제어하고 공용 인터넷으로 노출을 방지하여 민감한 주요 비즈니스 데이터를 보호합니다.

보안
네트워크 경로의 모든 홉을 제어하고 공용 인터넷으로 노출을 방지하여 민감한 주요 비즈니스 데이터를 보호합니다.

안정성
원격 네트워크와 IBM Cloud 환경 간에 더 일관되고 처리량이 높은 연결이 필요한 고객을 위해 설계되었습니다.

pt-br.description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link ajuda a garantir a segurança de dados sensíveis para e da IBM Cloud
pt-br.long_description:
Esta é a versão 2.0 do Direct Link. O IBM Cloud Direct Link ajuda a garantir a segurança de dados sensíveis para e da IBM Cloud. Faça backup ou armazene enormes volumes de dados do seu data center na IBM Cloud com custos previsíveis de largura da banda. Com uma conexão de rede dedicada, as suas taxas de transferência são rápidas, consistentes e confiáveis.

Seguro
Proteja os dados críticos e sensíveis de seus negócios, controlando cada hop de seu caminho de rede e evitando a exposição à Internet pública.

Seguro
Proteja os dados críticos e sensíveis de seus negócios, controlando cada hop de seu caminho de rede e evitando a exposição à Internet pública.

Confiável
Projetado para clientes que precisam de conectividade mais consistente e com maior rendimento entre uma rede remota e seus ambientes IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link 帮助确保进出 IBM Cloud 的敏感数据的安全性
zh-cn.long_description:
这是 2.0 版本的 Direct Link。IBM Cloud Direct Link 帮助确保进出 IBM Cloud 的敏感数据的安全性。以可预测的带宽成本在 IBM Cloud 上备份或存储来自数据中心的海量数据。利用专用网络连接，传输速率快速、一致且可靠。

安全
通过控制网络路径的每个中继段并避免暴露于公共因特网，保护您的敏感、业务关键型数据。

安全
通过控制网络路径的每个中继段并避免暴露于公共因特网，保护您的敏感、业务关键型数据。

可靠
专门针对在远程网络及其 IBM Cloud 环境之间需要更加一致且更高吞吐量的连接的客户而设计。

zh-tw.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link 協助確保進出 IBM Cloud 的機密資料的安全性
zh-tw.long_description:
這是 2.0 版 Direct Link。IBM Cloud Direct Link 協助確保進出 IBM Cloud 的機密資料的安全性。將資料中心的巨量資料備份或儲存到 IBM Cloud，而且頻寬成本可預測。透過專用網路連線，您的傳送速率快速、一致且可靠。

安全
透過控制其網路路徑的每個中繼站並避免暴露於公用網際網路，保護敏感的重要商業資料。

安全
透過控制其網路路徑的每個中繼站並避免暴露於公用網際網路，保護敏感的重要商業資料。

可靠
專門針對需要在遠端網路與其 IBM Cloud 環境之間提供更一致、更高傳輸量連線的客戶設計。

de.description: Erstellen Sie eine beispiellose Netzleistung zu und von den Ressourcen auf der IBM Cloud-Plattform mit angepasstem Support für sichere, dedizierte Workloads, für die eine vorhersehbare Latenzzeit erforderlich ist.
de.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
de.long_description: Von IBM Cloud kann die Akquisition des Colocationbereichs angeordnet werden, der Ihre Anforderungen erfüllt. Ist Ihre Ausrüstung in einer Einrichtung eines Colocationanbieters in der Nähe eines IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrums installiert, können unsere Netzentwickler auch gemeinsam mit Ihnen die End-to-End-Verbindung zwischen Ihrer vorhandenen Hardware und der IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur erleichtern. Wie bei allen Direct Link-Produkten können Sie globales Routing hinzufügen, das privaten Netzverkehr zu allen IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglicht.

en.description: Establish unparalleled network performance to and from your IBM Cloud platform resources, with customized support for your secure, dedicated workloads that require predictable latency.
en.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
en.long_description: IBM Cloud can arrange the acquisition of colocation space that fits your needs. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

es.description: Consiga un rendimiento de red sin precedentes para los flujos destinados y procedentes de sus recursos de la plataforma IBM Cloud, con soporte personalizado para cargas de trabajo seguras y dedicadas que requieran una latencia predecible.
es.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
es.long_description: IBM Cloud puede planificar la adquisición de espacio de colocación que se ajuste a sus requisitos. O, si su engranaje ya está instalado en la instalación del proveedor de colocación cerca de un centro de datos de IBM Cloud, nuestros ingenieros de red trabajarán con el usuario para facilitar la conectividad de extremo a extremo entre el hardware y la infraestructura de IBM Cloud. Como sucede con todos los productos de Direct Link, puede añadir direccionamiento global para habilitar el tráfico de red privada con todas las ubicaciones de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: Bénéficiez de performances réseau inégalées depuis et vers les ressources des ressources de votre plateforme IBM Cloud, avec un support personnalisé pour vos charges de travail dédiées sécurisées requérant un temps d'attente prévisible.
fr.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud peut organiser l'acquisition d'un espace de collocation adapté à vos besoins. Ou, si votre équipement est déjà installé sur le site d'un fournisseur de collocation proche d'un centre de données IBM Cloud, nos ingénieurs réseau peuvent collaborer avec vous pour permettre une connectivité de bout en bout entre votre matériel existant et votre infrastructure IBM Cloud. Comme avec tous les produits Direct Link, vous pouvez ajouter le routage mondial pour autoriser le trafic de réseau privé vers tous les emplacements IBM Cloud.

it.description: Stabilisci prestazioni di rete senza precedenti verso e dalle proprie risorse IBM Cloud Platform, con supporto personalizzato per i carichi di lavoro sicuri e dedicati che richiedono una latenza prevedibile.
it.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
it.long_description: IBM Cloud può organizzare l'acquisizione dello spazio di co-location che si adatta alle tue esigenze. In alternativa, se la propria attrezzatura è già installata in una struttura del provider accanto ad un data center IBM Cloud, i nostri ingegneri di rete possono collaborare per rendere più semplice la connettività end-to-end tra l'hardware esistente e l'infrastruttura IBM Cloud. Come per tutti i prodotti Direct Link, è possibile aggiungere l'instradamento globale che abilita il traffico di rete su tutte le ubicazioni IBM Cloud.

ja.description: 予測可能な待機時間を必要とする、セキュアな専用ワークロードのカスタマイズされたサポートによって、IBM Cloud プラットフォーム・リソースとの間で無比のネットワーク・パフォーマンスを確立します。
ja.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud は、お客様のニーズに合ったコロケーション・スペースの取得を準備できます。 または、IBM Cloud データ・センターの近くのコロケーション・プロバイダーの設備にギアが既に取り付けられている場合、ネットワーク・エンジニアがお客様と協力して、既存のハードウェアと IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャー間をエンドツーエンドで接続できます。 他の Direct Link 製品と同様に、すべての IBM Cloud ロケーションへのプライベート・ネットワーク・トラフィックを使用できるようにする、グローバル・ルーティングを追加できます。

ko.description: 예측 가능한 대기 시간을 요구하는 보안된 전용 워크로드에 대한 맞춤형 지원을 통해 최상의 IBM Cloud 플랫폼 리소스 관련 네트워크 성능을 달성하십시오.
ko.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud는 사용자가 필요로 하는 코로케이션 영역을 제공할 수 있습니다. 또는 사용자의 장비가 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터 근처의 코로케이션 제공자 설비에 이미 설치되어 있는 경우, IBM의 네트워크 엔지니어가 사용자와 협력하여 사용자의 기존 하드웨어와 IBM Cloud 인프라 간의 엔드-투-엔드 연결을 용이하게 할 수 있습니다. 모든 Direct Link 제품과 마찬가지로, 사용자는 모든 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 사설 네트워크 트래픽을 가능하게 하는 글로벌 라우팅을 추가할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Estabeleça desempenho de rede incomparável de e para os recursos da plataforma IBM Cloud, com suporte customizado para suas cargas de trabalho seguras e dedicadas que requerem latência previsível.
pt-br.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud pode providenciar a aquisição de espaço de colocação que se ajusta às suas necessidades ou, se o seu equipamento já estiver instalado em uma instalação do provedor de colocação perto de um data center do IBM Cloud, nossos engenheiros de rede poderão trabalhar com você para facilitar a conectividade de ponta a ponta entre o seu hardware existente e a infraestrutura do IBM Cloud. Como com todos os produtos Direct Link, é possível incluir roteamento global que permite tráfego de rede privada para todos os locais do IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: 建立与 IBM Cloud 平台资源之间无与伦比的网络性能，并为需要可预测等待时间的安全专用工作负载提供定制支持。
zh-cn.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud 可以安排购买符合您需求的主机托管空间。或者，如果您的设备已安装在 IBM Cloud 数据中心附近的主机托管提供商的设施中，那么我们的网络工程师可以与您合作，帮助建立您的现有硬件与 IBM Cloud Infrastructure 之间的端到端连接。与所有 Direct Link 产品一样，您可以添加全球路由，以支持专用网络流量流入所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

zh-tw.description: 使用需要可預測延遲之安全專用工作負載的自訂支援，以建立 IBM Cloud 平台資源之間的無與倫比網路效能。
zh-tw.display_name: Direct Link Dedicated Hosting on Classic
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud 可以整理符合您需求之主機託管空間的取得。或者，如果您的齒輪已安裝在接近 IBM Cloud 資料中心之主機託管提供者的機能中，則網路工程師可以與您一起工作，以促進現有硬體與 IBM Cloud 基礎架構之間的端對端連線功能。與所有 Direct Link 產品相同，您可以將啟用專用網路資料流量的廣域路徑新增至所有 IBM Cloud 位置。
