name: direct-link-network-service-provider

de.description: Über eine Single-Tenant-Verbindung mit dediziertem Schaltkreis oder Querverbindungen ('Cross-Connect') sind Sie direkt mit IBM Cloud verbunden und erhalten eine beispiellose Netzleistung von und zu Ihren IBM Cloud-Plattformressourcen.
de.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated ist ein Single-Tenant-Produkt. Es bietet einen dedizierten Port, der sich optimal für Banken, Versicherungsunternehmen und alle Organisationen mit strengen Konformitätsrichtlinien eignet. Über einen Netzserviceanbieter (Network Service Provider, NSP) wird in einem IBM Cloud-Bereitstellungspunkt (Point of Presence, PoP) eine Glasfaserquerverbindung erstellt. Unsere Entwickler haben die durchgängige Konnektivität mit dem NSP Ihrer Wahl vereinfacht; auf Ihre Cloudinfrastruktur haben Sie im lokalen IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum Zugriff. Die Last-Mile-Verbindungen werden vom NSP direkt zwischen einem Router in Ihrem Netz und einem IBM Cloud-Router ausgeführt. Wie bei allen Direct Link-Produkten können Sie globales Routing hinzufügen, das privaten Netzverkehr zu allen IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglicht.

en.description: Connect directly to IBM Cloud through a single-tenant connection, using a dedicated circuit or cross-connect, for unparalleled network performance to and from your IBM Cloud platform resources.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated is a single-tenant product. It offers a dedicated port that is perfect for banks, insurance companies or anyone with strict compliance policies. Create a fiber cross-connection through a network service provider (NSP) in an IBM Cloud network point of presence (PoP). Our engineers facilitate end-to-end connectivity with your selected NSP, and you have access to your cloud infrastructure in the local IBM Cloud data center. The NSP runs last-mile links directly between a router on your network and an IBM Cloud router. As with all of the Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

es.description: Conéctese directamente a IBM Cloud a través de una conexión de un solo arrendatario mediante un circuito dedicado o una conexión cruzada, para conseguir un rendimiento de red inigualable desde y hacia sus recursos de la plataforma IBM Cloud.
es.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated es un producto de un solo arrendatario. Ofrece un puerto dedicado y es la solución perfecta para bancos, compañías aseguradoras o para cualquiera que tenga que cumplir con políticas de conformidad estrictas. Le permite crear una conexión cruzada de fibra mediante un proveedor de servicios de red (NSP) en un punto de presencia (PoP) de la red de IBM Cloud. Nuestros ingenieros facilitan la conectividad de extremo a extremo con el NSP y el cliente tiene acceso a la infraestructura de nube en el centro de datos local de IBM Cloud. El NSP ejecuta enlaces de última milla o kilómetro directamente entre un direccionador de la red y un direccionador de IBM Cloud. Como sucede con todos los productos de Direct Link, puede añadir direccionamiento global para habilitar el tráfico de red privada con todas las ubicaciones de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: Connectez-vous directement à IBM Cloud avec une connexion à service exclusif, via un circuit dédié ou une interconnexion, permettant des performances réseau inégalées depuis et vers les ressources de votre plateforme IBM Cloud.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated est un produit à service exclusif. Il offre un port dédié, idéal pour les banques, les compagnies d'assurance ou tout utilisateur devant respecter des règles de conformité strictes. Créez une interconnexion fibre via un fournisseur de service réseau sur un point de présence du réseau IBM Cloud. Nos ingénieurs assurent la connexion de bout en bout avec le fournisseur de services réseau sélectionné et vous avez accès à votre infrastructure de cloud dans le centre de données IBM Cloud local. Le fournisseur de services réseau établit les liaisons du dernier kilomètre directement entre un routeur sur votre réseau et un routeur IBM Cloud. Comme avec tous les produits Direct Link, vous pouvez ajouter le routage mondial pour autoriser le trafic de réseau privé vers tous les emplacements IBM Cloud.

it.description: Connettiti direttamente a IBM Cloud tramite una connessione a singolo tenant, utilizzando un circuito dedicato o la connessione incrociata per prestazioni di rete senza precedenti verso e dalle risorse IBM Cloud Platform.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated è un prodotto con tenant singolo. Offre una porta dedicata perfetta per banche, compagnie di assicurazioni o chiunque disponga di politiche di conformità rigorose. Crea una connessione incrociata in fibra mediante un provider di servizi di rete (NSP, network service provider) in una(NSP) in PoP (point of presence) globale di IBM Cloud. I nostri ingegneri semplificano la connettività end-to-end con il provider NSP selezionato e potrai accedere alla tua infrastruttura cloud nel data center IBM Cloud locale. L'NSP esegue collegamenti dell'ultimo miglio tra un router sulla tua rete ed un router IBM Cloud. Come per tutti i prodotti Direct Link, è possibile aggiungere l'instradamento globale che abilita il traffico di rete globale verso tutte le ubicazioni IBM Cloud.

ja.description: IBM Cloud プラットフォーム・リソースとの間で無比のネットワーク・パフォーマンスを実現するために、専用サーキットまたは相互接続を使用して、シングル・テナント接続を通して IBM Cloud に直接接続します。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated はシングル・テナント製品です。 これは、銀行、保険会社、または厳しいコンプライアンス・ポリシーを持つお客様に最適な、専用ポートを提供します。 IBM Cloud ネットワーク Point-of-Presence (PoP) でネットワーク・サービス・プロバイダー (NSP) を介してファイバー相互接続を作成します。 エンジニアはお客様が選択した NSP とエンドツーエンドで接続できるようにします。お客様は、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センター内のクラウド・インフラストラクチャーにアクセスできます。 NSP は、ネットワーク上のルーターと IBM Cloud ルーター間のラストマイル・リンクを直接実行します。 他の Direct Link 製品と同様に、すべての IBM Cloud ロケーションへのプライベート・ネットワーク・トラフィックを使用できるようにする、グローバル・ルーティングを追加できます。

ko.description: 최상의 IBM Cloud 플랫폼 리소스 관련 네트워크 성능을 달성하기 위해, 전용 회선 또는 교차 연결을 사용한 싱글 테넌트 연결을 통해 IBM Cloud에 직접 연결하십시오.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated는 싱글 테넌트 제품입니다. 이는 은행, 보험사 또는 엄격한 규제 준수 정책을 사용하는 모든 사용자에게 적합한 전용 포트를 제공합니다. IBM Cloud 네트워크 상호접속 위치(PoP)에 네트워크 서비스 제공자(NSP)를 통한 광섬유 교차 연결을 작성합니다. IBM의 엔지니어는 사용자가 선택한 NSP와의 엔드-투-엔드 연결을 용이하게 하며, 사용자는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터에 있는 자신의 클라우드 인프라에 대한 액세스 권한을 얻습니다. NSP는 사용자의 네트워크에 있는 라우터와 IBM Cloud 라우터 간의 마지막 지점(last-mile) 링크를 직접 실행합니다. 모든 Direct Link 제품과 마찬가지로, 사용자는 모든 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 사설 네트워크 트래픽을 가능하게 하는 글로벌 라우팅을 추가할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Conecte-se diretamente ao IBM Cloud por meio de uma conexão de único locatário, usando um circuito dedicado ou de conexão cruzada, para desempenho de rede incomparável de e para os recursos da plataforma IBM Cloud.
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated é um produto de único locatário. Ele oferece uma porta dedicada que é perfeita para bancos, empresas de seguro ou qualquer uma com políticas estritas de conformidade. Crie uma conexão cruzada de fibra por meio de um network service provider (NSP) em um ponto de presença (PoP) de rede IBM Cloud. Nossos engenheiros facilitam a conectividade de ponta a ponta com o NSP selecionado e você tem acesso à sua infraestrutura em nuvem no data center local do IBM Cloud. O NSP executa links de última milha diretamente entre um roteador em sua rede e um roteador IBM Cloud. Como com todos os produtos Direct Link, é possível incluir roteamento global que permite tráfego de rede privada para todos os locais do IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: 使用专用电路或交叉连接，通过单租户连接直接连接到 IBM Cloud，实现与 IBM Cloud 平台资源之间无与伦比的网络性能。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated 是一种单租户产品。它提供了一个专用端口，最适合银行、保险公司或有严格合规政策的任何人。在 IBM Cloud 网络存在点 (PoP) 中，通过网络服务提供商 (NSP) 创建光纤交叉连接。我们的工程师可以帮助与您所选的 NSP 建立端到端连接，并且您有权访问本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心内的云基础架构。NSP 直接在网络上的路由器与 IBM Cloud 路由器之间运行最后一英里链接。与所有 Direct Link 产品一样，您可以添加全球路由，以支持专用网络流量流入所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

zh-tw.description: 使用專用電路或交互連接，透過單一承租戶連線直接連接至 IBM Cloud，以取得 IBM Cloud 平台資源之間的無與倫比網路效能。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated 是單一承租戶產品。它提供最適合銀行、保險公司或具有嚴格規範原則之任何人的專用埠。在 IBM Cloud 網路存在點 (PoP) 中，透過網路服務提供者 (NSP) 建立光纖交互連線。工程師會協助與您所選取 NSP 的端對端連線功能，而且可以在本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心內存取雲端基礎架構。NSP 會直接執行您網路上路由器與 IBM Cloud 路由器之間的最後一哩鏈結。與所有 Direct Link 產品相同，您可以將啟用專用網路資料流量的廣域路徑新增至所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

description: Connect directly to IBM Cloud through a single-tenant connection, using a dedicated circuit or cross-connect, for unparalleled network performance to and from your IBM Cloud platform resources.
longDescription: IBM Cloud Direct Link Dedicated is a single-tenant product. It offers a dedicated port that is perfect for banks, insurance companies or anyone with strict compliance policies. Create a fiber cross-connection through a network service provider (NSP) in an IBM Cloud network point of presence (PoP). Our engineers facilitate end-to-end connectivity with your selected NSP, and you have access to your cloud infrastructure in the local IBM Cloud data center. The NSP runs last-mile links directly between a router on your network and an IBM Cloud router. As with all of the Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

name: direct-link-cloud-exchange

de.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange bietet über Ihr lokales IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum Multi-Tenant-Verbindungen zu Ihrer IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur, was sich ideal für die Erstellung einer Anbindung zu mehreren Clouds in einer einzelnen Umgebung eignet.
de.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange bietet über Ihr lokales IBM Cloud-Rechenzentrum Multi-Tenant-Verbindungen zu Ihrer IBM Cloud-Infrastruktur. Diese Option eignet sich hervorragend zum Erstellen von Anschlussmöglichkeiten zu mehreren Clouds in einer einzelnen Umgebung. Wir verbinden Kunden mithilfe einer gemeinsamen Bandbreitentopologie mit dem privaten IBM Cloud-Netz. Sie können MPLS, VPLS oder EVPN mit einem unserer globalen Netz- und Datenaustauschprovider im IBM Cloud-Netz über VLANs zusammenfassen. Wie bei allen Direct Link-Produkten können Sie globales Routing hinzufügen, das privaten Netzverkehr zu allen IBM Cloud-Standorten ermöglicht.

en.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offers multi-tenant connections to your IBM Cloud infrastructure, through your local IBM Cloud data center, perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offers multi-tenant connections to your IBM Cloud infrastructure, through your local IBM Cloud data center. This option is perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment. We connect customers to the IBM Cloud private network, using a shared bandwidth topology. You can aggregate your MPLS, VPLS, or EVPN into the IBM Cloud network over VLANs, using one of our global network and exchange providers. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

es.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange ofrece conexiones multiarrendatario para la infraestructura de IBM Cloud a través de un centro de datos local de IBM Cloud, por lo que constituye la solución perfecta para crear conectividad multinube en un único entorno.
es.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange ofrece conexiones multiarrendatario para la infraestructura de IBM Cloud a través de un centro de datos local de IBM Cloud. Esta opción es perfecta para crear conectividad multinube en un entorno único. Conectamos a los clientes con la red privada de IBM Cloud mediante una topología de ancho de banda compartido. Puede añadir MPLS, VPLS o EVPN a la red IBM Cloud mediante VLAN, utilizando uno de nuestros proveedores globales de intercambio y de red. Como sucede con todos los productos de Direct Link, puede añadir direccionamiento global para habilitar el tráfico de red privada con todas las ubicaciones de IBM Cloud.

fr.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offre des connexions à service partagé à votre infrastructure IBM Cloud, via votre centre de données IBM Cloud local, ce qui est idéal pour la création d'une connectivité multi-cloud dans un environnement individuel.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offre des connexions à service partagé à votre infrastructure IBM Cloud, via votre centre de données IBM Cloud local. Cette option est idéale pour la création d'une connectivité multi-cloud dans un environnement individuel. Nous connectons des clients au réseau privé IBM Cloud grâce à une topologie de bande passante partagée. Vous pouvez agréger vos connexions MPLS, VPLS ou EVPN sur le réseau IBM Cloud via des réseaux locaux virtuels avec l'un de nos fournisseurs d'échanges et de réseau mondial. Comme avec tous les produits Direct Link, vous pouvez ajouter le routage mondial pour autoriser le trafic de réseau privé vers tous les emplacements IBM Cloud.

it.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offre connessioni multitenant alla propria infrastruttura IBM Cloud, attraverso il data center IBM Cloud locale, perfetto per la creazione di connettività multicloud in un singolo ambiente.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offre connessioni multitenant alla propria infrastruttura IBM Cloud, attraverso il data center IBM Cloud locale. Questa opzione è perfetta per la creazione di connettività multicloud in un singolo ambiente. I clienti vengono collegati alla rete privata IBM Cloud, utilizzando una topologia di larghezza di banda condivisa. Puoi aggregare i tuoi MPLS, VPLS o EVPN alla rete IBM Cloud attraverso VLAN, utilizzando uno dei nostri provider di scambio e di rete globali. Come per tutti i prodotti Direct Link, è possibile aggiungere l'instradamento globale che abilita il traffico di rete su tutte le ubicazioni IBM Cloud.

ja.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange を利用することで、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センターを経由した IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャーへのマルチテナント接続を実現します。これは、単一環境に複数のクラウド接続を作成する場合に最適です。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange を利用することで、ローカルの IBM Cloud データ・センターを経由した IBM Cloud インフラストラクチャーへのマルチテナント接続が実現します。 このオプションは、単一環境に複数のクラウド接続を作成する場合に最適です。 共有帯域幅トポロジーを使用して、お客様を IBM Cloud プライベート・ネットワークに接続します。 いずれかのグローバル・ネットワーク・プロバイダーと交換プロバイダーを使用して、MPLS、VPLS、EVPN を、VLAN 経由で IBM Cloud ネットワークに集約できます。 他の Direct Link 製品と同様に、すべての IBM Cloud ロケーションへのプライベート・ネットワーク・トラフィックを使用できるようにする、グローバル・ルーティングを追加できます。

ko.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터를 통해 사용자의 IBM Cloud 인프라에 대한 멀티 테넌트 연결을 제공하며, 하나의 환경에서 여러 클라우드 연결을 작성하는 데 적합합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange는 로컬 IBM Cloud 데이터 센터를 통해 사용자의 IBM Cloud 인프라에 대한 멀티 테넌트 연결을 제공합니다. 이 옵션은 하나의 환경에 여러 클라우드 연결을 작성하는 데 적합합니다. 고객은 공유 대역폭 토폴로지를 사용하여 IBM Cloud 사설 네트워크에 연결됩니다. 사용자는 IBM의 글로벌 네트워크 및 교환 서비스 제공업체 중 하나를 사용하여, VLAN을 통해 자신의 MPLS, VPLS 또는 EVPN을 IBM Cloud 네트워크로 모을 수 있습니다. 모든 Direct Link 제품과 마찬가지로, 사용자는 모든 IBM Cloud 위치에 대한 사설 네트워크 트래픽을 가능하게 하는 글로벌 라우팅을 추가할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange oferece conexões de diversos locatários para sua infraestrutura do IBM Cloud, por meio do data center local do IBM Cloud, perfeito para criar conectividade com múltiplas nuvens em um único ambiente.
pt-br.long_description: O IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange oferece conexões de diversos locatários para sua infraestrutura do IBM Cloud, por meio do data center local do IBM Cloud. Essa opção é perfeita para criar conectividade com múltiplas nuvens em um único ambiente. Nós conectamos os clientes à rede privada do IBM Cloud usando uma topologia de largura de banda compartilhada. É possível agregar o MPLS, o VPLS ou o EVPN à rede do IBM Cloud em VLANs usando um de nossos provedores globais de troca e de rede. Como com todos os produtos Direct Link, é possível incluir roteamento global que permite tráfego de rede privada para todos os locais do IBM Cloud.

zh-cn.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange 通过本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心提供与 IBM Cloud Infrastructure 的多租户连接，最适合在单个环境中创建多云连接。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange 通过本地 IBM Cloud 数据中心提供与 IBM Cloud Infrastructure 的多租户连接。此选项最适合于在单个环境中创建多云连接。我们使用共享带宽拓扑将客户连接到 IBM Cloud 专用网络。您可以使用我们的其中一个全球网络和交换提供商，通过 VLAN 将 MPLS、VPLS 或 EVPN 聚集到 IBM Cloud 网络中。与所有 Direct Link 产品一样，您可以添加全球路由，以支持专用网络流量流入所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

zh-tw.description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange 透過本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心，提供與 IBM Cloud 基礎架構的多方承租戶連線，這最適合在單一環境中建立多雲端連線功能。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange 透過本端 IBM Cloud 資料中心，提供與 IBM Cloud 基礎架構的多方承租戶連線。此選項最適合在單一環境中建立多雲端連線功能。我們使用共用頻寬拓蹼，將客戶連接至 IBM Cloud 專用網路。您可以使用其中一個廣域網路及交換提供者，透過 VLAN 將 MPLS、VPLS 或 EVPN 聚集至 IBM Cloud 網路。與所有 Direct Link 產品相同，您可以將啟用專用網路資料流量的廣域路徑新增至所有 IBM Cloud 位置。

description: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offers multi-tenant connections to your IBM Cloud infrastructure, through your local IBM Cloud data center, perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment.
longDescription: IBM Cloud Direct Link Exchange offers multi-tenant connections to your IBM Cloud infrastructure, through your local IBM Cloud data center. This option is perfect for creating multi-cloud connectivity in a single environment. We connect customers to the IBM Cloud private network, using a shared bandwidth topology. You can aggregate your MPLS, VPLS, or EVPN into the IBM Cloud network over VLANs, using one of our global network and exchange providers. As with all Direct Link products, you can add global routing that enables private network traffic to all IBM Cloud locations.

name: dizzion-cloud-pc

en.description: Deliver modern, secure, and scalable cloud desktops with Dizzion Cloud PC, a fully managed solution on IBM Cloud infrastructure.
en.long_description:
With Dizzion Cloud PC on IBM Cloud, organizations can streamline their virtual desktop delivery by combining the power of the Dizzion cloud platform with the global scale and security of IBM Cloud. This fully managed Desktop as a Service (DaaS) solution enables persistent, personal Windows 11 desktop experiences, built for hybrid work and maximum productivity. We offer two complementary tiers - Core and Complete - to fit every operational model.


The Core Tier is ideal for organizations that already have in-house IT operations, identity services, and endpoint management tools in place. If your team can handle monitoring, patching, and support with existing staff and systems, Core lets you spin up Cloud PCs in minutes - without overhauling your workflows. Companies with 25 or more users can choose from five performance-tuned configurations, plug into your existing AD or run as standalone, and deploy directly over the internet or via private networking.


The Complete Tier builds on the flexibility of Core with enterprise-grade management, security, and unlimited scalability for 50+ desktops, and requires Private Network Access per region. With Dizzion-managed services - Overwatch real-time observability & analytics, automated OS and Application patching, and self-service software deployment for up to two administrators - you get a truly hands-off Cloud PC experience. Tailored for organizations requiring centralized identity, granular performance controls, and seamless global expansion, the Complete Tier also offers a rich add-on catalog - from vulnerability monitoring to advanced firewalling - delivering a turnkey solution that scales with your business. The only elements you manage are end-user support and application deployment.


Whether you are migrating from on-premises VDI or looking to modernize legacy PC deployments, Dizzion Cloud PC provides a seamless path forward with predictable pricing, great user experience, fast provisioning, simplified management, and deployment.


For sales support, reach out to Dizzion directly at sales@dizzion.com.

name: dns-svcs

de.description: Verwenden Sie DNS Services in privaten VPC-Netzen, um Hostnamen und IP-Adressen zu verwalten und den Zugriff auf die DNS-Datensätze auf Zugriff aus berechtigten Netzen zu beschränken.
de.long_description: 'DNS Services' bietet einen zuverlässigen und sicheren DNS-Service mit dem Domänennamen in einem virtuellen Netz verwaltet und aufgelöst werden können, ohne dass eine angepasste DNS-Lösung hinzugefügt werden muss. Durch die Verwendung privater DNS-Zonen können Sie Ihre eigenen angepassten Domänennamen verwenden und die Architektur Ihres virtuellen Netzes optimal an die Anforderungen Ihres Unternehmens anpassen. Der Service umfasst die Namensauflösung für virtuelle Maschinen (VMs) innerhalb eines VPC-Netzes und zwischen VPC-Netzen. Darüber hinaus können Sie Namen für Zonen mit eines Split-Horizon-Ansicht konfigurieren, bei der eine private und eine öffentliche DNS-Zone denselben Namen verwenden.

en.description: Use DNS Services on VPC Private Networks to manage hostnames and IP addresses while limiting access to the DNS records from permitted networks only.
en.long_description:
DNS Services provides a reliable, secure mechanism to manage DNS records, and resolve domain names from a VPC without adding a custom DNS solution. With DNS Services, you can 
- Create private DNS zones which can only be resolved from IBM Cloud's private network.
- Perform forward and reverse DNS lookup.
- Configure zone names with a split-horizon view, which allows a private and a public DNS zone to share the name.

es.description: Utilizar Servicios DNS en redes privadas de VPC para gestionar nombres de host y direcciones IP al tiempo que se limita el acceso a los registros de DNS solo desde redes permitidas.
es.long_description: Los Servicios DNS proporcionan un servicio DNS seguro y fiable para gestionar y resolver nombres de dominio en una red virtual sin necesidad de añadir una solución de DNS personalizada. Utilizando zonas DNS privadas, puede utilizar sus propios nombres de dominio personalizados y adaptar la arquitectura de red virtual según las necesidades de su organización. Proporciona una resolución de nombres para máquinas virtuales (VM) dentro de una red VPC y entre redes VPC. Asimismo, puede configurar nombres de zona con una vista de horizonte dividido, lo que permite a una zona DNS privada y a una pública compartir el nombre.

fr.description: Utilisez DNS Services sur les réseaux privés VPC pour gérer les noms d'hôte et les adresses IP et faire en sorte que seuls les réseaux permis puissent accéder aux enregistrements DNS.
fr.long_description: DNS Services fournit un service DNS sûr et fiable, qui permet de gérer et résoudre les noms de domaine dans un réseau virtuel sans qu'il soit nécessaire d'ajouter une solution DNS personnalisée. Avec des zones DNS privées, vous pouvez utiliser vos propres noms de domaine et adapter votre architecture de réseau virtuel aux besoins de votre organisation. Vous bénéficiez de la résolution des noms entre les machines virtuelles (MV) au sein d'un même réseau VPC ainsi qu'entre les machines de différents réseaux VPC. Vous pouvez aussi configurer les noms des zones avec une vue split horizon, ce qui permet leur partage par une zone DNS publique et privée.

it.description: Utilizzare i servizi DNS sulle reti VPC private per gestire i nomi host e gli indirizzi IP mentre si limita l'accesso ai record DNS solo dalle reti consentite.
it.long_description: DNS Services fornisce un servizio DNS sicuro, affidabile per gestire e risolvere i nomi dominio in una rete virtuale senza la necessità di aggiungere una soluzione DNS personalizzata. Utilizzando le zone DNS, è possibile utilizzare i propri nomi dominio personalizzati e personalizzare la propria architettura di rete virtuale in modo da adattarla alle esigenze dell'organizzazione. Fornisce la risoluzione del nome per le VM (virtual machine) all'interno della rete PVC e tra reti  VPC. Inoltre, è possibile configurare i nomi delle zone con una vista divisa in orizzontale, che consente alle zone DNS pubblica e privata di condividere il nome.

ja.description: VPC プライベート・ネットワークで DNS Services を使用することで、DNS レコードへのアクセスを許可されたネットワークからのアクセスのみに制限しながら、ホスト名と IP アドレスを管理します。
ja.long_description: DNS Services は、カスタム DNS ソリューションを追加することなく、仮想ネットワーク内でドメイン名を管理および解決するための信頼性が高く、セキュアな DNS サービスを提供します。 プライベート DNS ゾーンを使用することで、独自のカスタム・ドメイン名を使用し、組織のニーズに合わせて仮想ネットワーク・アーキテクチャーを調整できます。 これは、VPC ネットワーク内および VPC ネットワーク間での仮想マシン (VM) の名前解決を提供します。 さらに、水平分割ビューを使用してゾーン名を構成できます。これにより、プライベートとパブリックの DNS ゾーンで名前を共有できるようになります。

ko.description: 허용된 네트워크에서만 DNS 레코드에 대한 액세스를 제한하면서 VPC 프라이빗 네트워크의 DNS Services를 사용하여 호스트 이름과 IP 주소를 관리합니다.
ko.long_description: DNS Services는 사용자 정의 DNS 솔루션을 추가하지 않고도 가상 네트워크에서 도메인 이름을 관리하고 분석할 수 있는 안정적이고 보안이 강화된 DNS 서비스를 제공합니다. 프라이빗 DNS 구역을 사용하면 고유 사용자 정의 도메인 이름을 사용하고 사용자 조직의 요구사항에 가장 적합하도록 가상 네트워크 아키텍처를 조정할 수 있습니다. VPC 네트워크 사이 및 VPC 네트워크 내에서 가상 머신(VM)에 대한 이름을 분석할 수 있습니다. 또한 구역 이름을 분할-수평 보기로 구성할 수 있으며 이를 통해 프라이빗 및 퍼블릭 DNS 구역이 이름을 공유할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Use o DNS Services em redes privadas VPC para gerenciar nomes de host e endereços IP enquanto limita o acesso aos registros DNS somente de redes permitidas.
pt-br.long_description: O DNS Services fornece um serviço DNS confiável e seguro para gerenciar e resolver nomes de domínio em uma rede virtual sem a necessidade de incluir uma solução DNS customizada. Ao utilizar zonas de DNS privadas, é possível usar seus próprios nomes de domínio customizados e personalizar sua arquitetura de rede virtual para que ela se adeque às necessidades da sua organização. Ele fornece resolução de nomes para máquinas virtuais (VMs) dentro de uma rede VPC e entre redes VPC. Além disso, é possível configurar nomes de zonas com uma visualização split-horizon, que permite a uma zona DNS privada e pública compartilhar o nome.

zh-cn.description: 在 VPC 专用网络上使用 DNS 服务来管理主机名和 IP 地址，同时将对 DNS 记录的访问限制为仅允许的网络。
zh-cn.long_description: DNS 服务提供安全可靠的 DNS 服务来管理和解析虚拟网络中的域名，而无需添加定制 DNS 解决方案。通过使用专用 DNS 区域，您可以使用自己的定制域名并定制虚拟网络架构，从而最适合贵组织的需求。它会在 VPC 网络内和 VPC 网络之间提供虚拟机 (VM) 的名称解析。此外，您可以使用水平分割视图来配置区域名称，这使得专用和公共 DNS 区域能够共享名称。

zh-tw.description: 使用「VPC 私密網路」上的「DNS 服務」來管理主機名稱和 IP 位址，同時限制為只接受從允許的網路存取 DNS 記錄。
zh-tw.long_description: 「DNS 服務」提供可靠安全的 DNS 服務來管理和解析虛擬網路中的網域名稱，而不需要新增自訂 DNS 解析。透過使用專用 DNS 區域，您可以使用專屬自訂網域名稱並修改您的虛擬網路架構以最適合您組織的需求。它為一個 VPC 網路中的虛擬機器 (VM) 以及 VPC 網路之間的虛擬機器 (VM) 提供名稱解析。此外，您也可以透過水平分割的視圖來配置區域名稱，讓專用和公用 DNS 區域共用該名稱。

en.description: AI-powered sales intelligence platform that finds high-value prospects,reveals buyer priorities,and personalizes outreach to Scale
en.long_description:
Draup for Sales is a Global Sales Intelligence platform that transforms how enterprise sales and account teams identify opportunities, plan pursuits, and win complex deals. 

Built on rich, proprietary market and labor data ecosystems, Draup delivers contextual, comprehensive, and real-time intelligence across every stage of the enterprise sales lifecycle. 

Unlike traditional databases that just list contacts, Draup maps industries, accounts, and buyers into a single explainable interface, showing who to target, why now, and what to say. 

Core Modules 

·       Industry Intelligence: Explore emerging use cases, market drivers, and investment trends across 33 industries. Identify fast-moving opportunities with live signals from 70K+ data sources. 

·       Account Intelligence: Access 360° company profiles with financials, tech stacks, outsourcing vendors, talent demand, business priorities and geo-level workforce trends. 

·       Buyer Intelligence: Discover true decision-making committees, track leadership moves, and tailor outreach using intent and influence data. 

·       Braindesk: AI-curated repository for on-demand reports and presentations on market, location, and talent trends  

·       Projects: Dedicated workspace to build and manage account plans, bookmark key orgs, and collaborate across pursuits with saved searches, lists, and live signal tracking. 

 

Why It Matters 

·       For Account Executives: Build sharper, faster pursuit plans aligned to each buyer’s priorities. 

·       For ABM & Marketing Teams: Target the right industries and accounts at the right moment. 

·       For Partner Sales & Alliances: Identify where partnerships can accelerate growth and attach motions. 

·       For Sales Leadership: De-risk forecasts with verified real-time signals that show deal readiness and timing.  

Core Use Cases: 

·       Account Prioritization & Whitespace Discovery 
Identify and rank high-potential accounts using verified intent, fit, and timing signals to focus on where revenue is most likely to convert. 

·       Buyer Committee Mapping & Persona Targeting 
Uncover true decision-making committees, map influencers and stakeholders, and tailor outreach with persona-level insights and context. 

·       Account Planning & Management 
Build dynamic, data-backed account plans that track business intentions, tech stacks, partnerships, and executive movements - all in one view. 

·       Partner & Channel Sales Enablement 
Align sales motions with partner strengths, uncover co-sell opportunities, and accelerate joint wins through verified ecosystem and workload data. 

·       Signal-Driven Prospecting (Fit, Intent, and Timing) 
Convert millions of live market signals into prioritized prospect lists, targeting the right accounts at the right moment with the right message.  

Key Outcomes: 
↑ Win rate & ACV ↓ Sales cycle & research time ↑ Meeting→Opportunity conversion ↓ Forecast slips & cost-to-sell

name: elastio

en.description: Elastio adds advanced ransomware protection to IBM Cloud Object Storage by proactively validating data is clean and uncompromised.
en.long_description:
Before getting started, ensure you have an IBM Cloud Object storage instance. You can create one here: https://cloud.ibm.com/objectstorage

As ransomware increasingly bypasses endpoint and network defenses, customers now expect storage itself to become an active layer of cyber defense - a model analysts define as cyberstorage. In this approach, stored data is no longer passive infrastructure, but a control point where attacks are detected, scoped, and recovery decisions are made. 

Elastio enhances IBM Cloud Object Storage (COS) by adding a data integrity layer that detects ransomware, malware, and corruption directly within stored cloud object data. Using advanced machine learning built on over a decade of ransomware research, Elastio identifies known and zero-day encryption techniques, including stealthy, fileless attacks that evade traditional security tools.

By scanning data outside of production systems, Elastio provides early visibility into ransomware impact and enables recovery assurance from pre-validated data. This transforms IBM Cloud Object Storage from durable storage into cyberstorage: strengthening cyber resilience, supporting compliance requirements, and giving customers confidence that the data they store in IBM COS is trustworthy.

Any questions? Reach out to ibm@elastio.com

en.description: etiCloud Secure Digital Agile Workplace - Secure Desktop-as-a-Service delivered as a private business environment.
en.long_description:
Agile Digital Workplace:
Access documents, files, emails and relevant applications quickly and securely, anytime, anywhere – enabling a truly agile digital workplace to improve cost and time efficiencies.

Computing in the modern workplace:
When it comes to the computing experience in your business, how easy is it for you to access the system and relevant applications? Chances are you’re rolling your eyes because it’s probably a little hit and miss. Right?

If you’re office-based, do you find yourself turning on your laptop and heading to the kitchen to make coffee while the system loads? When you’re travelling on a train, do you have to wait ages to open a single file? And if you’re working from home, do you get frustrated with how long it takes to send an email? Have you simply got used to circumventing the workflow to allow for inefficiencies in the existing IT system?

Many UK companies and organisations employ a range of functionality to deliver IT. A mix of Cloud, on-premise and legacy systems in place, all evolving over time, can lead to an inefficient and cumbersome platform that is simply not fit for purpose. This poses challenges for everyone from end users to IT teams:

Difficulty in accessing information quickly and reliably, irrespective of whether you’re in the office or on the move
Different passwords for different systems
Inadequate cybersecurity protocols for remote working access
Having uniform, fast, secure and reliable ‘round-the-clock’ access to every piece of information you need to do your job efficiently and effectively is imperative for commercial success. Irrespective of your location, whether you’re office-based or on the move, you need data, documents, files, spreadsheets, emails and everything in between instantly at your fingertips. Not possible? Think again. With etiCloud Agile Digital Workplace you can have all of this, and more, in one single place.

name: event-notifications

de.description: Geben Sie E-Mail, SMS und Webhooks und andere Möglichkeiten zur Benachrichtigungen für Ihre IBM Cloud-Serviceereignisse an.
de.long_description: Bei IBM Cloud® Event Notifications handelt es sich um einen Routing-Service für Ereignisbenachrichtigungen, mit dem Sie über kritische Ereignisse in Ihrem IBM Cloud-Konto informiert werden oder der automatisierte Aktionen mithilfe von Webhooks auslöst. Sie können Ereignisbenachrichtigungen von IBM Cloud-Services wie Monitoring, Security and Compliance Centerund Secrets Manager filtern und als E-Mails, SMS und Webhooks weiterleiten.

en.description: Transactional email via SMTP relay, plus event-driven automation and alerting across webhooks, Code Engine, SMS, Slack, and more. One centralized service. Rapid, no-code routing.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications is an event notification routing service that notifies you to critical events that occur in your IBM Cloud account or triggers automated actions by using webhooks. You can filter and route event notifications from IBM Cloud services to Email, SMS, Webhooks and Push Notifications.

es.description: Entregue correo electrónico, SMS y Webhooks y otras notificaciones para los sucesos de servicio de IBM Cloud.
es.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications es un servicio de direccionamiento de notificaciones de sucesos que le notifica los sucesos críticos que se producen en la cuenta de IBM Cloud o desencadena acciones automatizadas utilizando webhooks. Puede filtrar y direccionar las notificaciones de sucesos desde servicios de IBM Cloud como Monitoring, Security and Compliance Center, y Secrets Manager por correo electrónico, SMS y webhooks.

fr.description: Distribuez des e-mails, SMS et webhooks ainsi que d'autres notifications pour vos événements de service IBM Cloud.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications est un service de routage de notification d'événements qui vous avertit des événements critiques qui se produisent dans votre compte IBM Cloud ou qui déclenche des actions automatisées à l'aide de webhooks. Vous pouvez filtrer et acheminer les notifications d'événements à partir de services IBM Cloud tels que Monitoring, Security and Compliance Center et Secrets Manager vers des e-mails, SMS et webhooks.

it.description: Consegnare email, SMS, webhook e altre notifiche per gli eventi di servizio IBM Cloud.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications è un servizio di instradamento delle notifiche di eventi che invia agli utenti la notifica per gli eventi critici che si verificano nell'account IBM Cloud o attiva le azioni automatizzate utilizzando i webhook. È possibile filtrare e instradare le notifiche degli eventi dai servizi IBM Cloud come Monitoring, Security and Compliance Centere Secrets Manager a email, SMS e webhook.

ja.description: IBM Cloudサービス・イベントに関する電子メール、SMS、Webhook、その他の通知を配信します。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notificationsは、IBM Cloudアカウントで発生した重要なイベントを通知したり、Webhook を使用して自動アクションをトリガーしたりするイベント通知ルーティングサービスです。 IBM Cloudモニタリング、Security and Compliance Center、およびSecrets Managerのようなサービスから電子メール、SMS、および Webhook にイベント通知をフィルタリングおよび経路指定を行うことができます。

ko.description: IBM Cloud 서비스 이벤트에 대한 이메일, SMS, 웹훅 및 기타 알림을 전달하십시오.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications은(는) IBM Cloud 계정에서 발생하는 중요한 이벤트를 알리거나 웹훅을 사용하여 자동화된 조치를 트리거하는 이벤트 알림 라우팅 서비스입니다. Monitoring, Security and Compliance Center 및 Secrets Manager과(와) 같은 IBM Cloud 서비스의 이벤트 알림을 필터링하여 이메일, SMS 및 웹훅으로 라우팅할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.description: Entregue e-mail, SMS e Webhooks e outras notificações para seus eventos de serviço da IBM Cloud.
pt-BR.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications é um serviço de roteamento de notificação de eventos que o notifica sobre eventos críticos que ocorrem em sua conta IBM Cloud ou aciona ações automatizadas usando webhooks. É possível filtrar e rotear notificações de eventos de serviços IBM Cloud como Monitoring, Security and Compliance Center e Secrets Manager para e-mail, SMS e webhooks.

zh-Hans.description: 为 IBM Cloud 服务事件提供电子邮件、SMS 和 Webhook 以及其他通知。
zh-Hans.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications 是事件通知路由服务，它会将发生在您的 IBM Cloud 帐户中的关键事件通知您，或使用 Webhook 触发自动操作。 您可以过滤来自 IBM Cloud 服务（如 Monitoring、Security and Compliance Center 和 Secrets Manager）的事件通知并将其路由到电子邮件、SMS 和 Webhook。

zh-Hant.description: 為您的 IBM Cloud 服務事件遞送電子郵件、SMS 和 Webhook 及其他通知。
zh-Hant.long_description: IBM Cloud® Event Notifications 是事件通知遞送服務，會通知您在 IBM Cloud 帳戶中發生的重要事件，或使用 Webhook 觸發自動化動作。 您可以過濾來自 IBM Cloud 服務（如 Monitoring、Security and Compliance Center 及 Secrets Manager）的事件通知並將其遞送至電子郵件、SMS 及 Webhook。

de.description: Mit diesem Plan wird Ihnen für aufgenommene Ereignisse und ausgehende digitale Nachrichten eine Gebühr berechnet.  Bei einem aufgenommenen Ereignis handelt es sich um ein Ereignis, das empfangen und gefiltert wird.  Wenn eine Quelle verbunden ist, aber keine Filter für sie definiert sind, werden die eingehenden Ereignisse gelöscht und es wird Ihnen nichts berechnet.  Ausgehende digitale Nachrichten werden in verschiedenen Typen ausgegeben und jeder Typ wird separat berechnet.

en.description: With this plan you are charged for ingested events and for outbound digital messages.  An ingested event is one that is received and filtered.  If a source is connected but no filters are defined for it, the incoming events are dropped and you are not charged.  Outbound digital messages come in various types, and each type is priced separately. With this plan you get 10 million free push notifications. For SMS units and country-wise charges, refer to [SMS charges page](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/event-notifications?topic=event-notifications-en-destinations-sms#en-destinations-sms-charge).

Los mensajes digitales tienen tipos diferentes, y cada tipo tiene un precio diferente.

name: messagehub

de.description: Nutzen Sie unseren vollständig verwalteten Kafka-Service, um intelligente Anwendungen zu erstellen, die in Echtzeit auf Ereignisse reagieren.
de.long_description: Event Streams in IBM Cloud ist ein vollständig verwalteter Nachrichtenbus mit hohem Durchsatz, der auf Apache Kafka basiert und die Kommunikation von Anwendungen und Services ermöglicht. Er ist für die Ereignisaufnahme in IBM Cloud und die Ereignisverteilung zwischen Ihren Services und Anwendungen optimiert. Event Streams in IBM Cloud ermöglicht Ihnen, produktionsbereite Apache Kafka-Apps bereitzustellen und native Cloud-Apps in einer sicheren und hoch verfügbaren Umgebung zu erstellen.

en.description: Leverage our fully managed Kafka service to help you build intelligent applications that react to events in real time.
en.long_description: Event Streams on IBM Cloud is a fully managed, high-throughput message bus built on Apache Kafka that enables applications and services to communicate. It is optimized for event ingestion into IBM Cloud and event distribution between your services and applications. Event Streams on IBM Cloud allows you to deploy production ready Apache Kafka and build cloud native apps in a secure and highly available environment.

es.description: Aproveche nuestro servicio Kafka totalmente gestionado para ayudarle a crear aplicaciones inteligentes que reaccionen a los sucesos en tiempo real.
es.long_description: Event Streams en IBM Cloud es un bus de mensajes de alto rendimiento totalmente gestionado basado en Apache Kafka que permite que las aplicaciones y los servicios se comuniquen. Está optimizado para la ingesta de sucesos en IBM Cloud y la distribución de sucesos entre los servicios y las aplicaciones. Event Streams en IBM Cloud le permite desplegar Apache Kafka listo para producción y crear aplicaciones nativas en la nube en un entorno seguro y de alta disponibilidad.

fr.description: Tirez parti de notre service Kafka entièrement géré pour vous aider à créer des applications intelligentes qui réagissent aux événements en temps réel.
fr.long_description: Event Streams on IBM Cloud est un bus de messages à haut débit entièrement géré et basé sur Apache Kafka qui permet aux applications et aux services de communiquer. Il est optimisé pour l'ingestion d'événements dans IBM Cloud et la distribution d'événements entre vos services et applications. Event Streams on IBM Cloud vous permet de déployer des applications Apache Kafka prêtes pour la production et de créer des applications cloud natives dans un environnement sécurisé et à haute disponibilité.

it.description: Sfrutta il nostro servizio Kafka completamente gestito per aiutarti a creare applicazioni intelligenti che reagiscono agli eventi in tempo reale.
it.long_description: Event Streams su IBM Cloud è un bus di messaggi completamente gestito e con capacità di elaborazione elevata basato su Apache Kafka che consente alle applicazioni e ai servizi di comunicare. È ottimizzato per l'inserimento di eventi in IBM Cloud e la distribuzione di eventi tra servizi e applicazioni. Event Streams su IBM Cloud consente di distribuire Apache Kafka pronto per la produzione e create app cloud native in un ambiente sicuro e altamente disponibile.

ja.description: フル・マネージドの Kafka サービスを活用して、リアルタイムでイベントに対応するインテリジェントなアプリケーションを構築できます。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud 上の Event Streams は、アプリケーションとサービスの通信を可能にする Apache Kafka 上に構築されたフルマネージドの高スループット メッセージ バスです。 これは、IBM Cloud へのイベント取り込み、およびサービスとアプリケーションの間のイベント配布のために最適化されています。 IBM Cloud 上の Event Streams を使用すると、実動対応の Apache Kafka をデプロイし、セキュアで高可用性の環境でクラウド・ネイティブ・アプリケーションを作成できます。

ko.description: 완전 관리형 Kafka 서비스를 활용하면 실시간으로 이벤트에 반응하는 지능형 애플리케이션을 빌드할 수 있습니다.
ko.long_description: Event Streams on IBM Cloud는 Apache Kafka에 빌드된 완전 관리형의 대량 처리 메시지 버스로, 애플리케이션과 서비스가 통신할 수 있도록 합니다. IBM Cloud에 대한 이벤트 수집 및 서비스와 애플리케이션 간 이벤트 분배에 최적화되어 있습니다. Event Streams on IBM Cloud를 사용하면 프로덕션 준비 Apache Kafka를 배치하고 보안 및 고가용성 환경에서 클라우드 원시 앱을 빌드할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Aproveite o nosso serviço Kafka totalmente gerenciado para ajudá-lo a construir aplicativos inteligentes que reagem a eventos em tempo real.
pt-br.long_description: O Event Streams na IBM Cloud é um barramento de mensagem totalmente gerenciado e de alto rendimento construído no Apache Kafka que permite que aplicativos e serviços se comuniquem. Ele é otimizado para a ingestão de eventos na IBM Cloud e distribuição de eventos entre seus serviços e aplicativos. O Event Streams na IBM Cloud permite que você implemente o Apache Kafka pronto para produção e construa apps nativos em nuvem em um ambiente seguro e altamente disponível.

zh-cn.description: 利用我们完全受管的 Kafka 服务，帮助您构建智能应用程序，实时响应事件。
zh-cn.long_description: Event Streams on IBM Cloud 是基于 Apache Kafka 构建的完全受管的高吞吐量消息总线，支持应用程序和服务进行通信。 它针对到 IBM Cloud 中的事件采集以及服务与应用程序之间的事件分发进行了优化。 Event Streams on IBM Cloud 允许您部署生产就绪的 Apache Kafka，以及在安全且高度可用的环境中构建云本机应用程序。

zh-tw.description: 利用我們完全受管理的 Kafka 服務來協助您建置智慧型應用程式，以即時回應事件。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud 上的 Event Streams 是在 Apache Kafka 上建置的完全受管理高傳輸量訊息匯流排，可讓應用程式及服務進行通訊。 它已針對將事件汲取至 IBM Cloud 以及服務與應用程式之間的事件配送進行最佳化。 IBM Cloud 上的 Event Streams 可讓您部署正式作業就緒 Apache Kafka，並在安全且高可用性的環境中建置雲端原生應用程式。

en.description: Provides fully managed IBM Power offsite data storage.
en.long_description:
FalconStor Habanero is a fully managed storage service designed to simplify secure offsite data storage for IBM Power, especially IBM i on-premises environments, delivering ransomware resilient retention, disaster recovery, compliance, and long term archiving at a cost model comparable to object storage and requiring no changes to existing backup infrastructures.

Habanero integrates directly with existing IBM Power backup applications and processes delivering simplified secure offsite data protection for on-premises IBM Power systems including IBM i, AIX, and Linux workloads.

plans.name: annual-subscription

en.description:
Pricing is based on source data in terabytes. Subscription commitment is for a full year with automatic renewal with monthly billing and is discounted 30% off list price.  If the service is cancelled, the remaining months of the annual subscription term will be billed.
Starting price is $2,500 per month, which includes up to 250 TB active tier.
There are no data retrieval fees from active tier. Archive unused or infrequently requested data to save cost on storage of long-term data. Restoring data from archive tier may take up to 12 hours.
IBM Power11 server packages support Habanero as an all inclusive off site backup-DR-Archive solution which includes an On-Prem Appliance, Cloud infrastructure -  PVS server & IBM COS, Software licensing and SaaS that creates an environment continually monitored by FalconStor Super Admin.
Customers can use their earned P11 server package to cover their Habanero monthly charge to be used within 12 months.

name: falconstor-software-storsafe-vtl-for-power

en.description: Decrease your on-premise backup storage capacity by up to 90%, while improving your existing backup solution performance.
en.long_description:
FalconStor StorSafe is a software solution that optimizes backup and restore, to improve performance and significantly reduce backup storage costs, all without requiring changes to the existing backup solution currently being used. With its integrated deduplication, the solution removes redundant copies of data, thereby reducing capacity requirements, decreasing storage costs, and minimizing replication and restore times. StorSafe can be used with all leading backup solutions, and enables both hybrid and native-cloud backup, as well as both workload and tape migration to the cloud, including IBM PowerVS.
This solution is applicable to hybrid cloud deployments where you can have a backup of data on your on-premises deployment in the cloud. You can also use this solution for your on-premises workload migration to the cloud.
 
For a free assessment, contact a solution expert at ibmsales@falconstor.com.

name: file-storage

de.description: Schneller und flexibler NFS-basierter Dateispeicher mit Kapazitätsoptionen von 20 GB bis 12 TB.
de.long_description:
Fügen Sie zu Ihrem IBM Cloud-Portfolio schnellen und flexiblen NFS-basierten Dateispeicher hinzu. Eine auf Flashspeicher basierende Architektur ermöglicht umfassende Kontrolle und eine Reduzierung der Kosten auf ein Minimum. Erstellen Sie gemeinsam genutzte Dateiressourcen mit einer Größe von 20 GB bis 12 TB und richten Sie sie mit einer Vielzahl flexibler und leistungsbasierter Optionen ein.

Wählen Sie Endurance-Tiers für eine einfache, vordefinierte, auf GB-Einheiten basierende Preisstruktur aus - ideal für Workloads ohne eindeutig definierte Leistungsanforderungen. 
Oder erstellen Sie eine differenziert abgestimmte Umgebung mit zugeordneten IOPS und Leistungsoptionen - ideal für im Detail bekannte Workloadanforderungen außerhalb der verfügbaren Endurance-Tiers.

en.description: Fast and flexible NFS-based file storage with capacity options from 20GB to 12TB.
en.long_description:
Add fast and flexible NFS-based file storage to your IBM Cloud portfolio. Get total control and help minimize costs with flash-backed architecture. Create file shares from 20GB to 12TB—and provision it all with a variety of flexible and power-based options. 

Choose Endurance tiers for simple, predefined, per-GB pricing—ideal for workloads without well defined performance requirements. 
Or, build a fine-tuned environment with allocated IOPS with Performance options—ideal for well-understood workload requirements that fall outside of the available Endurance tiers.

es.description: Almacenamiento de archivos basado en NFS rápido y flexible con opciones de capacidad de 20 GB a 12 TB.
es.long_description:
Añada almacenamiento de archivos basado en NFS rápido y flexible a su portfolio de IBM Cloud. Disfrute de un control total y minimice los costes con la arquitectura con soporte flash. Cree comparticiones de archivo de 20 GB a 12 TB y suminístrelas con una amplia variedad de opciones flexibles basadas en Power. 

Elija niveles de resistencia para obtener un establecimiento de precios simple y predefinido por GB, ideal para cargas de trabajo sin requisitos de rendimiento bien definidos. 
O bien, cree un entorno ajustado con IOPS asignadas de Rendimiento, ideal para empresas con requisitos de rendimiento bien conocidos que quedan fuera de los niveles de resistencia disponibles.

fr.description: Stockage de fichiers NFS rapide et flexible, avec des options de capacité allant de 20 Go à 12 To.
fr.long_description:
Ajoutez à votre portefeuille IBM Cloud du stockage de fichiers basé NFS rapide et flexible. Ayez un contrôle total et réduisez les coûts grâce à une architecture flash. Créez des partages de fichiers de 20 Go à 12 To, et mettez ces partages à disposition de tous grâce à toute une gamme d'options puissantes et flexibles. 

Optez pour des niveaux Endurance pour une tarification simple, prédéfinie et par Go, idéale pour charges de travail pour lesquelles les exigences de performance ne sont pas parfaitement définies. 
Ou bien, créez un environnement optimisé en choisissant des IOPS allouées avec des options Performance, idéales pour des exigences de charge de travail bien maîtrisées et qui dépassent les niveaux Endurance disponibles.

it.description: Archiviazione file basata su NFS veloce e flessibile con opzioni di capacità da 20GB a 12TB.
it.long_description:
Aggiungi l'archiviazione file basata su NFS veloce e flessibile al tuo portfolio IBM Cloud. Ottieni il controllo totale e riduci i costi con l'architettura con supporto all-flash. Crea condivisioni file da 20GB a 12TB ed eseguine il provisioning con molte opzioni basate sulla potenza e flessibili. 

Scegli i livelli di durata per carichi di lavoro semplici, predefiniti, per GB e ideali per prezzo senza requisiti di prestazioni ben definiti. 
Oppure crea un ambiente ottimizzato con IOPS assegnati con opzioni di prestazioni ideali per requisiti del carico di lavoro ben compresi che non rientrano nei livelli di durata disponibili.

ja.description: 20 GB から 12 TB までの、容量オプションを備えた、高速で柔軟な NFS ベースのファイル・ストレージです。
ja.long_description:
高速で柔軟な NFS ベースのファイル・ストレージを IBM Cloud のポートフォリオに追加します。 flash-backed アーキテクチャーにより、全体の制御を得るとともに、コストを最小限に抑えます。 20 GB から 12 TB までのファイル共有を作成し、柔軟でパワーを兼ね備えたさまざまなオプションを用いてプロビジョンします。 

シンプルで事前定義された、GB 単位の価格設定で提供されるエンデュランス層は、パフォーマンス要件が明確に定義されていないワークロードにとって理想的です。 
あるいは、パフォーマンス・オプションによって割り振られた IOPS によるきめ細かな環境の構築は、使用可能なエンデュランス層の範囲外の、十分に理解されたワークロード要件にとって理想的です。

ko.description: 20GB - 12TB의 용량 옵션을 가진 빠르고 유연한 NFS 기반 파일 스토리지입니다.
ko.long_description:
빠르고 유연한 NFS 기반 파일 스토리지를 IBM Cloud 포트폴리오에 추가합니다. 플래시백 아키텍처로 완벽하게 제어할 수 있고 비용은 최소화할 수 있습니다. 20GB - 12TB의 파일 공유를 작성하고 유연한 여러 하드웨어 성능 기반 옵션을 사용하여 모두 프로비저닝합니다. 

사전 정의된 단순한 GB당 가격을 원할 경우 Endurance 티어를 선택하십시오. 이는 성능 요구사항이 제대로 정의되지 않은 워크로드에 적합합니다. 
또는 성능 옵션을 통해 할당된 IOPS로 세부 조정된 환경을 빌드하십시오. 이는 사용 가능한 Endurance 티어를 벗어나는 워크로드 요구사항이 명확한 경우에 적합합니다.

pt-br.description: Armazenamento de arquivos rápido e flexível, baseado em NFS, com opções de capacidade de 20 GB a 12 TB.
pt-br.long_description:
Adicione armazenamento de arquivo baseado em NFS rápido e flexível ao seu portfólio IBM Cloud. Obtenha controle total e ajude a minimizar custos com uma arquitetura com suporte flash. Crie compartilhamentos de arquivo de 20GB a 12TB e provisione tudo com uma variedade de opções flexíveis e baseadas em energia. 

Escolha camadas do Endurance para precificação por GB simples e predefinida: ideais para cargas de trabalho sem requisitos de desempenho bem definidos. 
Ou construa um ambiente ajustado com IOPs alocados com opções do Performance: ideal para requisitos de carga de trabalho bem compreendidos que não são abrangidos pelas camadas disponíveis do Endurance.

zh-cn.description: 快速、灵活的基于 NFS 的文件存储器，容量选项为 20 GB 到 12 TB。
zh-cn.long_description:
向您的 IBM Cloud 产品组合添加快速、灵活的基于 NFS 的文件存储器。全面掌控基于闪存的体系结构，并帮助最大限度地降低其成本。创建从 20 GB 到 12 TB 的文件共享 - 并为所有文件共享供应各种基于能力的灵活选项。

为简单、预定义的按 GB 计算的定价选择“耐久性”层 - 最适用于没有明确定义性能需求的工作负载。
或者，使用“性能”选项构建具有已分配 IOPS 的微调环境 - 最适用于充分了解工作负载需求超出可用“耐久性”层的情况。

zh-tw.description: 快速且有彈性的 NFS 檔案儲存空間，並且具有從 20GB 到 12TB 的容量選項。
zh-tw.long_description:
將快速且有彈性的 NFS 檔案儲存空間新增至您的 IBM Cloud 組合。使用快閃記憶體支援的架構取得完全的控制，並有助於將成本降到最低。建立從 20GB 到 12TB 的檔案共用，並使用各種彈性且以性能為基礎的選項來佈建它。

選擇「耐久性」層級可獲得簡單、預先定義、以每 GB 為基礎的定價—最適合沒有完整定義之效能需求的工作負載。
或者，使用已配置 IOPS 與「效能」選項，建置微調的環境—最適合清楚瞭解且落在可用「耐久性」層級以外的工作負載需求。

bullets.description: You can avoid data loss during maintenance or failures without needing to create system-level RAID arrays. Redundant network architecture (multiple network paths) and redundant storage (high availability pairs) ensure that file shares tolerate service interruption to a part of the infrastructure, and service availability is maintained.
bullets.title: Durability

bullets.description: Your data on a file share is encrypted with IBM-managed keys at no cost to you. For more control and greater security, you can bring your own root keys to the cloud or have an IBM key management service generate root keys for you. Supported key management services are Key Protect and Hyper Protect Crypto Services (HPCS).
bullets.title: Security for data at rest

bullets.description: You can use security group policies to manage access to the file share. During normal operations, data is moving through a secure data center network. In addition, the traffic between the authorized virtual server instance and the file share can be IPsec encapsulated by the client when Encryption-in-transit is enabled.
bullets.title: Security for data in flight

name: is.share

en.description: Create a shared storage that you can share across multiple Virtual Servers within your VPC.
en.long_description: The IBM Cloud® File Storage for VPC service provides secure, persistent, NSFv4.1 protocol-based file storage. IBM Cloud® File Storage for VPC is backed by All-Flash architecture. You can create file shares with capacity that ranges from 10 GB to 32 TB with flexible options. You can mount the file share on multiple IBM Cloud Virtual Servers for file sharing and collaboration. You have total control over your data as you manage access to the file shares with IAM profiles, security groups, and context-based restrictions. You can also bring your own root keys to add another layer of encryption. You can manage your cost by provisioning only what you need. You can increase the share capacity later when you need more storage, and you can adjust the IOPS to increase or decrease performance anytime.

name: flacron-ar-ai-agent

en.description: AI agent that analyzes property inspection photos for damage, generates repair scopes, and produces cost estimates.
en.long_description:
Flacron AR Agent automates the repetitive part of property inspection follow up. Feed it an inspection photo and it identifies visible damage type, location, severity, and a recommended action. From there, it turns those findings into a structured repair scope of work, and prices that scope into a full cost estimate with labor, material, and total line items.
Each action is a discrete, callable tool with a defined input and output, so it fits directly into an automated workflow: trigger damage analysis on a new photo, generate the scope from the findings, generate the estimate from the scope. Authentication is a company-scoped API key, so every call is tied to the right account and project.

description: AI agent that analyzes property inspection photos for damage, generates repair scopes, and produces cost estimates.
longDescription:
Flacron AR Agent automates the repetitive part of property inspection follow up. Feed it an inspection photo and it identifies visible damage type, location, severity, and a recommended action. From there, it turns those findings into a structured repair scope of work, and prices that scope into a full cost estimate with labor, material, and total line items.
Each action is a discrete, callable tool with a defined input and output, so it fits directly into an automated workflow: trigger damage analysis on a new photo, generate the scope from the findings, generate the estimate from the scope. Authentication is a company-scoped API key, so every call is tied to the right account and project.

name: is.flow-log-collector

de.description: Ermöglicht die Erfassung von Informationen zum Datenverkehr mit Internet Protocol (IP) an Netze und aus Netzen in Ihren virtuellen privaten Clouds (VPCs).
de.long_description: Datenflussprotokolle können Sie bei verschiedenen Tasks unterstützen, beispielsweise bei der Fehlerbehebung, wenn ein bestimmter Datenverkehr eine Instanz nicht erreicht, was wiederum die Diagnose von Sicherheitsgruppenregeln fördert.  Die Datenflussprotokollausgabe können Sie darüber hinaus als Quelle für Anwendungen einsetzen, von denen der Datenverkehr analysiert wird, der Ihre Ressourcen erreicht.  Datenflussprotokolle sind ein äußerst wichtiges Tool für die Ermittlung des Gesamtzustands bei der Netzüberwachung und Ursachenanalyse.

en.description: Enables the capture of information about the Internet Protocol (IP) traffic going to and from networks of your Virtual Private Clouds (VPC).
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Flow Logs for VPC is an add-on feature to IBM Cloud VPC Gen2, enabling the collection of information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. Flow logs can help with a number of tasks; for example, to troubleshoot why specific traffic is not reaching an instance, which in turn helps to diagnose security group rules. You can also use flow log output as a source for applications that analyze traffic that is reaching your resources. Flow logs is a critical tool for determine the overall health of network monitoring and root cause analysis.

es.description: Permite la captura de información sobre el tráfico de Protocolo Internet (IP) que se traslada hacia y desde en las redes de sus nubes privadas virtuales (VPC).
es.long_description: Los registros de flujo son muy útiles con muchas tareas, por ejemplo, para solucionar por qué un determinado tráfico no accede a una instancia, lo que a su vez permite diagnosticar reglas de grupo de seguridad. También puede utilizar la salida del registro de flujo como fuente para las aplicaciones que analizan el tráfico que accede a sus recursos. El registro de flujo es una herramienta clave para determinar el estado general de la supervisión de red y el análisis de causa raíz.

fr.description: Active la capture d'informations sur le trafic IP (Internet Protocol) vers et depuis les réseaux de vos clouds privés virtuels (VPC).
fr.long_description: Les journaux de flux peuvent vous aider à effectuer un certain nombre de tâches ; par exemple, identifier et résoudre les raisons pour lesquelles un trafic spécifique n'atteint pas une instance, ce qui aide ensuite à diagnostiquer les règles de groupe de sécurité.  Vous pouvez également utiliser la sortie du journal de flux comme source pour les applications analysant le trafic qui atteint vos ressources.  Les journaux de flux constituent un outil essentiel pour déterminer la santé globale de la surveillance du réseau et l'analyse de la cause première.

it.description: Abilita l'acquisizione di informazioni relative al traffico IP (Internet Protocol) verso e dalle reti dei propri VPC (Virtual Private Cloud).
it.long_description: I log di flusso possono essere utili per una serie di attività; ad esempio, per individuare il motivo per cui il traffico specifico non raggiunge un'istanza e, di conseguenza, diagnosticare le regole del gruppo di sicurezza.  È possibile utilizzare l'output dei log di flusso anche come origine per le applicazioni che analizzano il traffico che raggiunge le proprie risorse.  I log di flusso rappresentano uno strumento critico per determinare lo stato generale del monitoraggio della rete e l'analisi della causa principale.

ja.description: 仮想プライベート・クラウド (VPC) のネットワークを往来するインターネット・プロトコル (IP) トラフィックに関する情報をキャプチャーすることができます。
ja.long_description: フロー・ログはさまざまなタスクで役立ちます。例えば、特定のトラフィックがインスタンスに到達しない原因のトラブルシューティングを行うのに使用でき、セキュリティー・グループ・ルールの診断にも役立ちます。  また、リソースに到達するトラフィックを分析するアプリケーションで、フロー・ログ出力をソースとして使用することもできます。  フロー・ログは、ネットワークのモニタリングと根本原因分析の全体的な正常性を判断するのに重要なツールです。

ko.description: VPC(Virtual Private Cloud)의 네트워크에서 송/수신되는 IP(Internet Protocol) 트래픽에 대한 정보를 캡처할 수 있습니다.
ko.long_description: Flow Logs는 여러 태스크를 지원할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 특정 트래픽이 인스턴스에 도달하지 않는 이유를 해결하고, 보안 그룹 규칙을 진단하는 데 도움이 되는 태스크를 수행합니다. 또한 리소스에 도달하는 트래픽을 분석하는 애플리케이션의 소스로 플로우 로그 출력을 사용할 수 있습니다. 플로우 로그는 네트워크 모니터링 및 근본 원인 분석의 전반적인 상태를 결정하는 중요한 도구입니다.

pt-br.description: Permite a captura de informações sobre o tráfego do protocolo da Internet (IP) de entrada e saída das redes de suas nuvens privadas virtuais (VPC).
pt-br.long_description: Os logs de fluxo podem ajudar em diversas tarefas; por exemplo, para solucionar o motivo porque um tráfego específico não está atingindo uma instância que, por sua vez, ajuda a diagnosticar as regras do grupo de segurança.  Também é possível usar a saída do log de fluxo como origem para aplicativos que analisam o tráfego que atinge seus recursos.  Os logs de fluxo são uma ferramenta crítica para determinar o funcionamento geral do monitoramento de rede e a análise de causa raiz.

zh-cn.description: 支持捕获有关进出虚拟私有云 (VPC) 网络的因特网协议 (IP) 流量的信息。
zh-cn.long_description: 流日志可帮助完成许多任务；例如，对特定流量未到达实例的原因进行故障诊断，从而有助于诊断安全组规则。您还可以使用流日志输出作为分析到达资源的流量的应用程序的数据源。流日志是用于确定网络监视和根本原因分析的整体运行状况的关键工具。

zh-tw.description: 能夠擷取往返於虛擬私有雲 (VPC) 網路上的網際網路通訊協定 (IP) 資料流量的相關資訊。
zh-tw.long_description: 流程日誌可協助許多作業；例如，對於為何特定的資料流量未能抵達至某個實例進行疑難排解，而這反而有助於診斷安全群組規則。您也可以使用流程日誌輸出作為應用程式的來源，來分析抵達您資源的資料流量。流程日誌是判斷網路監視整體性能及主要原因分析的重要工具。

description: Enables the capture of information about the Internet Protocol (IP) traffic going to and from networks of your Virtual Private Clouds (VPC).
longDescription: IBM Cloud Flow Logs for VPC is an add-on feature to IBM Cloud VPC Gen2, enabling the collection of information about the IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in your VPC. Flow logs can help with a number of tasks; for example, to troubleshoot why specific traffic is not reaching an instance, which in turn helps to diagnose security group rules. You can also use flow log output as a source for applications that analyze traffic that is reaching your resources. Flow logs is a critical tool for determine the overall health of network monitoring and root cause analysis.

If your environment includes multiple data centers, FNTS can support several options for data replication to PowerVS based on your business continuity requirements, but it is outside the scope of this service.

name: fresche-security-suite-v2

en.description: Security, auditing, compliance, data encryption, and intrusion detection software solutions for IBM i systems.
en.long_description: The IBM i Security Suite by Fresche Solutions offers a comprehensive approach to safeguarding your critical business data. This suite addresses key areas of vulnerability, including unauthorized remote access through third-party applications, ODBC connections, file shares, and web servers. It also protects against Integrated File System (IFS) exposures and allows continuous monitoring to ensure system integrity is retained and ransomware attacks are minimized. This solution also monitors real-time system access and escalates critical security events to a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system or email server. The suite not only enhances security but also simplifies compliance with industry standards such as PCI and HIPAA through built-in content.

en.description: AI Powered Application Discovery and Understanding tool for managing and modernizing applications that run on IBM i.
en.long_description: X-Analysis is an AI Powered Application Discovery and Understanding tool that is used to understand and manage applications that run on IBM i.  X-Analyis extracts metadata from application objects and the source code used to create those objects in order to provide a detailed, comprehensive view of how an application interacts with the objects/components that are part of the application.  The tool automates the generation of documentation, performs impact analysis, extracts business rules, maps applications, visualizes data models, and assesses code quality. These features collectively empower development teams to gain a profound understanding of existing applications, thereby accelerating informed decision-making during modernization initiatives.

name: gbg-reach

en.description: Verify, standardise and cleanse address, email and phone data using GBG Loqate, with policy-aware decisions.
en.display_name: GBG Reach - Address Email and Phone Verification
en.long_description:
GBG Reach is a data quality agent for IBM watsonx Orchestrate that verifies, validates, and cleanses key elements of your customer data - postal addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers - using GBG Loqate's trusted global reference data.

Hand Reach a single value, several records, a block of free-form text, or an uploaded CSV, and it automatically detects every address, email, and phone number present, then returns a clear, policy-aware recommendation for each: accept, review, or reject, complete with a confidence score and clean, standardized output. Your agent gets a decision it can act on - without any custom parsing logic.

Use Reach the way that suits your workflow:
- Chat with it directly for quick, ad-hoc verification.
- Add it as a collaborator to your own agent so it cleans data mid-conversation, for example validating a customer's address during onboarding before you save it.
- Build it into an automated workflow to verify and standardize records at scale.

Because every decision is policy-aware, you control how strict verification is for each scenario, from light-touch marketing list hygiene to strict KYC and onboarding checks. Teams use Reach to improve email deliverability, reduce failed deliveries and shipping costs, cut fraud and returns, clean up CRM and marketing data, and keep customer records accurate and up to date. Every decision can be logged for auditability, giving you a record for compliance review or reporting.

Powered by GBG Loqate's global address verification, email verification, and phone validation, Reach stops bad data at the source so you can act on information you trust - backed by the engine enterprises rely on, verifying data across 245 countries and 3 billion times a year.

en.description: Secure, private agentic platform with advanced document and database search capabilities for analyzing large-scale data.
en.long_description:
Generate is a private, secure agentic AI platform built for multiple industries. 
The Healthcare Edition helps hospitals uncover and recover leaked revenue from unpaid and underpaid claims by unifying claims, remits, denials, contracts, and payer policies into a single, action-driven workflow. It highlights recovery opportunities, filing deadlines, root-cause patterns, and ROI impact so teams can collect more while working less.

Hospitals lose revenue every day through underpayments, avoidable denials, missed appeal windows, and documentation gaps. Because billing teams rarely have the capacity to pursue every claim Generate addresses this by turning fragmented data (EHR exports, clearinghouse files, payer remits, contracts, medical policies, SOPs, spreadsheets, emails) into a prioritized recovery pipeline that teams can act on immediately.

Generate can help uncover 4–12% of net patient revenue in underpaid claims by making recovery work systematic and scalable. With data connectors, your team can “connect and forget” the sources you already use. Then Agentic Cards surface what matters most:

1. Claims with recovery potential (underpaid, denied, pending)

2. Estimated dollars at risk and expected recoverable value

3. Deadlines (timely filing, appeals, reconsiderations)

4. Next-best actions with supporting evidence

5. Recurring error patterns that improve first-pass claim accuracy

Generate runs privately within IBM Cloud to support healthcare-grade security and privacy requirements.

Beyond healthcare, Generate is a versatile horizontal platform that enables agentic workflows and analytics across both structured and unstructured data, supporting use cases in finance, legal, public sector, and more.

Customer Quotes
“The data and dashboards have been invaluable… We now understand our true financial picture, can hold vendors accountable, respond to audits, and recover underpaid claims.” — Robin Cetti, Director of Decision Support & Revenue Integrity, Hutchinson Regional Health System

“A playground of answers to all the questions healthcare leaders are asking.” — Dr. F.X. Campion, MIT Research & Engineering

de.description: Schützen Sie Ihre IBM IaaS-Umgebung (und sämtliche dort gespeicherten Informationen) und verhindern Sie, dass böswillige Aktivitäten jemals Ihre Server oder Endbenutzer erreichen.
de.long_description: Firewalls stellen einen wichtigen Schritt beim Schutz Ihrer IBM IaaS-Umgebung (und aller darin gespeicherten Informationen) dar und verhindern, böswillige Aktivitäten Ihre Server oder die Endbenutzer erreichen. Ist dies Teil Ihrer Sicherheitsstrategie, können Firewalloptionen für Hardware und Software zur Sicherstellung Ihrer Betriebszeit beitragen, Ihre Server und Netze schützen und Ihnen eine umfassendere Steuerung der Zugriffsschutzeinstellungen in Ihrer Infrastruktur ermöglichen. Zum Hinzufügen einer Firewall zu einem Server klicken Sie auf den folgenden Link: Geräte > Geräteliste > Auf den gewünschten Server klicken > Konfiguration > Seitenende: Hardware Firewall im Kundenportal bestellen. Hierdurch wird der Bestellprozess für eine entsprechende Firewall basierend auf der Uplinkgeschwindigkeit des ausgewählten Servers gestartet.

en.description: Secure your IBM IaaS environment (and all the information stored there) as well as preventing malicious activity from ever reaching your servers or end users.
en.long_description: Firewalls are an important step in securing your IBM IaaS environment (and all the information stored there) as well as preventing malicious activity from ever reaching your servers or end users. When added to your security strategy, hardware and software firewall options will help ensure uptime, protect your servers and network, and give you greater control of your infrastructure’s protection settings. To add a firewall to a server, click on the link Devices > Device List > Click the desired server > Configuration > Bottom of the page: Order Hardware Firewall in the customer portal. This will begin the order process for an appropriate firewall based on the uplink speed of the selected server.

es.description: Proteja el entorno IBM IaaS (y toda la información almacenada ahí) y evite que la actividad maliciosa alcance a los servidores o usuarios finales.
es.long_description: Los cortafuegos constituyen un paso importante para proteger el entorno de IBM IaaS (y toda la información que almacena) e impedir que la actividad maliciosa alcance a los servidores o usuarios finales. Cuando se añade a su estrategia de seguridad, las opciones de cortafuegos de hardware y software ayudarán a garantizar la actividad, a proteger los servidores y la red, y a darle un mayor control de los valores de protección de la infraestructura. Para añadir un cortafuegos a un servidor, pulse el enlace Dispositivos > Lista de dispositivos > pulse el servidor que desee > Configuración > parte inferior de la página: Pedir cortafuegos de hardware en el portal de clientes. Esto iniciará el proceso de pedido del cortafuegos correspondiente basándose en la velocidad del enlace ascendente del servidor seleccionado.

fr.description: Sécurisez votre environnement IBM IaaS (et toutes les informations qui y sont stockées) et empêchez toute tentative malveillante d'accès à vos serveurs ou vos utilisateurs finaux.
fr.long_description: Les pare-feu sont essentiels pour sécuriser votre environnement IBM IaaS (et toutes les informations qui y sont stockées) et empêcher toute tentative malveillante d'accès à vos serveurs ou vos utilisateurs finaux. Lorsqu'elles sont ajoutées à votre stratégie de sécurité, les options de pare-feu matériel et logiciel assurent la disponibilité, protègent vos serveurs et votre réseau, et vous permettent de mieux contrôler les paramètres de protection de votre infrastructure. Pour ajouter un pare-feu à un serveur, cliquez sur le lien Unités > Liste des unités > Cliquez sur le serveur de votre choix > Configuration > Bas de la page : Commander pare-feu matériel dans le portail client. Vous lancerez ainsi le processus de commande d'un pare-feu approprié en fonction de la vitesse de liaison montante du serveur sélectionné.

it.description: Proteggi il tuo ambiente IBM IaaS (e tutte le informazioni memorizzate) ed impedisci alle attività dannose di raggiungere i tuoi server o utenti finali.
it.long_description: I firewall rappresentano un elemento importante per la protezione del proprio ambiente IBM IaaS (e di tutte le informazioni memorizzate) ed impediscono alle attività dannose di raggiungere i propri server o utenti finali. Quando vengono aggiunte alla propria strategia di sicurezza, le opzioni firewall hardware e software aiutano a garantire la continuità del servizio, proteggere i server e la rete e forniscono un maggiore controllo sulle impostazioni di protezione dell'infrastruttura. Per aggiungere un firewall ad un server, fare clic sul link Dispositivi > Elenco dispositivi > Fare clic sul server desiderato > Configurazione > Parte inferiore della pagina: Ordina firewall hardware nel portale del cliente. In questo modo, viene avviato il processo di ordinazione di un firewall appropriato in base alla velocità uplink del server selezionato.

ja.description: お客様の IBM IaaS 環境 (そして、そこに保管されているすべての情報) を保護するだけでなく、悪意のあるアクティビティーがサーバーやエンド・ユーザーにたどり着くことができないようにします。
ja.long_description: ファイアウォールは、お客様の IBM IaaS 環境 (そして、そこに保管されているすべての情報) を保護するだけでなく、悪意のあるアクティビティーがサーバーやエンド・ユーザーにたどり着くことができないようにする重要なステップです。 これがセキュリティー戦略に追加されると、ハードウェアおよびソフトウェアのファイアウォール・オプションにより実行可能時間が確保され、サーバーとネットワークも保護され、インフラストラクチャーの保護設定もさらに制御するために役立ちます。 サーバーにファイアウォールを追加するには、カスタマー・ポータルでリンク「デバイス」 > 「デバイス・リスト」と移動した後、目的のサーバーをクリックし、「構成」をクリックして画面下部に移動し、「ハードウェア・ファイアウォールの注文」をクリックします。 これにより、選択されたサーバーのアップリンク速度に基づいて、適切なファイアウォールの注文プロセスが開始されます。

ko.description: IBM IaaS 환경(및 여기에 저장된 모든 정보)에 보안을 설정하고 악의적 활동이 서버 또는 일반 사용자에게 도달하지 못하도록 합니다.
ko.long_description: 방화벽은 IBM IaaS 환경(및 여기에 저장된 모든 정보)에 보안을 설정하고 악의적 활동이 서버 및 일반 사용자에게 도달하지 못하도록 하는 데 있어 중요한 단계입니다. 보안 전략에 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어 방화벽 옵션을 추가하면 가동 시간을 보장하고, 서버 및 네트워크를 보호하고, 인프라 보호 설정에 대한 제어를 향상시키는 데 도움이 됩니다. 서버에 방화벽을 추가하려면 고객 포털에서 디바이스 > 디바이스 목록 > 원하는 서버 클릭 > 구성 > 페이지 맨 아래에서 Hardware Firewall 주문 링크를 클릭하십시오. 선택한 서버의 업링크 속도를 기반으로 적절한 방화벽에 대한 주문 프로세스가 시작됩니다.

pt-br.description: Proteja o seu ambiente do IBM IaaS (e todas as informações armazenadas nele) e evite que atividades maliciosas atinjam os seus servidores ou os usuários finais.
pt-br.long_description: Firewalls são uma etapa importante para proteger o seu ambiente do IBM IaaS (e todas as informações armazenadas nele) e para evitar que atividades maliciosas atinjam os seus servidores ou os usuários finais. Quando incluídas em sua estratégia de segurança, as opções de firewall de hardware e software ajudarão a assegurar o tempo de atividade, proteger seus servidores e a rede e fornecer maior controle sobre as configurações de proteção de sua infraestrutura. Para incluir um firewall em um servidor, clique no link Dispositivos > Lista de dispositivos > clique no servidor desejado > Configuração > Parte inferior da página: solicite o Hardware Firewall no portal do cliente. Isso iniciará o processo de solicitação de um firewall apropriado com base na velocidade de uplink do servidor selecionado.

zh-cn.description: 保护您的 IBM IaaS 环境（以及在其中存储的所有信息），并防止恶意活动到达服务器或最终用户。
zh-cn.long_description: 防火墙是至关重要的部署，可保护您的 IBM IaaS 环境（以及存储在其中的所有信息），并防止恶意活动到达服务器或最终用户。在安全性策略中添加硬件和软件防火墙选项时，这些选项将帮助确保正常运行时间、保护服务器和网络并使您能够更好地控制基础架构保护设置。要向服务器添加防火墙，请在客户门户网站中单击链接“设备”>“设备列表”> 单击所需服务器 >“配置”> 页面底部：订购 Hardware Firewall。这样将根据所选服务器的上行速度，开始相应防火墙的订购流程。

zh-tw.description: 保護 IBM IaaS 環境（以及該處儲存之所有資訊）安全以及防止惡意活動接觸您的伺服器或一般使用者。
zh-tw.long_description: 防火牆是保護 IBM IaaS 環境（以及該處儲存之所有資訊）安全以及防止惡意活動接觸您的伺服器或一般使用者的重要步驟。加入您安全策略中的軟硬體防火牆選項有助於確保上線時間，保護伺服器和網路，並讓您對基礎架構的保護設定有更大的控制權。若要將防火牆新增至伺服器，請在客戶入口網站中按一下鏈結「裝置」>「裝置清單」> 按一下「必要伺服器」> 「配置」> 頁面底端：訂購 Hardware Firewall。這將根據所選取伺服器的上行網路速度，開始適當防火牆的訂購程序。
