bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services stellt einen Schlüsselmanagementservice für einen einzigen Tenant bereit, mit dem Sie Schlüssel mithilfe standardisierter APIs erstellen, importieren, wechseln und verwalten können. Nachdem die Chiffrierschlüssel gelöscht wurden, können Sie sicher sein, dass Ihre Daten nicht mehr abrufbar sind.
bullets.title: Management des Schlüssellebenszyklus

bullets.description: Wenn Hyper Protect Crypto Services mit anderen IBM Cloud-Services integriert wird, können Sie Ihre eigene Verschlüsselung in die Cloud übertragen. Der Service bietet durch das Wrapping der Ihren Cloud-Services zugeordneten Chiffrierschlüssel einen doppelten Schutz für Ihre Clouddaten.
bullets.title: Verschlüsselung für IBM Cloud-Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services kann mit IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) integriert werden, um Ihnen die differenzierte Steuerung der Benutzerzugriffe auf Serviceressourcen zu ermöglichen. Außerdem können Sie die Aktivitäten von Hyper Protect Crypto Services mit IBM Cloud Activity Tracker und dem LogDNA-Service überwachen.
bullets.title: Zugriffsmanagement und -prüfung

bullets.description: Mit KYOK (Keep Your Own Key) ermöglicht Hyper Protect Crypto Services Ihnen, durch Zuordnung eigener Administratoren und Laden von Masterschlüsseln das Eigentumsrecht am HSM zu übernehmen. Auf diese Weise haben Sie uneingeschränkte Kontrolle über die gesamte Schlüsselhierarchie, ohne dass IBM Cloud-Administratoren Zugriff auf Ihre Schlüssel haben.
bullets.title: Kundengesteuertes HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services unterstützt Enterprise PKCS #11 für Verschlüsselungsoperationen. Das gehören das Generieren von Schlüsseln, das Ver- und Entschlüsseln von Daten, das Signieren von Daten und das Verifizieren von Signaturen. Die Verschlüsselungsfunktionen werden in HSMs ausgeführt und können über APIs aufgerufen werden, um den hardwarebasierten Schutz für Ihre Anwendungen zu gewährleisten.
bullets.title: Verschlüsselungsoperationen

bullets.description: Der Service basiert auf zertifizierter FIPS 140-2 Level 4-Hardware, der sichersten Hardware, die von Cloud-Providern in der Branche angeboten wird. Das HSM ist zur Einhaltung von Common Criteria Part 3 conformant EAL 4 ebenfalls zertifiziert.
bullets.title: Sicherheitszertifizierung

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator stellt ein Schlüssellebenszyklusmanagement gemäß NIST-Empfehlungen sowie eine sichere Übertragung von Schlüsseln auf interne Keystores in der Serviceinstanz oder in externen Keystores bereit. Sie können Ihre Schlüssel mit einer Push-Operation an Cloud-Keystores anderer Anbieter wie Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), Google Cloud KMS oder IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud übertragen, Schlüssel auf Keystores verteilen und Schlüssel und Keystores sowohl über die Benutzerschnittstelle als auch über REST-API verwalten.
bullets.title: Verbindung zu externen Keystores

bullets.description: Mit Unified Key Orchestrator können Sie alle Schlüssel in IBM Cloud sichern. Sie können Schlüssel über Ihre Hyper Protect Crypto Services-Instanz umverteilen, um eine schnelle Wiederherstellung nach schwerwiegenden Cloudfehlern zu ermöglichen. Und gleichzeitig besitzen Sie das Stammvertrauen Ihrer Schlüsselhierarchie.
bullets.title: Einheitliches System zur Sicherung und Verwaltung von Schlüsseln

bullets.description: Sie können Schlüssel über eine einzige und einheitliche Benutzererfahrung über mehrere Clouds hinweg mit einem überprüfbaren Mechanismus für die Orchestrierung des Schlüssellebenszyklus orchestrieren.
bullets.title: Wichtige Orchestrierung in mehreren Clouds
Compliance: DSGVO, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Typ 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services provides a single-tenant key management service that allows you to create, import, rotate, and manage keys with standardized APIs. Once the encryption keys are deleted, you can be assured that your data is no longer retrievable.
bullets.title: Key lifecycle management

bullets.description: By integrating with other IBM Cloud services, Hyper Protect Crypto Services offers the capability of bringing your own encryption to the cloud. The service provides double-layer protection for your cloud data by wrapping the encryption keys associated with your cloud services.
bullets.title: Encryption for IBM Cloud services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services integrates with IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) to enable your granular control over user access to service resources. You can also monitor activities of Hyper Protect Crypto Services using IBM Cloud Activity Tracker with LogDNA service.
bullets.title: Access management and auditing

bullets.description: With Keep Your Own Key, Hyper Protect Crypto Services allows you to take the ownership of the HSM through assigning your own administrators and loading master keys. This ensures your full control of the entire key hierarchy where no IBM Cloud administrators have access to your keys.
bullets.title: Customer-controlled HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services supports Enterprise PKCS #11 for cryptographic operations. This includes generating keys, encrypting and decrypting data, signing data, and verifying signatures. The cryptographic functions are executed in HSMs and can be accessed through APIs to provide hardware-based protection for your applications.
bullets.title: Cryptographic operations

bullets.description: The service is built on FIPS 140-2 Level 4-certified hardware, the highest offered by any cloud provider in the industry. The HSM is also certified to meet the Common Criteria Part 3 conformant EAL 4.
bullets.title: Security certification

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator provides key lifecycle management according to NIST recommendations and secure transfer of keys to internal keystores in the service instance or external keystores. You can push your keys to third-party cloud keystores, such as Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), Google Cloud KMS, or IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud, distribute keys across keystores, and manage keys and keystores through both the UI and REST API.
bullets.title: Connection to external keystores

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator enables you to back up all keys in IBM Cloud. You can redistribute keys through your Hyper Protect Crypto Services instance to quickly recover from fatal cloud errors. And at the same time, you own the root trust of your key hierarchy.
bullets.title: Unified key backup and management system

bullets.description: You can orchestrate keys through a single and unified user experience across multiple clouds with an auditable key lifecycle orchestration mechanism.
bullets.title: Key orchestration across multiple clouds
Compliance: GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Type 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services proporciona un servicio de gestión de claves de un solo arrendatario que le permite crear, importar, rotar y gestionar claves con API estandarizadas. Una vez suprimidas las claves de cifrado, puede tener la seguridad de que los datos ya no serán recuperables.
bullets.title: Gestión del ciclo de vida de claves

bullets.description: Mediante la integración con otros servicios IBM Cloud, Hyper Protect Crypto Services ofrece la posibilidad de llevar su propio cifrado a la nube. El servicio proporciona protección de doble capa para los datos en la nube al envolver las claves de cifrado asociadas a los servicios en la nube.
bullets.title: Cifrado para servicios IBM Cloud

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services se integra con IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) para permitir el control detallado del acceso de los usuarios a los recursos de los servicios. También es posible supervisar las actividades de Hyper Protect Crypto Services mediante el servicio IBM Cloud Activity Tracker con LogDNA.
bullets.title: Gestión de acceso y auditoría

bullets.description: Al permitirle mantener su propia clave, Hyper Protect Crypto Services le permite tomar propiedad del HSM mediante la asignación de sus propios administradores y la carga de claves maestras. Esto garantiza el control total de toda la jerarquía de claves, donde ningún administrador de IBM Cloud tiene acceso a sus claves.
bullets.title: HSM controlado por el cliente

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services da soporte a Enterprise PKCS #11 para operaciones de cifrado. Esto incluye la generación de claves, el cifrado y descifrado de datos, la firma de datos y la verificación de firmas. Las funciones de cifrado se ejecutan en los HSM y se puede acceder a ellas mediante las API para proporcionar protección basada en hardware para las aplicaciones.
bullets.title: Operaciones de cifrado

bullets.description: El servicio se basa en hardware con certificación FIPS 140-2 de Nivel 4, el nivel más alto ofrecido por cualquier proveedor en el sector. El HSM también está certificado para cumplir la Parte 3 de Criterios comunes conforme a EAL 4.
bullets.title: Certificación de seguridad

bullets.description: Unificado Key Orchestrator proporciona gestión del ciclo de vida de claves de acuerdo con las recomendaciones de NIST y la transferencia segura de claves a almacenes de claves internos en la instancia de servicio o almacenes de claves externos. Puede enviar sus claves a almacenes de claves de nube de terceros, como por ejemplo Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), Google Cloud KMS o IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud, distribuir claves entre almacenes de claves y gestionar claves y almacenes de claves a través de la interfaz de usuario y la API REST.
bullets.title: Conexión a almacenes de claves externos

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator le permite realizar una copia de seguridad de todas las claves en IBM Cloud. Puede redistribuir claves a través de la instancia de Hyper Protect Crypto Services para recuperarse rápidamente de errores de nube muy graves. Al mismo tiempo, usted posee la confianza raíz de su jerarquía de claves.
bullets.title: Sistema unificado de copia de seguridad y gestión de claves

bullets.description: Puede orquestar claves a través de una única experiencia de usuario unificada en varias nubes con un mecanismo de orquestación de ciclo de vida de clave auditable.
bullets.title: Orquestación de claves en varias nubes
Conformidad: RGPD, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Tipo 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services fournit un service de gestion de clés à service exclusif qui permet de créer, importer, faire pivoter et gérer des clés avec des API standardisées. Une fois les clés de chiffrement supprimées, vous pouvez être assuré que vos données ne sont plus récupérables.
bullets.title: Gestion du cycle de vie des clés

bullets.description: En s'intégrant à d'autres services IBM Cloud, Hyper Protect Crypto Services vous permet d'utiliser votre propre chiffrement dans le cloud. Le service fournit une protection à double couche pour vos données de cloud en encapsulant les clés associées à vos services de cloud.
bullets.title: Chiffrement des services IBM Cloud

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services s'intègre à IBM Cloud Identity et Access Management (IAM) pour activer le contrôle granulaire sur l'accès des utilisateurs aux ressources de service. Vous pouvez également surveiller les activités d'Hyper Protect Crypto Services à l'aide d'IBM Cloud Activity Tracker avec le service LogDNA.
bullets.title: Gestion et audit des accès

bullets.description: Avec la conservation de votre propre clé, Hyper Protect Crypto Services vous permet de devenir propriétaire du service HSM en affectant vos propres administrateurs et en chargeant des clés principales. Cela vous assure un contrôle complet de l'ensemble de la hiérarchie de clés dans laquelle aucun administrateur IBM Cloud n'a accès à vos clés.
bullets.title: HSM contrôlé par le client

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services prend en charge Enterprise PKCS #11 pour les opérations de chiffrement. Cela inclut la génération de clés, le chiffrement et le déchiffrement des données, la signature des données et la vérification des signatures. Les fonctions de chiffrement sont exécutées dans des modules HSM et sont accessibles via des API afin de fournir à vos applications une protection basée sur le matériel.
bullets.title: Opérations de chiffrement

bullets.description: Le service repose sur un matériel certifié FIPS 140-2 niveau 4, qui propose le niveau de sécurité maximal offert par un fournisseur de cloud sur le marché. Le module HSM est également certifié conforme à Common Criteria Part 3 EAL 4.
bullets.title: Certification de sécurité

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator assure la gestion du cycle de vie des clés conformément aux recommandations du NIST et le transfert sécurisé des clés vers les magasins de clés internes dans l'instance de service ou les magasins de clés externes. Vous pouvez envoyer vos clés à des magasins de clés de cloud tiers, tels que Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), Google Cloud KMS ou IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud, distribuer des clés dans des magasins de clés et gérer des clés et des magasins de clés via l'interface utilisateur et l'API REST.
bullets.title: Connexion à des fichiers de clés externes

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator vous permet de sauvegarder toutes les clés dans IBM Cloud. Vous pouvez redistribuer des clés via votre instance Hyper Protect Crypto Services pour une reprise rapide après des erreurs de cloud fatales. Et en même temps, vous possédez la confiance des racines de votre hiérarchie.
bullets.title: Système unifié de sauvegarde et de gestion des clés

bullets.description: Vous pouvez orchestrer les clés par le biais d'une expérience utilisateur unique et unifiée sur plusieurs nuages grâce à un mécanisme d'orchestration du cycle de vie des clés vérifiable.
bullets.title: Orchestration des clés dans plusieurs clouds
Conformité : RGPD, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Type 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services fornisce un KMS (key management service) single-tenant che consente di creare, importare, ruotare e gestire chiavi con API standardizzate. Una volta eliminate le chiavi di codifica, è sicuro che i dati non sono più richiamabili.
bullets.title: Gestione del ciclo di vita delle chiavi

bullets.description: Integrandolo con altri servizi IBM Cloud, Hyper Protect Crypto Services fornisce la possibilità di portare la propria codifica sul cloud. Il servizio fornisce sicurezza a due livelli per i dati cloud proteggendo le chiavi di codifica associate ai servizi cloud.
bullets.title: Codifica per i servizi IBM Cloud

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services si integra con IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) per permettere un controllo granulare sull'accesso utente alle risorse del servizio. È anche possibile monitorare le attività di Hyper Protect Crypto Services utilizzando IBM Cloud Activity Tracker con il servizio LogDNA.
bullets.title: Gestione e verifica accessi

bullets.description: Con il KYOK (Keep Your Own Key), Hyper Protect Crypto Services permette di acquisire la proprietà dell'HSM attraverso l'assegnazione di propri amministratori e il caricamento di chiavi master. Ciò garantisce il controllo completo dell'intera gerarchia di chiavi, in cui nessun amministratore IBM Cloud ha accesso alle chiavi.
bullets.title: HSM controllato dal cliente

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services supporta Enterprise PKCS #11 per operazioni crittografiche. Ciò include la generazione di chiavi, la codifica e decodifica di dati e la verifica delle firme. Le funzioni crittografiche sono eseguite in HSM ed è possibile accedervi tramite API per fornire alle applicazioni protezione basata sull'hardware.
bullets.title: Operazioni crittografiche

bullets.description: Il servizio si basa su hardware certificato da FIPS 140-2 Livello 4, il livello più alto offerto da qualsiasi provider cloud nel settore. Anche l'HSM è certificato per essere conforme alla sezione 3 dei criteri comuni di EAL 4.
bullets.title: Certificazione di sicurezza

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator fornisce la gestione del ciclo di vita delle chiavi in base alle raccomandazioni NIST e il trasferimento sicuro delle chiavi ai keystore interni nell'istanza del servizio o a keystore esterni. È possibile eseguire il push delle chiavi a keystore cloud di terze parti, ad esempio Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), Google Cloud KMS o IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud, distribuire le chiavi tra i keystore, e gestire le chiavi e i keystore tramite l'interfaccia utente e l'API REST.
bullets.title: Connessione a keystore esterni

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator consente di effettuare il backup di tutte le chiavi in IBM Cloud. È possibile ridistribuire le chiavi attraverso l'istanza Hyper Protect Crypto Services per recuperare rapidamente da errori cloud irreversibili. E allo stesso tempo, disporre del root trust della propria gerarchia di chiavi.
bullets.title: Sistema di gestione e backup delle chiavi unificato

bullets.description: È possibile orchestrare le chiavi tramite un'esperienza utente singola e unificata su più cloud con un meccanismo di orchestrazione del ciclo di vita delle chiavi verificabile.
bullets.title: Orchestrazione di chiavi su più cloud
Conformità: GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Tipo 1, IRAP IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services は、標準化された API を使用した鍵の作成、インポート、ローテーション、管理を可能にするシングル・テナント型の鍵管理サービスを提供します。 暗号鍵を削除すると、データを取り出すことができなくなるので安心です。
bullets.title: 鍵ライフサイクル管理

bullets.description: 他の IBM Cloud サービスと統合することで、Hyper Protect Crypto Services は、独自の暗号化をクラウドに持ち込む機能を提供します。 このサービスは、クラウド・サービスに関連付けられた暗号鍵をラッピングすることで、クラウド・データを二重に保護します。
bullets.title: IBM Cloud サービスの暗号化

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services は IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) と統合されているので、サービス・リソースに対するユーザー・アクセスをきめ細かく管理することができます。 また、IBM Cloud Activity Tracker with LogDNA サービスを使用して、Hyper Protect Crypto Services のアクティビティーをモニターすることもできます。
bullets.title: アクセス管理と監査

bullets.description: Hyper ProtectCrypto Services では、Keep Your Own Key を使用することで、管理者を独自に割り当て、マスター鍵をロードして HSM をお客様自身で管理できます。 これにより、鍵階層全体をお客様が完全に管理することが保証されます。IBM Cloud の管理者でさえ鍵階層にアクセスすることはできません。
bullets.title: お客様管理の HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services では、暗号操作のための Enterprise PKCS #11 をサポートしています。 例えば、鍵の生成、データの暗号化と復号、データの署名、署名の検証などの操作があります。 暗号機能は HSM で実行され、API を使用して暗号機能を利用することで、アプリケーションをハードウェア・ベースで保護できます。
bullets.title: 暗号操作

bullets.description: このサービスは、FIPS 140-2 レベル 4 認定を受けたハードウェア上に構築されており、クラウド・プロバイダーが提供するサービスとしては業界最高クラスのサービスです。 また、HSM はコモン・クライテリア・パート 3 準拠の EAL 4 にも適合しています。
bullets.title: セキュリティー認証

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator は、NIST の推奨事項に従って鍵のライフサイクル管理を行い、サービス・インスタンスまたは外部鍵ストア内の内部鍵ストアへの鍵のセキュアな転送を提供します。 Azure Key Vault、AWS Key Management Service (KMS)、Google Cloud KMS、または IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud などのサード・パーティーのクラウド鍵ストアに鍵をプッシュし、鍵ストア間で鍵を配布し、UI と REST API の両方を介して鍵と鍵ストアを管理できます。
bullets.title: 外部キー・ストアとの接続

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator を使用すると、IBM Cloud 内のすべての鍵をバックアップできます。 Hyper Protect Crypto Services インスタンスを介して鍵を再配布することで、致命的なクラウド・エラーから素早く復旧できます。 同時に、お客様はキー階層のルート・トラストを所有します。
bullets.title: 統合された鍵バックアップおよび管理システム

bullets.description: 監査可能なキー・ライフサイクル・オーケストレーション・メカニズムを使用して、複数のクラウド全体にわたって統一された一元的なユーザー・エクスペリエンスでキーをオーケストレーションできます。
bullets.title: 複数のクラウドにわたる主要なオーケストレーション
コンプライアンス: GDPR、HIPAA、ISO 27001/27017/27018、SOC 2 タイプ 1、IRAP、IBM Cloud for Financial Services

navigation_items.label: インスタンス・ポリシー

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services는 표준화된 API를 사용하여 키 작성, 가져오기, 순환 및 관리를 수행할 수 있는 단일 테넌트 키 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 암호화 키가 삭제되면 더 이상 해당 데이터를 검색하지 못하도록 보장할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 키 라이프사이클 관리

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services는 다른 IBM Cloud 서비스와 통합되어 사용자 고유의 암호화를 클라우드로 가져올 수 있는 기능을 제공합니다. 이 서비스는 클라우드 서비스와 연관된 암호화 키를 랩핑하여 클라우드 데이터에 대한 이중 계층 보호를 제공합니다.
bullets.title: IBM Cloud 서비스에 대한 암호화

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services는 IBM Cloud Identity and AccessManagement(IAM)과 통합되어 서비스 자원에 대한 사용자 액세스를 세부 단위로 제어할 수 있도록 합니다. 또한 IBM Cloud Activity Tracker with LogDNA 서비스를 사용하여 Hyper Protect Crypto Services의 활동을 모니터할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 액세스 관리 및 감사

bullets.description: KYOK(Keep Your Own Key)를 사용하면, Hyper Protect Crypto Services를 사용하여 자체 관리자를 지정하고 마스터 키를 로드하여 HSM의 소유권을 가져올 수 있습니다. 이렇게 하면 전체 키 계층 구조를 완벽하게 제어할 수 있으며 IBM Cloud 관리자도 사용자의 키에 액세스할 수 없습니다.
bullets.title: 고객이 제어하는 HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services는 암호화 조작을 위해 Enterprise PKCS #11을 지원합니다. 여기에는 키 생성, 데이터 암호화 및 복호화, 데이터 서명 및 서명 확인이 포함됩니다. 암호화 기능은 HSM에서 실행되며 API를 통해 액세스하여 애플리케이션에 대한 하드웨어 기반 보호를 제공할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 암호화 조작

bullets.description: 이 서비스는 업계의 모든 클라우드 제공자가 제공하는 최고의 FIPS 140-2 레벨 4 인증 하드웨어를 기반으로 빌드되었습니다. 또한 HSM은 Common Criteria 파트 3 준수 EAL 4를 충족하도록 인증되었습니다.
bullets.title: 보안 인증

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator는 NIST 권장사항에 따라 키 라이프사이클 관리를 제공하고, 서비스 인스턴스 또는 외부 키 저장소에 있는 내부 키 저장소로 키를 안전하게 전송합니다. 써드파티 클라우드 키 저장소(예: Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service(KMS), Google Cloud KMS 또는 IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud)로 키를 밀어넣고 키 저장소에 키를 분배하고, UI 및 REST API 둘 다를 통해 키 및 키 저장소를 관리할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 외부 키 저장소에 대한 연결

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator를 사용하여 IBM Cloud의 모든 키를 백업할 수 있습니다. Hyper Protect Crypto Services 인스턴스를 통해 키를 재분배하여 치명적인 클라우드 오류에서 빠르게 복구할 수 있습니다. 동시에 해당 키 계층의 루트 신뢰를 소유합니다.
bullets.title: 통합 키 백업 및 관리 시스템

bullets.description: 감사 가능한 키 라이프사이클 오케스트레이션 메커니즘을 통해 복수의 클라우드에서 단일 및 통합 사용자 경험을 통해 키를 조정할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 복수의 클라우드를 통한 키 오케스트레이션
준수: GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 유형 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: O Hyper Protect Crypto Services fornece um serviço de gerenciamento de chaves de locatário único que permite criar, importar, girar e gerenciar chaves com APIs padronizadas. Depois que as chaves de criptografia são excluídas, seus dados não são mais recuperáveis.
bullets.title: Gerenciamento de ciclo de vida de chave

bullets.description: Ao realizar a integração com outros serviços da IBM Cloud, o Hyper Protect Crypto Services oferece a capacidade de trazer sua própria criptografia para a nuvem. O serviço fornece proteção de camada dupla para seus dados de nuvem ao agrupar as chaves de criptografia associadas aos seus serviços de nuvem.
bullets.title: Criptografia para os serviços da IBM Cloud

bullets.description: O Hyper Protect Crypto Services se integra ao IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) para permitir controle granular sobre o acesso do usuário aos recursos do serviço. Também é possível monitorar atividades do Hyper Protect Crypto Services usando o serviço IBM Cloud Activity Tracker with LogDNA.
bullets.title: Auditoria e gerenciamento de acesso

bullets.description: Com o KYOK (Keep Your Own Key), o Hyper Protect Crypto Services permite que você assuma a propriedade do HSM ao designar seus próprios administradores e carregar chaves mestras. Isso garante controle total da hierarquia de chaves, pois nenhum administrador da IBM Cloud tem acesso a elas.
bullets.title: HSM controlado pelo cliente

bullets.description: O Hyper Protect Crypto Services suporta o Enterprise PKCS #11 para operações criptográficas. Isso inclui a geração de chaves, a criptografia e decriptografia de dados, a assinatura de dados e a verificação de assinaturas. As funções criptográficas são executadas em HSMs e podem ser acessadas por meio de APIs para fornecer proteção baseada em hardware para seus aplicativos.
bullets.title: Operações criptográficas

bullets.description: O serviço é construído sobre o hardware certificado FIPS 140-2 de nível 4, o mais alto oferecido por qualquer provedor em nuvem no segmento de mercado. O HSM também é certificado para atender ao Common Criteria Part 3 em conformidade com o EAL 4.
bullets.title: Certificação de segurança

bullets.description: O Unified Key Orchestrator fornece gerenciamento de ciclo de vida de chave de acordo com as recomendações NIST e transferência segura de chaves para keystores internos na instância de serviço ou keystores externos. Pode-se enviar por push suas chaves para keystores em nuvem de terceiros, como Azure Key Vault, AWS Key Management Service (KMS), o Google Cloud KMS ou o IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud, distribuir chaves entre keystores e gerenciar chaves e keystores por meio da interface com o usuário e da API de REST.
bullets.title: Conexão com keystores externos

bullets.description: O Unified Key Orchestrator permite fazer backup de todas as chaves na IBM Cloud. Pode-se redistribuir chaves por meio da instância do Hyper Protect Crypto Services para se recuperar rapidamente de erros fatais em nuvem. E, ao mesmo tempo, você possui a confiança raiz de sua hierarquia de chaves.
bullets.title: Sistema unificado de backup e gerenciamento de chaves

bullets.description: Você pode orquestrar chaves por meio de uma experiência de usuário única e unificada em várias nuvens com um mecanismo de orquestração de ciclo de vida de chave auditável.
bullets.title: Orquestração principal entre diversas nuvens
Conformidade: GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001/27017/27018, SOC 2 Type 1, IRAP, IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 提供了单租户密钥管理服务，使您能够通过标准化 API 创建、导入、轮换和管理密钥。 删除加密密钥之后，保证再也无法检索到数据。
bullets.title: 密钥生命周期管理

bullets.description: 与其他 IBM Cloud 服务集成之后，您可以使用 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 对云端进行自加密。 通过封装与云服务相关联的加密密钥，该服务可为云数据提供双层保护。
bullets.title: 对 IBM Cloud 服务进行加密

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 与 IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) 集成，从而支持精细化控制用户访问服务资源的权限。 您还可以使用 IBM Cloud Activity Tracker with LogDNA 服务监视 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 的活动。
bullets.title: 访问权管理和审计

bullets.description: 借助“保管自己的密钥”功能，您可以使用 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 指定自己的管理员并装入主密钥来获取 HSM 所有权。 此操作可确保您能够对整个密钥层次结构进行完全控制，IBM Cloud 管理员无法在其中访问您的密钥。
bullets.title: 客户控制的 HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 支持 Enterprise PKCS #11 进行加密操作。 此操作包括生成密钥、加密和解密数据、签署数据和验证签名。 加密功能在 HSM 中执行，并且可以通过 API 访问，从而为应用程序提供硬件保护。
bullets.title: 加密操作

bullets.description: 该服务在通过 FIPS 140-2 级别 4 认证的硬件上构建，该级别是行业内任何云提供者提供的最高级别。 HSM 也经认证，以符合遵循“通用标准”第 3 部分的 EAL 4。
bullets.title: 安全认证

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator 根据 NIST 建议来提供密钥生命周期管理，并将密钥安全传输到服务实例中的内部密钥库或外部密钥库。 您可以将密钥推送到第三方云密钥库（例如，Azure 密钥保险库、AWS 密钥管理服务 (KMS)、Google Cloud KMS 或 IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud)，在密钥库之间分发密钥，以及通过 UI 和 REST API 来管理密钥和密钥库。
bullets.title: 与外部密钥库的连接

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator 使您能够备份 IBM Cloud 中的所有密钥。 您可以通过 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 实例重新分发密钥，以快速从致命的云错误中恢复。 同时，您拥有密钥层次结构的根信任。
bullets.title: 统一密钥备份和管理系统

bullets.description: 您可以使用可审计的密钥生命周期编排机制，通过跨多个云的单一统一用户体验来编排密钥。
bullets.title: 跨多个云的密钥编排
合规性：GDPR、HIPAA、ISO 27001/27017/27018、SOC 2 类型 1、IRAP、IBM Cloud for Financial Services

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 提供單一租戶金鑰管理服務，可讓您使用標準化 API 建立、匯入、輪替及管理金鑰。 刪除加密金鑰之後，可以確保無法再擷取您的資料。
bullets.title: 金鑰生命週期管理

bullets.description: 透過與其他 IBM Cloud 服務整合，Hyper Protect Crypto Services 提供將您自己的加密資料放置到雲端的功能。 該服務透過包裝與雲端服務相關聯的加密金鑰，為您的雲端資料提供雙層保護。
bullets.title: 針對 IBM Cloud 服務加密

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 與 IBM Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) 整合，讓您能對服務資源的使用者存取權進行細微控制。 您也可以透過搭配使用 IBM Cloud Activity Tracker 與 LogDNA 服務，來監視 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 的活動。
bullets.title: 存取管理與審核

bullets.description: 使用「保存您自己的金鑰」，Hyper Protect Crypto Services 可讓您透過指派自己的管理者並載入主要金鑰，取得 HSM 的所有權。 這會確保完全控制整個金鑰階層，其中沒有任何 IBM Cloud 管理者可以存取您的金鑰。
bullets.title: 客戶控制的 HSM

bullets.description: Hyper Protect Crypto Services 支援 Enterprise PKCS #11 以進行加密作業。 這包括產生金鑰、加密及解密資料、簽署資料及驗證簽章。 加密函數是在 HSM 中執行，並且可以透過 API 進行存取，為您的應用程式提供硬體式保護。
bullets.title: 加密作業

bullets.description: 該服務建置於 FIPS 140-2 Level 4 認證的硬體上，是業界中所有雲端提供者提供的最高等級。 HSM 也經認證，以符合 EAL 4 的「共用準則第 3 部分」。
bullets.title: 安全憑證

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator 根據 NIST 建議提供金鑰生命週期管理，並安全地將金鑰傳送至服務實例或外部金鑰儲存庫中的內部金鑰儲存庫。 您可以將金鑰推送至協力廠商雲端金鑰儲存庫（例如 Azure 金鑰儲存庫、AWS 金鑰管理服務 (KMS)、Google Cloud KMS 或 IBM Key Protect for IBM Cloud），在金鑰儲存庫之間配送金鑰，並透過使用者介面和 REST API 來管理金鑰和金鑰儲存庫。
bullets.title: 與外部金鑰儲存庫的連線

bullets.description: Unified Key Orchestrator 可讓您備份 IBM Cloud 中的所有金鑰。 您可以透過 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 實例重新配送金鑰，以快速從嚴重雲端錯誤中回復。 同時，您擁有金鑰階層的根信任。
bullets.title: 統一金鑰備份及管理系統

bullets.description: 您可以使用可審核的金鑰生命週期編排機制，透過跨多個雲端的單一統一使用者體驗來編排金鑰。
bullets.title: 跨多個雲端的關鍵編排
法規遵循：GDPR、HIPAA、ISO 27001/27017/27018、SOC 2 Type 1、IRAP、IBM Cloud for Financial Services

name: hs-crypto

de.description: KYOK (Keep Your Own Key) für die Verschlüsselung von Clouddaten mit einem dedizierten KMS (Key Management Service, Schlüsselmanagementservice), der auf einem zertifizierten FIPS 140-2 Level 4-HSM basiert.
de.long_description: Ein dedizierter Schlüsselmanagementservice und ein Hardwaresicherheitsmodul (HSM) stellen Ihnen die Funktion "Keep Your Own Key" für die Clouddatenverschlüsselung zur Verfügung. Hyper Protect Crypto Services basiert auf zertifizierter FIPS 140-2 Level 4-Hardware und bietet Ihnen die exklusive Steuerung Ihrer Verschlüsselungsschlüssel. Mit Unified Key Orchestrator können Sie Ihre Serviceinstanz mit Keystores in IBM Cloud und Cloud-Providern von Drittanbietern verbinden, Schlüssel mithilfe eines einheitlichen Systems sichern und verwalten und Schlüssel in mehreren Clouds koordinieren.

en.description: Keep Your Own Key for cloud data encryption with a dedicated key management service built on FIPS 140-2 Level 4 certified HSM.
en.long_description: A dedicated key management service and Hardware Security Module (HSM) provides you with the Keep Your Own Key capability for cloud data encryption. Built on FIPS 140-2 Level 4 certified hardware, Hyper Protect Crypto Services provides you with exclusive control of your encryption keys. With Unified Key Orchestrator, you can connect your service instance to keystores in IBM Cloud and third-party cloud providers, back up and manage keys using a unified system, and orchestrate keys across multiple clouds.

es.description: Mantenga su propia clave para el cifrado de datos en la nube con un servicio de gestión de claves dedicado basado en HSM con certificación FIPS 140-2 de Nivel 4.
es.long_description: Un servicio de gestión de claves dedicado y un módulo de seguridad de hardware (HSM) le proporciona la prestación "Keep Your Own Key" (mantener su propia clave) para el cifrado de datos en la nube. Basado en hardware certificado FIPS 140-2 Nivel 4, Hyper Protect Crypto Services le proporciona el control exclusivo de las claves de cifrado. Con Unified Key Orchestrator, puede conectar su instancia de servicio a almacenes de claves en IBM Cloud y proveedores de nube de terceros, realizar una copia de seguridad y gestionar claves mediante un sistema unificado y orquestar claves en varias nubes.

fr.description: Conservez votre propre clé pour le chiffrement des données de cloud avec un service de gestion de clés dédié intégré au service HSM certifié FIPS 140-2 niveau 4.
fr.long_description: Un service de gestion de clés dédié et un module HSM (Hardware Security Module) fournissent la fonction Keep Your Own Key pour le chiffrement des données de cloud. Reposant sur du matériel certifié FIPS 140-2 Level 4, Hyper Protect Crypto Services fournit un contrôle exclusif de vos clés de chiffrement. Avec Unified Key Orchestrator, vous pouvez connecter votre instance de service à des magasins de clés dans IBM Cloud et des fournisseurs de cloud tiers, sauvegarder et gérer des clés à l'aide d'un système unifié et orchestrer des clés dans plusieurs clouds.

it.description: Keep Your Own Key per la crittografia dei dati su cloud con un servizio di gestione chiavi dedicato, basato su HSM con certificazione FIPS 140-2 Livello 4.
it.long_description: Un servizio di gestione delle chiavi dedicato e HSM (Hardware Security Module) fornisce la funzionalità Keep Your Own Key per la crittografia dei dati cloud. Basato sull'hardware certificato FIPS 140-2 Livello 4, Hyper Protect Crypto Services fornisce il controllo esclusivo delle chiavi di crittografia. Con Unified Key Orchestrator, è possibile connettere la propria istanza del servizio ai keystore in IBM Cloud e provider cloud di terze parti, eseguire il backup e gestire le chiavi utilizzando un sistema unificato, e orchestrare le chiavi su più cloud.

ja.description: FIPS 140-2 レベル 4 認定 HSM 上に構築された専用鍵管理サービスを使用するクラウド・データ暗号化のための Keep Your Own Key。
ja.long_description: 専用の鍵管理サービスとハードウェア・セキュリティー・モジュール (HSM) は、クラウド・データ暗号化のための Keep Your Own Key 機能を提供します。 Hyper Protect Crypto Services は、FIPS 140-2 レベル 4 認定ハードウェア上に構築されており、暗号鍵の排他制御を提供します。 Unified Key Orchestrator を使用すると、サービス・インスタンスを IBM Cloud およびサード・パーティーのクラウド・プロバイダーの鍵ストアに接続し、統一されたシステムを使用して鍵をバックアップおよび管理し、複数のクラウドにわたって鍵を調整することができます。

ko.description: FIPS 140-2 레벨 4 인증 HSM을 기반으로 빌드된 전용 키 관리 서비스를 사용하여 클라우드 데이터 암호화를 위한 사용자 고유의 키를 보관(KYOK)합니다.
ko.long_description: 전용 키 관리 서비스 및 HSM(Hardware Security Module)은 클라우드 데이터 암호화를 위한 Keep Your Own Key 기능을 제공합니다. FIPS 140-2 레벨 4 인증 하드웨어에 빌드된 Hyper Protect Crypto Services는 암호화 키를 독점적으로 제어할 수 있도록 합니다. Unified Key Orchestrator를 사용하여 서비스 인스턴스를 IBM Cloud 및 써드파티 클라우드 제공자의 키 저장소에 연결하고, 통합 시스템을 사용하여 키를 백업 및 관리하고, 복수의 클라우드에서 키를 조정할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: KYOK (Keep Your Own Key) para a criptografia de dados de nuvem com um serviço de gerenciamento de chaves dedicado criado em um HSM certificado em FIPS 140-2 de nível 4.
pt-br.long_description: Um serviço de gerenciamento de chave dedicado e o HSM (Hardware Security Module) fornece a você o recurso Keep Your Own Key para criptografia de dados em nuvem. Desenvolvido sobre o hardware certificado FIPS 140-2 Level 4, o Hyper Protect Crypto Services fornece a você o controle exclusivo de suas chaves de criptografia. Com o Unified Key Orchestrator, pode-se conectar sua instância de serviço a keystores na IBM Cloud e em provedores em nuvem de terceiros, fazer backup e gerenciar chaves usando um sistema unificado e orquestrar chaves entre diversas nuvens.

zh-cn.description: 在通过 FIPS 140-2 级别 4 认证的 HSM 上构建的专用密钥管理服务可实现云数据加密所需的“保管自己的密钥”功能。
zh-cn.long_description: 专用密钥管理服务和硬件安全模块 (HSM) 为您提供了用于云数据加密的“保管自己的密钥”功能。 Hyper Protect Crypto Services 基于 FIPS 140-2 级别 4 认证的硬件构建，为您提供对加密密钥的独占控制。 通过 Unified Key Orchestrator，您可以将服务实例连接到 IBM Cloud 和第三方云提供者中的密钥库，使用统一系统备份和管理密钥，以及跨多个云编排密钥。

zh-tw.description: 利用以 FIPS 140-2 Level 4 認證 HSM 所建置的專用金鑰管理服務，保存您自己的金鑰進行雲端資料加密。
zh-tw.long_description: 專用金鑰管理服務及 Hardware Security Module (HSM) 為您提供「保留自己的金鑰」功能，以進行雲端資料加密。 以 FIPS 140-2 Level 4 認證硬體為建置基礎，Hyper Protect Crypto Services 為您提供加密金鑰的專用控制。 使用 Unified Key Orchestrator，您可以將服務實例連接至 IBM Cloud 及協力廠商雲端提供者中的金鑰儲存庫，使用統一系統備份及管理金鑰，以及在多個雲端之間編排金鑰。

de.description: Zur Differenzierung des Zugriffs auf die Schlüssel in Ihrem Schlüsselmanagementservice können Schlüssel in separaten Vaults erstellt werden. Vaults sind sichere Repositorys für Ihre Verschlüsselungsschlüssel und Keystores. Ein verwalteter Schlüssel oder ein Keystore kann sich immer nur in einer einzigen Vault befinden. Ein verwalteter Schlüssel kann nur für Verschlüsselung und Entschlüsselung verwendet werden, wenn er in mindestens einem Keystore installiert ist. Sie können einen verwalteten Schlüssel in mehreren internen oder externen Keystores installieren, auch in Clouds wie Azure, AWS und Google Cloud Platform. Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus des verwalteten Schlüssels über die Vault. Wenn Sie Änderungen am verwalteten Schlüssel vornehmen, synchronisiert die Vault alle installierten Schlüssel. Sie können bis zu 5 freie interne Keystores und 1 freien externen Keystore haben. Der Stundenbasispreis für Unified Key Orchestrator wird angewendet, sobald Sie für die Serviceinstanz eine Verbindung zu einem externen Keystore herstellen.

en.description: For distinct access to your key management service keys, keys can be created in separate vaults. Vaults are secure repositories for your cryptographic keys and keystores. A managed key or keystore can only be in one vault at a time. A managed key can only be used for encryption and decryption when it is installed in at least one keystore. You can install a managed key in multiple keystores, internal or external, even across clouds such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. Manage the lifecycle of the managed key from the vault. When you make changes to the managed key, the vault keeps its all installed keys in sync. You can have up to 5 free internal keystores and 1 free external keystore. The Unified Key Orchestrator hourly base price is applied as soon as you connect to an external keystore for the service instance.

es.description: Para un acceso distinto a las claves de servicio de gestión de claves, las claves se pueden crear en distintas cajas fuertes. Las cajas fuertes son repositorios seguros para sus claves criptográficas y almacenes de claves. Una clave gestionada o un almacén de claves solo puede estar en una caja fuerte a la vez. Una clave gestionada sólo se puede utilizar para el cifrado y descifrado cuando está instalada en al menos un almacén de claves. Puede instalar una clave gestionada en varios almacenes de claves, internos o externos, incluso entre nubes como Azure, AWSy Google Cloud Platform. Gestione el ciclo de vida de la clave gestionada desde la caja fuerte. Cuando realiza cambios en la clave gestionada, la caja fuerte mantiene sincronizadas todas las claves instaladas. Puede tener hasta 5 almacenes de claves internos gratis y 1 almacén de claves externo gratis. El precio base por hora de Unified Key Orchestrator se aplica en cuanto se conecta a un almacén de claves externo para la instancia de servicio.

fr.description: Pour un accès distinct à vos clés sous contrôle du service de gestion des clés, les clés peuvent être créées dans des coffres distincts. Les coffres sont des référentiels sécurisés pour vos clés cryptographiques et vos magasins de clés. Une clé gérée ou un magasin de clés ne peut se trouver que dans un seul coffre à la fois. Une clé gérée ne peut être utilisée pour le chiffrement et le déchiffrement que lorsqu'elle est installée dans au moins un magasin de clés. Vous pouvez installer une clé gérée dans plusieurs magasins de clés, internes ou externes, et même dans des clouds tels que Azure, AWS et Google Cloud Platform. Gérez le cycle de vie de la clé gérée depuis le coffre. Lorsque vous modifiez la clé gérée, le coffre assure la synchronisation de toutes ses clés installées. Vous pouvez disposez de jusqu'à 5 magasins de clés internes gratuits et d'un magasin de clés externe gratuit. Le prix de base horaire d'Unified Key Orchestrator est appliqué dès que vous vous connectez à un magasin de clés externe pour l'instance de service.

it.description: Per un accesso distinto alle chiavi del servizio di gestione delle chiavi, è possibile creare le chiavi in vault separati. I vault sono repository sicuri per chiavi crittografiche e keystore. Una chiave gestita o un keystore possono risiedere in un solo vault alla volta. Una chiave gestita può essere utilizzata per la crittografia e la decrittografia solo se è installata in almeno un keystore. È possibile installare una chiave gestita in più keystore, interni o esterni, anche in cloud come Azure, AWS e Google Cloud Platform. Gestisci dal vault il ciclo di vita della chiave gestita. Quando si apportano modifiche alla chiave gestita, il vault mantiene sincronizzate tutte le proprie chiavi installate. È possibile avere fino a 5 keystore interni gratuiti e 1 keystore esterno gratuito. Il prezzo di base orario di Unified Key Orchestrator viene applicato non appena ci si connette a un keystore esterno per l'istanza del servizio.

ja.description: 鍵管理サービス鍵に個別にアクセスするために、別々のボールトに鍵を作成することができます。 ボールトは、暗号鍵および鍵ストアのセキュア・リポジトリーです。 管理対象鍵または鍵ストアは、一度に 1 つのボールトにのみ存在できます。 管理対象鍵は、少なくとも 1 つの鍵ストアにインストールされている場合にのみ、暗号化および暗号化解除に使用できます。 管理対象鍵は、Azure、AWS、Google Cloud Platform などのクラウドにまたがっていても、内部または外部の複数の鍵ストアにインストールできます。 ボールトから管理対象鍵のライフサイクルを管理します。 管理対象鍵に変更を加えると、ボールトはそのすべてのインストール済みの鍵を同期したまま維持します。 最大 5 つの無料の内部鍵ストアと 1 つの無料の外部鍵ストアを持つことができます。 Unified Key Orchestrator の時間単位の基本価格は、サービス・インスタンスの外部鍵ストアに接続するとすぐに適用されます。

ko.description: 키 관리 서비스 키에 대한 고유한 액세스를 위해 별도의 볼트에 키를 작성할 수 있습니다. 볼트는 암호화 키 및 키 저장소에 대한 보안 저장소입니다. 관리 키 또는 키 저장소는 한 번에 하나의 볼트에만 있을 수 있습니다. 관리 키는 하나 이상의 키 저장소에 설치된 경우 암호화 및 복호화에만 사용할 수 있습니다. Azure, AWS 및 Google Cloud Platform과 같은 클라우드 전반에 걸쳐 내부 또는 외부의 여러 키 저장소에 관리 키를 설치할 수 있습니다. 볼트에서 관리 키의 라이프사이클을 관리합니다. 관리 키를 변경하는 경우 볼트는 설치된 모든 키를 동기화 상태로 유지합니다. 최대 5개의 무료 내부 키 저장소와 1개의 무료 외부 키 저장소를 보유할 수 있습니다. Unified Key Orchestrator 시간당 기본 가격은 서비스 인스턴스의 외부 키 저장소에 연결하는 즉시 적용됩니다.

pt-BR.description: Para um acesso distinto às suas chaves de serviço de gerenciamento de chaves, as chaves podem ser criadas em áreas seguras separadas. Áreas seguras são repositórios seguros para suas chaves criptográficas e keystores. Uma chave gerenciada ou um keystore só pode estar em uma área segura por vez. Uma chave gerenciada só pode ser usada para criptografia e decriptografia quando ela estiver instalada em pelo menos um keystore. Pode-se instalar uma chave gerenciada em diversos keystores, internos ou externos, mesmo entre nuvens como Azure, AWS e Google Cloud Platform. Gerencie o ciclo de vida da chave gerenciada por meio da área segura. Ao fazer mudanças na chave gerenciada, a área segura mantém todas as suas chaves instaladas em sincronia. Pode-se ter até 5 keystores internos livres e 1 keystore externo livre. O preço base por hora do Unified Key Orchestrator será aplicado assim que conectar-se a um keystore externo para a instância de serviço.

zh-cn.description: 为了能够分别访问密钥管理服务密钥，可以在不同的保险库中创建密钥。 保险库是加密密钥和密钥库的安全存储库。 受管密钥或密钥库一次只能位于一个保险库中。 仅当受管密钥安装在至少一个密钥库中时，才能用于加密和解密。 您可以在多个密钥库（内部或外部）中安装受管密钥，即使在诸如 Azure、AWS 和 Google Cloud Platform 之类的云中也是如此。 在保险库中管理受管密钥的生命周期。 当您更改受管密钥时，保险库会使其所有已安装的密钥保持同步。 最多可以有 5 个免费内部密钥库和 1 个免费外部密钥库。 在连接到服务实例的外部密钥库后，将立即应用 Unified Key Orchestrator 每小时基本价格。

zh-tw.description: 若要明確存取金鑰管理服務金鑰，可以在個別儲存庫中建立金鑰。 儲存庫是用於存放加密金鑰和金鑰儲存庫的安全儲存庫。 一次只能在一個儲存庫中存放一個受管理金鑰或金鑰儲存庫。 當受管理金鑰安裝在至少一個金鑰儲存庫中時，它只能用於加密和解密。 您可以在多個金鑰儲存庫（內部或外部）中安裝受管理金鑰，即使在 Azure、AWS及 Google Cloud Platform 等雲端之間也一樣。 從儲存庫管理受管理金鑰的生命週期。 當您變更受管理金鑰時，儲存庫會保持其所有已安裝金鑰同步。 您最多可以有 5 個可用的內部金鑰儲存庫及 1 個可用的外部金鑰儲存庫。 只要您連接至服務實例的外部金鑰儲存庫，即會套用 Unified Key Orchestrator 每小時基本價格。

plans.description: For distinct access to your key management service keys, keys can be created in separate vaults. Vaults are secure repositories for your cryptographic keys and keystores. A managed key or keystore can only be in one vault at a time. A managed key can only be used for encryption and decryption when it is installed in at least one keystore. You can install a managed key in multiple keystores, internal or external, even across clouds such as Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. Manage the lifecycle of the managed key from the vault. When you make changes to the managed key, the vault keeps its all installed keys in sync. You can have up to 5 free internal keystores and 1 free external keystore. The Unified Key Orchestrator hourly base price is applied as soon as you connect to an external keystore for the service instance.

en.description: Image Service for VPC provides capabilities for customers to bring their own images or create images for rapid deployment
en.long_description:
Custom images are used to create new virtual server instances with your own settings and configurations.  You can create a custom image on IBM Cloud in two ways: 
1. You can create a custom image on premises and import it to your IBM Cloud Virtual Private Cloud infrastructure from IBM Cloud Object Storage. 
2. You can create a custom image of a boot volume that is attached to a virtual server instance at import time. For more information, see [about creating an image](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-image-from-volume-vpc).
Images are private to the account that they're imported to. New virtual server instance deployments are limited to the region where the image is imported. For more information about importing custom images, see [importing custom images](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-importing-custom-images-vpc). For more information about managing custom images, see [Managing custom images](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-managing-custom-images).

You have many considerations when you create a custom image, such as operating systems, image requirements, and whether you want to share your custom image to a private catalog. For more information about planning for custom images, see [planning for custom images](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-planning-custom-images).

), ticketing portal (JIRA, access provided post-subscription), or a dedicated support phone number (shared upon subscription).

Our standard support hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST, with 24x7 coverage for critical issues.

We assist customers with:
Onboarding and configuration
Troubleshooting and usage guidance
Issue resolution, bug fixes, and escalations
Solution updates and enhancements

We acknowledge all requests within 4 business hours and resolve critical issues as quickly as possible.

de.description: Cloud Internet Services (CIS) verwendet Cloudflare und umfasst einen Domain Name Service (DNS), globale Lastausgleichsfunktionen (Global Load Balancer - GLB), DDoS-Schutz, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Transport Layer Security (TLS), Ratenbegrenzung, Smart Routing und Caching.

en.long_description: Intics.ai Agentic Document Intelligence is an AI-powered platform that streamlines document processing for healthcare and pharmaceutical organizations. Our solution automatically extracts, classifies, and organizes data from a wide range of documents including forms, clinical records, and reports. By leveraging advanced machine learning and natural language processing, Intics.ai significantly reduces manual effort, improves data accuracy, and accelerates workflow efficiency. The platform supports integration with existing systems, ensures compliance with industry regulations, and maintains robust data privacy and security. With customizable automation and user-friendly dashboards, Intics.ai empowers teams to make better decisions quickly, cut operational costs, and focus resources on value-added tasks. Unlock the full potential of your organization’s information assets with intelligent automation and real-time insights for smarter business processes.

name: kms

de.description: Erstellen oder verwalten Sie kryptografische Schlüssel in der Cloud, um ruhende Daten zu schützen.
de.long_description: Key Protect ist ein cloudbasierter Sicherheitsservice, mit dem die Verwaltung des Lebenszyklus für Verschlüsselungsschlüssel bereitgestellt wird, die in IBM Cloud-Services oder Kundenanwendungen verwendet werden. Key Protect stellt RoT (Roots of Trust) bereit, die durch ein HSM (Hardwaresicherheitsmodul) gesichert werden.

en.description: Create or manage cryptographic keys in the cloud to protect data at rest.
en.long_description: Key Protect is a cloud-based security service that provides life cycle management for encryption keys that are used in IBM Cloud services or customer-built applications. Key Protect provides roots of trust (RoT), backed by a hardware security module (HSM).

es.description: Cree o gestione claves criptográficas en la nube para proteger los datos en reposo.
es.long_description: Key Protect es un servicio de seguridad basado en la nube que proporciona la gestión del ciclo de vida para las claves de cifrado que se utilizan en servicios de IBM Cloud o aplicaciones creadas por el cliente. Key Protect proporciona claves raíz de confianza (RoT), respaldadas por un módulo de seguridad de hardware (HSM).

fr.description: Créez ou gérez des clés cryptographiques dans le cloud pour protéger les données au repos.
fr.long_description: Key Protect est un service de sécurité basé sur le cloud qui fournit une gestion de cycle de vie des clés de chiffrement utilisées dans les services IBM Cloud ou dans les applications générées par le client. Key Protect fournit des racines de confiance (RoT, roots of trust), appuyées par un module de sécurité matériel (HSM, hardware security module).

it.description: Creare o gestire le chiavi crittografiche nel cloud per proteggere i dati inattivi.
it.long_description: Key Protect è un servizio di sicurezza basato sul cloud che fornisce la gestione del ciclo di vita delle chiavi di crittografia utilizzate nei servizi IBM Cloud o nelle applicazioni create dai clienti. Key Protect fornisce RoT (Roots of Trust) che si avvale di un HSM (Hardware Security Module).

ja.description: Data at Rest (保存されたデータ) を保護するため、クラウドで暗号キーを作成または管理します。
ja.long_description: Key Protect はクラウド・ベースのセキュリティー・サービスであり、IBM クラウド・サービスまたはお客様がビルドしたアプリケーションで使用される暗号鍵のライフサイクル管理を行います。 Key Protect は、ハードウェア・セキュリティー・モジュール (HSM) に裏付けられた信頼のルート (RoT) を提供します。

ko.description: 클라우드에서 암호화 키를 작성하거나 관리하여 저장된 데이터를 보호하십시오.
ko.long_description: Key Protect는 IBM Cloud 서비스 또는 고객이 빌드한 애플리케이션에서 사용되는 암호화 키의 라이프사이클 관리를 제공하는 클라우드 기반의 보안 서비스입니다. Key Protect는 하드웨어 보안 모듈(HSM)에서 지원하는 RoT(Roots of Trust)를 제공합니다.

pt-BR.description: Crie ou gerencie chaves criptográficas na nuvem para proteger os dados em repouso.
pt-BR.long_description: O Key Protect é um serviço de segurança com base em nuvem que fornece gerenciamento de ciclo de vida para chaves de criptografia que são usadas em serviços da IBM Cloud ou em aplicativos desenvolvidos do cliente. O Key Protect fornece raízes de confiança (RoT), suportadas por um módulo de segurança de hardware (HSM).

zh-Hans.description: 在云中创建或管理加密密钥，以保护静态存储的数据。
zh-Hans.long_description: Key Protect 是基于云的安全服务，为在 IBM Cloud 服务或客户构建的应用程序中使用的加密密钥提供生命周期管理。 Key Protect 提供由硬件安全模块 (HSM) 支持的“信任根”(RoT)。

zh-Hant.description: 在雲端中建立或管理加密金鑰，以保護靜態資料。
zh-Hant.long_description: Key Protect 是雲端型安全服務，可提供用於 IBM Cloud 服務或客戶建置應用程式中之加密金鑰的生命週期管理。 Key Protect 提供信任根目錄 (RoT)，由硬體安全模組 (HSM) 支援。

de.description:
Schlüsselversionen werden erstellt, wenn ein Schlüssel erstellt oder importiert wird und wenn ein vorhandener Schlüssel rotiert wird. Ein Schlüssel, der beispielsweise fünfmal gedreht wurde, hat sechs Versionen (fünf Versionen, die durch Drehungen entstanden sind, plus die ursprüngliche Version).

Dieser Plan bietet keine überregionale Widerstandsfähigkeit.

en.description:
Key versions are created whenever a key is created or imported, and whenever an existing key is rotated. A key that has been rotated five times, for example, has six versions (five versions created by rotations plus the initial version).

This plan does not offer cross-regional resiliency.

name: komprise-intelligent-data-management-suite

en.description: Analyze, migrate, tier, archive, manage file and object data at scale simply and reliably. Optimize costs, deliver data value.
en.long_description:
For sales support, please reach out to Komprise directly at IBM@komprise.com

Komprise enables organizations to handle the two most pressing issues with unstructured data: managing its rampant growth across multi-vendor storage and unlocking data value. Komprise is a data management service that connects easily via open standards to any file storage to provide much-needed analytics and visibility across all storage silos.

Key benefits for customers include optimizing the management of petabytes of unstructured data to accelerate cloud migrations while dramatically cutting costs. Komprise automatically migrates or tiers unstructured/file data to secondary storage according to the plans which users create so that data always lives in the right place at the right time according to its age, usage or other parameters such as security.

This adds up to significant storage savings (up to 70%) from migrating and archiving data. Komprise’s elastic grid architecture and patented TMT (transparent move technology) ensures that once data is moved from NAS and cloud file services, users can always access files from the original location, in their original form, without getting in the hot data path and enabling native access in the destination storage.

bullets.description: 請參閱「檢視文件」鏈結，以取得關於項目（例如建立叢集以及將應用程式部署到叢集中）的 IBM Cloud Container Service 說明文件和指導教學。
bullets.title: 指導教學與說明文件

name: containers-kubernetes

de.description: Stellen Sie sichere, hoch verfügbare Apps in einem nativen Kubernetes-Benutzererlebnis bereit. Der IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service erstellt einen Cluster mit Rechenhosts und stellt hoch verfügbare Container bereit.
de.long_description: Der IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service erstellt einen Cluster mit Rechenhosts und stellt hoch verfügbare Container bereit. Mit einem Kubernetes-Cluster können Sie die Ressourcen, die Sie für die schnelle Bereitstellung, Aktualisierung und Skalierung von Anwendungen benötigen, sicher verwalten.

en.description: Deploy secure, highly available apps in a native Kubernetes experience. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service creates a cluster of compute hosts and deploys highly available containers.
en.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service creates a cluster of compute hosts and deploys highly available containers. A Kubernetes cluster lets you securely manage the resources that you need to quickly deploy, update and scale applications.

es.description: Desplegar aplicaciones seguras y con alta disponibilidad en una experiencia Kubernetes nativa. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service crea un clúster de hosts de cálculo y despliega contenedores de alta disponibilidad.
es.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service crea un clúster de hosts de cálculo y despliega contenedores de alta disponibilidad. Un clúster de Kubernetes le permite administrar de forma segura los recursos que necesita para desplegar, actualizar y escalar rápidamente las aplicaciones.

fr.description: Déployez des applications sécurisées à haute disponibilité dans une expérience Kubernetes native.  IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service crée un cluster d'hôtes de calcul et déploie des conteneurs haute disponibilité.
fr.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service créé un cluster d'hôtes de calcul et déploie des conteneurs haute disponibilité. Un cluster Kubernetes vous permet de gérer de manière sécurisée les ressources nécessaires au déploiement, à la mise à jour et à la mise à l'échelle rapides d'applications.

it.description: Distribuire applicazioni sicure e ad elevata disponibilità in un'esperienza Kubernetes nativa. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service crea un cluster di host di elaborazione e distribuisce contenitori ad alta disponibilità.
it.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service crea un cluster di host di elaborazione e distribuisce contenitori ad alta disponibilità. Un cluster Kubernetes consente di gestire in modo sicuro le risorse di cui si ha bisogno per distribuire, aggiornare e ridimensionare velocemente le applicazioni.

ja.description: Kubernetes 固有のエクスペリエンスにより安全で可用性の高いアプリケーションをデプロイします。 IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service はコンピューティングホストのクラスターを作成し、高可用性コンテナーをデプロイします。
ja.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service はコンピューティングホストのクラスターを作成し、高可用性コンテナーをデプロイします。 Kubernetes クラスターにより、迅速にデプロイ、更新する必要のあるリソースをセキュアに管理し、アプリケーションを拡張できるようになります。

ko.description: 고유한 Kubernetes 경험으로 안전한 고가용성 앱을 배치합니다. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service는 컴퓨팅 호스트의 클러스터를 작성하고 고가용성 컨테이너를 배치합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service는 컴퓨팅 호스트의 클러스터를 작성하고 고가용성 컨테이너를 배치합니다. Kubernetes 클러스터를 사용하는 경우 신속하게 애플리케이션을 배치, 업데이트 및 스케일링해야 하는 자원을 안전하게 관리할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.description: Implemente aplicativos seguros e altamente disponíveis em uma experiência nativa do Kubernetes. O IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service cria um cluster de hosts de computação e implementa contêineres altamente disponíveis.
pt-BR.long_description: O IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service cria um cluster de hosts de computação e implementa contêineres altamente disponíveis. Um cluster do Kubernetes permite gerenciar com segurança os recursos que você precisa implementar rapidamente, atualizar e escalar aplicativos.

zh-cn.description: 按照本机 Kubernetes 体验来部署安全且高度可用的应用程序。 IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service 创建计算主机的集群并部署高可用性的容器。
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service 创建计算主机的集群并部署高可用性的容器。 Kubernetes 集群允许您安全地管理快速部署、更新和扩展应用程序所需的资源。

zh-tw.description: 使用原生 Kubernetes 經驗來部署安全且高可用性的應用程式。 IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service 會建立計算主機的叢集，並部署高可用性容器。
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service 會建立計算主機的叢集，並部署高可用性容器。 Kubernetes 叢集可讓您安全地管理您需要快速部署、更新和調整應用程式的資源。

description: Deploy secure, highly available apps in a native Kubernetes experience. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service creates a cluster of compute hosts and deploys highly available containers.
longDescription: IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service creates a cluster of compute hosts and deploys highly available containers. A Kubernetes cluster lets you securely manage the resources that you need to quickly deploy, update and scale applications.

support.process:
Lantrasoft provides different levels of support based on the need of engagement.

This includes 24x7 verbiage for critical issues with a short response time (e.g., "15-minute response for production system outages") and standard business hours verbiage for non-urgent issues (e.g., "standard requests will be handled during business hours, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time"). 

For critical/emergency support: 
This service provides 24/7 support for critical incidents. Support will be engaged within 15 minutes of the issue being reported.

For 24/7 availability: Support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for critical incidents. Critical issues will be triaged and responded to immediately, regardless of the time of day, to minimize downtime.

Definition: An incident is considered critical if it causes a complete production system outage or has a severe impact on business operations and is affecting multiple users or departments. 

Standard business hours support:
This service provides standard support is available during regular business hours. For standard support requests, the initial response will be provided during the next business day. Urgent but non-critical issues may have different response times outlined in the service level agreement (SLA).

Business Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, excluding public holidays.

Definition: A standard support request is any issue that does not meet the criteria for a critical incident, such as general inquiries, feature requests, or non-production system malfunctions. 

Support and escalations can be raised thru a secure Help Desk portal dedicated for each authorized user associated with the support contract. This portal also provides authorized users with general knowledge base and community documentation for frequently asked questions.

This includes 24x7 verbiage for critical issues with a short response time (e.g., "15-minute response for production system outages") and standard business hours verbiage for non-urgent issues (e.g., "standard requests will be handled during business hours, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time"). 

For critical/emergency support: 
This service provides 24/7 support for critical incidents. Support will be engaged within 15 minutes of the issue being reported.

For 24/7 availability: Support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for critical incidents. Critical issues will be triaged and responded to immediately, regardless of the time of day, to minimize downtime.

Definition: An incident is considered critical if it causes a complete production system outage or has a severe impact on business operations and is affecting multiple users or departments. 

Standard business hours support:
This service provides standard support is available during regular business hours. For standard support requests, the initial response will be provided during the next business day. Urgent but non-critical issues may have different response times outlined in the service level agreement (SLA).

Business Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, excluding public holidays.

Definition: A standard support request is any issue that does not meet the criteria for a critical incident, such as general inquiries, feature requests, or non-production system malfunctions. 

Support and escalations can be raised thru a secure Help Desk portal dedicated for each authorized user associated with the support contract. This portal also provides authorized users with general knowledge base and community documentation for frequently asked questions.

name: libero-ai-pty-ltd-legislative-compliance

en.description: AI agent that reviews industrial operations documentation against current legislation, regulations and standards to identify compl
en.long_description:
Heavy industrial operations must comply with legislation, regulations and standards set by government departments. Compliance requirements change continuously, yet most organisations check against these requirements only when an audit is due — a reactive approach that exposes them to fines, stop-work orders and reputational damage.

Libero AI's Legislative Compliance Agent uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to compare an organisation's policies, processes and procedures against current legislative and regulatory requirements. It surfaces prioritised compliance gaps so teams can act early — not at audit time.

What the agent does:

- Ingests procedure documents and relevant legislation or registered standards via secure PDF upload
- Compares requirements against existing internal policies and procedures using purpose/scope, document dates, and detailed section-by-section analysis
- Identifies and prioritises compliance gaps, classifying each section as fully compliant, partially compliant, or non-compliant with specific issues and required actions
- Provides actionable recommendations prioritised by risk level (High, Medium, or Low) to guide remediation efforts
- Generates a downloadable Word document report summarising all compliance findings and recommendations for distribution to stakeholders

Proven in industry:

Deployed in a co-creation engagement with IBM Client Engineering for a major mining operation, the agent interrogated compliance records against QGN 34, RS14, RS15 and RS20. Three previously undetected non-conformances were identified before the next regulatory audit

en.description: Elastic Load Balancer as a service with core load balancing features and flexible usage-based pricing.
en.long_description:
Deploy IBM Cloud Load balancer for VPC in front of application servers to distribute incoming user traffic, providing protection against failure of an individual application server instance. You can seamlessly scale your applications by adding or removing servers. with minimal to no disruption to existing traffic flows.

##### Application load balancer (ALB)

Both public and private ALBs provide layer-7 and layer-4 load balancing on IBM Cloud, supporting SSL offloading. The incoming and outgoing packets flow through the load balancer, which distributes data traffic based on configured policies and rules. When incoming requests match the rules that are associated with a policy, that policy defines how the load balancer distributes its traffic.

##### Network load balancer (NLB)

An NLB provides only layer-4 load balancing on IBM Cloud, and does not support SSL offloading. The NLB is zonal, which means that the members must be in the same zone as the load balancer. The client sends public network traffic to the NLB, which forwards it to its targets. These targets then respond directly to the client by using Direct Server Return (DSR). The load balancer does not perform a check on the contents of the packet. Since Layer 4 network load balancing only processes ingress traffic, it is ideal for workloads that require high throughput and low latency.

[Compare offerings](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-nlb-vs-elb)

Private Path Network Load Balancer is a SDN based, Layer 4 Load Balancer that is focused ISVs who want to host their services on VPC and provide secure access to their customers via VPE.

Private Path Network Load Balancer es un equilibrador de carga de capa 4 basado en SDN que se centra en los ISV que desean alojar sus servicios en VPC y proporcionar acceso seguro a sus clientes a través de VPE.

L'équilibreur de charge du réseau de chemins privés est un équilibreur de charge de niveau 4 reposant sur la mise en réseau définie par logiciel, qui se concentre sur les éditeurs de logiciels indépendants souhaitant héberger leurs services dans un cloud privé virtuel et fournir un accès sécurisé à leurs clients via un noeud final privé virtuel.

Private Path Network Load Balancer è un bilanciatore di carico a 4 livelli basato su SDN che è progettato per ISV che vogliono ospitare i propri servizi su VPC e fornire un accesso sicuro ai propri clienti tramite VPE.
プライベート・パス・ネットワーク・ロード・バランサーは SDN ベースのレイヤー 4 ロード・バランサーであり、VPC 上でサービスをホストし、VPE を介してお客様にセキュアなアクセスを提供する ISV に焦点を当てています。
Private Path Network Load Balancer는 VPC에서 서비스를 호스팅하고 VPE를 통해 고객에게 보안 액세스를 제공하려는 ISV에 중점을 둔 SDN 기반의 계층 4 로드 밸런서입니다.
O Private Path Network Load Balancer é um balanceador de carga de camada 4 baseado em SDN, focado em ISVs que desejam hospedar seus serviços em VPC e fornecer acesso seguro a seus clientes via VPE.
专用路径网络负载均衡器是基于 SDN 的第 4 层负载均衡器，它是重点关注的 ISV ，希望在 VPC 上托管其服务并通过 VPE 向客户提供安全访问。
「專用路徑網路負載平衡器」是 SDN 型第 4 層負載平衡器，它是聚焦 ISV ，想要在 VPC 上管理其服務，並透過 VPE 提供安全存取給其客戶。

description: Elastic Load Balancer as a service with core load balancing features and flexible usage-based pricing.
longDescription:
Deploy IBM Cloud Load balancer for VPC in front of application servers to distribute incoming user traffic, providing protection against failure of an individual application server instance. You can seamlessly scale your applications by adding or removing servers. with minimal to no disruption to existing traffic flows.

##### Application load balancer (ALB)

Both public and private ALBs provide layer-7 and layer-4 load balancing on IBM Cloud, supporting SSL offloading. The incoming and outgoing packets flow through the load balancer, which distributes data traffic based on configured policies and rules. When incoming requests match the rules that are associated with a policy, that policy defines how the load balancer distributes its traffic.

##### Network load balancer (NLB)

An NLB provides only layer-4 load balancing on IBM Cloud, and does not support SSL offloading. The NLB is zonal, which means that the members must be in the same zone as the load balancer. The client sends public network traffic to the NLB, which forwards it to its targets. These targets then respond directly to the client by using Direct Server Return (DSR). The load balancer does not perform a check on the contents of the packet. Since Layer 4 network load balancing only processes ingress traffic, it is ideal for workloads that require high throughput and low latency.

[Compare offerings](/docs/vpc?topic=vpc-nlb-vs-elb)

de.description: Nutzen Sie die Managed Network Security Services für das Management, die Überwachung und das Alerting von Sicherheitsvorrichtungen, um Ihre Sicherheitsaktivitäten und Ihre Sicherheitsverwaltung in der Cloud und lokal vor Ort mit Firewalls der nächsten Genration, Systemen für die Erkennung und Verhinderung von unbefugtem Zugriff, konsolidierten Stationen für das Bedrohungsmanagement und sicheren Weg-Gateways zu erweitern.
de.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services bieten Folgendes: 

- Sicherheitsüberwachung, -management und -analyse der Alerts und Protokolle von Sicherheitsvorrichtungen nahezu in Echtzeit
- Know-how im Bereich der Richtlinienverwaltung für Geräte, um böswillige Angriffe zu verhindern
- erweiterte Ereignisanalyse durch intelligente Systeme und Alerts zur Eskalierung und Untersuchung
- ausführliche Berichte für eine verbesserte Entscheidungsfindung
- Zugriff auf den Bedrohungsanalyseservice IBM® X-Force® (der Sicherheitsinformationen ermittelt)

Die Managed Network Security Services unterstützen für die Installation von Hardwarekomponenten und virtueller Software in Ihrer Umgebung oder in AWS, Azure und IBM Cloud eine Matrix aus gründlich getesteten Anbieterplattformen und Technologien, die die besten ihrer Art sind, z. B. Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto und Cisco, um nur einige zu nennen.

Bereitgestellt werden die Services aus einem Netz globaler IBM Security Operations Centers (SOCs), die das ganze Jahr, auch sonn- und feiertags, rund um die Uhr arbeiten.

en.description: Expand your network security operations and management with our Managed Network Security Services that provides management, monitoring, and alerting of security devices in the cloud and on premises including:  Next-Gen Firewalls,  Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems, Unified Threat Management Stations, and Secure Web Gateways.
en.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services provides: 

- Near real-time security monitoring, management and analysis of security device alerts and logs
- Expertise in device policy management to help prevent malicious attacks
- Advanced event analysis by intelligent systems and alerts for escalation and investigation
- Detailed reporting for improved decision making
- Access to IBM® X-Force® threat analysis service (security intelligence)

Managed Network Security Services support a matrix of thoroughly tested and best of breed vendor platforms and technologies as hardware devices and virtual software installed in your environment, or in AWS, Azure & IBM cloud including:  Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto, and Cisco to name a few).

Delivered from a network of global IBM Security Operations Centers (SOCs) operating 24 hours/day, 7 days/week 365 days/year.

es.description: Expanda las operaciones de seguridad de la red y la gestión con Managed Network Security Services, que proporciona gestión, supervisión y creación de alertas de dispositivos de seguridad en el cloud y en el entorno local, que incluyen: cortafuegos de nueva generación, sistemas de prevención y detección de intrusiones, estaciones de gestión de amenazas unificadas y pasarelas web seguras.
es.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services proporciona: 

- Supervisión de la seguridad, gestión y análisis de alertas y registros de dispositivos de seguridad casi en tiempo real
- Experiencia en la gestión de políticas de dispositivo para ayudar a evitar ataques malintencionados
- Análisis avanzado de sucesos realizado por sistemas inteligentes y alertas para la escalada e investigación
- Informes detallados para una mejor toma de decisiones
- Acceso al servicio de análisis de amenazas IBM® X-Force® (inteligencia de seguridad)

Managed Network Security Services admite una matriz de plataformas y tecnologías de los mejores proveedores de su clave exhaustivamente probadas como dispositivos de hardware y software virtual instalado en su entorno, o en AWS, Azure & IBM Cloud, que incluyen:  Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto y Cisco, entre muchos otros).

Distribuido desde una red de centros globales de operaciones (SOC) de IBM que funcionan 24 horas al día, 7 días a la semana, los 365 días del año.

fr.description: Développez votre capacité de gestion et vos opérations en matière de sécurité des réseaux avec la solution Managed Network Security Services qui fournit des fonctions de gestion, de surveillance et d'alerte des périphériques de sécurité dans le cloud et sur site, notamment des pare-feu de nouvelle génération, des systèmes de prévention et de détection d'intrusion (IDPS), des stations de gestion unifiée des menaces (UTS) et des passerelles Web sécurisées.
fr.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services fournit les fonctions suivantes : 

- Surveillance de la sécurité presque en temps réel, gestion et analyse des alertes et journaux des périphériques de sécurité
- Expertise en matière de gestion des stratégies de périphérique afin d'empêcher toute attaque malveillante
- Analyse d'événement avancée par des systèmes intelligents et des alertes à des fins d'escalade et d'investigation
- Génération de rapports détaillés pour améliorer la prise de décision
- Accès au service d'analyse des menaces IBM® X-Force® (sécurité intérieure)

Prise en charge par Managed Network Security Services d'une matrice de plateformes et de technologies rigoureusement testées et très réputées pour les périphériques matériels et les logiciels virtuels installés dans votre environnement, ou dans AWS, Azure & IBM cloud, incluant Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto et Cisco, entre autres).

Livraison à partir d'un réseau de centres IBM Security Operations Center (SOC) présents dans le monde entier, fonctionnant 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7 et 365 jours par an.

it.description: Espandi le tue operazioni di sicurezza di rete e di gestione con Managed Network Security Services, che fornisce la gestione, il monitoraggio e la creazione di avvisi dei dispositivi di sicurezza nel cloud ed in sede, inclusi: Next-Gen Firewalls,  Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems, Unified Threat Management Stations e Secure Web Gateways.
it.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services fornisce: 

- Monitoraggio della sicurezza in tempo quasi reale, gestione ed analisi dei log e degli avvisi dei dispositivi di sicurezza
- Esperienza nella gestione delle politiche dei dispositivi per aiutare ad impedire attacchi dannosi
- Analisi avanzata degli eventi mediante sistemi intelligenti e avvisi per escalation ed indagini
- Creazione di report dettagliati per un processo decisionale migliorato
- Accesso al servizio di analisi delle minacce IBM® X-Force® (intelligence sulla sicurezza)

Managed Network Security Services supporta una matrice di piattaforme e tecnologie di fornitori accuratamente testate come dispositivi hardware e software virtuale installato nell'ambiente, oppure in AWS, Azure & IBM cloud che include: Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto e Cisco, per citarne alcuni.

Fornito da una rete di IBM Security Operations Centers (SOC) globali, attivi 24 ore al giorno, 7 giorni alla settimana, 365 giorni all'anno.

ja.description: クラウドとオンプレミスのセキュリティー・デバイスの管理、モニター、アラートを提供する Managed Network Security Services を使用して、ネットワーク・セキュリティーの操作と管理を拡張します。これには、次世代のファイアウォール、侵入検知および侵入防止システム、統合脅威管理ステーション、セキュア Web ゲートウェイが含まれます。
ja.long_description:
Managed Network Security Services は以下のものを提供します。

- セキュリティー・デバイスのアラートとログのほぼリアルタイムのセキュリティー・モニター、管理、分析
- 悪質な攻撃を防ぐのに役立つデバイス・ポリシー管理の専門知識
- インテリジェント・システムによる高度なイベント分析と、報告と調査に役立つアラート
- 意思決定の向上に役立つ詳細なレポート作成
- IBM® X-Force® 脅威分析サービス (セキュリティー・インテリジェンス) へのアクセス

Managed Network Security Services は、徹底的にテストされた最高品質のベンダー・プラットフォームとテクノロジーのマトリックスを、ご使用の環境または AWS、Azure、IBM Cloud に取り付けられるハードウェア・デバイスや仮想ソフトウェアでサポートします。例を挙げると、Checkpoint、Fortinet、Juniper、Palo Alto、Cisco があります。

1 日 24 時間/週 7 日/1 年 365 日作動している IBM Security Operations Center (SOC) のグローバル・ネットワークから提供されます。

ko.description: 차세대 방화벽, 침입 탐지 및 방지 시스템, 통합 위협 관리 스테이션 및 보안 웹 게이트웨이를 포함하여 클라우드 및 온프레미스의 보안 디바이스에 대한 관리, 모니터링 및 경보를 제공하는 Managed Network Security Services로 네트워크 보안 오퍼레이션 및 관리를 확장하십시오.

Managed Network Security Services는 다음을 제공합니다.

- 의사결정을 개선하기 위한 자세한 보고
- IBM® X-Force® 위협 분석 서비스(보안 인텔리전스)에 대한 액세스

Managed Network Security Services는 사용자 환경 또는 AWS, Azure 및 IBM Cloud(예: Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto 및 Cisco)에 설치된 하드웨어 디바이스 및 가상 소프트웨어로 철저히 테스트된 최고의 공급업체 플랫폼 및 기술의 매트릭스를 지원합니다.

연중무휴로 운영되는 글로벌 IBM 보안 관제 센터(SOC)의 네트워크에서 제공됩니다.

pt-br.description: Expanda as suas operações e o gerenciamento de segurança de rede com nossos Managed Network Security Services que fornecem gerenciamento, monitoramento e alertas de dispositivos de segurança na nuvem e no local, incluindo: firewalls de nova geração, sistemas de detecção e prevenção de intrusões, estações unificadas de gerenciamento de ameaças e segurança de gateways da web.

- Análise avançada de eventos por sistemas inteligentes e alertas para escalada e investigação
- Relatórios detalhados para a melhoria da tomada de decisão

Os Managed Network Security Services suportam uma matriz das melhores plataformas e tecnologias totalmente testadas, como dispositivos de hardware e softwares virtuais instalados em seu ambiente ou na AWS, no Azure e na IBM Cloud, incluindo: Checkpoint, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto e Cisco para citar alguns).

zh-cn.description: 利用我们的 Managed Network Security Services，扩展网络安全运营和管理，从而针对云和本地的安全设备提供管理、监控和警报，包括：下一代防火墙、入侵检测和预防系统、统一威胁管理站和安全 Web 网关。

en.description: MarvelX helps insurance teams process claims faster with Agentic AI.
en.long_description:
MarvelX Claims Assistant helps insurance teams handle claims faster and with greater accuracy. It combines document understanding, Q&A, and structured claim analysis in one tool.




Upload claim files such as PDFs, scans or emails, and the assistant automatically checks for coverage, red flags, inconsistencies and missing information. Through a simple chat, you can ask questions about claims or policies in plain language and get clear, evidence-backed answers.




Each claim is summarized into a scannable analysis with decisions, reasoning and checks performed. This makes it easier for claim handlers to review outcomes quickly, reduce errors, and improve the consistency of claim decisions.
