name: mdm-oc

de.description: Verbessern Sie das Vertrauen in KI-Pipelines, indem Sie doppelte Datensätze ermitteln und zuverlässige Daten zu Ihren Kunden, Lieferanten oder Partnern bereitstellen.
de.long_description: Verwenden Sie IBM Master Data Management, um schnell Datenpipelines für Analysen und andere Data Science-Anwendungsfälle unter Verwendung von Stammdaten zu erstellen.  Beginnen Sie mit Ihren Entitäten von IBM MDM Advanced oder Standard Edition oder mit beliebigen Datenassets, die Teilnehmerinformationen aus dem Wissenskatalog enthalten, und ordnen Sie Ihrem Datenmodell schnell neue Attribute zu und modellieren Sie diese, um eine vollständigere Sicht auf Ihre Kunden zu erhalten.  Die KI-gestützte abgleichende Engine beschleunigt die Konfiguration, indem sie dieselben statistischen Methoden verwendet, auf die sich Clients stützen, um genau übereinstimmende Ergebnisse zu erzielen.  Die Ergebnisse können über RESTful-APIs abgerufen, in unstrukturierte Dateien exportiert oder online über den Entity Explorer angezeigt werden.

en.description: Improve trust in AI pipelines by identifying duplicate records and providing reliable data about your customers, suppliers, or partners.
en.long_description: Use IBM Master Data Management to quickly build data pipelines for analytics and other data science use cases using master data.  Start with your IBM MDM Advanced or Standard Edition entities, or with any data assets containing party information from the knowledge catalog and quickly map and model new attributes to your data model for a more complete view of your customers. The AI-powered matching engine speeds configuration using the same statistical methods clients have relied on to produce accurate match results.  Results can be accessed via RESTful APIs, exported to flat files, or viewed online via the entity explorer.

es.description: Mejore la confianza en los conductos de IA mediante la identificación de registros duplicados y proporcionando datos fiables sobre sus clientes, proveedores o socios.
es.long_description: Utilice Master Data Management para crear rápidamente conductos de datos para análisis y otros casos de uso de ciencia de datos mediante datos maestros.  Empiece por las entidades de IBM MDM Advanced o Standard Edition, o bien por los activos de datos que contienen información de terceros procedente del catálogo de conocimientos y asigne y modele rápidamente nuevos atributos en el modelo de datos para obtener una visión más completa de los clientes.  El motor de comparación basado en IA acelera la configuración utilizando los mismos métodos estadísticos en los que los clientes han confiado para generar resultados de comparación precisos.  Se puede acceder a los resultados mediante API RESTful, exportarlos a archivos planos o visualizarlos en línea mediante el explorador de entidades.

fr.description: Améliorez la confiance dans les pipelines d'IA en identifiant les enregistrements en double et en fournissant des données fiables sur vos clients, fournisseurs ou partenaires.
fr.long_description: Utilisez Master Data Management pour créer rapidement des pipelines de données pour l'analyse et d'autres cas d'utilisation de la science des données à l'aide de données de référence.  Commencez avec vos entités IBM MDM Advanced ou Standard Edition ou avec des actifs de données contenant des informations sur les parties issues du catalogue de connaissances, puis mappez et modélisez rapidement de nouveaux attributs dans votre modèle de données pour obtenir une vue plus complète de vos clients.  Le moteur de correspondance optimisé par l'IA accélère la configuration en utilisant les mêmes méthodes statistiques que celles utilisées par les clients pour produire des résultats de correspondance précis.  Les résultats sont accessibles via des API RESTful, peuvent être exportés dans des fichiers à plat ou peuvent être consultés en ligne via l'explorateur d'entités.

it.description: Aumentare l'attendibilità delle pipeline di AI identificando i record duplicati e fornendo dati affidabili su clienti, fornitori o partner.
it.long_description: Utilizzare IBM Master Data Management per creare rapidamente pipeline di dati per l'analytics e altri casi d'uso di data science utilizzando i dati master.  Iniziare con le entità IBM MDM Advanced o Standard Edition, o con qualsiasi asset di dati contenente informazioni sulle parti dal knowledge catalog, e associare e modellare rapidamente i nuovi attributi sul proprio modello di dati per una visione più completa dei clienti.  Il motore di corrispondenza con tecnologia AI accelera la configurazione utilizzando gli stessi metodi statistici su cui i clienti hanno fatto affidamento per produrre risultati di corrispondenza accurati.  È possibile accedere ai risultati tramite le API RESTful, esportarli in file flat o visualizzarli online tramite l'explorer delle entità.

ja.description: 重複レコードを特定し、顧客、サプライヤー、パートナーに関する信頼性の高いデータを提供することで、AIパイプラインの信頼性を向上させます。
ja.long_description: IBM Master Data Managementを使用すると、マスター・データを活用してアナリティクスやその他のデータ・サイエンスのユース・ケースのためのデータ・パイプラインを迅速に構築できます。  IBM MDM AdvancedまたはStandard Editionのエンティティー、あるいはナレッジ・カタログの当事者情報を含むデータ資産から開始し、新しい属性をデータ・モデルに素早くマッピングおよびモデリングして、顧客の全体像を提供します。  AIを搭載したマッチング・エンジンは、クライアントが正確なマッチング結果を得るために信頼してきたものと同じ統計手法を使用して、構成を迅速化します  結果は、RESTful APIを介してアクセスしたり、フラット・ファイルにエクスポートしたり、エンティティー・エクスプローラーを介してオンラインで表示したりすることができます。

ko.description: 중복된 레코드를 식별하고 고객, 공급자 또는 파트너에 대한 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터를 제공하여 AI 파이프라인에 대한 신뢰를 높입니다.
ko.long_description: 마스터 데이터를 사용하여 분석 및 기타 데이터 사이언스 유스 케이스를 위한 데이터 파이프라인을 빠르게 빌드하려면 IBM Master Data Management을 사용하십시오.  IBM MDM Advanced 또는 Standard Edition 엔티티 또는 지식 카탈로그의 당사자 정보가 포함된 데이터 자산으로 시작하여 새로운 속성을 데이터 모델에 빠르게 맵핑하고 모델링하여 고객을 보다 완벽하게 파악할 수 있습니다.  AI 기반 일치 엔진은 클라이언트가 정확한 일치 결과를 생성하는 데 사용하는 것과 동일한 통계적 방법을 사용하여 구성 속도를 높입니다.  결과는 RESTful API를 통해 액세스하거나, 플랫 파일로 내보내거나, 엔티티 탐색기를 통해 온라인으로 볼 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: Aumente a confiança nos pipelines de IA identificando registros duplicados e fornecendo dados confiáveis sobre seus clientes, fornecedores ou parceiros.
pt-br.long_description: Use o IBM Master Data Management para construir rapidamente pipelines de dados para análise e outros casos de uso de ciência de dados utilizando dados mestre.  Comece com suas entidades do IBM MDM Advanced ou Standard Edition, ou com quaisquer ativos de dados que contenham informações de partes do catálogo de conhecimento e mapeie e modele rapidamente novos atributos para o seu modelo de dados para uma visualização mais completa dos seus clientes.  O mecanismo de correspondência impulsionado por IA acelera a configuração utilizando os mesmos métodos estatísticos nos quais os clientes confiam para produzir resultados de correspondência precisos.  Os resultados podem ser acessados por meio de APIs de RESTful, exportados para arquivos simples ou visualizados on-line por meio do explorador de entidades.

zh-cn.description: 通过识别重复记录并提供有关客户、供应商或合作伙伴的可靠数据，提高 AI 管道的可信度。
zh-cn.long_description: 借助 IBM Match 360 with Watson，利用主数据快速构建用于分析和其他数据科学用例的数据管道。  从 IBM MDM Advanced 或 Standard Edition 实体开始，或从包含知识目录中参与方信息的任何数据资产开始，快速将新属性映射和建模到数据模型，以获得更全面的客户视图。  AI 驱动的匹配引擎采用与客户生成准确匹配结果所依靠的相同统计方法来加快配置。  可通过 RESTful API 访问结果，可将结果导出为平面文件，也可以通过实体资源管理器在线查看结果。

zh-tw.description: 透過識別重複記錄，並提供有關您的客戶、供應商或夥伴的可靠資料，以提升 AI 管道的信任度。
zh-tw.long_description: 使用 IBM Match 360 with Watson 快速建立資料管道，以便使用主資料進行分析和其他資料科學使用案例。  從您的 IBM MDM Advanced 或 Standard Edition 實體開始，或從知識型錄中包含各方資訊的任何資料資產開始，快速將新屬性對映和建模至您的資料模型，以獲得更完整的客戶視圖。  採用 AI 技術的比對引擎使用客戶信賴的統計方法，加速配置並產出精確的比對結果。  結果可透過 RESTful API 存取、匯出至平面檔案，或透過實體瀏覽器線上檢視。

en.description:
This plan provides you with the core capabilities of IBM Master Data Management, a multi-domain operational and analytical master data management (MDM) service that delivers at scale an integrated and consolidated view of critical enterprise data across data silos, leveraging intelligent and tunable data matching and entity resolution as well as management of other related entities across the enterprise.

*** Advanced governance and quality capabilities, including support for Al assisted profiling and mapping, data quality assessment of inputs and resolved entities, as well as enforcing enterprise data quality and privacy policies for master data is provided by an additional subscription of IBM watsonx.data intelligence Standard plan.

bullets.description: Im Rahmen dieses Testplans können Kunden IBM Match 360 with Watson mit einer einzelnen Serviceinstanz und bis zu 1 Million Datensätze testen.
IBM Master Data Management as a Service Trial
5000 Qualified API Calls
50 Capacity Unit hours
7000 Entities
Se trata de un plan de pruebas que permite a los clientes probar IBM Match 360 with Watson con un máximo de 1M de recuentos de registros con una instancia de servicio.
Il s'agit d'un programme d'essai permettant aux clients d'évaluer IBM Match 360 with Watson avec jusqu'à 1 million d'enregistrements avec une seule instance de service.
Questo è un piano di prova per consentire ai clienti di provare IBM Match 360 con Watson con un massimo di 1M di conteggi record con un'istanza di servizio.
これは、クライアントが 1 つのサービス・インスタンスで最大 100 万件のレコードに対し IBM Match 360 with Watson を試行できるトライアル・プランです。
이는 클라이언트가 하나의 서비스 인스턴스에서 최대 1M의 레코드 수로 IBM Match 360 with Watson을 사용할 수 있는 평가판 플랜입니다.
Trata-se de um plano de avaliação para permitir que os clientes experimentem o IBM Match 360 with Watson com até 1 milhão de contagens de registro com uma instância de serviço.
此试验计划旨在让客户尝试使用 IBM Match 360 with Watson，通过一个服务实例处理多达 100 万条记录。
此試行計劃可讓用戶端透過 IBM Match 360 with Watson 使用一個服務實例來處理多達 100 萬筆記錄。

description: Improve trust in AI pipelines by identifying duplicate records and providing reliable data about your customers, suppliers, or partners.
longDescription: Use IBM Master Data Management to quickly build data pipelines for analytics and other data science use cases using master data.  Start with your IBM MDM Advanced or Standard Edition entities, or with any data assets containing party information from the knowledge catalog and quickly map and model new attributes to your data model for a more complete view of your customers. The AI-powered matching engine speeds configuration using the same statistical methods clients have relied on to produce accurate match results.  Results can be accessed via RESTful APIs, exported to flat files, or viewed online via the entity explorer.

name: viclinic-inc-medical-coding-agent

en.description: AI agent analyzing clinical data to automate coding, improve accuracy, and optimize revenue cycle workflows and claim outcomes.
en.long_description:
The Medical Coding & RCM Agent is an AI-powered solution that automates and enhances clinical coding and revenue cycle workflows by transforming structured and unstructured clinical data into accurate, compliant, and billable outputs.
Healthcare organizations often face revenue loss due to incomplete documentation, coding errors, and delayed claim submissions. This agent addresses these challenges by analyzing clinical notes, diagnoses, procedures, and supporting data to generate coding suggestions aligned with ICD and CPT standards.
Integrated directly into clinical workflows, the agent ensures that coding begins early in the care process and continues through discharge. It identifies missing documentation elements, suggests improvements, and supports clean claim submission by aligning clinical data with payer requirements.
The agent also enables proactive denial prevention by flagging inconsistencies, incomplete records, or potential compliance risks before claims are submitted. This improves claim acceptance rates, reduces rework, and accelerates reimbursement cycles.
By combining clinical intelligence with workflow orchestration, the Medical Coding & RCM Agent reduces administrative burden, improves coding accuracy, and delivers measurable financial impact across the revenue cycle.

fr.description:

name: mylua-health-inc-mylua-care-recommendation-agent

en.description: Analyzes maternal client data and surfaces personalized, evidence-based care recommendations for birthing parents.
en.long_description: Employers, health plans, and care teams struggle to identify which maternal members need support before risks become crises. The MyLÚA Care Recommendation Agent analyzes client documentation including health assessments, intake forms, case notes, lab reports, discharge summaries, and clinical records, then returns structured, evidence-based care recommendations for each member. For every client submitted, the agent surfaces a prioritized needs summary, urgency-classified outreach actions, a step-by-step care pathway sequence, referral and escalation routing, and validated community resources sourced in real time. It supports both individual-level care planning and population-level trend analysis, helping care coordinators act earlier and organizations demonstrate measurable impact across their maternal health programs. Integrating organizations are responsible for implementing appropriate data safeguards before submitting client information to the agent.

bullets.title: Skalierung

bullets.description: Risikofreie, reibungslose Netezza-Upgrades auf die Cloud mit einer nahtlosen Lift-and-shift-Aktion und eine überzeugende, linear skalierbare Leistung mit einem kalkulierbaren Kostenprofil mit nur einem Befehl: nz_migrate oder nzbackup.
bullets.title: Migration

bullets.description: Halten Sie das System über die Konsole, die CLI oder über die APIs an oder setzen Sie es fort.  Die Funktion zum automatischen Anhalten/Fortsetzen ist standardmäßig aktiviert und kann den spezifischen Geschäfts- und Workloadanforderungen eines Unternehmens entsprechend geplant werden.
bullets.title: Anhalten & Fortsetzen

bullets.description: Incrementally scale compute independent of storage, as needed. Select the performance characteristics that best meet your workload requirement for the data capacity and pay for only what you need.
bullets.title: Ultimate control with granular elastic scaling

bullets.description: Manage consumption with automated or scheduled pause and resume. Spin up the Netezza data warehouse only when needed (or on your schedule) to consume only when and what’s required.
bullets.title: No awkward pauses

bullets.description: Achieve faster insight and faster time to value with vastly superior price-performance. Take advantage of an hourly credit consumption model, with no overcharges or over-provisioned t-shirt sizes. Netezza scales with you to match your business needs.
bullets.title: Predictable price and performance

bullets.description: Load and go — it’s that simple. Netezza requires no indexing or tuning; just decide how fast you want to go and how much data you need while accessing data from any cloud and any object store. Experience risk-free frictionless upgrades with a single Netezza command.
bullets.title: Simplicity

bullets.description: Execute machine learning models at scale for predictive and prescriptive analysis. Accelerate your data science initiatives with Netezza’s in-database analytics and mature support for in-place machine learning model execution.
bullets.title: Sophistication

bullets.description: Escale fácilmente utilizando la consola o la API de una manera aleatoria o planificada.  Elija entre 4 perfiles de contorno de carga de trabajo y permita el escalado independiente de cálculo (rendimiento) y almacenamiento sin interrupciones.
bullets.title: Escalado

bullets.description: Actualizaciones de Netezza a la nube sin riesgos ni problemas con un sencillo movimiento, y un rendimiento de gran velocidad linealmente escalable con un perfil de coste predecible con un solo mandato: nz_migrate o nzbackup.
bullets.title: Migración

bullets.description: Detenga o reanude el sistema desde la consola, la CLI o mediante las API.  La pausa/reanudación automática es el valor predeterminado y puede planificarse para adaptarse a los requisitos específicos de la empresa y de la carga de trabajo.
bullets.title: Pausa y Reanudación

bullets.description: Mise à l'échelle facile à l'aide de la console ou de l'API d'une manière ad hoc ou planifiée.  Choisissez parmi 4 profils de contour de charge de travail et autorisez la mise à l'échelle indépendante du traitement (performances) et du stockage sans interruption.
bullets.title: Mise à l'échelle

bullets.description: Des mises à niveau Netezza vers le Cloud sans risque et sans frictions avec un simple réherbergement, et des performances évolutives linéaires remarquables avec un profil de coût prévisible et une commande unique : nz_migrate ou nzbackup.
bullets.title: Migration

bullets.description: Mettez en pause ou reprenez le système à partir de la console, de l'interface de ligne de commande ou des API.  La mise en pause/reprise automatique est active par défaut et peut être planifiée en fonction des besoins métier et des charges de travail spécifiques.
bullets.title: Mettre en pause et reprendre

bullets.description: Eseguire facilmente il ridimensionamento utilizzando la console o l'API in un modo ad-hoc o pianificato.  Scegliere tra 4 profili di distribuzione dei carichi di lavoro e consentire un ridimensionamento indipendente di calcolo (prestazioni) e storage senza alcuna interruzione.
bullets.title: Ridimensionamento

bullets.description: Upgrade di Netezza al cloud senza rischi e problemi con una semplice modalità lift-and-shift e velocissime prestazioni scalabili linearmente con un profilo di costo prevedibile con un singolo comando: nz_migrate o nzbackup.
bullets.title: Migrazione

bullets.description: Sospendere o riprendere il sistema dalla console, dalla CLI o tramite le API.  La sospensione/ripresa automatica viene eseguita per impostazione predefinita e può essere pianificata per rispondere a specifici requisiti di business e di carico di lavoro.
bullets.title: Sospendi e riprendi

bullets.description: コンソールまたは API を使用して、随時またはスケジュールされた方法で簡単に拡張できます。  4 つのワークロード概略プロファイルから選択でき、中断ゼロのコンピュート (パフォーマンス) とストレージの独立したスケーリングが可能です。
bullets.title: スケーリング

bullets.description: 単一のコマンド (nz_migrate または nzbackup) で予測可能なコスト・プロファイルを使用して、シンプルなリフト & シフトによりクラウドへのリスクのない円滑な Netezza のアップグレードと、非常に直線的に拡張可能なパフォーマンスを実現します。
bullets.title: マイグレーション

bullets.description: コンソール、CLI、または API を使用して、システムを一時停止または再開します。  自動一時停止/再開はデフォルトで、特定のビジネス要件およびワークロード要件に合わせてスケジュールすることができます。
bullets.title: 一時停止 & 再開

bullets.description: 콘솔 또는 API를 사용하여, 임시 또는 스케줄된 방식으로 쉽게 확장할 수 있습니다.  4개의 워크로드 개요 프로파일 중에서 선택하여 컴퓨팅(성능) 및 스토리지의 원활한 스케일링을 가능하게 하십시오.
bullets.title: 스케일링

bullets.description: 간단한 리프트 앤 시프트를 통한, 원활하며 리스크 없는 Netezza의 클라우드 업그레이드, 그리고 단일 명령(nz_migrate 또는 nzbackup)을 사용한, 예측 가능한 비용 프로파일을 갖춘 뛰어난 선형 스케일링 가능 성능
bullets.title: 마이그레이션

bullets.description: 콘솔, CLI 또는 API를 통해 시스템을 일시정지하거나 재개하십시오.  자동 일시정지/재개가 기본적으로 적용되며, 특정 비즈니스 및 워크로드 요구사항에 맞게 이를 스케줄할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 일시정지 및 재개

bullets.description: Escale facilmente usando o Console ou API em modo ad-hoc ou programado.  Escolha entre 4 perfis de delineamento de carga de trabalho e permita o ajuste de escala independente de cálculo (desempenho) e armazenamento sem interrupção.
bullets.title: Ajuste de escala

bullets.description: Upgrades Netezza sem risco e sem atrito para a Nuvem com uma elevação & desloacamento simples, desempenho linearmente escalável e perfil de custo previsível com um único comando: nz_migrate ou nzbackup.
bullets.title: Migração

bullets.description: Pausar ou continuar o sistema a partir do Console, CLI ou por meio de APIs.  A pausa/retomada automática é por padrão, planejada para adequar os requisitos específicos de negócios e de carga de trabalho.
bullets.title: Pausar & continuar

bullets.description: 以临时或安排的方式使用控制台或 API 轻松进行扩展。  从 4 个工作负载轮廓概要文件中进行选择，并允许对计算（性能）和存储进行独立扩展（零分解）。
bullets.title: 缩放

bullets.description: 零风险、零摩擦的 Netezza 通过简单的提升和转移升级到云端，并通过单个命令 nz_migrate 或 nzbackup，以可预测的成本概要文件实现线性可扩展的性能。
bullets.title: 迁移

bullets.description: 从控制台、CLI 或通过 API 暂停或继续系统。  缺省情况下是自动暂停/恢复，并且可以对其进行调度以满足特定业务和工作负载需求。
bullets.title: 暂停并恢复

bullets.description: 以特定或排程方式，使用主控台或 API 輕鬆地擴充。  從 4 種工作負載輪廓設定檔進行選擇，並容許獨立擴充運算 (效能) 及不中斷的儲存空間。
bullets.title: 調整

bullets.description: 透過簡單的提升與移轉，Netezza 能無風險且平順地升級至雲端，並透過單一指令 nz_migrate 或 nzbackup，以可預測的成本設定檔來提升線性可調式效能。
bullets.title: 移轉

bullets.description: 從主控台、CLI 或透過 API 暫停或回復系統。  依預設會執行自動的暫停/回復，且可以進行排定以符合特定的商業及工作負載需求。
bullets.title: 暫停與回復

name: data-warehouse

de.description: Ein leistungsfähiger, vollständig verwalteter und nutzungsabhängiger Cloud-Data-Warehouse-Service für Datenvolumen im Petabyte-Bereich, der die Netezza-Datenbankengine der nächsten Generation ausführt, die über Cloud Pak for Data bereitgestellt wird
de.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server ist ein vollständig verwaltetes, elastisches cloudnatives Data-Warehouse. Mit erweiterten datenbankinternen Analysefunktionen ermöglicht es Ihnen, datenwissenschaftliche Untersuchungen und maschinelles Lernen mit große Datenvolumen im Petabyte-Bereich durchzuführen.

en.description: A high performance petabyte scale fully managed pay-as-you-go cloud data warehouse service running the next generation Netezza database engine delivered through Cloud Pak for Data
en.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server is a fully managed, a true elastic cloud native data warehouse. With advanced in-database analytics capabilities, it enables you to do data science and machine learning with data volumes scaling into the petabytes.

es.description: Un servicio de depósito de datos en la nube de pago por uso totalmente gestionado a escala de petabyte de alto rendimiento que ejecuta el motor de base de datos Netezza de nueva generación entregado mediante Cloud Pak for Data
es.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server es un verdadero almacén de datos nativo en la nube elástico totalmente gestionado. Gracias a las funciones avanzadas de análisis en base de datos, puede hacer ciencia de datos y aprendizaje automático con el escalado de volúmenes de datos en petabytes.

fr.description: Un service d'entrepôt de données en nuage de données haute performance à l'échelle du pétaoctet, entièrement géré, avec paiement à la carte, exécutant le moteur de base de données Netezza de nouvelle génération livré avec Cloud Pak for Data
fr.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server est un véritable entrepôt de données natif élastique en  nuage, entièrement géré. Grâce à ses capacités d'analyse de base de données avancées, il vous permet de faire de la science des données et de l'apprentissage automatique avec une échelle de grandeur des volumes de données dans les pétaoctets.

it.description: Un servizio di data warehouse cloud con pagamento a consumo completamente gestito e nell'ordine dei petabyte che viene eseguito sul motore di database Netezza di prossima generazione fornito tramite Cloud Pak for Data
it.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server è un vero data warehouse nativo del cloud completamente gestito ed elastico. Grazie alle funzionalità di analytics in-database avanzate, consente di impiegare la data science e il machine learning con volumi di dati nell'ordine dei petabyte.

ja.description: Cloud Pak for Data を介して提供される次世代の Netezza データベース・エンジンを実行する、高性能なペタバイト・スケールの完全に管理された従量制課金のクラウド・データウェアハウス・サービス
ja.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server は、完全に管理された、真の弾力性のあるクラウドネイティブ・データウェアハウスです。 高度なインデータベース分析機能を使用することにより、データ・ボリュームをペタバイト単位に拡大してデータサイエンスと機械学習を行うことができます。

ko.description: Cloud Pak for Data를 통해 제공되는 차세대 Netezza 데이터베이스 엔진을 실행하는, 고성능 페타바이트 스케일의 완전 관리 종량과금제 클라우드 데이터 웨어하우스 서비스
ko.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server는 완전히 관리되는, 진정한 탄력적 클라우드 네이티브 데이터 웨어하우스입니다. 이는 고급 데이터베이스 내부 분석 기능을 통해, 페타바이트로 스케일링되는 데이터 볼륨을 사용하여 데이터 사이언스 및 머신 러닝 작업을 수행할 수 있게 해 줍니다.

pt-br.description: Um serviço de data warehouse em nuvem pré-pago de alto desempenho em escala de petabyte totalmente gerenciado, executando o mecanismo de banco de dados Netezza da próxima geração fornecido por meio do Cloud Pak for Data
pt-br.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server é um verdadeiro data warehouse nativo de nuvem elástico. Com recursos avançados de análise dentro do banco de dados, ele permite realizar ciência de dados e aprendizado de máquina com ajustes de escala de volumes de dados para os petabytes.

zh-cn.description: 高性能 PB 级完全管理的按使用量付费的云数据仓库服务，它运行通过 Cloud Pak for Data 提供的下一代 Netezza 数据库引擎
zh-cn.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server 是一个完全管理的，真正具有弹性的云原生数据仓库。 通过高级的数据库内分析功能，您可以使用将数据量以 PB 计的数据科学和机器学习。

zh-tw.description: 高效能 PB 規模且完全受管理的隨收隨付制雲端資料倉儲服務，執行透過 Cloud Pak for Data 提供的新一代 Netezza 資料庫引擎
zh-tw.long_description: IBM Netezza Performance Server 是完全受管理、真正彈性的雲端原生資料倉儲。 透過進階的資料庫內分析功能，它使您能夠將數據磁區擴展到 PB 級來進行數據科學和機器學習。

bullets.description: Nahtlose Migration mit der Möglichkeit, die Rechenleistung unabhängig zu skalieren und die Option zur Self-Service-Sicherung und -Wiederherstellung sowie zum Anhalten und Fortsetzen der Instanz nach Bedarf zu nutzen.
Seamless migration with the capability to scale compute independently, self-service backup and restore, and pause & resume instance as workload requires.

Migración sin interrupciones con capacidad de escalar el cálculo de forma independiente, copia de seguridad y restauración de autoservicio y pausa y reanudación de la instancia según requiera la carga de trabajo.

Migration transparente avec les fonctions de mise à l'échelle indépendante du traitement, de sauvegarde et de restauration en libre-service, et de mise en pause et de reprise des instances en fonction de la charge de travail.

Migrazione senza soluzione di continuità con capacità di eseguire il ridimensionamento del calcolo in modo indipendente, backup e ripristino self-service e sospensione e ripresa dell'istanza in base ai requisiti del carico di lavoro.
コンピュートの単独スケーリング、セルフサービスのバックアップとリストア、ワークロードの必要に応じたインスタンスの一時停止および再開の機能を備えた、シームレスなマイグレーションです。
컴퓨팅의 독립적 스케일링, 셀프 서비스 백업 및 복원, 워크로드의 요구에 따라 인스턴스를 일시정지하고 재개하는 기능을 갖춘 원활한 마이그레이션.
Migração perfeita, com capacidade de escalar a computação de modo independente, realizar backup e restauração de autoatendimento, pausar & retomar instância, conforme requer a carga de trabalho.
无缝迁移，能够根据工作负载需要独立扩展计算、自助服务备份和复原以及暂停和恢复实例。
無縫移轉，且能夠獨立擴充運算、自助式備份及還原，以及根據工作負載需要而暫停及回復實例。

support.process: Netomi provides full technical support for the Netomi Virtual Agent for IBM Orchestrate, including onboarding, configuration, and runtime troubleshooting for responses delivered via Orchestrate APIs. en.description: Netomi AI Agent
en.long_description: Netomi is the world’s leading enterprise agentic AI platform for customer experience, trusted in production by Fortune 500 companies across travel, hospitality, retail, insurance, banking, telecom, and media. Its field-proven platform delivers autonomous, goal-driven interactions that go beyond reactive support, anticipating customer needs, acting preemptively, and driving measurable outcomes across every channel and touchpoint. Unlike siloed AI tools, Netomi is architected as a composable and sanctioned agentic system, deeply integrated with enterprise workflows, and pre-built with embedded AI governance, compliance, and security at its core. Through its Agentic Factory and the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC), enterprises can rapidly design, govern, and scale specialized AI agents with consistency and resilience at Fortune 500 scale. With the fastest deployment times and consistently proven ROI, Netomi turns customer experience into a strategic advantage for the world’s largest organizations.  For more information, visit www.netomi.com

en.description: Network ACL ID

bullets.description: By default, all traffic is allowed to enter or exit your network. To provide security and improve network performance, you can create rules to determine how to handle your inbound and outbound network traffic. This provides control over the traffic and makes it less vulnerable to unwanted traffic entering your network.
bullets.title: Rules

bullets.description: Rules with lower numbers are evaluated first and override rules with higher numbers. As a best practice, give fine-grained rules a higher priority than coarse-grained rules. For example, suppose you have a rule that blocks all traffic from the subnet 10.10.30.0/24. If it is assigned a higher priority, any fine-grained rules with lower priority that allow traffic from 10.10.30.5 are never applied.
bullets.title: Rule priority

bullets.description: Each subnet can be attached to only one ACL. However, each ACL can be attached to multiple subnets.
bullets.title: Subnets

bullets.description: An ACL is a built-in, virtual firewall, similar to a security group. In contrast to security groups, ACL rules control traffic to and from the subnets, rather than to and from the instances.
bullets.title: Comparison to security groups

en.description: Analyzes nominations for quality and impact. Automates review process to reduce bias, save time, and spotlight standout stories.
en.long_description: Nomination Agent is an AI-powered tool that transforms how organizations manage employee recognition through nomination-based programs. Whether it’s for a President’s Award, Innovator of the Year, or any high-impact honor, Nomination Agent helps surface the most meaningful submissions by analyzing nominations for quality, alignment to company values, and overall impact. Using advanced language models and ideal criteria benchmarks, it delivers automated recommendations that reduce manual review time, minimize bias, and improve decision-making. The result is a faster, fairer, and more inspiring recognition process that saves time, lowers costs, and ensures every standout story gets the attention it deserves.

de.description: Vereinfachen Sie Ihr Risikomanagement und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften mit einer einheitlichen GRC-Plattform, die durch KI und all Ihre Daten unterstützt wird.
de.long_description: Führen Sie eine KI-gesteuerte, hoch skalierbare Governance-, Risiko- und Compliance-Lösung (GRC) in einer beliebigen Cloud aus. Zentralisieren Sie isolierte Risikomanagementfunktionen in einer einzigen Umgebung, die Ihnen hilft, Risiken und die Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu erkennen, zu verwalten, zu überwachen und darüber Bericht zu erstatten, insbesondere in der sich wandelnden Unternehmenslandschaft von heute.

en.description: Simplify how you manage risk and regulatory compliance with a unified GRC platform fueled by AI and all your data.
en.long_description: Run an AI-driven, highly scalable, governance, risk and compliance (GRC) solution on any cloud. Centralize siloed risk management functions within a single environment designed to help you identify, manage, monitor and report on risk and regulatory compliance, especially in today’s changing business landscape.

es.description: Simplifique la gestión de riesgos y el cumplimiento normativo con una plataforma GRC unificada impulsada por IA y todos sus datos.
es.long_description: Ejecute una solución de gobierno, riesgo y cumplimiento (GRC) basada en IA y altamente escalable en cualquier nube. Centralice las funciones de gestión de riesgos aisladas en un único entorno diseñado para ayudarle a identificar, gestionar, supervisar y elaborar informes sobre riesgos y cumplimiento normativo, especialmente en el cambiante panorama empresarial actual.

fr.description: Simplifiez la façon dont vous gérez les risques et la conformité réglementaire avec une plateforme GRC unifiée alimentée par l'IA et toutes vos données.
fr.long_description: Exécutez une solution de gouvernance, de risque et de conformité (GRC) pilotée par l'IA et hautement évolutive sur n'importe quel cloud. Centraliser les fonctions cloisonnées de gestion des risques au sein d'un environnement unique conçu pour vous aider à identifier, gérer, surveiller et rendre compte des risques et de la conformité réglementaire, en particulier dans le contexte actuel d'évolution des entreprises.

it.description: Semplificate la gestione del rischio e della conformità normativa con una piattaforma GRC unificata alimentata dall'intelligenza artificiale e da tutti i vostri dati.
it.long_description: Eseguite una soluzione di governance, rischio e conformità (GRC) altamente scalabile e guidata dall'intelligenza artificiale su qualsiasi cloud. Centralizzate le funzioni di gestione del rischio all'interno di un unico ambiente progettato per aiutarvi a individuare, gestire, monitorare e rendicontare i rischi e la conformità alle normative, soprattutto nell'attuale panorama aziendale in continua evoluzione.

ja.description: AIとすべてのデータを活用した統合GRCプラットフォームで、リスクと法規制コンプライアンスの管理を簡素化します。
ja.long_description: AIを活用した拡張性の高いガバナンス・リスク・コンプライアンス（GRC）ソリューションを、あらゆるクラウド上で実現します。 サイロ化されたリスク管理機能を単一の環境に集約し、特に今日の変化するビジネス環境において、リスクと法規制コンプライアンスの特定、管理、監視、報告を支援します。

ko.description: AI와 모든 데이터를 기반으로 하는 통합 GRC 플랫폼으로 위험 및 규정 준수 관리 방법을 간소화하세요.
ko.long_description: 모든 클라우드에서 확장성이 뛰어난 AI 기반의 거버넌스, 리스크 및 규정 준수(GRC) 솔루션을 실행하세요. 특히 오늘날과 같이 변화하는 비즈니스 환경에서 위험 및 규정 준수를 식별, 관리, 모니터링, 보고할 수 있도록 설계된 단일 환경 내에서 사일로화된 위험 관리 기능을 중앙 집중화합니다.

pt-br.description: Simplifique a forma como você gerencia o risco e a conformidade regulamentar com uma plataforma GRC unificada alimentada por IA e todos os seus dados.
pt-br.long_description: Execute uma solução de governança, risco e conformidade (GRC) orientada por IA, altamente escalável, em qualquer nuvem. Centralize as funções de gerenciamento de riscos em silos em um único ambiente projetado para ajudá-lo a identificar, gerenciar, monitorar e gerar relatórios sobre riscos e conformidade regulamentar, especialmente no atual cenário de negócios em constante mudança.

zh-cn.description: 利用由人工智能和所有数据驱动的统一 GRC 平台，简化您管理风险和合规性的方式。
zh-cn.long_description: 在任何云上运行人工智能驱动、高度可扩展的治理、风险与合规性（GRC）解决方案。 在单一环境中集中孤立的风险管理功能，旨在帮助您识别、管理、监控和报告风险及监管合规情况，尤其是在当今不断变化的业务环境中。

zh-tw.description: 利用由人工智慧和所有數據驅動的統一 GRC 平台，簡化您管理風險和監管合規性的方式。
zh-tw.long_description: 在任何雲端上運行人工智慧驅動、高度可擴展的治理、風險和合規 (GRC) 解決方案。 將孤立的風險管理功能集中在一個環境中，旨在幫助您識別、管理、監控和報告風險和法規遵從性，特別是在當今不斷變化的業務環境中。

Questo servizio utilizzerà un approccio per la configurazione della best practice e si allineerà ai requisiti del client. Questo servizio fornisce la configurazione logica di SAP HANA on IBM Power per un ambiente HA/DR di produzione.

ja.description: IBM は、共同で開発したプランとターゲットを絞ったユース・ケースに基づいて、IBM Power への SAP HANA のデプロイを支援します。 このサービスは、ベスト・プラクティス構成のアプローチを利用し、お客様の要件に合わせて調整します。 このサービスは、実動 HA/DR 環境用に IBM Power 上の SAP HANA の論理構成を提供します。

ko.description: IBM은 공동으로 개발된 계획 및 대상 유스 케이스를 기반으로 IBM Power에 SAP HANA를 배치하도록 지원합니다. 이 서비스는 우수 사례 구성을 위한 접근 방식을 활용하고 클라이언트의 요구사항에 맞게 조정합니다. 이 서비스는 프로덕션 HA/DR 환경을 위해 IBM Power 기반 SAP HANA의 논리 구성을 제공합니다.

bullets.description: Instantly provision an enterprise planning solution with zero-downtime upgrades and industry-standard SLAs that can scale with your business as you increase data volume, number of users, or planning models without impacting performance. IBM Planning Analytics with Watson allows users to build and change plans based on business processes, illustrating a flexible and intuitive user experience that is built for you with real-world context in mind
bullets.title: Fast performance, scalability and flexibility

bullets.description: Uncover deep insights through robust dashboards. Create scorecards and metrics, including ad-hoc reports and compelling visualizations, to share financial metrics effectively and compare actual results to performance targets for improved financial reporting.  Identify trends and drill down into data with built-in reporting and analysis capabilities
bullets.title: Data visualization

bullets.description: Fueled by AI, with IBM Planning Analytics you can forecast outcomes based on evolving trends or predictive insights and perform in-depth, what-if scenario analysis to test alternative assumptions. Create personal sandboxes to compare different scenarios. See the impact of your decisions before making them
bullets.title: What-if scenario testing

bullets.description: Improve operational performance. Make better, more optimal business decisions with direct integration of decision optimization. Amid ever-changing business challenges, Planning Analytics helps you make better decisions that consider how to optimally deploy your resources. Optimize scenarios with complex variables and constraints to create the decision model that can be parameterized and reused over time
bullets.title: Constraint-based planning

bullets.description: Improve the accuracy and speed of your forecasts. With built-in predictive capabilities,  you canidentify and assess trends and seasonality patterns in historic values and have the power of algorithmic forecasting in your hands—even without data science skills—for more accurate, consistent, and timely forecasts
bullets.title: Predictive forecasting

bullets.description: Easily manage and govern workflows to ensure a smooth and streamlined planning process. Create customized applications to manage, facilitate, and increase participation and collaboration in your company’s budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
bullets.title: Workflow automation

bullets.description: Gain visibility into your data. All users have access to the same data, and trust in a single source of truth. The IBM Planning Analytics with Watson OLAP in-memory database, the Planning Analytics Engine, connects directly to source data and refreshes in real-time.
bullets.title: Real-time data access and in-memory database

name: viclinic-inc-post-surgery-recovery-support-agent

en.description: AI agent supporting post-surgery recovery with follow-up, patient guidance, and early risk detection to improve outcomes.
en.long_description:
The Post-Surgery Recovery Support Agent is an AI-powered solution designed to support patients and care teams after discharge, ensuring safe recovery and continuous follow-up care.
After surgery, many complications and readmissions happen due to gaps in monitoring, unclear instructions, or delayed intervention. This agent addresses those challenges by guiding patients through their recovery, tracking symptoms, and detecting early signs of risk.
Using a conversational interface, the agent checks in with patients, collects recovery data (pain, symptoms, medication adherence, wound status), and provides personalized guidance based on clinical protocols. It continuously monitors patient responses and flags potential complications for timely clinician review.
The agent orchestrates post-discharge workflows by connecting patient follow-up, care coordination, and clinical oversight into a single process. It helps ensure that no critical signals are missed and that patients stay on track with their recovery plan.
For healthcare providers, the agent reduces manual follow-up workload, improves care continuity, and supports early intervention. For patients, it delivers clear guidance, reassurance, and an easy way to stay connected with their care team.
By improving recovery monitoring, enhancing patient engagement, and enabling early risk detection, the Post-Surgery Recovery Support Agent helps reduce complications, lower readmission rates, and improve overall clinical outcomes.

Whether you're moving to a new IBM i server or transitioning to the PowerVS cloud, our professional services team takes care of the entire migration process from start to finish.

- Expert-Led Migration: Let our team of seasoned professionals handle the complexities of your IBM i system migration. With years of experience, we ensure a seamless and efficient transition.

en.description: Ease your live Power i migration with BUS4i "Migrate While Active" Services. Focus on your core tasks while we handle the rest.
en.display_name: Power i Migrate While Active Services
en.long_description:
BUS4i "Migrate While Active" Professional Services can ensure a smooth and efficient migration of your Power i system to a PowerVM in PowerVS or any other Power i system anywhere in the world without disruption to your daily operations.

Imagine this: you need to move your entire business infrastructure from your current Power i system to a PowerVM environment in PowerVS. This process can be daunting, especially if you're concerned about downtime and its impact on your business.  Here's where BUS4i "Migrate While Active" Professional Services comes in. We specialize in performing these migrations seamlessly,  with zero downtime during your regular office hours. This means:

- No interruption to your workday: Your employees can continue using your critical business applications throughout the migration process. There won't be any unexpected system shutdowns or periods of inaccessibility.
- Minimal impact on productivity: By eliminating downtime, we ensure your team can maintain their productivity levels throughout the entire migration. No need to worry about lost work hours due to system outages.
- Reduced risk and stress: Our experienced team will handle the entire migration process, minimizing the risk of errors and ensuring a smooth transition. You can focus on your core business activities with complete peace of mind.

So, how exactly do we achieve this? BUS4i "Migrate While Active" Professional Services utilizes a proven methodology that combines advanced tools and expertise to migrate your Power i system to PowerVM in a non-disruptive manner. Here's a simplified breakdown of the process:

1. Planning and Assessment: We'll work closely with you to understand your specific requirements and develop a customized migration plan. This plan will account for your system configuration, applications, and workload to ensure a seamless transition.
2. Data and Application Migration: Using specialized tools and techniques, we'll migrate your data and applications from your Power i system to the new PowerVM environment. This process is designed to minimize disruption and ensure data integrity.
3. Testing and Validation: Once the migration is complete, we'll perform rigorous testing of the synchronicity in the new environment. This ensures a smooth transition for your end-users.
4. Cutover and Go-Live: With everything in place and thoroughly tested, we'll perform a final cutover to switch your operations to the new PowerVM environment. This process will be conducted during a pre-defined maintenance window to minimize any potential impact.

Throughout the entire migration process, our team of experts will be available to answer your questions and address any concerns you may have. We understand the importance of clear communication, and we'll keep you informed every step of the way.

By choosing BUS4i "Migrate While Active" Professional Services, you can ensure a stress-free and efficient migration of your Power i system to PowerVM in PowerVS, without any disruption to your business operations.  Focus on what you do best, while we handle the technical complexities of the migration.

plans.name: iseries-managed-services-gold

en.description: Monitoring Tool included for LPAR. Per LPAR use of automated monitoring service. Includes: • Real-time monitoring of message queues, problem log, disk and CPU usage, • Backup readiness and completion status. • E-mail alerting of selected issues Standard Plus additional services as follows: Creation of profiles (system application) - Ricoh will create user profiles based upon existing templates and communicate these profiles to the new users. - These requests must be based upon authorization lists provided by the customer. Creation of line/controller/ device - Ricoh will create new iSeries communication object configuration as needed by the customer. OUTQ creation and maintenance - Ricoh will create new print queues as required by the customer. TCPIP monitoring and maintenance - TCP/IP status of communication devices and configurations will be monitored, and Ricoh will determine and take appropriate action. - Purchase of monitoring application or availability of customer-provided application required. Monitor WRKSYSACT screen & terminate runaway jobs - Ricoh will monitor the WRKSYSACT screen for customers who have this utility, which is part of the IBM performance tools license program. - Ricoh will terminate ‘runaway’ jobs that are using excessive CPU or DASD to ensure system integrity. Monitor system service tools - Per-shift check of system service tools to check for hardware and licensed code errors. - Hardware errors will be escalated to IBM or any other service provider designated by the customer Maintain basic and core system security - Logs will be checked to ensure that system security is not breached. - Ricoh will also, upon customer request, advise as to changes in system values that can help maintain system security. Month-end scheduling and performance - Ricoh will monitor scheduled month-end processing to ensure system integrity and performance is maintained. Issues will be communicated to the customer per its escalation procedures. Ad-hoc requests for batch, SAV/RST, or other jobs - Ricoh will process batch jobs, save requests, and restore requests submitted by authorized customer personnel through the Ricoh NOC. - Save requests may require tapes to be returned from off-site storage at additional expense. - Ricoh will manage tape retrieval only if we are responsible for tape management. - 8/month Tape library maintenance - Management of online tape library system provided by customer or acquired through Ricoh, whether external (i.e., Recall or Iron Mountain), or online (i.e., BRMS, Robot/SAVE).

en.description: AI agent streamlining prior authorization and eligibility workflows, accelerating approvals and reducing delays in care delivery.
en.long_description:
The Prior Authorization & Eligibility Agent is an AI-powered solution designed to streamline payer-related workflows by automating eligibility verification and prior authorization processes.
Delays in prior authorization and incomplete eligibility checks are among the leading causes of care disruption, administrative burden, and revenue loss in healthcare systems. This agent addresses these challenges by capturing, validating, and structuring the clinical and administrative data required for payer review.
Working in coordination with pre-visit and clinical documentation workflows, the agent ensures that all necessary information is prepared before submission. It supports eligibility verification, identifies missing data, and aligns clinical inputs with payer requirements to improve approval rates.
The agent reduces manual back-and-forth between providers and payers by enabling cleaner, more complete submissions and by flagging potential issues early in the process. This results in faster approvals, fewer delays, and improved patient access to care.
By integrating payer workflows into the broader clinical process, the Prior Authorization & Eligibility Agent improves operational efficiency, enhances revenue cycle performance, and supports a more seamless care experience.
This agent is part of the ViClinic agentic healthcare orchestration platform (AHOS), where multiple AI agents work together across clinical workflows—from intake to follow-up—under clinician supervision. By sharing structured data and context, these agents enable end-to-end workflow automation, improved decision-making, and measurable operational and clinical outcomes.

name: is.private-path-service-gateway

en.description: Enable and manage private connectivity for your hosted service.
en.long_description:
Private Path service for VPC allows a provider’s service to connect on the IBM Cloud private  network, providing secure communication between VPCs and supported IBM Cloud and third-party services. The provider first deploys their service on IBM Cloud and creates a Private Path network load  balancer (NLB) to enable their service for private connectivity. Next, the provider creates a Private Path service to expose and control access to their service. After the Private Path service is verified and published, other accounts can then connect to the provider’s service through endpoint gateways.

For consumers to connect to a provider’s service, the provider must relay information to their consumers, such as the cloud resource name (CRN) that maps to the Private Path service and a port, if required. Consumers then privately connect to the service by creating a VPE gateway with the information provided. Next, the consumer's connection request is sent to the service provider for review (the default policy). If there is an account policy for the consumer, that policy takes precedence over the default policy (to review, permit, or deny access).  

The consumer can now access the service privately from their VPC, and the provider can host and manage consumer’ connections from within their own VPCs.

name: primaryio-protectio-managed-service

en.description: PrimaryIO’s DRaaS platform replicates and protects a customer’s primary site whether on-prem or IBM cloud-based VMware workloads
en.long_description:
ProtectIO is PrimaryIO’s on-demand disaster recovery as a service (“DRaaS”) platform. ProtectIO is delivered as a web-accessible, multi-tenant, IBM Cloud-native Software-as-a-Service and helps customers by providing a robust disaster recovery solution while leveraging the latest cloud economics for an attractive Total Cost of Ownership.

Continuous Data Protection (CDP) is delivered via PrimaryIO’s proprietary VAIO Replication filter and Authenticated Block Stream Protocol that ships the changed I/O blocks to a DR Receiver process in the Target/DR environment and commits to IBM Cloud Object Storage.

At failover time, ProtectIO rehydrates from the Cloud Object Storage buckets into the respective VMDKs and instantiates the VMs that compose the application workload that is being protected. This delivers near zero RPO and an RTO correlated with the amount of data that needs to be rehydrated, which provides a compelling Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) solution for customers.

ProtectIO supports on-premises, IBM Cloud Classic and IBM Cloud VPC as the Primary Site and utilizes IBM Cloud Classic or VPC for the Target/DR Site, depending upon the customer and available VPC capacity. The UI/UX and associated Control Plane, which runs in an IBM Cloud VPC,  has been designed to be extremely intuitive and allow customers to operate without needing assistance from a Managed Service Provider.

Pre-requisites:

	1. Customer needs to have a IBM tenant account
	2. Customer needs to have COS instance
Note: PrimaryIO team will help you setup IBM tenant account and COS instance

name: px-backup

en.description: Portworx Backup and Data Protection for Kubernetes
en.long_description:
Portworx PX-Backup

Portworx PX-Backup delivers enterprise-grade point-and-click backup and recovery protection for all applications running on IBM Kubernetes Service and Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud, even if they are stateless. Built exclusively for containerized applications, Portworx PX-Backup protects your applications - data, application configuration, and Kubernetes objects - with a single click at the Kubernetes Pod, Namespace, or Cluster level. 

PX-Backup enables: 
• Point and click recovery for any stateless or stateful Kubernetes application 
• Pod and Namespace granularity for application-centric protection 
• Application-aware protection for complex distributed applications 
• Role-Based Access Control for secure user access

With PX-Backup, you achieve application-aware automation for data integrity, Role-Based Access Control and audit log for policy compliance, and Pod and Namespace granularity. Portworx PX-Backup includes out-of-the-box integration with many popular services such as Kafka, Elasticsearch, Cassandra, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and many more.

PX-Backup is compatible with any Kubernetes cluster, including managed and cloud deployments. PX-Backup integrates with major block storage providers:
IBM VPC Block
Portworx PX-Store
Amazon EBS
Google Persistent Disk
Azure Managed Disks
CSI Enabled Storage

Release Notes:
https://backup.docs.portworx.com/release-notes/

name: rackware-rmm-draas-per-unit

en.description: Protect any-source environment (physical, virtual, cloud) to IBM Cloud VPC using RMM Disaster Recovery As A Service
en.long_description:
RackWare RMM enables a modern DR architecture by non-disruptly replicating workloads from any source environment into IBM Cloud VPC, maintaining a synchronized DR environment in the cloud, enabling failover into IBM Cloud VPC without source environment dependencies, supporting fallback to source environment during transition periods, and extending DR to additional public clouds for redundancy. 

This allows IBM Cloud VPC to serve as both a disaster recovery landing zone and a strategic approach for setting up a DR environment for production environment# License Information:

# Description - RackWare DR & DRaaS for IBM Cloud 

# RackWare DR for IBM Cloud 

RackWare DR provides workload-level disaster recovery to IBM Cloud VPC through flexible, per-VM licensing. This solution includes the RackWare DR software and standard support. Each license protects one source server or virtual machine that is replicated and managed through the RackWare Management Module (RMM).

Pricing: $192 per protected VM per year 

Licensing and sizing are based solely on the number of source servers or virtual machines included within the RMM scope. 

 
# RackWare DRaaS for IBM Cloud 

RackWare DRaaS provides workload-level disaster recovery to IBM Cloud VPC through flexible, per-VM licensing. This fully managed solution includes the RackWare DR software, standard support, DRaaS operations, and one non-disruptive disaster recovery drill per protected VM each year. 
The service includes daily monitoring and maintenance, daily operational reports, automated alerts to RackWare, problem diagnosis and resolution (including triage of warnings and errors), issue resolution within the defined support scope, coordination with external teams for issues outside the service scope, and the application of patches, bug fixes, and support release upgrades. 
Each RackWare DRaaS license protects one source server or virtual machine that is replicated and managed through the RackWare Management Module (RMM). 

Pricing: $495 per protected VM per year 

Licensing and sizing are based solely on the number of source servers or virtual machines included within the RMM scope. 

 
# Architecture Flexibility

1) RackWare DR can be deployed as a single instance or scaled across multiple RackWare DR RMM instances to meet performance, isolation, and design requirements.
 
2) For example, 100 VMs (20 vCPUs) can be distributed across multiple instances (e.g., 5 RMM instances, each supporting 20 VMs/servers).
 
# Licensing Example (e.g. 100 VMs)

1) 1 vCPU supports 5 VMs
2) 100 VMs require 20 vCPUs
3) A single RMM instance with 4 vCPU and 32 GB RAM can cover 20 VMs.
4) 4 RMM instances should cover 100 VMs to be protected in DR
5) For DR 1 VM is billed at $192, 100 VMs x $192 = $19200 / Year
6) For DRaaS 1 VM is billed at $495, 100 VMs x $495 = $49500 / Year
 
Note: RackWare DR software pricing does not include IBM Cloud compute, storage.


RackWare's RMM Disaster Recovery ( DR ) are an automated, easy, and convenient process to protect existing workloads from your current location to IBM Cloud VPC. RMM creates an exact duplicate of a running image without the burden of rebuilding or recreating template images and applications. It decouples the application stack from the underlying platform, allowing it to be ported to the IBM Cloud infrastructure with ease. RMM simplifies protection of large, complex environments through a simple interface and reduces the time required from weeks to days, reducing capital and operating expenses. RackWare RMM includes discovery, analysis, automation features like DR policy engine, dynamic provisioning allowing all processes to be fast, easy, and error-free.

en.description: Migrate any-source environment (physical, virtual, cloud) to IBM Cloud VPC
en.long_description:
RackWare Management Module (RMM) Migration is an automated process to migrate as well as protect your bare metal and virtual workloads from IBM Cloud or any other source environment to Virtual Server Instances on IBM Cloud VPC.

RMM creates an exact duplicate of a running image without the burden of rebuilding or recreating template images and applications. It decouples the application stack from the underlying platform, allowing it to be ported to the IBM Cloud infrastructure with ease.

RMM simplifies migration of large, complex environments through a simple interface and reduces the time required from weeks to days, reducing capital and operating expenses. RMM includes discovery, analysis, and automation features, allowing all processes to be fast, easy, and error-free.RackWare's RMM Server Migration solution provides an easy, automated, and simplified process to migrate existing workloads from your current location to IBM Cloud. 

# License Information

# Description – RackWare Migration for IBM Cloud

RackWare Migration enables fast, automated workload migration to IBM Cloud VPC with flexible, infrastructure-based hourly licensing.

# Licensing Model
RackWare Migration is fixed cost based on the number of source VMs in scope.

1 VM is billed at $110
8 vCPU supports up to 50 source VMs

# Sizing Guidance
RackWare provides a simple, linear scaling model based on VM count:

50 VMs → A single RMM with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
100 VMs → 2 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
1,000 VMs → 20 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
10,000 VMs → 200 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM

This model scales linearly beyond these examples, allowing customers to support environments of any size by continuing the same 5 VMs per vCPU ratio. Capacity can be increased incrementally to align with migration waves, timelines, and performance requirements.

# Architecture Flexibility
RackWare Migration can be deployed as a single instance or distributed across multiple RMM instances depending on performance, isolation, or design requirements.

For example, a customer migrating 100 VMs would require 2 RMMs:

100 VMs × $110/VM = $11,000

This can be deployed as:

A single RMM with 4 vCPU and 32 GB RAM supporting 50 VMs in parallel for migration , or
Multiple RMM instances based on the migration VMs count (e.g., 4 vCPUs supporting 50 VMs each) aligned to migration waves or application groupings

This flexible architecture enables parallel migrations, better control over cutover groups, and alignment to enterprise design requirements.

# The supported use cases are

1. VMware virtual machine (On-premises) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
2. VMware virtual machine (IBM Cloud classic) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
3. Hyper-V virtual machine (On-premises, IBM Cloud Classic) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
4. On-premises physical machines to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
5. GCP, AWS, Azure, virtual machines and OCI Baremetal to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
6. IBM Cloud classic bare metal to IBM Cloud classic bare metal
7. IBM Cloud classic bare metal to IBM Cloud VPC bare metal
8. Migration of popular databases (e.g., MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL etc. Oracle RAC and ASM disk-based databases are not supported. Also, AWS RDS like databases are not supported)

## Product Overview
RackWare's RMM migrations are an automated, easy, and convenient process to migrate existing workloads from your current location to IBM Cloud. RMM creates an exact duplicate of a running image without the burden of rebuilding or recreating template images and applications. It decouples the application stack from the underlying platform, allowing it to be ported to the IBM Cloud infrastructure with ease. RMM simplifies migration of large, complex environments through a simple interface and reduces the time required from weeks to days, reducing capital and operating expenses. RackWare RMM includes discovery, analysis, and automation features, allowing all processes to be fast, easy, and error-free.

# Key Benefits

- Live and Non-Disruptive Migrations
- Highly secure and efficient data transfer
- Auto provision of target Virtual Server Instance
- Include / Exclude Lists: Capture and sync only specific files and directories rather than entire systems
- Delta Sync: Sync only the changed parts of files during the final data sync, drastically lowering cutover times
- Network optimization: bandwidth usage limitations, compression and check point restart for all sync operations

- For more information, visit https://www.rackwareinc.com/cloud-migration

RMM creates an exact duplicate of a running image without the burden of rebuilding or recreating template images and applications. It decouples the application stack from the underlying platform, allowing it to be ported to the IBM Cloud infrastructure with ease.

RMM simplifies migration of large, complex environments through a simple interface and reduces the time required from weeks to days, reducing capital and operating expenses. RMM includes discovery, analysis, and automation features, allowing all processes to be fast, easy, and error-free.RackWare's RMM Server Migration solution provides an easy, automated, and simplified process to migrate existing workloads from your current location to IBM Cloud. 

# License Information

# Description – RackWare Migration for IBM Cloud

RackWare Migration enables fast, automated workload migration to IBM Cloud VPC with flexible, infrastructure-based hourly licensing.

# Licensing Model
RackWare Migration is fixed cost based on the number of source VMs in scope.

1 VM is billed at $110
8 vCPU supports up to 50 source VMs

# Sizing Guidance
RackWare provides a simple, linear scaling model based on VM count:

50 VMs → A single RMM with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
100 VMs → 2 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
1,000 VMs → 20 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM
10,000 VMs → 200 RMMs with 8 vCPUs and 64 GB RAM

This model scales linearly beyond these examples, allowing customers to support environments of any size by continuing the same 5 VMs per vCPU ratio. Capacity can be increased incrementally to align with migration waves, timelines, and performance requirements.

# Architecture Flexibility
RackWare Migration can be deployed as a single instance or distributed across multiple RMM instances depending on performance, isolation, or design requirements.

For example, a customer migrating 100 VMs would require 2 RMMs:

100 VMs × $110/VM = $11,000

This can be deployed as:

A single RMM with 4 vCPU and 32 GB RAM supporting 50 VMs in parallel for migration , or
Multiple RMM instances based on the migration VMs count (e.g., 4 vCPUs supporting 50 VMs each) aligned to migration waves or application groupings

This flexible architecture enables parallel migrations, better control over cutover groups, and alignment to enterprise design requirements.

# The supported use cases are

1. VMware virtual machine (On-premises) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
2. VMware virtual machine (IBM Cloud classic) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
3. Hyper-V virtual machine (On-premises, IBM Cloud Classic) to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
4. On-premises physical machines to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
5. GCP, AWS, Azure, virtual machines and OCI Baremetal to IBM Cloud VPC virtual servers
6. IBM Cloud classic bare metal to IBM Cloud classic bare metal
7. IBM Cloud classic bare metal to IBM Cloud VPC bare metal
8. Migration of popular databases (e.g., MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL etc. Oracle RAC and ASM disk-based databases are not supported. Also, AWS RDS like databases are not supported)

## Product Overview
RackWare's RMM migrations are an automated, easy, and convenient process to migrate existing workloads from your current location to IBM Cloud. RMM creates an exact duplicate of a running image without the burden of rebuilding or recreating template images and applications. It decouples the application stack from the underlying platform, allowing it to be ported to the IBM Cloud infrastructure with ease. RMM simplifies migration of large, complex environments through a simple interface and reduces the time required from weeks to days, reducing capital and operating expenses. RackWare RMM includes discovery, analysis, and automation features, allowing all processes to be fast, easy, and error-free.

# Key Benefits

- Live and Non-Disruptive Migrations
- Highly secure and efficient data transfer
- Auto provision of target Virtual Server Instance
- Include / Exclude Lists: Capture and sync only specific files and directories rather than entire systems
- Delta Sync: Sync only the changed parts of files during the final data sync, drastically lowering cutover times
- Network optimization: bandwidth usage limitations, compression and check point restart for all sync operations

- For more information, visit https://www.rackwareinc.com/cloud-migration

en.long_description:
The RCS for Business Messaging Suite helps businesses turn ordinary text messaging into rich, interactive experiences that keep customers engaged and connected. With branded visuals, buttons, videos, and guided responses, you can deliver conversations that feel more like an app—directly inside your customer’s messaging inbox. After a simple integration with your existing tech stack, this channel gives you a powerful, fully trackable way to reach customers with smarter campaigns and measurable outcomes.

Use the RCS for Business Messaging Suite to:

- Launch marketing campaigns with video, carousels, and high-quality images
- Enable one-tap purchasing and seamless retail checkout
- Offer easy scheduling and appointment management
- Reduce call center costs with 24/7 conversational AI handling customer inquiries
- Send surveys and collect real-time customer feedback
- Use built-in analytics to understand user behavior, measure journeys, and make data-driven decisions

This is the next generation of trackable, interactive business messaging—designed to boost engagement, improve conversions, and deliver better customer experiences.
