name: viclinic-inc-structured-clinical-documentation-agent

en.description: AI agent converting free-text clinical notes into structured, clinic-defined forms to improve documentation, coding, and workflows
en.long_description:
The Structured Clinical Documentation Agent is an AI-powered solution that converts free-text clinical notes into structured, standardized documentation aligned with clinic-specific templates and specialty requirements.
In many healthcare settings, clinicians document freely, while systems require structured formats such as SOAP notes or specialty-specific forms. This gap creates inefficiencies, inconsistent records, and challenges in coding and workflow execution.
This agent bridges that gap by transforming unstructured clinical notes—including physician input or AI scribe output—into predefined, structured formats configured by each clinic or specialty. Organizations can define their own documentation templates, forms, and requirements, and the agent ensures that all notes are structured accordingly.
By aligning documentation with clinic-specific workflows, the agent improves consistency, completeness, and usability of clinical data across care teams. It also enhances downstream processes such as coding, billing, reporting, and clinical decision support.
This agent is part of the ViClinic agentic healthcare orchestration platform (AHOS), where multiple AI agents work together across clinical workflows—from intake to follow-up—under clinician supervision. By sharing structured data and context, these agents enable end-to-end workflow automation, improved decision-making, and measurable operational and clinical outcomes

name: is.subnet

en.description: Subnet for VPC
en.long_description:
Subnets are created from VPC address prefixes and are bound to a single zone in one region; customers can have multiple subnets per address prefix. 

Each subnet in a VPC can reach other subnets through private layer 3 routing through the implicit router. The implicit router is the inherent network connectivity between all the subnets that are created within a VPC. A VPC, like a subnet, is also deployed and bound to only one region. Within that region, a VPC can span multiple zones, however, subnets are bound to a single zone and do not span multiple zones.

name: l4s-corp-tapestryx

en.description: TapestryX is next-generation Networked Accounting Ledger Technology (NALT) that can be deployed to support B2B networks.
en.long_description:
TapestryX is a real-time, high-capacity, secure and scalable, decentralized B2B transaction synchronization and double-entry accounting protocol.

▪ Each Node (representing an institutional participant) controls its segment of the entire, interlinked platform ledger
▪ Event-driven and self-synchronizing(1)
▪ Each Node posts asset transfer details as well as (future-dated) obligations into immutable ledgers
▪ Transaction Accounting Periods - allowing period archiving and active memory optimization
▪ Simple, deterministic scripts (asset & life-cycle agnostic)
▪ Interoperable with legacy infrastructure (via Airlock feature)
▪ Confidential and Secure
▪ Configurable for proper GAAP or IFRS Financial Reporting
▪ Decentralized initiation of transaction, validation and processing – no single point of failure
▪ High Performance (~ 100K TPS) and Resilient to Cyber attacks

Consistency and Completeness of all Decentralized Ledgers without reliance on consensus, mining or 3rd Party validation.

bullets.description: Arabisch, Portugiesisch (Brasilien), Chinesisch (Mandarin), Niederländisch, Englisch (USA und Vereinigtes Königreich), Französisch, Deutsch, Italienisch, Japanisch, Koreanisch und Spanisch (Kastilisch, Lateinamerika und Nordamerika).
bullets.title: Verfügbare Sprachen

bullets.description: Wählen Sie aus einer Vielzahl von männlichen und weiblichen Stimmen für verschiedene Sprachen aus. Die meisten Sprachen bieten sowohl neuronale Stimmen als auch Standardstimmen, einige bieten jedoch nur einen Typ an. Neuronale Stimmen erzeugen Audio, indem sie sich auf tiefe neuronale Netze stützen, um die akustischen Eigenschaften der gewünschten Sprache vorherzusagen.  Standardstimmen setzen die Audiosignale durch die Verkettung von Segmenten aufgezeichneter Sprache zusammen.
bullets.title: Verfügbare Stimmen

bullets.description: Fordern Sie eine Synthese mit HTTP-REST- oder WebSocket-APIs. Für andere Sprachen als Japanisch können Sie mit WebSockets auch Ablaufsteuerungsinformationen für Wörter des resultierenden Audios erhalten. Verwenden Sie SDKs für eine vereinfachte, schnelle Entwicklung in Node, Java, Python, Swift und vielen anderen Sprachen.
bullets.title: Schnittstellen und SDKs

bullets.description: Annotieren Sie Eingabetext mit der Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML), einer XML-basierten Standardnotation für Sprachsyntheseanwendungen. Verwenden Sie SSML, um Aspekte der Sprachsynthese wie Aussprache, Lautstärke, Tonhöhe, Geschwindigkeit und andere Attribute zu steuern.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Verwenden Sie die Stimmanpassung, um die sprachabhängigen Ausspracheregeln des Service zu optimieren. Definieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Wörterbücher für domänenspezifische Begriffe, Wörter ausländischer Herkunft, persönliche oder geografische Namen und Abkürzungen oder Akronyme im Lexikon Ihrer Anwendung. Definieren Sie Aussprachen, die auf anderen Wörtern basieren, oder erstellen Sie Aussprachen, die auf Phonemsymbolen im Internationalen Phonetischen Alphabet (IPA) oder IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR) basieren.
bullets.title: Stimmanpassung

bullets.description: Arbeiten Sie mit IBM zusammen, um eine neue Stimme für Ihren speziellen Anwendungsfall und Zielmarkt zu trainieren. IBM kann eine neue Stimme mit nur einer Stunde von Trainingsdaten trainieren. Dieses Feature steht zurzeit nur Premium-Kunden zur Verfügung.
bullets.title: Benutzerdefinierte Stimmen

bullets.description: Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Mandarin dialect), Dutch, English (US and UK dialects), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish (Castilian, Latin American, and North American dialects).
bullets.title: Available languages

bullets.description: Choose from a variety of male and female voices for different languages. Most languages provide both Neural and Standard voices, although some provide only one type. Neural voices generate audio by relying on Deep Neural Networks to predict the acoustic features of the requested speech.  Standard voices assemble audio by concatenating segments of recorded speech.
bullets.title: Available voices

bullets.description: Request synthesis with HTTP REST or WebSocket APIs. For languages other than Japanese, WebSockets also allow you to obtain timing information for words of the resulting audio. Use SDKs for simplified rapid development in Node, Java, Python, Swift, and many other languages.
bullets.title: Interfaces and SDKs

bullets.description: Annotate input text with the Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML), a standard XML-based notation for speech-synthesis applications. Use SSML to control aspects of speech synthesis such as pronunciation, volume, pitch, speed, and other attributes.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Use voice customization to refine the service's language-dependent rules for pronunciation. Define custom dictionaries for domain-specific terms, words with foreign origins, personal or geographic names, and abbreviations or acronyms in your application's lexicon. Define pronunciations based on other words, or create pronunciations based on phoneme symbols in the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) or IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR).
bullets.title: Voice Customization

bullets.description: Work with IBM to train a new voice for your specific use case and target market. IBM can train a new voice with as little as one hour of training data. This feature is currently available only to Premium customers.
bullets.title: Custom Voices

bullets.description: Árabe, portugués de Brasil, chino (mandarín), holandés, inglés (de Estados Unidos y el Reino Unido), francés, alemán, italiano, japonés, coreano y español (de España, Latinoamérica y Norteamérica).
bullets.title: Idiomas disponibles

bullets.description: Elija entre una selección de voces femeninas y masculinas para los distintos idiomas. La mayoría de los idiomas proporcionan voces neuronales y voces estándar, aunque algunas proporcionan solo un tipo. Las voces neuronales generan audio basándose en redes neuronales profundas para predecir las características acústicas del habla solicitada.  Las voces estándar ensamblan el audio concatenando segmentos de habla grabada.
bullets.title: Voces disponibles

bullets.description: Solicite síntesis con las API REST HTTP o WebSocket. Con la excepción del japonés, los WebSockets le permiten obtener información de temporización de las palabras del audio resultante. Utilice SDK para el desarrollo rápido simplificado en Node, Java, Python, Swift y muchos otros lenguajes.
bullets.title: Interfaces y SDK

bullets.description: Anote texto de entrada con SSML (Speech Synthesis Markup Language), una notación basada en XML estándar para aplicaciones de síntesis de habla. Utilice SSML para controlar aspectos de la síntesis del habla como por ejemplo la pronunciación, el volumen, el tono, la velocidad y otros atributos.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Utilice la personalización de voz para ajustar las reglas del servicio que dependen del idioma para la pronunciación. Defina diccionarios personalizados para términos específicos del dominio, extranjerismos, nombres personales o geográficos y abreviaturas o acrónimos en el léxico de su aplicación. Defina pronunciaciones basadas en otras palabras, o cree pronunciaciones basadas en fonemas del Alfabeto fonético internacional (IPA) o la Representación fonética simbólica (SPR) de IBM.
bullets.title: Personalización de la voz

bullets.description: Trabaje con IBM para entrenar una nueva voz para su caso de uso específico y mercado objetivo. IBM puede entrenar una nueva voz con apenas una hora de datos de entrenamiento. Esta característica solo está disponible actualmente para clientes Premium.
bullets.title: Voces personalizadas

bullets.description: Arabe, portugais brésilien, chinois (mandarin), néerlandais, anglais (Etats-Unis et Royaume-Uni), français, allemand, italien, japonais, coréen et espagnol (castillan et dialectes d'Amérique latine et d'Amérique du Nord).
bullets.title: Langues disponibles

bullets.description: Choisissez une voix masculine ou féminine parmi celles proposées dans les différentes langues. La plupart des langues fournissent à la fois des voix neurales et standard, mais certaines ne proposent qu'un seul type. Les voix neurales génèrent de l'audio en s'appuyant sur des réseaux de neurones profonds pour prévoir les caractéristiques acoustiques du discours demandé.  Les voix standard assemblent les données audio en concaténant des segments de paroles enregistrées.
bullets.title: Voix disponibles

bullets.description: Demandes une synthèse avec des API REST HTTP ou WebSocket. Pour les langues autres que le japonais, WebSockets permet également d'obtenir des informations temporelles pour les mots de l'audio obtenu. Utilisez des SDK pour un développement rapide simplifié en langage Node, Java, Python, Swift ou autres.
bullets.title: Interfaces et SDK

bullets.description: Annotez le texte en entrée à l'aide du langage SSML (Speech Synthesis Markup Language), une notation XML standard pour les applications de synthèse vocale. Utilisez SSML pour contrôler certains aspects de la synthèse vocale, tels que la prononciation, le volume, l'intensité, la vitesse et d'autres attributs.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Utilisez la personnalisation vocale pour affiner les règles linguistiques de prononciation du service. Définissez des dictionnaires personnalisés pour les termes spécifiques à un domaine, les mots d'origine étrangère, les noms propres ou géographiques, ainsi que les abréviations ou les acronymes du lexique de votre application. Définissez les prononciations en fonction d'autres mots ou créez des prononciations en fonction des symboles de phonème de l'alphabet phonétique international (IPA) ou de la représentation phonétique symbolique d'IBM (SPR).
bullets.title: Personnalisation vocale

bullets.description: Avec l'aide d'IBM, entraînez une nouvelle voix pour votre scénario d'utilisation spécifique et votre marché cible. Une heure de données d'apprentissage suffit à IBM pour entraîner une nouvelle voix. Cette fonctionnalité n'est actuellement disponible que pour les clients Premium.
bullets.title: Voix personnalisées

bullets.description: Arabo, portoghese brasiliano, cinese (dialetto mandarino), olandese, inglese (dialetti USA e Regno Unito), francese, tedesco, italiano, giapponese, coreano e spagnolo (dialetti castigliano, latino americano e nordamericano).
bullets.title: Lingue disponibili

bullets.description: Scegli tra una varietà di voci maschili e femminili per diverse lingue. La maggior parte delle lingue fornisce entrambe le voci Neural e Standard, sebbene per alcune se ne fornisca un solo tipo. Le voci Neural generano audio affidandosi a Deep Neural Networks per prevedere le funzioni acustiche del parlato richiesto.  Le voci Standard assemblano l'audio concatenando segmenti del discorso registrato.
bullets.title: Voci disponibili

bullets.description: Richiedi la sintesi con le API HTTP REST o WebSocket. Per lingue diverse dal giapponese, WebSockets consente anche di ottenere informazioni di tempistica per le parole dell'audio risultante. Utilizza SDK per uno sviluppo rapido semplificato in Node, Java, Python, Swift e molti altri linguaggi.
bullets.title: Interfacce e SDK

bullets.description: Annota il testo di input con il SSML (Speech Synthesis Markup Language), una notazione basata su XML standard per le applicazioni di sintesi vocale. Utilizza SSML per controllare gli aspetti della sintesi vocale quali pronuncia, volume, pitch, velocità e altri attributi.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Utilizza la personalizzazione vocale per perfezionare le regole dipendenti dalla lingua del servizio per la pronuncia. Definisci i dizionari personalizzati per i termini specifici del dominio, le parole con origini straniere, i nomi personali o geografici e le abbreviazioni o gli acronimi nel lessico della tua applicazione. Definisci le pronunce basate su altre parole o crea pronunce basate su simboli fonemi in International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) o IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR).
bullets.title: Personalizzazione vocale

bullets.description: Collabora con IBM per formare una nuova voce per il tuo scenario di utilizzo specifico e mercato di destinazione. IBM può formare una nuova voce con non più di un'ora di dati formativi. Questa funzione è attualmente disponibile solo per i clienti Premium.
bullets.title: Voci personalizzate

bullets.description: アラビア語、ブラジル・ポルトガル語、中国語 (北京語)、オランダ語、英語 (米国と英国の方言)、フランス語、ドイツ語、イタリア語、日本語、韓国語、スペイン語 (カスティリャ、ラテン・アメリカ、北米の各方言)。
bullets.title: 使用可能な言語

bullets.description: 複数の言語でさまざまな男性と女性の音声から選択できます。 ほとんどの言語ではニューラル音声と標準音声の両方がありますが、一部の言語では 1 つのタイプしか提供されていません。 ニューラル音声は、ディープ・ニューラル・ネットワークを使用して、要求された音声の音響特徴を予測することによって音声を生成します。  標準音声は、録音された音声のセグメントを連結することによって、音声を組み立てます。
bullets.title: 使用可能な音声

bullets.description: HTTP REST または WebSocket API を使用して合成を要求します。 日本語以外の言語の場合、WebSocket を使用すると、生成される音声の単語のタイミング情報を取得することもできます。 SDK を使用して、Node、Java、Python、Swift を始めとする多くの言語で迅速で簡素化された開発を行えます。
bullets.title: インターフェースと SDK

bullets.description: 音声合成アプリケーション用の XML ベースの標準表記である Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) を使用して、入力テキストにアノテーションを付けることができます。 SSML を使用して、発音、音量、音の高さ、速度、その他の属性などの音声合成の側面を制御できます。
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: 音声カスタマイズを使用すると、このサービスの言語依存の発音ルールを洗練することができます。 アプリケーションの用語集で、分野固有用語、外来語、人名、地名、略語、頭字語のカスタム辞書を定義できます。 他の単語に基づいて発音を定義することもできますし、International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) または IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR) の音素記号に基づいて発音を作成することもできます。
bullets.title: 音声カスタマイズ

bullets.description: IBM と協力して、特定のユース・ケースとターゲット市場に合わせて新しい音声をトレーニングすることができます。 IBM では、わずか 1 時間分のトレーニング・データがあれば新しい音声をトレーニングできます。 この機能は、現時点ではプレミアム・ユーザーのみが利用できます。
bullets.title: カスタム音声

bullets.description: 아랍어, 브라질 포르투갈어, 중국어(만다린 방언), 네델란드어, 영어(미국 및 영국 방언), 프랑스어, 독일어, 이탈리아어, 일본어, 한국어 및 스페인어(카스티야, 라틴 아메리카 및 북미 방언).
bullets.title: 사용 가능한 언어

bullets.description: 여러 다른 언어에 제공되는 다양한 남성 및 여성 음성 중에서 선택하십시오. 대부분의 언어에서는 신경 및 표준 음성을 둘 다 제공합니다. 단, 일부는 한 유형만 제공합니다. 신경 음성은 요청된 음성의 음향 기능을 예측하는 심층 신경망을 사용하여 오디오를 생성합니다. 표준 음성은 녹음된 음성의 세그먼트를 연결하여 음성을 조합합니다.
bullets.title: 사용 가능한 음성

bullets.description: HTTP REST 또는 WebSocket API로 합성을 요청합니다. 일본어 이외의 언어에서 WebSockets를 사용하면 결과적으로 생성된 오디오 단어의 시간 정보도 얻을 수 있습니다. Node, Java, Python, Swift 및 다른 모든 언어에서 간단하고 빠른 개발을 위해 SDK를 사용하십시오.
bullets.title: 인터페이스 및 SDK

bullets.description: 음성 합성 애플리케이션의 표준 XML 기반 표기법인 SSML(Speech Synthesis Markup Language)로 입력 텍스트의 어노테이션을 작성하십시오. SSML을 사용하여 발음, 볼륨, 피치, 속도 및 기타 속성과 같은 음성 합성의 요소를 제어하십시오.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: 음성 사용자 정의를 사용하여 발음에 관한 서비스의 언어 종속 규칙을 세분화하십시오. 애플리케이션 용어집에서 도메인별 용어, 외래어, 개인 이름 또는 지명 및 약어에 맞게 사용자 정의 사전을 정의하십시오. 다른 언어를 기반으로 발음을 정의하거나 IPA(International Phonetic Alphabet) 또는 IBM SPR(Symbolic Phonetic Representation)의 음소 기호를 기반으로 발음을 작성하십시오.
bullets.title: 음성 사용자 정의

bullets.description: IBM과 함께 작업하여 특정 유스 케이스 및 대상 시장에 맞는 새 음성을 훈련하십시오. IBM에서는 단 1시간 동안의 훈련 데이터로 새 음성을 훈련시킬 수 있습니다. 이 기능은 현재 Premium 고객만 사용할 수 있습니다.
bullets.title: 사용자 정의 음성

bullets.description: Árabe, português do Brasil, chinês (dialeto mandarim), holandês, inglês (dialetos dos EUA e do Reino Unido), francês, alemão, italiano, japonês, coreano e espanhol (dialetos castelhano, latino-americano e norte-americano).
bullets.title: Idiomas disponíveis

bullets.description: Escolha entre uma variedade de vozes masculinas e femininas para idiomas diferentes. A maioria dos idiomas fornece as vozes Neural e Padrão, embora alguns forneçam apenas um tipo. As vozes neurais geram áudio confiando nas Redes neurais profundas para prever os recursos acústicos do discurso solicitado.  Vozes padrão montam áudio concatenando segmentos de discurso gravado.
bullets.title: Vozes disponíveis

bullets.description: Solicitação de síntese com REST de HTTP ou APIs de WebSocket. Para idiomas diferentes do japonês, os WebSockets também permitem obter informações de sincronização para palavras do áudio resultante. Use SDKs para desenvolvimento rápido simplificado em Node, Java, Python, Swift e muitas outras linguagens.
bullets.title: Interfaces e SDKs

bullets.description: Anote o texto de entrada com o Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML), uma notação padrão baseada em XML para aplicativos de síntese de discurso. Use o SSML para controlar aspectos da síntese de discurso como pronúncia, volume, densidade, velocidade e outros atributos.
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: Use a customização de voz para refinar as regras dependentes da linguagem do serviço para a pronúncia. Defina dicionários customizados para termos específicos de domínio, palavras com origens estrangeiras, nomes de pessoas ou de locais geográficos e abreviações ou acrônimos no léxico do seu aplicativo. Defina pronúncias com base em outras palavras ou crie pronúncias baseadas em símbolos fonêmicos no Alfabeto fonético internacional (IPA) ou no IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR).
bullets.title: Customização de voz

bullets.description: Trabalhe com a IBM para treinar uma nova voz para o seu caso de uso específico e mercado de destino. A IBM pode treinar uma nova voz com apenas uma hora de dados de treinamento. Esse recurso está atualmente disponível apenas para clientes Premium.
bullets.title: Vozes customizadas

bullets.description: 阿拉伯语、巴西葡萄牙语、中文（普通话）、荷兰语、英语（美国和英国方言）、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语和西班牙语（卡斯蒂利亚、拉美和北美方言）。
bullets.title: 可用语言

bullets.description: 可选择不同语言的各种男声和女声。大多数语言提供“神经”和“标准”语音，但是某些仅提供一种类型。神经语音依靠深度神经网络来预测所请求的语音的声学特征，然后生成音频。标准语音通过合并录制的语音段来组合音频。
bullets.title: 可用语音

bullets.description: 使用 HTTP REST 或 WebSocket API 请求合成。对于日语之外的语言，WebSocket 还支持获取结果音频中单词的计时信息。使用 SDK，简化采用 Node、Java、Python、Swift 和多种其他语言的开发工作。
bullets.title: 接口和 SDK

bullets.description: 使用语音合成标记语言 (SSML) 来注释输入文本，SSML 是用于语音合成应用程序的基于 XML 的标准注释。使用 SSML 以控制语音合成的各个方面，例如，发音、音量、间距、速度和其他属性。
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: 使用语音定制以优化服务的独立于语言的发音规则。可针对特定于领域的术语、外来词、人名或地理名称，以及应用程序词典中的缩写和首字母缩略词，定义定制字典。基于其他词定义发音，或者基于国际音标 (IPA) 或 IBM 符号音标表示法 (SPR) 中的音素符号创建发音。
bullets.title: 语音定制

bullets.description: 与 IBM 合作，针对您的特定用例和目标市场训练新语音。IBM 可以利用最少 1 小时的训练数据来训练新语音。此功能当前仅可用于“白金”客户。
bullets.title: 定制语音

bullets.description: 阿拉伯文、巴西葡萄牙文、中文（普通話）、荷蘭文、英文（美國和英國語）、法文、德文、義大利文、日文、韓文和西班牙文（卡斯蒂利亞、拉丁美洲和北美洲語）。
bullets.title: 可用語言

bullets.description: 從各種不同語言的男性和女性語音選擇。大部分的語言都提供神經和標準語音，但有些則只提供一種類型。神經語音倚賴「深度神經網路」來產生音訊，以預測所要求之語音的聲學特徵。標準語音是透過連結錄製語音的段落來組合音訊。
bullets.title: 可用的語音

bullets.description: 以 HTTP REST 或 WebSocket API 合成要求。對於日文以外的語言，WebSocket 也允許您取得所產生音訊之單字的計時資訊。使用 SDK，以 Node、Java、Python、Swift 和許多其他語言進行簡化、快速的開發。
bullets.title: 介面和 SDK

bullets.description: 以「語音合成標記語言 (SSML)」註釋輸入文字，這是一種語音合成應用程式的標準 XML 型表示法。SSML 用來控制語音合成的多個層面，例如發音、音量、音調、速度和其他屬性。
bullets.title: SSML

bullets.description: 使用語音自訂作業來調整服務的和語言有關的發音規則。針對領域特定詞彙、外來語、個人或地名，以及您應用程式之辭彙中的縮寫或字首語，定義自訂字典。以其他單字為基礎來定義發音，或根據建立 International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) 或 IBM Symbolic Phonetic Representation (SPR) 中的音素符號來建立發音。
bullets.title: 語音自訂作業

bullets.description: 與 IBM 一起為您特定的使用案例和目標市場訓練新的語音。IBM 可以運用少至一小時的訓練資料來訓練新的語音。此特性目前只供「高階」客戶使用。
bullets.title: 自訂語音

name: text-to-speech

de.description: Natürlich klingende und gut verständliche Sprache wird synthetisch aus Text erstellt.
de.long_description: Der Text to Speech-Service wandelt Text in gut verständliche Sprache um. Der Service streamt den synthetisch erstellen Ton mit minimaler Verzögerung zurück. Der Ton verwendet eine der Sprache und dem Dialekt angemessene Kadenz und Intonation, um Stimmen zu erzeugen, die reibungslos und natürlich sind. Der Service kann sowohl in Anwendungen wie sprachgesteuerten Chatbots als auch in einer Vielzahl von sprachgesteuerten und bildschirmlosen Anwendungen genutzt werden, wie z. B. Tools für Behinderte oder Sehbehinderte, Video-Filmkommentaren und Voice-Over sowie Bildungs- und Heim-Automatisierungslösungen.

en.description: Synthesizes natural-sounding speech from text.
en.long_description: The Text to Speech service converts written text to natural-sounding speech. The service streams the synthesized audio back with minimal delay. The audio uses appropriate cadence and intonation for its language and dialect to provide voices that are smooth and natural. The service can be used in applications such as voice-automated chatbots, as well as a variety of voice-driven and screenless applications, such as tools for the disabled or visually impaired, video narration and voice over, and educational and home-automation solutions.

es.description: Sintetiza habla natural a partir de texto.
es.long_description: El servicio Text to Speech convierte texto escrito en habla natural. El servicio transmite el audio sintetizado con un retardo mínimo. El audio utiliza la cadencia y la entonación adecuadas correspondientes al idioma y dialecto para proporcionar voces que suenan fluidas y naturales. Se puede utilizar el servicio en aplicaciones como por ejemplo chatbots automatizados de voz, así como en distintas aplicaciones sin pantalla y basadas en voz, como por ejemplo herramientas para personas discapacitadas o con problemas de visión, la narración de vídeo y la narración de voz y soluciones educativas y de automatización en el hogar.

fr.description: Synthétise des paroles qui semblent naturelles à partir d'un texte.
fr.long_description: Le service Text to Speech convertit le texte écrit en paroles naturelles. Il rediffuse l'audio synthétisé avec un retard minimal. L'audio utilise la cadence et l'intonation appropriées pour sa langue et son dialecte afin de fournir des voix qui sont douces et naturelles. Ce service peut être utilisé dans des applications telles que les agents conversationnels vocaux automatisés, ainsi que dans diverses applications vocales sans écran, telles que des outils pour personnes handicapées ou présentant une déficience visuelle, la narration vidéo et les voix off, ou encore des solutions éducatives et domotiques.

it.description: Sintetizza dal testo un parlato dal suono naturale.
it.long_description: Il servizio Text to Speech converte il testo scritto in un parlato dal suono naturale. Il servizio trasmette l'audio sintetizzato con un ritardo minimo. L'audio utilizza la cadenza appropriata e l'intonazione della propria lingua e dialetto per restituire voci fluide e naturali. Il servizio può essere utilizzato in applicazioni quali chatbot con automazione vocale, nonché in una varietà di applicazioni voice-driven e screenless, quali gli strumenti per disabili o non vedenti, la narrazione video e per voci fuori campo e per soluzioni formative e di automazione domestica.

ja.description: テキストから自然な音声を合成します。
ja.long_description: Text to Speech サービスは、書かれたテキストを自然な音声に変換します。 このサービスは、最小限の遅延で合成音声をストリーミングで戻します。 対象となる言語と方言において滑らかで自然な声になるように、適切なリズムとイントネーションの音声が使用されます。 このサービスの応用範囲として、音声自動チャットボットなどのアプリケーションに加えて、身体障害者向けまたは視覚障害者向けのツール、ビデオ・ナレーションとボイス・オーバー、教育ソリューション、ホーム・オートメーション・ソリューションなどの、画面を使用しないさまざまな音声駆動型アプリケーションで使用できます。

ko.description: 문자에서 자연스러운 음성을 합성합니다.
ko.long_description: Text to Speech 서비스는 문자 텍스트를 자연스럽게 들리는 음성 텍스트로 변환합니다. 이 서비스에서는 지연 시간을 최소화하며 합성된 오디오를 다시 스트리밍합니다. 오디오에서는 언어와 방언의 적절한 운율과 리듬을 사용하여 부드럽고 자연스러운 음성을 제공합니다. 이 서비스는 자동 음성 챗봇과 같은 애플리케이션 외에도, 장애가 있거나 시각적으로 불편한 사용자를 위한 도구, 동영상 내레이션과 보이스 오버, 교육 및 홈 자동화 솔루션과 같은 다양한 음성 기반 및 스크린이 없는 애플리케이션에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.description: Sintetiza o discurso em sonoridade natural do texto.
pt-BR.long_description: O serviço Text to Speech converte o texto escrito em discurso com som natural. O serviço transmite o áudio sintetizado de volta com um atraso mínimo. O áudio usa cadência e entonação apropriadas para a sua linguagem e dialeto para fornecer vozes suaves e naturais. O serviço pode ser usado em aplicativos como robôs de bate-papo automatizados por voz, bem como em uma variedade de aplicativos controlados por voz e sem tela, como ferramentas para deficientes visuais, narração de vídeo e voz, bem como soluções educacionais e de automação residencial.

zh-Hans.description: 从文本合成自然语音。
zh-Hans.long_description: Text to Speech 服务将书面文本转换为自然语音。此服务能够以最低延迟流式传回合成音频。音频将相应的节奏和语调用于其语言和方言，形成流畅而自然的语音。此服务可用于多种应用程序，例如，语音自动化聊天机器人，以及各种语音驱动的无屏幕应用程序，例如，针对残疾人或视力障碍人士的工具、视频旁白和配音，以及教育和住宅自动化解决方案。

zh-Hant.description: 從文字合成自然聲調語音。
zh-Hant.long_description: Text to Speech 服務將書寫文字轉換為自然聲調語音。服務以最小的延遲來串流合成音訊。音訊使用其語言和用語的適當節奏及語調，來提供平順自然的語音。服務可用於諸如語音自動化聊天機器人的應用程式，以及各種語音驅動和無螢幕式應用程式，例如身障或視障人士、影像旁白和配音，以及教育及家庭自動化解決方案的工具。

name: trademo-technologies-inc-finscreener

en.description: Trademo TradeScreen is an AI-based real-time trade transaction validation tool powered by  Knowledge graph of over 10 billion+data
en.long_description:
Trademo TradeScreen is an advanced AI-powered platform that revolutionizes how key stakeholders in global trade, i.e., Trade Finance, Insurance, Logistics, Ports, and Customs authorities, manage trade transaction processing, operations, compliance, and risk. 

By leveraging Trademo's proprietary fine-tuned vision models and global supply chain knowledge graph (TrademoKG) powered by open-source intelligence from thousands of authoritative data sources and billions of data points, TradeScreen provides real-time trade digitization, compliance automation, and risk management capabilities.

Key Features

Document Digitization & Classification

Our system uses advanced machine learning algorithms to automatically classify trade documents into specific categories, completely eliminating the need for manual sorting. Whether it's a Bill of Lading (BoL), Letter of Credit (LC), Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, or any other trade document, our intelligent classification engine instantly recognizes and organizes them into the correct buckets. This not only speeds up processing times but also enhances accuracy and reduces operational overhead.

Document Extraction

Powered by an advanced vision model combined with Optical Character Recognition (OCR), our system precisely extracts all the key attributes from your trade documents regardless of inconsistent formats and data structures. From shipment details and payment terms to product specifications and consignee information, the platform automates data extraction at scale, removing hours of manual effort and reducing the risk of human error. The result is faster workflows, more accurate data, and a significant boost in operational efficiency.

Maritime

Validate master bill of lading data and get details on transhipment ports, vessel location, and previous port calls of the vessel with the right information from shipping lines. Identify and mitigate risk by screening vessels and shipping entities flagged for maritime sanctions violations.

Compliance & Risk Checks

TBML (Trade-Based Money Laundering) Checks

Leverage real-time trade transactional data to identify risk from supply chain networks, such as limited trade partners, new product trade, multiple addresses, and more. Identify patterns in trade data that could indicate fraudulent activity, such as huge shipments, frequent changes in trading partners, unusual payment patterns, or inconsistent documentation.

Goods Screening

Ensure compliant financing by thoroughly screening for dual-use, hazardous, restricted/prohibited goods across different trade lanes. Trademo empowers trade finance institutions by offering real-time insights into country-specific trade restrictions, OGA/PGA regulations, and controls to mitigate risks, accelerate due diligence, and facilitate secure, compliant cross-border transactions.

Sanctions & AML Screening

Conduct enhanced due diligence on parties with links to sanctioned countries, entities, individuals, politically exposed persons, and forced labor entities.

UCP 600 Checks

Ensure trade documents meet the standards outlined under UCP 600 rules for seamless processing.

Entity Resolution

Trademo’s Entity Resolution helps trade finance institutions uncover hidden risks by mapping ownership structures, identifying linked entities, and automatically screening them against global sanctions and watchlists. This end-to-end visibility strengthens due diligence, enhances compliance, and ensures safer financing decisions.

Document Verification as per ICC Rules (UCP, ISBP, URC)

Trademo’s Document Check automates verification against UCP, URDG, URC, and ISBP rules as applicable, helping trade finance institutions quickly validate trade documents for compliance and accuracy. By reducing manual errors and speeding up document review, it ensures smoother letter of credit processing, lowers operational risk, and accelerates transaction approval.

Benefits:

Cost Efficiency Through Automation

By reducing manual tasks by up to 75%, TradeScreen lowers the cost of transaction processing and fraud detection. This reduction leads to decreased overhead for organizations as they streamline their operations.

Fraud Prevention

TradeScreen uses AI models to identify suspicious patterns before transactions are processed, enabling early intervention. This helps mitigate losses and prevent financial fraud, which is projected to cost the industry billions by 2027.

Improved Accuracy & Fewer False Positives

By reducing false positives by up to 40%, TradeScreen ensures compliance teams spend less time investigating non-issues and more time focusing on actual risks, making institutions more efficient and productive.

Enhanced Regulatory Compliance

With integrated tools for sanctions screening, goods checks, and supply chain transparency, TradeScreen helps financial institutions comply with AML, CTF, and sanctions laws, reducing the risk of regulatory penalties.

Increased Visibility Across Ecosystems

TradeScreen merges data from multiple sources to provide a transparent view of the entire trade and financial ecosystem. This visibility helps institutions better understand their clients, suppliers, and third-party risks.

Seamless Integration With Existing Infrastructure

TradeScreen is an open, scalable platform that easily integrates with existing banking infrastructure, enabling institutions to leverage its capabilities without extensive system overhauls.'

Enhanced Decision-Making

The platform delivers actionable insights and transparency into the participants in each transaction, empowering financial institutions to make informed decisions about trade transactions and client relationships.


Capabilities

Global Trade Risk Mitigation

Detects and prevents risks in trade transactions using a comprehensive database of international regulations and risk checks.

500+ Real-Time Compliance Checks

Perform 500+ real-time checks to ensure trade transactions comply with global regulations, reducing risks and non-compliance.

AI-Driven Knowledge Graph

Unlock insights with an AI-powered graph integrating billions of data points on trade, supply chains, risks, and ownership.

End-to-End Transaction Validation

Validate every aspect of trade transactions, ensuring full transparency and compliance from start to finish.

Continuous Risk Updates

Stay compliant with evolving regulations, as TradeScreen continuously updates its risk assessment framework in real time.

User Management Capabilities

Enable role-based access controls to tailor access and permissions across your teams, ensuring data security and governance compliance across workflows.


Workflow Capabilities

Support for maker-checker workflows, allowing teams to create, review, and approve trade transactions collaboratively. These workflows increase accountability and auditability across departments.

Configuration & Integration

Flexible Configuration

Customize workflows, compliance checks, and validation logic based on your internal policies and risk appetite.


Available via API

All core TradeScreen features are available through well-documented APIs, enabling seamless integration into existing banking, logistics, or compliance systems.


Workflow Capabilities

The platform supports maker-checker workflows, allowing multiple teams to collaborate, review, and approve documents efficiently. This enhances accountability and strengthens the overall due diligence process.

Pricing Plan:

Pricing Model: Platform Subscription (Base) + Optionals 

1. Base Platform Subscription Fee Annually: 20000 USD 
2. Optionals (at an extra cost in USD): per transaction checks

TBML Checks Module
Goods Screening Checks Module
Sanctions & AML Checks Module
Documentary Checks Module
Maritime Checks Module

name: upsun-fixed-products

en.description: Upsun is the cloud application platform that humans and robots love. Applications can be frustrating; Upsun makes it simple.
en.long_description:
Code without limits and deploy without worry.


Upsun helps developers launch faster and more reliably by removing the complexities of cloud infrastructure management. Platform.sh simplifies collaboration, streamlines deployments, and provides resources to guarantee performance and compliance. 




Upsun supports a wide array of runtimes, including Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, and Java, and offers fully managed services such as PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch, both with out-of-the-box optimizations and automated updates.




Its git-based workflows and full-stack cloning feature allows teams to replicate entire environments-including code, data, and services- for testing and iteration without disrupting production. Whether you're developing new applications or optimizing existing ones, Upsun offers a reliable, scalable solution for all your cloud needs.




For organizations transitioning to the cloud or modernizing legacy applications, Upsun provides the flexibility to do so with minimal effort. This is why we are the trusted partner to enterprises and agencies worldwide.

name: dataworks-research-srl-veridion-agent

en.description: Ask questions about any company, get structured answers powered by Veridion company data.
en.long_description:
Veridion Company Data enables natural language Q&A over company profiles in watsonx Orchestrate.




Ask questions about any company, and the agent retrieves structured company data from Veridion to produce a clear, actionable answer.




Behind the scenes, the agent uses an IBM tool integration to call Veridion’s Match & Enrich API directly.




It resolves the correct company entity from inputs like company name, website, and country, then retrieves enriched firmographic and profile data.




The agent uses this enriched data to answer the user’s questions.

description: Ask questions about any company, get structured answers powered by Veridion company data.
longDescription:
Veridion Company Data enables natural language Q&A over company profiles in watsonx Orchestrate.




Ask questions about any company, and the agent retrieves structured company data from Veridion to produce a clear, actionable answer.




Behind the scenes, the agent uses an IBM tool integration to call Veridion’s Match & Enrich API directly.




It resolves the correct company entity from inputs like company name, website, and country, then retrieves enriched firmographic and profile data.




The agent uses this enriched data to answer the user’s questions.

name: is.instance

de.description: Virtual Server for VPC-Instanzen bieten flexible Datenverarbeitungskapazitäten für Ihre Virtual Private Cloud. Durch die vollständige Integration in die IBM Cloud-Plattform und eine noch schnellere Bereitstellung bieten die neuen Virtual Servers for VPC eine höher Leistung und wesentliche Verbesserungen der Benutzerumgebung.
de.long_description: Virtual Servers for VPC wird mit bis zu 62 vCPUs und 496 GB RAM angeboten, damit jede benötigte Workload abgedeckt ist. Mit den jetzt integrierten IBM Cloud-Plattformservices wie IAM (Identity and Access Management, Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement) und dem Nutzungsdashboard können Sie Ihre IT-Ressourcen an derselben Stelle wie Ihre übrigen IBM Cloud-Services verwalten. Mit bis zu 5 vNICs für die Herstellung von Verbindungen zu verschiedenen Teilnetzen in Ihrer VPC steht Ihnen ein perfekter Baustein für Ihre moderne Cloudbereitstellung zur Verfügung.

en.description: Our latest generations of virtual machines with faster provisioning, higher performance, and enhanced isolation.
en.long_description:
In your own private space in the IBM Cloud, IBM Cloud VPC combines the security of a private cloud with the scalability of a public cloud. Use Virtual Private Cloud to isolate and provision network segments on the IBM Cloud, where you can deploy and manage compute resources, storage and networking cloud resources.

With Virtual Server for VPC, you can quickly provision instances with high network performance. When you provision an instance, you select a profile that matches the amount of memory and compute power that you need for the application that you plan to run on the instance. Instances are available on the x86 and s390x architectures. After you provision an instance, you control and manage those infrastructure resources.

es.description: Las instancias de servidor virtual para VPC ofrecen capacidad de cálculo flexible para Virtual Private Cloud. Totalmente integrados en la plataforma IBM Cloud y capaces de suministrar más rápido que nunca, nuestros nuevos servidores virtuales para VPC ofrecen un mejor rendimiento y una experiencia de usuario mejorada de forma significativa.
es.long_description: Ofrecemos servidores virtuales para VPC con hasta 62 vCPU y 496 GB RAM para satisfacer cualquier necesidad de carga de trabajo. Ahora integrados con servicios de IBM Cloud Platform como Identity and Access Management (IAM), Grupos de recursos y Panel de control de uso, puede gestionar sus recursos de cálculo en el mismo sitio que el resto de sus servicios IBM Cloud. Con hasta 5 vNIC para conectar con distintas subredes de su VPC, constituye el bloque de construcción perfecto para el despliegue moderno en la nube.

fr.description: Les instances de serveur virtuel pour VPC offrent une capacité de calcul flexible pour votre cloud privé virtuel. Entièrement intégrés à la plateforme IBM Cloud et pouvant être mis à disposition plus rapidement que jamais, nos nouveaux serveurs virtuels pour VPC offrent de meilleures performances et une expérience utilisateur sensiblement améliorée.
fr.long_description: Nous offrons des serveurs virtuels pour VPC avec jusqu'à 62 vCPU et 496 Go de RAM pour répondre à tout besoin de charge de travail. Maintenant intégrées avec des services IBM Cloud Platform comme IAM (Identity and Access Management), les groupes de ressources et le tableau de bord d'utilisation, vous pouvez gérer vos ressources de calcul au même endroit que le reste de vos services IBM Cloud. Avec jusqu'à 5 vNIC pour la connexion à différents sous-réseaux dans votre VPC, c'est le bloc de construction parfait pour votre déploiement de cloud moderne.

it.description: Le istanze di Virtual Server for VPC forniscono una capacità elaborativa flessibile per il Virtual Private Cloud. Completamente integrati con la piattaforma IBM Cloud ed in grado di erogare nel modo più veloce di sempre, i nostri Virtual Server for VPC forniscono prestazioni migliori e un'esperienza utente notevolmente migliore.
it.long_description: Offriamo Virtual Servers for VPC con un massimo di 62 vCPU e 496 GB di RAM per soddisfare qualsiasi esigenza di carico di lavoro. Ora integrati con i servizi IBM Cloud Platform come Identity and Access Management (IAM), i gruppi di risorse e i dashboard di utilizzo, è possibile gestire le risorse di calcolo dalla stessa posizione degli altri servizi IBM Cloud. Con una connessione fino a 5 vNIC in diverse sottoreti nel VPC, è l'elemento costituente perfetto per la moderna distribuzione nel cloud.

ja.description: VPC の仮想サーバー・インスタンスは、お使いの仮想プライベート・クラウドに軟なコンピュート能力を提供します。 IBM Cloud プラットフォームと完全統合され、これまでになく高速なプロビジョニングが可能になることで、新しい Virtual Servers for VPC は優れたパフォーマンスと大幅に強化されたユーザー・エクスペリエンスを提供します。
ja.long_description: すべてのワークロードのニーズに合わせて、最大 62 vCPU と 496 GB RAM の Virtual Servers for VPC を提供しています。 「ID およびアクセス権の管理 (IAM)」、「リソース・グループ」、「使用状況ダッシュボード」といった IBM Cloud のプラットフォーム・サービスと統合されるようになったことで、他の数多くの IBM Cloud サービスと同じ場所からコンピュート・リソースを管理できます。 お使いの VPC 内の異なるサブネットへの接続に最大 5 つの vNIC を使用できるため、最新のクラウド・デプロイメントにとって完璧なビルディング・ブロックと言えます。

ko.description: Virtual Server for VPC 인스턴스는 Virtual Private Cloud를 위한 유연한 컴퓨팅 용량을 제공합니다. IBM Cloud Platform에 완벽히 통합되었으며 그 어느 때보다도 빠르게 프로비저닝이 가능한 IBM의 새로운 Virtual Server for VPC는 보다 우수한 성능과 크게 향상된 사용자 경험을 제공합니다.
ko.long_description: IBM은 필요한 모든 워크로드에 적합하도록 최대 62개 vCPU 및 496GB RAM이 탑재된 Virtual Server for VPC를 제공합니다. 이제 IAM(Identity and Access Management), 리소스 그룹 및 사용량 대시보드와 같은 IBM Cloud Platform 서비스와 통합함으로써, IBM Cloud 서비스의 나머지 부분과 동일한 위치에서 컴퓨팅 리소스를 관리할 수 있습니다. VPC의 다른 서브넷으로 연결하기 위한 최대 5개의 vNIC가 포함된 현대적 클라우드 배치를 위한 완벽한 빌딩 블록입니다.

pt-br.description: As instâncias do Virtual Server for VPC oferecem capacidade de computação flexível para seu Virtual Private Cloud. Totalmente integrados à plataforma IBM Cloud e capazes de provisionar mais rápido do que nunca, nossos novos Servidores virtuais para VPC entregam melhor desempenho e uma experiência de usuário significativamente aprimorada.
pt-br.long_description: Oferecemos servidores virtuais para VPC com até 62 vCPUs e 496 GB de RAM para ajustar a qualquer necessidade de carga de trabalho. Agora integrado aos serviços do IBM Cloud Platform, como o Identity and Access Management (IAM), os Grupos de Recursos e o Painel de Uso, é possível gerenciar seus recursos de computação no mesmo local que o restante de seus serviços do IBM Cloud. Com até 5 vNICs para conectar-se a diferentes sub-redes em seu VPC, ele é o bloco de construção ideal para sua implementação moderna na nuvem.

zh-cn.description: 适用于 VPC 的虚拟服务器实例为虚拟私有云交付灵活的计算容量。我们全新的适用于 VPC 的虚拟服务器已完全集成到 IBM Cloud 平台中，配置速度比以往更快，并可交付更卓越的性能，显著增强用户体验。
zh-cn.long_description: 我们提供的 Virtual Servers for VPC 最多包含 62 个 vCPU 和 496 GB RAM，可满足任何工作负载的需求。现在，通过与“身份和访问管理”(IAM)、“资源组”和“使用情况仪表板”等 IBM Cloud Platform 服务相集成，您可以在与其余 IBM Cloud 服务相同的位置中管理计算资源。它具备多达 5 个 vNIC 以供连接到 VPC 中的不同子网，是现代云部署的理想构建块。

zh-tw.description: VPC 的虛擬伺服器實例為虛擬私有雲提供彈性計算容量。完全整合到 IBM Cloud Platform 且能夠比以往更快佈建，我們的新 Virtual Server for VPC 可以提供更出色的效能，且顯著增強使用者體驗。
zh-tw.long_description: 我們為配置有多達 62 個 vCPU 和 496 GB RAM 的 VPC 提供虛擬伺服器以適合任何工作量需求。現在，與「身分和存取管理 (IAM)」、「資源群組」和「使用情形儀表板」之類的 IBM Cloud Platform 服務整合，您可以在一個位置管理您的計算資源以及其他 IBM Cloud 服務。將多達 5 個 vNIC 連接至 VPC 中的不同子網路後，就成為現代雲端部署的完美構成要素。

description: Our latest generations of virtual machines with faster provisioning, higher performance, and enhanced isolation.
longDescription:
In your own private space in the IBM Cloud, IBM Cloud VPC combines the security of a private cloud with the scalability of a public cloud. Use Virtual Private Cloud to isolate and provision network segments on the IBM Cloud, where you can deploy and manage compute resources, storage and networking cloud resources.

With Virtual Server for VPC, you can quickly provision instances with high network performance. When you provision an instance, you select a profile that matches the amount of memory and compute power that you need for the application that you plan to run on the instance. Instances are available on the x86 and s390x architectures. After you provision an instance, you control and manage those infrastructure resources.

bullets.title: Broadcastverkehr in den öffentlichen und privaten Netzen isolieren
Isolate network broadcast traffic on the public and private networks
Aislar el tráfico de difusión de red en las redes públicas y privadas
Isoler le trafic réseau de diffusion sur les réseaux publics et privés
Isolamento del traffico broadcast di rete sulle reti pubbliche e private

공용 및 사설 네트워크에서 네트워크 브로드캐스트 트래픽 격리

name: VLAN

de.description: Über VLANs wird der Broadcastverkehr in allen öffentlichen und privaten IBM Cloud-Netzen isoliert. Wenn Sie eine komplexere Netztopologie benötigen, können Sie zusätzliche VLANs erwerben, um den Datenverkehr zwischen zusätzlichen Gerätegruppen zu isolieren.
de.long_description: Ein VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) ist ein Netzkonstrukt, das es ermöglicht, Broadcastdomänen auf der Ebene der zweiten Schicht des OSI-Modells zu erstellen. IBM Cloud verwendet VLANs, um den Broadcastverkehr zu isolieren, Paketidentifikation bereitzustellen und die Koexistenz mehrerer Workloads auf demselben physischen Gerät zu ermöglichen. Je nach Situation werden Sie nie direkt mit einem VLAN interagieren, da VLANs automatisch verwaltet werden. Sie können bei Bedarf ausgerichtet an Ihren Anforderungen in Bezug auf die Netzisolation zusätzliche VLANs bestellen.

en.description: VLANs isolate broadcast traffic on all IBM Cloud public and private networks. If you need a more complex network topology, additional VLANs can be purchased to isolate traffic between additional groups of devices.
en.long_description: A Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) is a network construct that makes it possible to create broadcast domains at the OSI Model layer-2 level. IBM Cloud uses VLANs to isolate broadcast traffic, to provide packet identification, and to let multiple workloads coexist on the same physical equipment. Depending on your situation, you may never need to interact with VLANs directly, because they are managed automatically. Optionally, you can order additional VLANs based on your unique network isolation requirements.

es.description: Las VLAN aíslan el tráfico de difusión en todas las redes públicas y privadas de IBM Cloud. Si necesita una topología de red más compleja, se pueden adquirir VLAN adicionales para aislar el tráfico entre grupos adicionales de dispositivos.
es.long_description: Una red de área local virtual (VLAN) es una construcción de red que hace posible que se creen dominios de difusión en el nivel de capa 2 del modelo OSI. IBM Cloud utiliza las VLAN para aislar el tráfico de difusión, para proporcionar identificación de paquetes y para permitir que varias cargas de trabajo coexistan en el mismo equipo físico. Dependiendo de su situación, es posible que nunca tenga que interactuar con las VLAN directamente, porque se gestionan automáticamente. Si lo desea, puede solicitar VLAN adicionales en función de sus requisitos exclusivos de aislamiento de red.

fr.description: Les réseaux locaux virtuels isolent le trafic de diffusion sur tous les réseaux publics et privés IBM Cloud. Si vous avez besoin d'une topologie réseau plus complexe, vous pouvez acheter des réseaux locaux virtuels supplémentaires pour isoler le trafic entre des groupes de périphériques supplémentaires.
fr.long_description: Un réseau local virtuel (VLAN) est une construction réseau qui permet de créer des domaines de diffusion au niveau de la couche 2 du modèle OSI. IBM Cloud utilise les réseaux locaux virtuels pour isoler le trafic de diffusion, pour fournir une identification des paquets et pour permettre à plusieurs charges de travail de coexister sur le même équipement physique. Selon votre situation, vous pouvez ne jamais avoir besoin d'interagir directement avec des réseaux locaux virtuels, car ils sont gérés automatiquement. Vous pouvez éventuellement commander des réseaux locaux virtuels supplémentaires en fonction de vos exigences propres d'isolement de réseau.

it.description: Le VLAN isolano il traffico broadcast su tutte le reti IBM Cloud pubbliche e private. Se è necessaria una topologia di rete più complessa, è possibile acquistare VLAN aggiuntive per isolare il traffico tra ulteriori gruppi di dispositivi.
it.long_description: Una VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) è una struttura di rete che consente di creare domini broadcast di livello OSI Model layer-2. IBM Cloud utilizza le VLAN per isolare il traffico broadcast, per fornire l'identificazione dei pacchetti e per consentire a più carichi di lavoro di coesistere sulla stessa apparecchiatura fisica. In base alla propria situazione, potrebbe non essere mai necessario interagire direttamente con le VLAN, in quanto vengono gestite automaticamente. Come opzione, è possibile ordinare VLAN aggiuntive in base ai propri requisiti univoci di isolamento della rete.

ja.description: VLAN は、すべての IBM Cloud のパブリック・ネットワークおよびプライベート・ネットワーク上のブロードキャスト・トラフィックを分離します。 より複雑なネットワーク・トポロジーが必要な場合は、追加の VLAN を購入して、追加のデバイス・グループ間のトラフィックを分離できます。
ja.long_description: 仮想ローカル・エリア・ネットワーク (VLAN) は、OSI モデルのレイヤー 2 レベルでブロードキャスト・ドメインを作成できるようにするネットワーク構成です。 IBM Cloud は VLAN を使用して、ブロードキャスト・トラフィックを分離したり、パケット ID を提供したり、同じ物理装置上に複数のワークロードが共存できるようにしたりします。 VLAN は自動的に管理されるため、お客様の状況によっては、お客様が VLAN と直接対話する必要がない場合があります。 オプションで、お客様の固有のネットワーク分離要件に基づいて、追加の VLAN を注文できます。

ko.description: VLAN은 모든 IBM Cloud 공용 및 사설 네트워크에서 브로드캐스트 트래픽을 격리합니다. 보다 복잡한 네트워크 토폴로지가 필요하면 추가로 VLAN을 구매하여 추가적인 디바이스 그룹 간의 트래픽을 격리할 수 있습니다.
ko.long_description: VLAN(Virtual Local Area Network)은 OSI 모델 계층-2 레벨에서 브로드캐스트 도메인을 작성할 수 있도록 하는 네트워크 구성입니다. IBM Cloud는 VLAN을 사용하여 브로드캐스트 트래픽을 격리하고 패킷 ID를 제공하며 다중 워크로드가 동일한 실제 장비에 공존할 수 있도록 합니다. 상황에 따라서는 자동 관리되므로 VLAN과 직접 상호작용할 필요가 없을 수 있습니다. 선택사항으로, 고유 네트워크 격리 요구사항에 따라 추가로 VLAN을 주문할 수 있습니다.

pt-br.description: As VLANs isolam o tráfego de transmissão em todas as redes públicas e privadas do IBM Cloud. Se você precisar de uma topologia de rede mais complexa, as VLANs adicionais poderão ser compradas para isolar o tráfego entre os grupos adicionais de dispositivos.
pt-br.long_description: Uma rede local virtual (VLAN) é uma construção de rede que possibilita a criação de domínios de difusão no nível de camada 2 do modelo OSI. O IBM Cloud usa as VLANs para isolar o tráfego de transmissão, para fornecer identificação de pacote e para permitir que múltiplas cargas de trabalho coexistam no mesmo equipamento físico. Dependendo de sua situação, talvez você nunca precise interagir com as VLANs diretamente porque elas são gerenciadas automaticamente. Opcionalmente, é possível solicitar VLANs adicionais com base em seus requisitos de isolamento de rede exclusivos.

zh-cn.description: VLAN 可隔离所有 IBM Cloud 公用和专用网络上的广播流量。如果您需要更复杂的网络拓扑，那么可以购买更多 VLAN 来隔离更多设备组之间的流量。
zh-cn.long_description: 虚拟局域网 (VLAN) 是一种网络构造，支持您在 OSI 模型第 2 层级别创建广播域。IBM Cloud 使用 VLAN 来隔离广播流量，提供数据包识别，以及允许多个工作负载在同一物理设备上共存。根据您的情况，您可能从不需要直接与 VLAN 进行交互，因为 VLAN 是自动进行管理的。（可选）您可以根据自己独特的网络隔离需求来订购更多 VLAN。

zh-tw.description: VLAN 會隔離所有 IBM Cloud 公用和專用網路上的廣播資料流量。如果您需要更複雜的網路拓蹼，可以購買其他 VLAN，以隔離其他裝置群組之間的資料流量。
zh-tw.long_description: 「虛擬區域網路 (VLAN)」是一種網路建構，可在 OSI Model layer-2 層次建立廣播網域。IBM Cloud 使用 VLAN 來隔離廣播資料流量、提供封包識別，以及讓多個工作負載共存於相同的實體設備。視您的情況而定，您可能不需要直接與 VLAN 互動，因為它們是自動進行管理的。您可以選擇性地根據獨特的網路隔離需求來訂購其他 VLAN。

description: VLANs isolate broadcast traffic on all IBM Cloud public and private networks. If you need a more complex network topology, additional VLANs can be purchased to isolate traffic between additional groups of devices.
longDescription: A Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) is a network construct that makes it possible to create broadcast domains at the OSI Model layer-2 level. IBM Cloud uses VLANs to isolate broadcast traffic, to provide packet identification, and to let multiple workloads coexist on the same physical equipment. Depending on your situation, you may never need to interact with VLANs directly, because they are managed automatically. Optionally, you can order additional VLANs based on your unique network isolation requirements.

en.description: Workload migrations and professional services performed as predictable, rapid, transparent projects or ongoing management.
en.long_description:
This selection of services targets VMware customers seeking to modernize and embrace various IBM cloud options as either a production or disaster recovery target site.

While PrimaryIO offers SaaS products in support of the Cloud Journey targeting data resiliency, this collection is comprised of advisory services and optionally the man-power to accomplish these modernizing, mobility-enhancing, cloud-embracing projects.

The services are designed to create an easy to consume, yet bespoke, tailored project.  Each project is fully detailed with project plan, associated cost and transparency to the project status with focus on rapid achievement of critical path objectives.

All projects, irrespective of category and customization, require a current state assessment coupled with a solid understanding of the customer goal and associated target environment.  Once well-comprehended, an accurate statement of work and associated price quote is generated in support of the project.  At such time, the project can be procured through the listed catalog option.

en.display_name: VPC COaaS (VPC Cost Optimization as a Service)
en.long_description:
This is a fully-managed cloud-based service designed to help IBM Cloud users manage their cloud costs.

Wanclouds COaaS provides IBM users with the tools and insights needed to optimize their cloud costs and services. With Wanclouds COaaS, users can track their cloud costs, identify potential cost savings opportunities, and develop customized strategies to reduce their overall cloud spending. The service also helps users identify areas of potential waste and inefficiency, and provides guidance on how to best manage their cloud costs. Additionally, Wanclouds COaaS can provide users with detailed reports and analytics to help them understand their cloud costs and make more informed decisions.

Resource Coverage:
- Idle Resources
- Volumes
- Floating IPs
- Public Gateways
- Dedicated Hosts
- Virtual Server Instances
- Images
- Snapshots

Benefits
- Tracking cloud costs
- Identification of potential cost savings
- Strategies to reduce their overall cloud spending, this Service can provide users with detailed reports and analytics to help them understand their cloud costs.
- Identify areas of potential waste and inefficiency, and provide guidance on how to best manage their cloud costs.

Learn more: https://www.wanclouds.net/coaas

For any help, please go to https://support.wanclouds.net or email us at support@wanclouds.net
For sales related queries, please contact usat sales@wanclouds.net

en.description: Multi Cloud Backup, Disaster Recovery and Optimization as a Service
en.display_name: VPC+ DRaaS (VPC+ Disaster Recovery as a Service)
en.long_description:
Wanclouds offers multi-cloud Backup, Migrations, Disaster Recovery, and Cost Optimization as a Service. At the heart of our approach is our SaaS application called VPC+ enabling seamless and hassle-free backups, migrations, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.

Add one or multiple public clouds accounts and create a comprehensive backup and DR setup for all of your IBM Cloud Resources across regions.

Backup and Disaster Recovery as a Service
- Backup your exisitng IBM Cloud VPC resources and configurations
- Backup IBM IKS (Kubernetes Service), ROKS (Red Hat Openshift)
- Backup Virtual Machines (VSIs) and attached Data Volumes
- Backup Cloud Object Storage Buckets (COS Buckets)
- Backup on-prem Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift clusters to IBM Cloud
- Restore or replicate your infrastructure across regions
- Restore your Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift clusters on-demand
- Backup VMware VMs to IBM Cloud VPC

Setup IBM Cloud as a DR site for On-Premise workoads

- Setup IBM Cloud as a Warm DR site for critical workloads 
- Leverage IBM Cloud as a Backup for your Windows, Linux, Kubernetes workloads and Data.

Cloud-Native Migration and Application Mobility

- Setup IBM Cloud as a DR site
- Discover and Migrate Kubernetes and OpenShift cluster to IBM Cloud
- Migrate your application across your Kubernetes clusters
- Migrate your on-prem Red Hat OpenShift Clusters to IBM ROKS
- Migration On-Premise clusters to IBM Cloud Satellite



Additional Features (needs to be separately enabled)

Cost Optimization as a Service
- Discover and track all of your resources across IBM Cloud
- Track all your Idle resources. Stop entire VPCs, or delete unused resources
- Rightsize your Compute based on your usage and optimise for cost
- Assign Purpose tags based on industry standards


It takes just a few minutes to get started - subscribe today or request a demo:

Learn more: https://www.wanclouds.net/ibm

For any help, please go to https://support.wanclouds.net or email us at support@wanclouds.net.

name: is.vpn

de.description: Erweitern Sie Ihr lokales Netz sicher über Site-to-Site-Gateways auf IBM Cloud.
de.long_description: VPN for VPC ist eine einfache, aber leistungsfähige Lösung für ein hoch skalierbares und stabiles VPN zwischen Sites. Dieser VPN-Service stellt eine Mischung von Sicherheits- und Verschlüsselungsoptionen gemäß Branchenstandard bereit und unterstützt die Authentifizierung vorab verteilter Schlüssel. Dieser Service bietet auch die Möglichkeit, VPN-Verbindungen schnell hinzufügen und entfernen, mit der Option, vordefinierte Konfigurationen zu verwenden.

en.description: Securely extend your on-premises network to IBM Cloud through site-to-site gateways.
en.long_description: VPN for VPC provides a simple yet powerful solution for highly scalable and robust site-to-site VPN. This VPN service provides a mixture of industry standard security and encryption options as well as support for Pre-shared Key authentication. The service also provides the ability to quickly add and remove VPN connections with the option to use pre-defined configurations.

es.description: Amplíe de forma segura la red local a IBM Cloud a través de pasarelas de sitio a sitio.
es.long_description: VPN para VPC proporciona una solución sencilla pero potente para redes VPN altamente escalables y robustas de sitio a sitio. Este servicio VPN ofrece una combinación de seguridad estándar del sector y opciones de cifrado así como soporte para autenticación de clave precompartida. El servicio también proporciona la posibilidad de añadir y eliminar con rapidez las conexiones VPN con la opción de uso de configuraciones predefinidas.

fr.description: Etendez en toute sécurité votre réseau local dans IBM Cloud via des passerelles de site à site.
fr.long_description: VPN pour VPC constitue une solution simple mais puissante pour un VPN de site à site hautement dimensionnable et robuste. Ce service de VPN offre un mix d'options de sécurité et de chiffrement aux normes de l'industrie ainsi que la prise en charge de l'authentification par clé pré-partagée. Il permet également d'ajouter et de retirer rapidement des connexions VPN avec l'option d'utiliser des configurations prédéfinies.

it.description: Estendi in modo sicuro la tua rete on-premise a IBM Cloud tramite gateway site-to-site.
it.long_description: VPN for VPC fornisce una soluzione semplice ma potente per una VPN da sito a sito altamente scalabile e solida. Questo servizio VPN fornisce una miscela di opzioni di sicurezza standard di settore e di crittografia oltre che il supporto per l'autenticazione della chiave pre-condivisa. Il servizio fornisce anche la possibilità di aggiungere e rimuovere rapidamente le connessioni VPN con la possibilità di utilizzare configurazioni predefinite.

ja.description: サイト間ゲートウェイを介してオンプレミス・ネットワークを IBM Cloud に安全に拡張します。
ja.long_description: VPN for VPC は、スケーラブルで堅牢なサイト間 VPN を利用するためのシンプルでいて強力なソリューションを提供します。 この VPN サービスでは、事前共有鍵認証に加え、業界標準のセキュリティーと暗号化オプションが合わせて提供されます。 このサービスではまた、事前に定義された構成を使用するオプションによって VPN 接続を素早く追加/削除するための機能も提供されます。

ko.description: 온프레미스 네트워크를 사이트 간 게이트웨이를 통해 IBM Cloud로 안전하게 확장하십시오.
ko.long_description: VPN for VPC는 확장성이 높으며 강력한 사이트 간 VPN을 위한 단순하지만 강력한 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 VPN 서비스는 사전 공유 키 인증에 대한 지원을 비롯하여 산업 표준 보안과 암호화 옵션을 함께 제공합니다. 또한 이 서비스는 사전 정의된 구성을 사용하기 위한 옵션으로 VPN 연결을 빠르게 추가하고 제거할 수 있는 기능도 제공합니다.

pt-br.description: Estenda com segurança a sua rede no local para a IBM Cloud por meio de gateways de site para site.
pt-br.long_description: O VPN for VPC fornece uma solução simples e ainda poderosa para VPN de site para site altamente escalável e robusta. Este serviço VPN fornece uma combinação de opções de segurança e criptografia padrão de mercado, bem como suporte para autenticação de chave pré-compartilhada. O serviço também fornece a capacidade de incluir e remover rapidamente conexões VPN com a opção para usar configurações predefinidas.

zh-cn.description: 通过站点到站点网关，将本地网络安全地扩展至 IBM Cloud。
zh-cn.long_description: 适用于 VPC 的 VPN 可为高度可扩展且健全的站点到站点 VPN 提供简单但功能强大的解决方案。 此 VPN 服务可提供行业标准安全性和加密混合选项，并且支持预先共享密钥认证。 此服务还可提供快速添加和移除 VPN 连接的功能，并具有使用预定义配置的选项。

zh-tw.description: 透過站台對站台閘道，安全地將內部部署網路延伸至 IBM Cloud。
zh-tw.long_description: 用於 VPC 的 VPN 為高可調式的穩健網站到網站 VPN 提供簡單但功能強大的解決方案。 此 VPN 服務將業界標準安全和加密選項的混合使用，以及提供對預先共用金鑰驗證的支援。 此服務還可讓您選擇使用預先定義的配置來快速添加和移除 VPN 連線。

en.description:
Chat with Your Infrastructure!
Meet WANDA(Wanclouds Digital Assistant) : Your 24/7 AIOps solution for Hybrid Cloud Operations
en.display_name: WANDA Agentic AI  - AIOps as a Service - for Hybrid Infrastructure Management
en.long_description:
Wanclouds AI (WANDA) allows you to create one or multiple AI Assistants for Cloud and IT Infrastructure management. It covers multi-vendor infrastructure resources and workloads including servers (Linux, Windows),firewalls, network routers, switches, VMware, Kubernetes and more. The Solution covers devices deployed in the cloud (IBM Cloud, other cloud) as well as On-Premise and Edge or Remote Sites.You can add your cloud, on-premises, and edge devices into a single platform, creating a unified interface for your entire infrastructure.







Think of it as your AI Expert Assistant(s) to help you watch your infrastructure 24x7, integrated with your existing monitoring, logging tools, devices, and fully aware of your policies and guidelines. It continuously monitors the health, logs, and metrics of your cloud and IT infrastructure. Proactively track configuration changes, software updates, and system behavior to ensure your environments run smoothly and cost-effectively.







By combining monitoring, logs, troubleshooting, and intelligent querying, it helps IT teams dramatically reduce the time to diagnose and resolve issues, all while learning and adapting to your unique environment through its contextual memory capabilities. Moreover, you can run security and optimization assessments on-demand as well as query any aspect of your infrastructure.







Key Features




-  Add cloud Environments (such as IBM Cloud VPC, Classic), On-Premise resources, as well as other cloud workloads.

- Add VMware resources or individual servers, routers, firewalls, and switches.

-  Configuration & Change Tracking – Watches for configuration drifts, software updates, and system changes that may impact stability.


-  Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis – Performs root-cause analysis and provides guided remediation steps to resolve issues faster.





- Proactive Monitoring – Continuously collects health, logs, and performance data from servers, GPUs, network devices, and applications.

- Perform Security risk assessments and compliance audits against known industry and government standards such as PCI, HIPAA, SOC2, NIST etc




-  Intelligent Querying – Answer natural language queries such as “What caused the last outage?” or “How is my cluster performing today?”.




 -  Adaptive Learning – Learns your infrastructure over time with a memory component, improving accuracy and insights.




 -  24x7 Availability – Acts as a round-the-clock virtual engineer without the overhead of traditional staffing.





- Review existing policy and compliance documents and create what’s missing or required




- Identify optimization opportunities to reduce costs and eliminate wastage




- Create Executive summaries against your infrastructure state as required




- Track software deployed in your infrastructure and discover EOL and assess risk levels 




- Backup and Migrate your VSIs and data volumes to IBM COS, making them ready for restoration in IBM Cloud VPC.




- Backup and Migrate your VMware / VCF VMs and Data to IBM COS and ready to restore as VPC native VSIs and volumes.







Benefits




  -  Faster Root-Cause Analysis – Reduce troubleshooting times from hours to minutes.




Increase uptime and reliability by tracking security compliance gaps and risks across your IT and cloud infrastructure. 

Keep costs in control by assessing wastage and oversized infrastructure resources




 -  Increased Reliability – Identify and resolve issues before they escalate.




 -  Cost-Effective Operations – Reduce operational costs by up to 50%. A fraction of the cost of adding human NOC/SRE staff.




 -  Improved IT Productivity – 3X and more productivity gains. Free up engineering teams to focus on innovation, not firefighting.




 -  Scalable & Adaptable – Grows with your environment and continuously learns from it.




- Addresses skill gaps with its expert troubleshooting, management, and assessments ranging from Windows, Linux to Nvidia GPUs as well as Firewalls and multi-vendor network devices.







   




Wanclouds AI (WANDA) is your always-on AI engineer from Wanclouds, helping you stay ahead of outages, errors, security risks, and costly downtime..







If you need a private instance of Wanclouds AI dedicated to your cloud and IT infrastructure resources, please contact Wanclouds at www.wanclouds.net or sales@wanclouds.net

Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage is easy to understand, simple to order, and incredibly cost-effective to scale. With Wasabi, there are no confusing storage tiers to decipher and no complicated fee structures to decode. And Wasabi storage is free from data access and API call fees, unlike traditional providers, which can substantially drive-up costs.

name: discovery

de.description: Sie können eine Engine für die kognitive Suche und Inhaltsanalyse zu Anwendungen hinzufügen.
de.long_description: Sie können eine Engine für die kognitive Suche und Inhaltsanalyse zu Anwendungen hinzufügen, um Muster, Trends und umsetzbare Analyseergebnisse zu identifizieren, die eine optimierte Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen. Vereinheitlichen Sie auf sichere Weise strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten mit vorab aufbereiteten Inhalten und verwenden Sie eine vereinfachte Abfragesprache, um so das manuelle Filtern der Ergebnisse zu eliminieren.

en.description: Add a cognitive search and content analytics engine to applications.
en.long_description: Add a cognitive search and content analytics engine to applications to identify patterns, trends and actionable insights that drive better decision-making. Securely unify structured and unstructured data with pre-enriched content, and use a simplified query language to eliminate the need for manual filtering of results.

es.description: Añada un motor de búsqueda cognitiva y análisis de contenido a las aplicaciones.
es.long_description: Añada un motor de búsqueda cognitiva y análisis de contenido a las aplicaciones para identificar patrones, tendencias y conocimientos útiles que permitan una mejor toma de decisiones. Unifique con seguridad datos estructurados y no estructurados con contenido preenriquecido y utilice un lenguaje de consulta simplificado para eliminar la necesidad de filtrar manualmente los resultados.

fr.description: Ajoutez un moteur de recherche cognitive et d'analyse de contenu aux applications.
fr.long_description: Ajoutez un moteur de recherche cognitive et d'analyse de contenu aux applications pour identifier les modèles, tendances et connaissances exploitables qui permettent d'améliorer la prise de décision. Unifiez vos données structurées et non structurées en toute sécurité avec un contenu enrichi au préalable et utilisez un langage d'interrogation simplifié afin de ne plus avoir à filtrer manuellement les résultats.

it.description: Aggiunge un motore di analitica del contenuto e di ricerca cognitiva alle applicazioni.
it.long_description: Aggiunge un motore di analitica del contenuto e di ricerca cognitiva alle applicazioni per identificare i pattern, le tendenze e le informazioni utilizzabili che determinano un processo decisionale migliore. Unifica in modo sicuro dati strutturati e non strutturati con contenuto prearricchito ed utilizza un linguaggio query semplificato per eliminare la necessità di filtro manuale dei risultati.

ja.description: コグニティブ検索、コンテンツ分析のエンジンをアプリケーションに追加します。
ja.long_description: コグニティブ検索やコンテンツ分析のエンジンをアプリケーションに追加して、より適切な意思決定を行うためのパターン、傾向、実行可能な洞察を識別します。 構造化データ、非構造化データを事前にエンリッチ化されたコンテンツと安全に統合し、簡易照会言語を使用することにより、結果を手動でフィルタリングする手間を省きます。

ko.description: 코그너티브 검색 및 컨텐츠 분석 엔진을 애플리케이션에 추가합니다.
ko.long_description: 코그너티브 검색 및 컨텐츠 분석 엔진을 애플리케이션에 추가하여 패턴, 경향 및 실행 가능한 인사이트를 파악함으로써 더 나은 의사결정을 내릴 수 있습니다. 사전 강화된 컨텐츠로 정형 및 비정형 데이터를 안전하게 통합하고, 결과를 수동으로 필터링하는 대신 간단한 조회 언어를 사용할 수 있습니다.

pt-BR.description: Inclua um mecanismo de analítica de conteúdo e procura cognitiva nos aplicativos.

Unifique de modo seguro dados estruturados e não estruturados com conteúdo pré-enriquecido e use uma linguagem de consulta simplificada para eliminar a necessidade de filtragem manual de resultados.

zh-Hans.long_description: 向应用程序添加认知搜索和内容分析引擎以识别模式、趋势和可行洞察，从而做出更明智的决策。将结构化数据和非结构化数据与预先填充的内容进行安全整合，并使用简化查询语言以避免手动过滤结果。

zh-Hant.description: 新增認知搜尋與內容分析引擎至應用程式。
zh-Hant.long_description: 新增認知搜尋與內容分析引擎至應用程式，以識別型樣、趨勢及可行的見解，來推動更出色的決策。將結構化及非結構化資料與預先強化的內容安全地統一，並使用簡化的查詢語言來省掉手動過濾結果這一程序。

de.description: Mit watsonx Assistant können Sie Dialogschnittstellen in beliebige Anwendungen, Geräte oder Kanäle integrieren.
de.long_description:
Mit watsonx Assistant können Sie Dialogschnittstellen in beliebige Anwendungen, Geräte oder Kanäle integrieren.

Sie können eine Schnittstelle mit natürlicher Sprache zu Ihrer Anwendung hinzufügen, um Interaktionen mit Endbenutzern zu automatisieren. Gängige Anwendungen enthalten virtuelle Agenten und Chatbots, die über beliebige Kanäle oder Geräte integriert werden und kommunizieren können. Sie können den Watson Conversation-Service mithilfe einer benutzerfreundlichen Webanwendung trainieren, die so konzipiert ist, dass Sie ohne großen Zeitaufwand natürliche Dialogabläufe zwischen Apps und Benutzern erstellen und skalierbare, kosteneffiziente Lösungen bereitstellen können.

en.description: IBM watsonx Assistant lets you build conversational interfaces into any application, device, or channel.
en.long_description:
watsonx Assistant lets you build conversational interfaces into any application, device, or channel.

Add a natural language interface to your application to automate interactions with your end users. Common applications include virtual agents and chat bots that can integrate and communicate on any channel or device. Train through an easy-to-use web application, designed so you can quickly build natural conversation flows between your apps and users, and deploy scalable, cost effective solutions.

es.description: watsonx Assistant le permite crear interfaces de conversación en cualquier aplicación, dispositivo o canal.
es.long_description:
watsonx Assistant le permite crear interfaces de conversación en cualquier aplicación, dispositivo o canal.

Añada una interfaz de lenguaje natural a la aplicación para automatizar las interacciones con los usuarios finales. Las aplicaciones comunes incluyen agentes virtuales y bots de conversación que se pueden integrar y comunicar en cualquier canal o dispositivo. Prepare el servicio Watson Conversation a través de una aplicación web fácil de utilizar, diseñado para que pueda crear rápidamente flujos de conversación natural entre las aplicaciones y los usuarios, y desplegar soluciones escalables y económicas.

fr.description: watsonx Assistant vous permet de générer des interfaces conversationnelles dans n'importe quelle application, ou sur n'importe quel appareil ou canal.
fr.long_description:
watsonx Assistant vous permet de générer des interfaces conversationnelles dans n'importe quelle application, ou sur n'importe quel appareil ou canal.
Ajoutez une interface en langage naturel à votre application pour automatiser les interactions avec vos utilisateurs finaux. Les applications courantes incluent des agents virtuels et des bots de discussion qui peuvent s'intégrer à tout canal ou périphérique et communiquer dessus. Entraînez le service Watson Conversation par l'intermédiaire d'une application Web conviviale conçue de sorte que vous puissiez générer rapidement des flux de conversations naturels entre vos applications et utilisateurs et déployer des solutions évolutives économiques.

it.description: watsonx Assistant consente di realizzare interfacce conversazionali in qualsiasi applicazione, dispositivo o canale.
it.long_description:
watsonx Assistant consente di realizzare interfacce conversazionali in qualsiasi applicazione, dispositivo o canale.

Aggiungere un'interfaccia di linguaggio naturale all'applicazione per automatizzare le interazioni con gli utenti finali. Tra le applicazioni comuni ci sono gli agent virtuali e i chat bot che possono integrarsi e comunicare con qualsiasi canale o dispositivo. Prova il servizio Watson Conversation tramite un'applicazione Web facile da usare, progettata per creare velocemente flussi di conversazioni naturali tra le app e gli utenti e per distribuire soluzioni scalabili ed economiche.

ja.description: watsonx Assistant を使用すると、任意のアプリケーション、デバイス、またはチャネル内に会話型インターフェースを作成できます。
ja.long_description:
watsonx Assistant を使用すると、任意のアプリケーション、デバイス、またはチャネル内に会話型インターフェースを作成できます。

アプリケーションに自然言語インターフェースを追加してエンドユーザーとのやり取りを自動化します。共通アプリケーションには、任意のチャネルやデバイスとの統合や通信を行える仮想エージェントとチャットボットが含まれます。簡単に利用できる Web アプリケーションを使用して Watson Conversation サービスのトレーニングを行います。サービスは、アプリとユーザーの自然な対話の流れを迅速に組み立てられるようにデザインされ、スケーラブルで費用効率の高いソリューションをデプロイします。

ko.description: watsonx Assistant를 사용하면 모든 애플리케이션, 디바이스 또는 채널에 대화형 인터페이스를 빌드할 수 있습니다.
ko.long_description:
watsonx Assistant를 사용하면 모든 애플리케이션, 디바이스 또는 채널에 대화형 인터페이스를 빌드할 수 있습니다.

애플리케이션에 자연어 인터페이스를 추가하여 일반 사용자와의 상호작용을 자동화합니다. 공통 애플리케이션에는 채널 또는 디바이스에서 통합하고 통신할 수 있는 가상 에이전트 및 대화 로봇이 포함되어 있습니다.사용하기 쉬운 웹 애플리케이션을 통한 Watson Conversation 서비스를 학습합니다. 이 서비스는 앱과 사용자 간의 자연어 대화 플로우를 신속하게 빌드하고, 확장 가능한 비용 효율적인 솔루션을 배치할 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

pt-BR.description: O watsonx Assistant permite que você construa interfaces de conversação em qualquer aplicativo, dispositivo ou canal.
pt-BR.long_description:
O watsonx Assistant permite que você construa interfaces de conversação em qualquer aplicativo, dispositivo ou canal.

Inclua uma interface de linguagem natural em seu aplicativo para automatizar as interações com os usuários finais. Os aplicativos comuns incluem agentes virtuais e robôs de bate-papo que podem se integrar e se comunicar com qualquer canal ou dispositivo. Aprenda a usar o serviço Watson Conversation por meio de um aplicativo da web fácil de usar, projetado para que você possa construir rapidamente fluxos de conversa natural entre seus aplicativos e os usuários e implementar soluções escaláveis e com efetividade de custo.

zh-Hans.description: watsonx Assistant 让您能够将会话式界面植入任何应用程序、设备或通道。
zh-Hans.long_description:
watsonx Assistant 让您能够将会话式界面植入任何应用程序、设备或通道。

在应用程序中添加自然语言界面，实现与最终用户的自动交互。常用的应用程序包括虚拟代理和聊天机器人，可在任意渠道或设备上进行集成和通信。通过简单易用的 Web 应用程序来训练 Watson Conversation 服务，其目的在于使您可以在应用程序和用户间快速构建自然对话流程，部署可扩展且节省成本的解决方案。

zh-Hant.description: watsonx Assistant 可讓您將交談式介面建置到任何應用程式、裝置或通道中。
zh-Hant.long_description:
watsonx Assistant 可讓您將交談式介面建置到任何應用程式、裝置或通道中。

在應用程式新增自然語言介面，以自動化與一般使用者的互動。共用應用程式包含虛擬代理程式和會談機器人，這些服務可在任何通道或裝置上進行整合及通訊。透過易於使用的 Web 應用程式來訓練 Watson Conversation 服務，此應用程式專門設計來供您快速建置在應用程式和使用者之間的自然交談訊息流，並部署可調式、符合成本效益的解決方案。
